`src/main/java/me/everyone/oculusai/check/WallCheck.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.check;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;
import me.everyone.oculusai.player.EntityTracker;
import me.everyone.oculusai.player.PlayerData;
import org.bukkit.FluidCollisionMode;
import org.bukkit.GameMode;
import org.bukkit.Location;
import org.bukkit.Material;
import org.bukkit.World;
import org.bukkit.block.Block;
import org.bukkit.block.data.Openable;
import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
import org.bukkit.util.BoundingBox;
import org.bukkit.util.RayTraceResult;
import org.bukkit.util.Vector;

public final class WallCheck implements CombatCheck {

    private static final double BOX_MARGIN = 0.02D;
    private static final double MIN_DISTANCE = 0.1D;
    private static final double MIN_DISTANCE_SQUARED = MIN_DISTANCE * MIN_DISTANCE;
    private static final double HIT_MARGIN = 0.03D;
    private static final double RAY_EPSILON = 0.005D;
    private static final int MAX_TRANSPARENT_PASSES = 16;
    private static final long HISTORY_MS = 500L;
    private static final int MAX_HISTORY_POSITIONS = 6;
    private static final int MAX_GRID_POSITIONS = 1;
    private static final int MAX_EYE_POSITIONS = 4;
    private static final int MAX_GRID_EYES = 2;
    // Four points per axis instead of five: the direct bounding-box ray below
    // catches the normal case, so the grid is only a fallback for edges, and
    // 64 samples per box is already generous for a 0.6-block target.
    private static final double[] GRID = {0.05D, 0.35D, 0.65D, 0.95D};
    private static final double[] COARSE = {0.15D, 0.5D, 0.85D};

    /** Material occlusion is state-independent for everything except doors,
     *  trapdoors and fence gates, which are checked through {@link Openable}
     *  before this cache is consulted. */
    private static final Map<Material, Boolean> OCCLUDING = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

    private final OculusAI plugin;

    public WallCheck(OculusAI plugin) {
        this.plugin = plugin;
    }

    @Override
    public String id() {
        return "wall";
    }

    @Override
    public boolean immediate() {
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean testOnly() {
        return plugin.config().checkWallTestOnly();
    }

    @Override
    public long cooldownMs() {
        return plugin.config().checkWallCooldownMs();
    }

    /** Reads blocks: the whole check is a ray through them. */
    @Override
    public boolean readsBlocks() {
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public CheckResult test(Player attacker, PlayerData data, int targetEntityId) {
        if (!plugin.config().wallCheckEnabled()) {
            return CheckResult.pass();
        }
        if (attacker.isDead() || attacker.getGameMode() == GameMode.SPECTATOR
                || attacker.isInsideVehicle()) {
            return CheckResult.pass();
        }
        if (targetEntityId == attacker.getEntityId()) {
            return CheckResult.pass();
        }

        Player online = findPlayer(targetEntityId);
        if (online != null) {
            if (online.isDead() || online.getGameMode() == GameMode.SPECTATOR
                    || online.isInvisible() || online.isInsideVehicle()
                    || !online.getWorld().equals(attacker.getWorld())) {
                return CheckResult.pass();
            }
        } else if (!plugin.tracker().playerLike(targetEntityId)) {
            return CheckResult.pass();
        }

        Location eye = attacker.getEyeLocation();
        World world = eye.getWorld();
        if (world == null
                || !world.isChunkLoaded(eye.getBlockX() >> 4, eye.getBlockZ() >> 4)) {
            return CheckResult.pass();
        }

        double maxDistance = plugin.config().wallCheckMaxDistance();
        Vector eyeVector = eye.toVector();
        List<BoundingBox> targets = targetBoxes(online, targetEntityId, world,
                eyeVector, maxDistance);
        if (targets.isEmpty()) {
            return CheckResult.pass();
        }

        double nearest = Double.MAX_VALUE;
        for (BoundingBox box : targets) {
            nearest = Math.min(nearest, eyeVector.distanceSquared(box.getCenter()));
        }
        if (nearest < MIN_DISTANCE_SQUARED) {
            return CheckResult.pass();
        }

        Vector look = lookDirection(data);
        List<Vector> eyes = eyePositions(attacker, data, world);
        if (visible(world, eyes, look, targets, maxDistance)) {
            return CheckResult.pass();
        }

        return CheckResult.cancel(plugin.lang().text("check.reason.wall"));
    }

    private Player findPlayer(int entityId) {
        return plugin.tracker().player(entityId);
    }

    private List<BoundingBox> targetBoxes(Player online, int entityId, World world,
                                          Vector eye, double maxDistance) {
        List<BoundingBox> boxes = new ArrayList<>(8);
        if (online != null && online.getBoundingBox().getHeight() > 0.05D) {
            addBox(boxes, online.getBoundingBox());
        }

        List<EntityTracker.Tracked> recent = plugin.tracker().recent(entityId);
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        UUID worldId = world.getUID();
        if (online == null) {
            for (int i = recent.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                BoundingBox current = trackedBox(recent.get(i), worldId, now);
                if (current != null) {
                    addBox(boxes, current);
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        int start = Math.max(0, recent.size() - MAX_HISTORY_POSITIONS);
        for (int i = start; i < recent.size(); i++) {
            BoundingBox box = trackedBox(recent.get(i), worldId, now);
            if (box != null) {
                addBox(boxes, box);
            }
        }

        double range = maxDistance + 1.0D;
        double limit = range * range;
        List<BoundingBox> within = new ArrayList<>(boxes.size());
        for (BoundingBox box : boxes) {
            if (!world.isChunkLoaded((int) Math.floor(box.getCenterX()) >> 4,
                    (int) Math.floor(box.getCenterZ()) >> 4)) {
                continue;
            }
            if (eye.distanceSquared(box.getCenter()) <= limit) {
                within.add(box);
            }
        }
        return within;
    }

    private BoundingBox trackedBox(EntityTracker.Tracked tracked, UUID worldId, long now) {
        if (now - tracked.at() > HISTORY_MS || tracked.worldId() == null
                || !tracked.worldId().equals(worldId)
                || !Double.isFinite(tracked.width()) || tracked.width() <= 0.01D
                || !Double.isFinite(tracked.height()) || tracked.height() <= 0.05D) {
            return null;
        }
        double halfWidth = tracked.width() / 2.0D;
        return new BoundingBox(
                tracked.x() - halfWidth, tracked.y(), tracked.z() - halfWidth,
                tracked.x() + halfWidth, tracked.y() + tracked.height(),
                tracked.z() + halfWidth);
    }

    private void addBox(List<BoundingBox> boxes, BoundingBox box) {
        BoundingBox expanded = new BoundingBox(
                box.getMinX() - BOX_MARGIN, box.getMinY() - BOX_MARGIN,
                box.getMinZ() - BOX_MARGIN, box.getMaxX() + BOX_MARGIN,
                box.getMaxY() + BOX_MARGIN, box.getMaxZ() + BOX_MARGIN);
        for (BoundingBox existing : boxes) {
            if (existing.getMinX() == expanded.getMinX()
                    && existing.getMinY() == expanded.getMinY()
                    && existing.getMinZ() == expanded.getMinZ()
                    && existing.getMaxX() == expanded.getMaxX()
                    && existing.getMaxY() == expanded.getMaxY()
                    && existing.getMaxZ() == expanded.getMaxZ()) {
                return;
            }
        }
        boxes.add(expanded);
    }

    private List<Vector> eyePositions(Player attacker, PlayerData data, World world) {
        List<Vector> eyes = new ArrayList<>(MAX_EYE_POSITIONS + 1);
        Vector current = attacker.getEyeLocation().toVector();
        eyes.add(current);

        double eyeHeight = attacker.getEyeHeight();
        List<EntityTracker.Tracked> recent = plugin.tracker().recent(data.entityId());
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        UUID worldId = world.getUID();
        int start = Math.max(0, recent.size() - MAX_EYE_POSITIONS);
        for (int i = start; i < recent.size(); i++) {
            EntityTracker.Tracked tracked = recent.get(i);
            if (now - tracked.at() > HISTORY_MS || tracked.worldId() == null
                    || !tracked.worldId().equals(worldId)) {
                continue;
            }
            Vector eye = new Vector(tracked.x(), tracked.y() + eyeHeight, tracked.z());
            if (eye.distanceSquared(current) < 1.0E-4D) {
                continue;
            }
            eyes.add(eye);
        }
        return eyes;
    }

    private Vector lookDirection(PlayerData data) {
        double yaw = Math.toRadians(data.lastYaw());
        double pitch = Math.toRadians(data.lastPitch());
        double cosPitch = Math.cos(pitch);
        return new Vector(-cosPitch * Math.sin(yaw), -Math.sin(pitch), cosPitch * Math.cos(yaw));
    }

    private boolean visible(World world, List<Vector> eyes, Vector look,
                            List<BoundingBox> targets, double maxDistance) {
        double reach = maxDistance + 2.0D;
        double limit = reach * reach;

        // A closed door over the attacker's eye used to make the whole check
        // return "pass". It is an occluder like any other block now, so being
        // inside a door no longer turns Wall off for that hit.
        boolean[] blocked = new boolean[eyes.size()];
        boolean anyClearEye = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < eyes.size(); i++) {
            blocked[i] = eyeOccluded(world, eyes.get(i));
            anyClearEye |= !blocked[i];
        }
        if (!anyClearEye) {
            // Every eye position is inside an occluder (the old code returned
            // "pass" for this case, which is why attackers inside a closed
            // door were never wall-checked).
            return false;
        }

        // First the exact ray the attacker used. This is the common case and
        // costs one block trace per target instead of the old duplicate pass
        // followed by a full sample grid. A closed door is an occluder here,
        // so no separate door walk is needed.
        for (int i = 0; i < eyes.size(); i++) {
            if (blocked[i]) {
                continue;
            }
            Vector eye = eyes.get(i);
            for (BoundingBox box : targets) {
                if (eye.distanceSquared(box.getCenter()) > limit) {
                    continue;
                }
                RayTraceResult hit = box.rayTrace(eye, look, reach);
                if (hit != null && clear(world, eye, hit.getHitPosition())) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }

        // Edge hits (target moving between ticks, or the ray passing beside
        // the sampled box) get a smaller grid. The old grid ran for every
        // history eye and every target box, which is what made a busy fight
        // expensive. The direct rays above already cover all history eyes;
        // this fallback only needs the current eye and the most recent one,
        // and only the current and latest target boxes.
        List<SampleBox> grid = sampleBoxes(targets);
        int gridEyes = Math.min(eyes.size(), MAX_GRID_EYES);
        for (int i = 0; i < gridEyes; i++) {
            if (blocked[i]) {
                continue;
            }
            Vector eye = eyes.get(i);
            boolean fine = i == 0;
            for (SampleBox target : grid) {
                List<Vector> points = fine ? target.fine() : target.coarse();
                for (Vector point : points) {
                    if (eye.distanceSquared(point) > limit) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    if (clear(world, eye, point)) {
                        return true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    private boolean eyeOccluded(World world, Vector eye) {
        Block block = world.getBlockAt(
                (int) Math.floor(eye.getX()),
                (int) Math.floor(eye.getY()),
                (int) Math.floor(eye.getZ()));
        return occludes(block);
    }

    private List<SampleBox> sampleBoxes(List<BoundingBox> targets) {
        List<BoundingBox> selected;
        if (targets.size() <= MAX_GRID_POSITIONS + 1) {
            selected = targets;
        } else {
            selected = new ArrayList<>(MAX_GRID_POSITIONS + 1);
            selected.add(targets.get(0));
            selected.addAll(targets.subList(targets.size() - MAX_GRID_POSITIONS, targets.size()));
        }

        List<SampleBox> boxes = new ArrayList<>(selected.size());
        for (BoundingBox box : selected) {
            boxes.add(new SampleBox(box, samples(box, true), samples(box, false)));
        }
        return boxes;
    }

    private List<Vector> samples(BoundingBox box, boolean fine) {
        double[] fractions = fine ? GRID : COARSE;
        List<Vector> points = new ArrayList<>(fractions.length * fractions.length * fractions.length + 1);
        points.add(box.getCenter());
        for (double y : fractions) {
            for (double x : fractions) {
                for (double z : fractions) {
                    points.add(new Vector(lerp(box.getMinX(), box.getMaxX(), x),
                            lerp(box.getMinY(), box.getMaxY(), y),
                            lerp(box.getMinZ(), box.getMaxZ(), z)));
                }
            }
        }
        return points;
    }

    private double lerp(double from, double to, double fraction) {
        return from + (to - from) * fraction;
    }

    private boolean clear(World world, Vector eye, Vector point) {
        return firstOccluder(world, eye, point) == null;
    }

    private Block firstOccluder(World world, Vector eye, Vector point) {
        Vector direction = point.clone().subtract(eye);
        double distance = direction.length();
        if (distance <= HIT_MARGIN) {
            return null;
        }
        direction.multiply(1.0D / distance);
        double remaining = distance - HIT_MARGIN;
        Vector start = eye.clone();
        Location origin = new Location(world, start.getX(), start.getY(), start.getZ());
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_TRANSPARENT_PASSES; i++) {
            origin.setX(start.getX());
            origin.setY(start.getY());
            origin.setZ(start.getZ());
            RayTraceResult hit = world.rayTraceBlocks(
                    origin, direction, remaining, FluidCollisionMode.NEVER, false);
            if (hit == null || hit.getHitBlock() == null) {
                return null;
            }
            Block block = hit.getHitBlock();
            if (occludes(block)) {
                return block;
            }

            Vector hitPosition = hit.getHitPosition();
            double advance = hitPosition.distance(start);
            if (advance < RAY_EPSILON) {
                advance = RAY_EPSILON;
            }
            remaining -= advance + RAY_EPSILON;
            if (remaining <= 0.0D) {
                return null;
            }
            start = hitPosition.add(direction.clone().multiply(RAY_EPSILON));
        }
        return null;
    }

    private boolean occludes(Block block) {
        if (block.getBlockData() instanceof Openable openable) {
            return !openable.isOpen();
        }

        Material material = block.getType();
        Boolean cached = OCCLUDING.get(material);
        if (cached != null) {
            return cached;
        }
        boolean occludes = occludesMaterial(block);
        OCCLUDING.put(material, occludes);
        return occludes;
    }

    private static boolean occludesMaterial(Block block) {
        if (block.isPassable()) {
            return false;
        }
        String name = block.getType().name();
        return !(name.equals("GLASS")
                || name.endsWith("_GLASS")
                || name.endsWith("GLASS_PANE"))
                && !name.endsWith("_LEAVES")
                && !name.endsWith("_BARS")
                && !name.endsWith("_FENCE")
                && !name.endsWith("_GRATE")
                && !name.endsWith("SPAWNER")
                && !name.endsWith("COPPER_BULB")
                && !name.equals("ICE")
                && !name.equals("BLUE_ICE")
                && !name.equals("FROSTED_ICE")
                && !name.equals("SLIME_BLOCK")
                && !name.equals("HONEY_BLOCK")
                && !name.equals("BEACON")
                && !name.equals("BARRIER")
                && !name.equals("VAULT")
                && !name.equals("LIGHT")
                && !name.equals("STRUCTURE_VOID")
                && !name.equals("END_GATEWAY")
                && !name.equals("END_PORTAL")
                && !name.equals("NETHER_PORTAL")
                && !name.equals("POWDER_SNOW")
                && !name.equals("BUBBLE_COLUMN");
    }

    private record SampleBox(BoundingBox box, List<Vector> fine, List<Vector> coarse) {
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/me/everyone/oculusai/check/punishment/Animations.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.check.punishment;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.concurrent.ThreadLocalRandom;
import org.bukkit.Color;
import org.bukkit.FireworkEffect;
import org.bukkit.Location;
import org.bukkit.Particle;
import org.bukkit.Sound;
import org.bukkit.World;
import org.bukkit.entity.Firework;
import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
import org.bukkit.inventory.meta.FireworkMeta;
import org.bukkit.util.Vector;

/** The send-off the plugin plays when it punishes somebody itself.
 *
 * <p>A show runs over a span of ticks rather than in one: the cheater is
 * lifted off the ground and held there while it plays, and only when it ends
 * are they disconnected. Kicking first and showing afterwards meant nobody
 * ever saw the thing - the punished player least of all, since they were
 * already at the server list.
 *
 * <p>Holding somebody still is not this class's job. It only draws; the freeze
 * and the disconnect belong to {@link Punishments}, which owns the sequence.
 *
 * <p>Nothing here touches the world. The explosion is particles and a sound
 * rather than {@code createExplosion}, and the lightning is
 * {@code strikeLightningEffect} rather than a real bolt: a punishment that
 * also blew a hole in somebody's base or set it alight would be a far more
 * expensive mistake than the false positive that caused it.
 *
 * <p>Particle and sound constants are looked up by name instead of being
 * written as enum constants. The plugin ships one jar per Minecraft
 * generation from the same shared source, and these two enums were renamed
 * between them - {@code SMOKE_LARGE} became {@code LARGE_SMOKE},
 * {@code EXPLOSION_LARGE} became {@code EXPLOSION}. A constant that exists in
 * only one of the two would not compile for the other. */
public final class Animations {

    public static final String NONE = "none";
    public static final String ASCEND = "ascend";
    public static final String EXPLODE = "explode";
    public static final String LIGHTNING = "lightning";
    public static final String FIREWORK = "firework";
    public static final String WITHER = "wither";
    public static final String RANDOM = "random";

    /** The default, and the one the rest are shaped after: the cheater is
     *  thrown upwards and everything they carried comes out of them. */
    public static final String DEFAULT = ASCEND;

    /** The order the dashboard cycles through. {@code random} is last so a
     *  click past the end of the real ones lands on it deliberately. */
    public static final List<String> ALL =
            List.of(NONE, ASCEND, EXPLODE, LIGHTNING, FIREWORK, WITHER, RANDOM);

    /** Everything {@code random} may pick, which is the real effects only. */
    private static final List<String> PICKABLE =
            List.of(ASCEND, EXPLODE, LIGHTNING, FIREWORK, WITHER);

    /** How long each show runs, in ticks. Long enough that somebody across
     *  the square turns to look, short enough that a cheater is not left
     *  hanging in the air while the server waits on them. */
    private static final int SHORT = 40;
    private static final int LONG = 50;

    /** The throw that starts a show, and the lift that keeps them up.
     *
     *  <p>The per-tick lift is deliberately small and purely vertical. A
     *  player who kept the velocity of the throw would sail off across the
     *  map and finish the show somewhere nobody is watching. */
    private static final double LAUNCH = 0.9D;
    private static final double LIFT = 0.12D;

    /** What {@code random} drew last time, so it does not draw it again.
     *
     *  <p>One shared value rather than one per player: the point is that two
     *  punishments in a row on the same server look different, and the people
     *  watching are the same people either way. */
    private static volatile String lastDrawn = "";

    private Animations() {
    }

    public static String normalise(String id) {
        String lower = id == null ? "" : id.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        return ALL.contains(lower) ? lower : DEFAULT;
    }

    /** The id after this one, for a button that cycles. */
    public static String next(String id) {
        int index = ALL.indexOf(normalise(id));
        return ALL.get((index + 1) % ALL.size());
    }

    /** Resolves {@code random} to the effect this particular punishment gets,
     *  so the whole sequence draws one show rather than a new one per tick. */
    public static String pick(String id) {
        String chosen = normalise(id);
        if (!chosen.equals(RANDOM)) {
            return chosen;
        }
        // Drawn from everything except what came last. With five to choose
        // from, a plain draw repeats itself one time in five, and two
        // identical send-offs in a row are exactly what "random always gives
        // the same one" looks like from the outside.
        List<String> pool = PICKABLE;
        if (PICKABLE.size() > 1 && PICKABLE.contains(lastDrawn)) {
            pool = new ArrayList<>(PICKABLE);
            pool.remove(lastDrawn);
        }
        String drawn = pool.get(ThreadLocalRandom.current().nextInt(pool.size()));
        lastDrawn = drawn;
        return drawn;
    }

    /** How many ticks {@link #pick} 's result runs for. */
    public static int ticks(String chosen) {
        return switch (chosen) {
            case NONE -> 0;
            case EXPLODE, LIGHTNING -> SHORT;
            default -> LONG;
        };
    }

    /** Throws the player up and opens the show. Runs on the owning thread. */
    public static void start(Player player, String chosen) {
        if (chosen.equals(NONE)) {
            return;
        }
        player.setVelocity(new Vector(0.0D, LAUNCH, 0.0D));
        Location where = player.getLocation();
        World world = where.getWorld();
        if (world == null) {
            return;
        }
        // Everybody gets the whoosh of being thrown; the rest is per show.
        play(world, where, 0.9F, 1.6F, "ENTITY_BLAZE_SHOOT");
        switch (chosen) {
            case ASCEND -> play(world, where, 1.0F, 1.4F, "ENTITY_ENDER_DRAGON_FLAP");
            case EXPLODE -> play(world, where, 0.8F, 0.6F, "ENTITY_TNT_PRIMED", "ENTITY_GENERIC_EXPLODE");
            case LIGHTNING -> {
                world.strikeLightningEffect(where);
                play(world, where, 0.7F, 0.8F, "ENTITY_ELDER_GUARDIAN_CURSE");
            }
            case WITHER -> play(world, where, 0.8F, 1.2F, "ENTITY_WITHER_SPAWN");
            default -> {
            }
        }
    }

    /** One frame. {@code tick} counts from 1 to {@code total}. */
    public static void frame(Player player, String chosen, int tick, int total) {
        if (chosen.equals(NONE) || !player.isOnline()) {
            return;
        }
        // Held up for the whole show: without this they are back on the
        // ground a second in, and the rest plays over a corpse on the floor.
        player.setVelocity(new Vector(0.0D, LIFT, 0.0D));

        Location where = player.getLocation();
        World world = where.getWorld();
        if (world == null) {
            return;
        }
        Location centre = where.clone().add(0.0D, 1.0D, 0.0D);
        switch (chosen) {
            case ASCEND -> {
                spawn(world, centre, 6, 0.35D, particle("CRIT", "CRIT"));
                spawn(world, centre, 4, 0.3D, particle("CLOUD", "CLOUD"));
                // A rising ladder of chimes: the pitch climbs with the player,
                // so the ear follows them up without a second effect.
                if (tick % 5 == 0) {
                    play(world, where, 0.7F, 0.8F + (1.2F * tick) / total,
                            "ENTITY_ITEM_PICKUP");
                }
            }
            case EXPLODE -> {
                // Builds towards the burst: the last ticks are visibly busier
                // than the first, so the end reads as an end.
                int count = 2 + (10 * tick) / total;
                spawn(world, centre, count, 0.4D, particle("SMOKE_NORMAL", "SMOKE"));
                spawn(world, centre, count / 2, 0.3D, particle("FLAME", "FLAME"));
                // A fuse that quickens: every fifth tick to begin with, every
                // other one by the end.
                int fuse = Math.max(2, 6 - (4 * tick) / total);
                if (tick % fuse == 0) {
                    play(world, where, 0.5F, 1.4F, "ENTITY_TNT_PRIMED");
                }
            }
            case LIGHTNING -> {
                if (tick % 8 == 0) {
                    world.strikeLightningEffect(around(where, 2.5D));
                }
                spawn(world, centre, 3, 0.3D, particle("ELECTRIC_SPARK", "CRIT"));
            }
            case FIREWORK -> {
                if (tick % 12 == 0) {
                    firework(world, around(where, 1.5D).add(0.0D, 1.0D, 0.0D), false);
                    play(world, where, 0.8F, 1.0F, "ENTITY_FIREWORK_ROCKET_LAUNCH");
                }
            }
            case WITHER -> {
                spawn(world, centre, 8, 0.45D, particle("SMOKE_LARGE", "LARGE_SMOKE"));
                spawn(world, centre, 4, 0.4D, particle("SOUL", "SOUL_FIRE_FLAME"));
                if (tick % 10 == 0) {
                    play(world, where, 0.6F, 0.7F, "BLOCK_PORTAL_TRIGGER");
                }
            }
            default -> {
            }
        }
    }

    /** The last beat, played where the player stood. Takes a location rather
     *  than the player because by now they may be dead. */
    public static void finish(World world, Location where, String chosen) {
        if (world == null || chosen.equals(NONE)) {
            return;
        }
        Location centre = where.clone().add(0.0D, 1.0D, 0.0D);
        switch (chosen) {
            case ASCEND -> {
                spawn(world, centre, 40, 0.6D, particle("CLOUD", "CLOUD"));
                play(world, where, 1.0F, 1.8F, "ENTITY_PLAYER_LEVELUP");
            }
            case EXPLODE -> {
                spawn(world, centre, 1, 0.0D, particle("EXPLOSION_HUGE", "EXPLOSION_EMITTER"));
                spawn(world, centre, 24, 0.6D, particle("EXPLOSION_LARGE", "EXPLOSION"));
                play(world, where, 1.0F, 1.0F, "ENTITY_GENERIC_EXPLODE");
            }
            case LIGHTNING -> world.strikeLightningEffect(where);
            case FIREWORK -> firework(world, centre, true);
            case WITHER -> {
                spawn(world, centre, 50, 0.6D, particle("SMOKE_LARGE", "LARGE_SMOKE"));
                play(world, where, 1.0F, 0.6F, "ENTITY_WITHER_DEATH", "ENTITY_WITHER_SPAWN");
            }
            default -> {
            }
        }
    }

    /** How often the inventory should let go of another handful, in ticks,
     *  or 0 for "all of it at once".
     *
     *  <p>The number is each show's own repeating beat - the chime ladder, the
     *  fuse, the rocket, the portal - so the items come out on the sound
     *  rather than beside it. A show with no beat of its own has nothing to
     *  fall in time with, and dribbling items out in silence looks like a lag
     *  spike, so it empties them in one go instead. */
    public static int spillEvery(String chosen) {
        return switch (chosen) {
            case ASCEND -> 5;
            case EXPLODE -> 4;
            case LIGHTNING -> 8;
            case WITHER -> 10;
            case FIREWORK -> 12;
            default -> 0;
        };
    }

    /** The sound of a cheater's inventory coming out of them: the chest
     *  opening under the clatter of what was in it. Played once for the lot
     *  rather than once per stack - forty items each firing their own pickup
     *  sound is a wall of noise, not an effect. */
    public static void spilled(World world, Location where) {
        if (world == null) {
            return;
        }
        play(world, where, 1.0F, 0.7F, "BLOCK_CHEST_OPEN");
        play(world, where, 1.0F, 1.4F, "ENTITY_ITEM_FRAME_BREAK");
        play(world, where, 0.8F, 0.6F, "BLOCK_ANVIL_LAND");
    }

    /** The push given to an item coming out of a punished player: up and
     *  away, so the inventory visibly leaves them rather than appearing in a
     *  heap under their feet. */
    public static Vector spill() {
        ThreadLocalRandom random = ThreadLocalRandom.current();
        return new Vector(
                random.nextDouble(-0.35D, 0.35D),
                random.nextDouble(0.35D, 0.75D),
                random.nextDouble(-0.35D, 0.35D));
    }

    private static Location around(Location where, double radius) {
        ThreadLocalRandom random = ThreadLocalRandom.current();
        return where.clone().add(
                random.nextDouble(-radius, radius), 0.0D, random.nextDouble(-radius, radius));
    }

    private static void firework(World world, Location where, boolean big) {
        Firework rocket = world.spawn(where, Firework.class);
        FireworkMeta meta = rocket.getFireworkMeta();
        meta.addEffect(FireworkEffect.builder()
                .withColor(Color.RED, Color.ORANGE)
                .withFade(Color.WHITE)
                .with(big ? FireworkEffect.Type.BALL_LARGE : FireworkEffect.Type.BALL)
                .withFlicker()
                .withTrail()
                .build());
        meta.setPower(0);
        rocket.setFireworkMeta(meta);
        // Straight away, not after a flight: the rocket would otherwise drift
        // off the spot everybody is looking at, and outlive the point.
        rocket.detonate();
    }

    private static void spawn(World world, Location where, int count, double spread,
                              Particle particle) {
        if (particle != null && count > 0) {
            world.spawnParticle(particle, where, count, spread, spread, spread, 0.0D);
        }
    }

    private static void play(World world, Location where, float volume, float pitch,
                             String... names) {
        Sound sound = sound(names);
        if (sound != null) {
            world.playSound(where, sound, volume, pitch);
        }
    }

    /** The first of these constants this server's API actually has. */
    private static Particle particle(String... names) {
        for (String name : names) {
            try {
                return Particle.valueOf(name);
            } catch (IllegalArgumentException absent) {
                // Try the name the other generation uses.
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    private static Sound sound(String... names) {
        for (String name : names) {
            try {
                return Sound.valueOf(name);
            } catch (IllegalArgumentException absent) {
                // Try the name the other generation uses.
            }
        }
        return null;
    }
}

```

`src/main/java/me/everyone/oculusai/check/punishment/BanCounter.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.check.punishment;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;
import me.everyone.oculusai.core.Service;
import org.bukkit.configuration.ConfigurationSection;
import org.bukkit.configuration.file.YamlConfiguration;

/** How many punishments each player has collected towards a ban.
 *
 * <p>Deliberately not the history's own tally, which counts every punishment
 * the player ever had. Two things make that the wrong number here.
 *
 * <p>The first is that switching the feature on must not reach backwards. An
 * operator who sets {@code ban-after: 3} on a server that has been running for
 * months is saying "three more", not "ban everybody who already has three" -
 * and the history-backed version would have banned a long list of people on
 * the next punishment each of them collected.
 *
 * <p>The second is the unban. A player the anticheat banned and an admin then
 * let back in has been forgiven, and an admin who forgives somebody does not
 * mean "until your next punishment". Their count starts again from zero. The
 * unban itself is never seen by the plugin, so it is inferred from the only
 * thing that proves it: they logged in, which a banned player cannot do. */
public final class BanCounter implements Service {

    private final OculusAI plugin;
    private final Map<UUID, Integer> counts = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private final Set<UUID> bannedByUs = ConcurrentHashMap.newKeySet();

    public BanCounter(OculusAI plugin) {
        this.plugin = plugin;
    }

    @Override
    public void enable() {
        reload();
    }

    @Override
    public void disable() {
        counts.clear();
        bannedByUs.clear();
    }

    @Override
    public void reload() {
        counts.clear();
        bannedByUs.clear();
        File file = file();
        if (!file.isFile()) {
            return;
        }
        YamlConfiguration stored = YamlConfiguration.loadConfiguration(file);
        ConfigurationSection section = stored.getConfigurationSection("counts");
        if (section != null) {
            for (String key : section.getKeys(false)) {
                UUID uuid = parse(key);
                if (uuid != null) {
                    counts.put(uuid, Math.max(0, section.getInt(key)));
                }
            }
        }
        for (String key : stored.getStringList("banned")) {
            UUID uuid = parse(key);
            if (uuid != null) {
                bannedByUs.add(uuid);
            }
        }
    }

    /** Counts one punishment and returns the new total. */
    public int record(UUID uuid) {
        int next = counts.merge(uuid, 1, Integer::sum);
        save();
        return next;
    }

    /** What this player stands at without counting anything. */
    public int count(UUID uuid) {
        return counts.getOrDefault(uuid, 0);
    }

    /** Remembers that the anticheat banned this player, and clears the count
     *  that got them there: whatever happens next is a fresh start, whether
     *  that is an unban today or in a year. */
    public void banned(UUID uuid) {
        counts.remove(uuid);
        bannedByUs.add(uuid);
        save();
    }

    /** Called when a player logs in.
     *
     *  <p>A banned player cannot reach this, so arriving here while still
     *  flagged means somebody lifted the ban. The flag is dropped and the
     *  player starts clean - the count was already cleared when they were
     *  banned, so this only has to stop them being treated as a returning
     *  convict. */
    public void seen(UUID uuid) {
        if (bannedByUs.remove(uuid)) {
            counts.remove(uuid);
            save();
            plugin.getLogger().info("Ban lifted for " + uuid
                    + " - their punishment count starts again.");
        }
    }

    /** True while the anticheat's own ban on this player stands. */
    public boolean bannedByUs(UUID uuid) {
        return bannedByUs.contains(uuid);
    }

    /** Wipes one player, for /oai forget. */
    public void forget(UUID uuid) {
        boolean changed = counts.remove(uuid) != null;
        changed |= bannedByUs.remove(uuid);
        if (changed) {
            save();
        }
    }

    private UUID parse(String value) {
        try {
            return UUID.fromString(value);
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException malformed) {
            plugin.getLogger().warning("Ignoring a malformed UUID in bans.yml: " + value);
            return null;
        }
    }

    private void save() {
        YamlConfiguration out = new YamlConfiguration();
        for (Map.Entry<UUID, Integer> entry : counts.entrySet()) {
            out.set("counts." + entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
        }
        out.set("banned", bannedByUs.stream().map(UUID::toString).toList());
        try {
            out.save(file());
        } catch (IOException failure) {
            plugin.getLogger().log(Level.WARNING,
                    "Could not save bans.yml: the ban counts will reset after a restart.",
                    failure);
        }
    }

    private File file() {
        return new File(plugin.getDataFolder(), "bans.yml");
    }
}

```

`src/main/java/me/everyone/oculusai/check/punishment/Punishments.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.check.punishment;


import me.everyone.oculusai.core.Platform;
import me.everyone.oculusai.core.Service;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;
import java.util.function.IntConsumer;
import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;
import me.everyone.oculusai.config.Config;
import me.everyone.oculusai.player.PlayerData;
import me.everyone.oculusai.core.Msg;
import org.bukkit.Location;
import org.bukkit.World;
import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
import org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack;
import org.bukkit.inventory.PlayerInventory;

/** Executes the configured punishment after a confirmed detection.
 *
 * <p>There is deliberately no recording window here. A separate capture made
 * the plugin keep recording a suspect after the decision had already been
 * made, delayed the punishment, and produced a second data path whose label
 * could disagree with the alert. The dataset tools in {@code /oai data} are
 * the only way to record training windows now. */
public final class Punishments implements Service {

    private final OculusAI plugin;
    private final Map<UUID, Long> lastPunished = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    /** Players whose send-off is playing right now.
     *
     *  <p>{@code PacketBridge} drops everything these send while they are in
     *  here, which is what "they cannot do anything" means in practice: a
     *  cancelled attack never lands, and a cancelled look or position never
     *  reaches the server, so the cheater is frozen where the show put them.
     *  The client will still swing and turn on its own screen - no server can
     *  prevent that - but nothing it does from here counts. */
    private final Set<UUID> held = ConcurrentHashMap.newKeySet();

    public Punishments(OculusAI plugin) {
        this.plugin = plugin;
    }

    @Override
    public void disable() {
        lastPunished.clear();
        held.clear();
    }

    /** True while this player's send-off is playing. */
    public boolean isHeld(UUID uuid) {
        return held.contains(uuid);
    }

    public void handle(PlayerData data) {
        if (!plugin.config().analysisEnabled()
                || !plugin.config().punishmentEnabled()
                || !data.player().isOnline()
                || plugin.bypass().isBypassed(data.player())) {
            return;
        }
        // A capture that ends in a kick is a capture cut short: the windows
        // after the threshold are the ones worth having, and the recorded
        // player is on the roster on purpose - they are meant to be cheating.
        // Analysis, readings and alerts carry on; only the punishment waits
        // until the recording is committed.
        if (data.recording() && plugin.config().punishmentSkipWhileRecording()) {
            return;
        }
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        long grace = plugin.config().firstJoinGraceMs();
        if (grace > 0L) {
            long firstPlayed = data.player().getFirstPlayed();
            if (firstPlayed <= 0L || now - firstPlayed < grace) {
                return;
            }
        }
        long cooldown = plugin.config().punishmentCooldownMs();
        Long previous = lastPunished.get(data.uuid());
        if (previous != null && now - previous < cooldown) {
            return;
        }
        lastPunished.put(data.uuid(), now);
        execute(data);
    }

    /** A kick or a ban an operator asked for by hand.
     *
     *  <p>Goes through the same send-off as a detection: the show, the
     *  stripping and the ordering are the punishment, and an admin kicking
     *  somebody they just watched cheat wants exactly what the plugin would
     *  have done on its own. What it skips is everything that belongs to the
     *  model - the buffer, the cooldown and the detection report - because
     *  nothing here was detected.
     *
     *  <p>{@code punishment.enabled} is not consulted either. That switch
     *  says whether the plugin may punish by itself; a person typing the
     *  command has already decided.
     *
     *  <p>Bypass is not consulted: it decides who the model looks at, not
     *  who an admin may remove.
     *
     *  @return false if the target left before the command landed */
    public boolean manual(Player player, boolean ban, String reason, String by) {
        if (!player.isOnline()) {
            return false;
        }
        UUID uuid = player.getUniqueId();
        String name = player.getName();
        Map<String, String> placeholders = Map.of(
                "player", name,
                "reason", reason,
                "by", by);

        plugin.history().note(uuid, name, "punish",
                (ban ? "manual ban by " : "manual kick by ") + by + ": " + reason);

        // An operator who just watched somebody cheat wants the same thing
        // the plugin keeps for itself: the seconds before the kick, playable
        // in the panel. Frozen before the send-off, as on the automatic path.
        PlayerData suspect = plugin.data().get(player);
        if (suspect != null) {
            plugin.replays().capture(suspect, ban ? "manual-ban" : "manual-kick");
        }

        boolean shown = true;
        boolean strip = plugin.config().punishmentStrip();
        if (ban) {
            String configured = Msg.fill(plugin.config().punishmentBanCommand(), placeholders).trim();
            boolean vanilla = configured.isBlank();
            String banCommand = vanilla ? "ban " + name + " " + reason : configured;
            if (vanilla) {
                show(player, strip, () -> run(banCommand));
            } else {
                // A named ban command owns the punishment, show included -
                // the same rule the automatic path follows.
                shown = false;
                run(banCommand);
            }
            plugin.banCounter().banned(uuid);
        } else {
            show(player, strip, () -> plugin.platform().onEntity(player, () -> kick(player, reason)));
        }

        plugin.getLogger().info(by + " " + (ban ? "banned " : "kicked ") + name
                + (shown && strip ? " with the send-off" : "") + ": " + reason);

        String broadcast = plugin.lang().text(ban ? "manual.broadcast-ban" : "manual.broadcast-kick",
                placeholders);
        if (!broadcast.isBlank()) {
            plugin.alerts().announce(plugin.config().prefix() + broadcast);
        }
        return true;
    }

    public void forget(UUID uuid) {
        lastPunished.remove(uuid);
        // A player who left in the middle of their own send-off must not stay
        // held: the id would be reused by their next session.
        held.remove(uuid);
    }

    private void execute(PlayerData data) {
        Player player = data.player();
        if (!player.isOnline()) {
            return;
        }
        plugin.history().note(data.uuid(), data.name(), "punish",
                "buffer " + Msg.round(data.buffer(), 1) + ", p " + Msg.probability(data.probability()));

        // Before anything else happens to them. The send-off strips the
        // inventory, kills the player and disconnects them, so a replay taken
        // after it would be a recording of the punishment rather than of the
        // thing that caused it.
        plugin.replays().capture(data, "punish");

        // Counted only while banning is switched on, and counted by
        // BanCounter rather than by the history: turning ban-after on must
        // not reach backwards over punishments collected before the operator
        // asked for any of this.
        int banAfter = plugin.config().punishmentBanAfter();
        int punishments = banAfter > 0
                ? plugin.banCounter().record(data.uuid())
                : plugin.banCounter().count(data.uuid());
        boolean ban = banAfter > 0 && punishments >= banAfter;

        Map<String, String> placeholders = Map.of(
                "player", data.name(),
                "probability", Msg.probability(data.probability()),
                "buffer", Msg.round(data.buffer(), 1),
                "punishments", Integer.toString(punishments));

        String command = Msg.fill(plugin.config().punishmentCommand(), placeholders).trim();
        if (ban) {
            String configured = Msg.fill(plugin.config().punishmentBanCommand(), placeholders).trim();
            boolean vanilla = configured.isBlank();
            // Minecraft's own ban, which also kicks. Dispatched rather than
            // written through BanList because the two jars compile against
            // APIs whose ban types differ, and because a server running a ban
            // plugin has it on /ban - taking that over is what an operator who
            // installed one expects.
            String banCommand = vanilla
                    ? "ban " + data.name() + " " + reason(placeholders) : configured;
            // The ban is the kick escalated, so it gets the same send-off -
            // but only when the plugin is the one banning. A named command
            // owns the punishment, show included.
            boolean strip = vanilla && plugin.config().punishmentStrip();
            if (vanilla) {
                show(player, strip, () -> run(banCommand));
            } else {
                run(banCommand);
            }
            plugin.banCounter().banned(data.uuid());
            plugin.getLogger().info((strip ? "Stripped, killed and banned " : "Banned ")
                    + data.name() + " after " + punishments + " punishment(s): " + banCommand);
        } else if (command.isBlank()) {
            boolean strip = plugin.config().punishmentStrip();
            show(player, strip,
                    () -> plugin.platform().onEntity(player, () -> kick(player, placeholders)));
            plugin.getLogger().info((strip ? "Stripped, killed and kicked " : "Kicked ")
                    + data.name());
        } else {
            run(command);
            plugin.getLogger().info("Executed punishment command for " + data.name()
                    + ": " + command);
        }

        String broadcast = plugin.config().punishmentBroadcast();
        if (!broadcast.isBlank()) {
            plugin.alerts().announce(Msg.parse(plugin.config().prefix() + broadcast, placeholders));
        }

        plugin.api().reportKick(data.name(), data.uuid().toString(),
                data.probability(), data.buffer(),
                ban ? "ban" : command.isBlank() ? "kick" : "command");
    }

    /** Runs a configured command from the console, with or without the slash
     *  the operator may have typed.
     *
     *  <p>Через global-регион, а не напрямую. На Folia
     *  {@code dispatchCommand} законен только на потоке, который не владеет
     *  ни одной сущностью, и с любого другого бросает
     *  {@code IllegalStateException: Dispatching command async}. Автоматический
     *  путь это не задевало - он идёт с тик-лупа, а тот и так global, - а
     *  {@code /oai ban} падал всегда: команда игрока исполняется на потоке его
     *  региона.
     *
     *  <p>Отправка от этого становится отложенной на тик, и это безопасно:
     *  вызывающий ничего о ней не узнаёт, а вернуть он должен был не её
     *  результат. Если забрать это назад в прямой вызов, оно сломается только
     *  на Folia и только на команде оператора - то есть не на тестах. */
    private void run(String command) {
        String withoutSlash = command.startsWith("/") ? command.substring(1) : command;
        if (withoutSlash.isBlank()) {
            return;
        }
        plugin.platform().onGlobal(() -> plugin.getServer().dispatchCommand(
                plugin.getServer().getConsoleSender(), withoutSlash));
    }

    /** Runs a show on a player: the throw, the frames, the closing burst.
     *
     *  <p>Holds nobody, strips nobody, disconnects nobody - those belong to
     *  the caller, which is why {@code /oai animations} can borrow this to
     *  preview an effect on an admin without any of the rest happening to
     *  them.
     *
     *  @param onStart runs on the owning thread right after the throw
     *  @param atEnd   runs on the tick loop once the show is over */
    public void playShow(Player player, String chosen, Runnable onStart,
                         IntConsumer onFrame, Runnable atEnd) {
        int total = Animations.ticks(chosen);
        if (total <= 0) {
            if (onStart != null) {
                plugin.platform().onEntity(player, onStart);
            }
            plugin.ticks().after(1L, atEnd);
            return;
        }

        plugin.platform().onEntity(player, () -> {
            Animations.start(player, chosen);
            if (onStart != null) {
                onStart.run();
            }
        });

        AtomicInteger tick = new AtomicInteger();
        Platform.Cancellable frames = plugin.platform().entityRepeating(player, 1L, 1L, () -> {
            int now = tick.incrementAndGet();
            Animations.frame(player, chosen, now, total);
            if (onFrame != null) {
                onFrame.accept(now);
            }
        });

        plugin.ticks().after(total, () -> {
            frames.cancel();
            plugin.platform().onEntity(player, () -> {
                if (player.isOnline()) {
                    Location where = player.getLocation();
                    Animations.finish(where.getWorld(), where, chosen);
                }
            });
            atEnd.run();
        });
    }

    /** Plays the send-off, then disconnects.
     *
     *  <p>The order is the whole point. The cheater is thrown up and frozen,
     *  their inventory comes out of them on the way, the show runs its span,
     *  and only at the end are they killed and disconnected. Before this the
     *  kick went first and the effect second, which meant the effect played
     *  over an empty spot and the punished player never saw any of it - they
     *  were already back at the server list.
     *
     *  <p>The disconnect still waits a tick after the kill. The death
     *  message, the statistic and the respawn state are all decided after
     *  {@code setHealth} returns, and a session that ends inside that window
     *  can save the player as they were before it.
     *
     *  <p>Frames run on the thread owning the player; the hand-offs go
     *  through the tick loop, which is the global thread on Folia, so the
     *  order holds on both servers. A disconnect that touches the player
     *  rather than dispatching a command has to find its way back onto the
     *  owning thread itself - the kick does, the ban command does not. */
    private void show(Player player, boolean strip, Runnable disconnect) {
        String chosen = Animations.pick(plugin.config().punishmentAnimation());
        UUID uuid = player.getUniqueId();
        int total = Animations.ticks(chosen);
        if (total > 0) {
            held.add(uuid);
        }

        // Taken off them at the very start whatever happens next: a cheater
        // who keeps their gear through the show would also take it with them
        // if the server stopped halfway. What varies is only how fast the
        // pile is let go of.
        int beat = total > 0 ? Animations.spillEvery(chosen) : 0;
        List<ItemStack> pending = new ArrayList<>();
        int[] perBeat = {Integer.MAX_VALUE};

        playShow(player, chosen,
                strip ? () -> {
                    pending.addAll(takeEverything(player));
                    if (beat <= 0) {
                        release(player, pending, pending.size());
                        return;
                    }
                    // Spread over the beats the show actually has, so the
                    // last handful lands on the last sound rather than
                    // halfway through.
                    int beats = Math.max(1, total / beat);
                    perBeat[0] = Math.max(1, (pending.size() + beats - 1) / beats);
                } : null,
                strip && beat > 0 ? tick -> {
                    if (tick % beat == 0) {
                        release(player, pending, perBeat[0]);
                    }
                } : null,
                () -> {
                    held.remove(uuid);
                    plugin.platform().onEntity(player, () -> {
                        if (!player.isOnline()) {
                            return;
                        }
                        if (strip) {
                            // Whatever the beats did not reach, plus anything
                            // picked up since - the show is over either way.
                            release(player, pending, pending.size());
                            release(player, takeEverything(player), Integer.MAX_VALUE);
                            player.setHealth(0.0D);
                        }
                    });
                    plugin.ticks().after(1L, disconnect);
                });
    }

    /** Drops up to {@code count} of the waiting items where the player is
     *  now, which during a show is wherever the throw has carried them. */
    private void release(Player player, List<ItemStack> waiting, int count) {
        if (waiting.isEmpty() || !player.isOnline()) {
            return;
        }
        Location where = player.getLocation();
        World world = where.getWorld();
        if (world == null) {
            return;
        }
        Location from = where.clone().add(0.0D, 1.0D, 0.0D);
        for (int i = 0; i < count && !waiting.isEmpty(); i++) {
            dropOne(world, from, waiting.remove(0));
        }
    }

    /** Disconnects a player who may already have left on their own. */
    private void kick(Player player, Map<String, String> placeholders) {
        kick(player, reason(placeholders));
    }

    /** What the punished player is shown, with the same placeholders the
     *  broadcast gets. Blank falls back rather than disconnecting somebody
     *  with an empty screen. */
    private String reason(Map<String, String> placeholders) {
        String configured = Msg.fill(plugin.config().punishmentKickMessage(), placeholders).trim();
        return configured.isBlank() ? Config.DEFAULT_KICK_MESSAGE : configured;
    }

    private void kick(Player player, String reason) {
        if (player.isOnline()) {
            player.kickPlayer(Msg.parse(reason));
        }
    }

    /** Drops the whole inventory on the ground and empties it.
     *
     *  <p>The death alone is not enough: a server with keepInventory on would
     *  kill the cheater and hand them everything back on respawn, which is the
     *  opposite of the point. Dropping first and clearing after means the
     *  gamerule no longer decides what this punishment does.
     *
     *  <p>Must run on the thread owning the player. */
    private List<ItemStack> takeEverything(Player player) {
        PlayerInventory inventory = player.getInventory();
        // Gathered before anything is thrown, and deduplicated by identity.
        // A player inventory's getContents() is 41 slots - the main grid, the
        // armour and the off hand - so the armour and off hand also come back
        // from their own getters. Dropping both lists would have turned one
        // helmet on a cheater into two on the ground, which is a duplication
        // bug handed to the one person with the most reason to exploit it.
        // The getters are still read: it costs nothing and does not assume
        // that every server agrees on what getContents() covers.
        List<ItemStack> spilling = new ArrayList<>();
        collect(spilling, inventory.getContents());
        collect(spilling, inventory.getArmorContents());
        collect(spilling, new ItemStack[] {inventory.getItemInOffHand()});

        inventory.clear();
        inventory.setArmorContents(null);
        inventory.setItemInOffHand(null);
        Location where = player.getLocation();
        if (!spilling.isEmpty()) {
            Animations.spilled(where.getWorld(), where.clone().add(0.0D, 1.0D, 0.0D));
        }
        return spilling;
    }

    /** Adds the real items of an array, skipping anything already gathered. */
    private void collect(List<ItemStack> into, ItemStack[] stacks) {
        if (stacks == null) {
            return;
        }
        for (ItemStack stack : stacks) {
            if (stack == null || stack.getType().isAir()) {
                continue;
            }
            boolean seen = false;
            for (ItemStack already : into) {
                if (already == stack) {
                    seen = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (!seen) {
                into.add(stack);
            }
        }
    }

    /** Throws one item out of the player: up and away, so the inventory is
     *  visibly leaving them instead of appearing under their feet. */
    private void dropOne(World world, Location where, ItemStack stack) {
        if (stack != null && !stack.getType().isAir()) {
            world.dropItem(where, stack.clone()).setVelocity(Animations.spill());
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.command;


import me.everyone.oculusai.core.Service;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;
import me.everyone.oculusai.command.SubCommand;
import me.everyone.oculusai.command.sub.BypassCommand;
import me.everyone.oculusai.command.sub.ConnectCommand;
import me.everyone.oculusai.command.sub.MlCommand;
import me.everyone.oculusai.command.sub.DashboardCommand;
import me.everyone.oculusai.command.sub.ForgetCommand;
import me.everyone.oculusai.command.sub.HistoryCommand;
import me.everyone.oculusai.command.sub.JournalCommand;
import me.everyone.oculusai.command.sub.MenuCommand;
import me.everyone.oculusai.command.sub.MathCommand;
import me.everyone.oculusai.command.sub.MonitorCommand;
import me.everyone.oculusai.command.sub.NpcCommand;
import me.everyone.oculusai.command.sub.PlayerCommand;
import me.everyone.oculusai.command.sub.ProbCommand;
import me.everyone.oculusai.command.sub.PunishCommand;
import me.everyone.oculusai.command.sub.ReloadCommand;
import me.everyone.oculusai.command.sub.UpdateCommand;
import org.bukkit.command.Command;
import org.bukkit.command.CommandExecutor;
import org.bukkit.command.CommandSender;
import org.bukkit.command.ConsoleCommandSender;
import org.bukkit.command.PluginCommand;
import org.bukkit.command.TabCompleter;
import org.bukkit.entity.Player;

public final class Commands implements Service, CommandExecutor, TabCompleter {

    private final OculusAI plugin;
    private final List<SubCommand> subCommands = new ArrayList<>();

    public Commands(OculusAI plugin) {
        this.plugin = plugin;
    }

    @Override
    public void enable() {
        subCommands.clear();
        subCommands.add(new MenuCommand(plugin));
        subCommands.add(new JournalCommand(plugin));
        subCommands.add(new HistoryCommand(plugin));
        subCommands.add(new ProbCommand(plugin));
        subCommands.add(new MathCommand(plugin));
        subCommands.add(new BypassCommand(plugin));
        subCommands.add(new MonitorCommand(plugin));
        subCommands.add(new PlayerCommand(plugin));
        subCommands.add(new ForgetCommand(plugin));
        subCommands.add(PunishCommand.kick(plugin));
        subCommands.add(PunishCommand.ban(plugin));
        subCommands.add(new MlCommand(plugin));
        subCommands.add(new NpcCommand(plugin));
        subCommands.add(new ConnectCommand(plugin));
        subCommands.add(new DashboardCommand(plugin));
        subCommands.add(new UpdateCommand(plugin));
        subCommands.add(new ReloadCommand(plugin));

        PluginCommand command = plugin.getCommand("oculusai");
        if (command == null) {
            plugin.getLogger().severe("/oculusai is missing from plugin.yml");
            return;
        }
        command.setExecutor(this);
        command.setTabCompleter(this);
    }

    public List<SubCommand> subCommands() {
        return subCommands;
    }

    /** Whether this sender may use a node.
     *
     * <p>The console is the server itself. It cannot be given a permission the
     * way a player can, and every node in plugin.yml is default:false - which
     * on a plain Paper box means the console was refused its own anticheat,
     * /oai reload and /oai monitor included, even though the monitor is
     * written to be able to print to it. Whoever reads the console already has
     * the machine, so there is nothing left to protect from them. A command
     * block is not the console and still has to be granted the node. */
    private static boolean allowed(CommandSender sender, String permission) {
        return sender instanceof ConsoleCommandSender || sender.hasPermission(permission);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean onCommand(CommandSender sender, Command command, String label, String[] args) {
        if (!allowed(sender, "oculusai.command")
                && (args.length == 0 || !(find(args[0]) instanceof MlCommand))) {
            sender.sendMessage(plugin.config().prefix() + plugin.lang().text("command.no-permission"));
            return true;
        }
        if (args.length == 0) {
            find("menu").execute(sender, new String[0]);
            return true;
        }

        SubCommand subCommand = find(args[0]);
        if (subCommand == null) {
            sender.sendMessage(plugin.config().prefix() + plugin.lang().text("command.unknown",
                    Map.of("label", label)));
            return true;
        }
        if (subCommand.permission() != null && !allowed(sender, subCommand.permission())) {
            sender.sendMessage(plugin.config().prefix() + plugin.lang().text("command.no-permission"));
            return true;
        }
        if (subCommand.playerOnly() && !(sender instanceof Player)) {
            sender.sendMessage(plugin.config().prefix() + plugin.lang().text("command.players-only"));
            return true;
        }

        subCommand.execute(sender, Arrays.copyOfRange(args, 1, args.length));
        return true;
    }

    @Override
    public List<String> onTabComplete(CommandSender sender, Command command, String label, String[] args) {
        boolean fullAccess = allowed(sender, "oculusai.command");
        if (args.length <= 1) {
            String partial = args.length == 0 ? "" : args[0].toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
            List<String> names = new ArrayList<>();
            for (SubCommand subCommand : subCommands) {
                if (!fullAccess && !(subCommand instanceof MlCommand)) {
                    continue;
                }
                if (subCommand.permission() != null && !allowed(sender, subCommand.permission())) {
                    continue;
                }
                if (subCommand.name().startsWith(partial)) {
                    names.add(subCommand.name());
                }
            }
            return names;
        }

        SubCommand subCommand = find(args[0]);
        if (subCommand == null || (!fullAccess && !(subCommand instanceof MlCommand))
                || (subCommand.permission() != null && !allowed(sender, subCommand.permission()))) {
            return List.of();
        }
        return subCommand.complete(sender, Arrays.copyOfRange(args, 1, args.length));
    }

    private SubCommand find(String input) {
        for (SubCommand subCommand : subCommands) {
            if (subCommand.matches(input)) {
                return subCommand;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

}
```

`src/main/java/me/everyone/oculusai/command/SubCommand.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.command;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;
import me.everyone.oculusai.core.Msg;
import org.bukkit.command.CommandSender;
import org.bukkit.entity.Player;

public abstract class SubCommand {

    protected final OculusAI plugin;

    private final String name;
    private final List<String> aliases;
    private final String permission;
    private final String usage;
    private final String description;
    private final boolean playerOnly;

    protected SubCommand(OculusAI plugin, String name, List<String> aliases, String permission,
                         String usage, String description, boolean playerOnly) {
        this.plugin = plugin;
        this.name = name;
        this.aliases = aliases;
        this.permission = permission;
        this.usage = usage;
        this.description = description;
        this.playerOnly = playerOnly;
    }

    public abstract void execute(CommandSender sender, String[] args);

    public List<String> complete(CommandSender sender, String[] args) {
        return List.of();
    }

    public boolean matches(String input) {
        if (name.equalsIgnoreCase(input)) {
            return true;
        }
        for (String alias : aliases) {
            if (alias.equalsIgnoreCase(input)) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    protected void reply(CommandSender sender, String miniMessage) {
        sender.sendMessage(plugin.config().prefix() + Msg.parse(accented(miniMessage)));
    }

    /** {@code <accent>} в строке, собранной в коде, - цвет акцента темы. */
    protected String accented(String miniMessage) {
        return plugin.theme() == null ? miniMessage : plugin.theme().resolveAccent(miniMessage);
    }

    protected void replyKey(CommandSender sender, String key) {
        sender.sendMessage(plugin.config().prefix() + plugin.lang().text(key));
    }

    protected void replyKey(CommandSender sender, String key, Map<String, String> placeholders) {
        sender.sendMessage(plugin.config().prefix() + plugin.lang().text(key, placeholders));
    }

    protected List<String> onlineNames(String partial) {
        String lower = partial.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        List<String> names = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Player player : plugin.getServer().getOnlinePlayers()) {
            if (player.getName().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).startsWith(lower)) {
                names.add(player.getName());
            }
        }
        return names;
    }

    public String name() {
        return name;
    }

    public String permission() {
        return permission;
    }

    public String usage() {
        return usage;
    }

    /** The usage line, safe to hand to the message parser.
     *
     *  <p>{@code Msg.parse} treats every {@code <...>} as a tag and replaces
     *  an unknown one with nothing, so printing a usage line through it ate
     *  the placeholders: {@code /oai report <name> [reason]} arrived as
     *  {@code /oai report  [reason]} on every one of these commands. The
     *  escapes are turned back into angle brackets at the end of parsing, so
     *  this is the form to interpolate - never {@link #usage()} itself. */
    public String usageText() {
        return usage.replace("<", "&lt;").replace(">", "&gt;");
    }

    public String description() {
        return description;
    }

    public boolean playerOnly() {
        return playerOnly;
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/me/everyone/oculusai/command/sub/BypassCommand.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.command.sub;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;
import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;
import me.everyone.oculusai.command.SubCommand;
import me.everyone.oculusai.player.Bypass;
import org.bukkit.OfflinePlayer;
import org.bukkit.command.CommandSender;
import org.bukkit.entity.Player;

/** Toggles the analysis exemption for one player.
 *
 * <p>Works for offline players too: the list stores UUIDs, so the command is
 * useful before the player joins rather than only after somebody notices them
 * in a fight. */
public final class BypassCommand extends SubCommand {

    public BypassCommand(OculusAI plugin) {
        super(plugin, "bypass", List.of("ignore"), "oculusai.command",
                "/oai bypass <player>",
                "Turn the anticheat on or off for one player.", false);
    }

    @Override
    public void execute(CommandSender sender, String[] args) {
        if (args.length != 1) {
            replyKey(sender, "bypass.usage", Map.of("value", usageText()));
            return;
        }

        String name;
        UUID uuid;
        Player online = plugin.getServer().getPlayerExact(args[0]);
        if (online != null) {
            name = online.getName();
            uuid = online.getUniqueId();
        } else {
            OfflinePlayer offline = plugin.getServer().getOfflinePlayer(args[0]);
            if (!offline.hasPlayedBefore()) {
                replyKey(sender, "bypass.unknown");
                return;
            }
            name = offline.getName() == null ? args[0] : offline.getName();
            uuid = offline.getUniqueId();
        }

        Bypass.Toggle toggle = plugin.bypass().toggle(uuid);
        replyKey(sender, toggle.enabled() ? "bypass.enabled" : "bypass.disabled",
                Map.of("player", name));
        if (!toggle.saved()) {
            replyKey(sender, "bypass.save-failed");
        }
        if (!toggle.enabled() && online != null && online.hasPermission("oculusai.bypass")) {
            replyKey(sender, "bypass.permission", Map.of("player", name));
        }
    }

    @Override
    public List<String> complete(CommandSender sender, String[] args) {
        return args.length == 1 ? onlineNames(args[0]) : List.of();
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/me/everyone/oculusai/command/sub/ConnectCommand.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.command.sub;

import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;
import me.everyone.oculusai.command.SubCommand;
import me.everyone.oculusai.core.TickLoop;
import net.md_5.bungee.api.chat.ClickEvent;
import net.md_5.bungee.api.chat.HoverEvent;
import net.md_5.bungee.api.chat.TextComponent;
import net.md_5.bungee.api.chat.hover.content.Text;
import org.bukkit.Bukkit;
import org.bukkit.command.CommandSender;
import org.bukkit.entity.Player;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

public final class ConnectCommand extends SubCommand {

    private static final long POLL_TICKS = 60L;
    private static final long TIMEOUT_MS = 10L * 60L * 1000L;

    private TickLoop.Handle poll;

    public ConnectCommand(OculusAI plugin) {
        super(plugin, "connect", List.of("link", "bind"), "oculusai.connect",
                "/oai connect", "Bind this server to your account.", false);
    }

    @Override
    public void execute(CommandSender sender, String[] args) {
        if (poll != null) {
            poll.cancel();
            poll = null;
        }
        plugin.api().linkStart(Bukkit.getServer().getName(), Bukkit.getBukkitVersion())
                .thenAccept(response -> plugin.mainThread().run(
                        () -> offer(sender, response)));
    }

    private void offer(CommandSender sender, JsonObject response) {
        if (response == null || !response.has("url") || !response.has("token")) {
            replyKey(sender, "connect.failed");
            return;
        }
        String url = response.get("url").getAsString();
        String token = response.get("token").getAsString();

        sendLink(sender, url);
        watch(sender, token, System.currentTimeMillis());
    }

    private void sendLink(CommandSender sender, String url) {
        String label = plugin.config().prefix() + plugin.lang().text("connect.open") + " ";
        String link = plugin.theme().accent("<underline>" + url);
        if (!(sender instanceof Player player)) {
            sender.sendMessage(label + link);
            return;
        }
        // One line, so the label and the link have to be one component tree:
        // two sendMessage calls would put the label above the link.
        TextComponent message = new TextComponent(TextComponent.fromLegacyText(label));
        TextComponent target = new TextComponent(TextComponent.fromLegacyText(link));
        target.setClickEvent(new ClickEvent(ClickEvent.Action.OPEN_URL, url));
        target.setHoverEvent(new HoverEvent(HoverEvent.Action.SHOW_TEXT,
                new Text(plugin.lang().text("connect.hover"))));
        message.addExtra(target);
        player.spigot().sendMessage(message);
    }

    private void watch(CommandSender sender, String token, long startedAt) {
        poll = plugin.ticks().every(POLL_TICKS, () -> {
            if (System.currentTimeMillis() - startedAt > TIMEOUT_MS) {
                stop();
                replyKey(sender, "connect.expired");
                return;
            }
            plugin.api().linkStatus(token).thenAccept(response ->
                    plugin.mainThread().run(() -> settle(sender, response)));
        });
    }

    private void settle(CommandSender sender, JsonObject response) {
        if (response == null || !response.has("state")) {
            return;
        }
        String state = response.get("state").getAsString();
        if (state.equals("waiting")) {
            return;
        }
        stop();
        if (!state.equals("linked") || !response.has("key")) {
            replyKey(sender, "connect.expired");
            return;
        }
        String key = response.get("key").getAsString();
        plugin.getConfig().set("api.key", key);
        plugin.saveConfig();
        plugin.reloadEverything();
        replyKey(sender, "connect.done", Map.of("address",
                response.has("address") ? response.get("address").getAsString() : "-"));
    }

    private void stop() {
        if (poll != null) {
            poll.cancel();
            poll = null;
        }
    }
}
```
