`src/main/java/me/everyone/oculusai/command/sub/CrystalDataCommand.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.command.sub;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture;
import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;
import me.everyone.oculusai.command.SubCommand;
import me.everyone.oculusai.player.PlayerData;
import me.everyone.oculusai.storage.CrystalDataset;
import org.bukkit.command.CommandSender;

/** /ai ml crystal - запись кристалльного датасета (схема 8).
 *
 * <p>Повторяет /oai data, но со своим списком игроков и своим пулом: окна
 * режутся вокруг постановок и ударов по кристаллам, а не каждые полсекунды
 * боя. */
public final class CrystalDataCommand extends SubCommand {

    private static final List<String> ACTIONS = List.of("add", "rem", "train", "stop", "list");

    public CrystalDataCommand(OculusAI plugin) {
        super(plugin, "datacrystal", List.of("crystaldata"), "oculusai.data",
                "/ai ml crystal add|rem|train|stop|list",
                "Record the crystal PvP dataset (CrystalAura, AutoCrystal).", false);
    }

    private CrystalDataset dataset() {
        return plugin.crystalData();
    }

    @Override
    public void execute(CommandSender sender, String[] args) {
        String action = args.length == 0 ? "" : args[0].toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        switch (action) {
            case "add" -> add(sender, args);
            case "rem", "remove" -> remove(sender, args);
            case "train", "start" -> start(sender);
            case "stop" -> stop(sender);
            case "list" -> list(sender);
            default -> replyKey(sender, "crystal-data.usage");
        }
    }

    private void add(CommandSender sender, String[] args) {
        if (args.length < 3 || !(args[1].equalsIgnoreCase("cheater") || args[1].equalsIgnoreCase("legit"))) {
            replyKey(sender, "crystal-data.usage");
            return;
        }
        PlayerData data = plugin.data().byName(args[2]);
        if (data == null) {
            replyKey(sender, "shared.player-offline");
            return;
        }
        String label = args[1].toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        dataset().enrol(data, label);
        replyKey(sender, "crystal-data.added", Map.of("player", data.name(), "label", label));
    }

    private void remove(CommandSender sender, String[] args) {
        CrystalDataset.Entry entry = args.length < 2 ? null : dataset().byName(args[1]);
        if (entry == null) {
            replyKey(sender, "crystal-data.unknown", Map.of("player", args.length < 2 ? "?" : args[1]));
            return;
        }
        dataset().unenrol(entry.uuid());
        replyKey(sender, "crystal-data.removed", Map.of("player", entry.name()));
    }

    private void start(CommandSender sender) {
        if (dataset().roster().isEmpty()) {
            replyKey(sender, "crystal-data.empty");
            return;
        }
        int started = dataset().start();
        replyKey(sender, "crystal-data.started", Map.of("value", Integer.toString(started)));
    }

    private void stop(CommandSender sender) {
        if (!dataset().serviceAccepts()) {
            // Окна остаются у игроков: после обновления сервиса stop
            // отправит их. Отправить сейчас - значит получить отказ и
            // вечный повтор в очереди.
            replyKey(sender, "crystal-data.service-old");
            return;
        }
        Map<String, CompletableFuture<Integer>> results = dataset().stop();
        if (results.isEmpty()) {
            replyKey(sender, "crystal-data.nothing");
            return;
        }
        replyKey(sender, "crystal-data.sending", Map.of("value", Integer.toString(results.size())));
        results.forEach((name, future) -> future.thenAccept(stored -> plugin.mainThread().run(() ->
                replyKey(sender, stored == null ? "crystal-data.failed" : "crystal-data.saved",
                        Map.of("player", name, "value", stored == null ? "0" : stored.toString())))));
    }

    private void list(CommandSender sender) {
        if (dataset().roster().isEmpty()) {
            replyKey(sender, "crystal-data.empty");
            return;
        }
        replyKey(sender, dataset().collecting() ? "crystal-data.list-recording" : "crystal-data.list-idle");
        for (CrystalDataset.Entry entry : dataset().roster()) {
            int recorded = dataset().recorded(entry.uuid());
            replyKey(sender, "crystal-data.list-line", Map.of(
                    "player", entry.name(),
                    "label", entry.label(),
                    "value", recorded < 0 ? "offline" : Integer.toString(recorded)));
        }
    }

    @Override
    public List<String> complete(CommandSender sender, String[] args) {
        if (args.length == 1) {
            return filter(ACTIONS, args[0]);
        }
        if (args.length == 2 && args[0].equalsIgnoreCase("add")) {
            return filter(List.of("cheater", "legit"), args[1]);
        }
        if (args.length == 3 && args[0].equalsIgnoreCase("add")) {
            return onlineNames(args[2]);
        }
        if (args.length == 2 && args[0].toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).startsWith("rem")) {
            List<String> names = new ArrayList<>();
            for (CrystalDataset.Entry entry : dataset().roster()) {
                names.add(entry.name());
            }
            return filter(names, args[1]);
        }
        return List.of();
    }

    private static List<String> filter(List<String> options, String typed) {
        String lower = typed.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        List<String> out = new ArrayList<>();
        for (String option : options) {
            if (option.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).startsWith(lower)) {
                out.add(option);
            }
        }
        return out;
    }
}
```

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.command.sub;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;
import me.everyone.oculusai.command.SubCommand;
import org.bukkit.command.CommandSender;

/** Continuously prints the latest crystal-model reading. */
public final class CrystalMonitorCommand extends SubCommand {

    public CrystalMonitorCommand(OculusAI plugin) {
        super(plugin, "monitorcrystal", List.of("crystalmonitor"), "oculusai.alerts",
                "/oai monitorcrystal [stop|player...]",
                "Watch crystal model readings.", false);
    }

    @Override
    public void execute(CommandSender sender, String[] args) {
        if (args.length == 0) {
            plugin.monitors().toggleCrystal(sender);
            return;
        }
        String first = args[0].toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        if (first.equals("stop") || first.equals("off") || first.equals("clear")) {
            plugin.monitors().stop(sender);
            return;
        }
        plugin.monitors().startCrystal(sender, List.of(args));
    }

    @Override
    public List<String> complete(CommandSender sender, String[] args) {
        if (args.length == 1) {
            List<String> options = new ArrayList<>(plugin.monitors().onlineNames(args[0]));
            for (String option : List.of("stop", "off")) {
                if (option.startsWith(args[0].toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT))) {
                    options.add(option);
                }
            }
            return options;
        }
        return plugin.monitors().onlineNames(args[args.length - 1]);
    }
}
```

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.command.sub;

import java.util.ArrayList;

import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;

import me.everyone.oculusai.core.Msg;
import me.everyone.oculusai.player.PlayerData;
import org.bukkit.command.CommandSender;
import org.bukkit.entity.Player;

/** Shows the last probability produced by the crystal model. */
public final class CrystalProbCommand extends SubCommand {

    public CrystalProbCommand(OculusAI plugin) {
        super(plugin, "probcrystal", List.of("crystalprob"), "oculusai.alerts",
                "/oai probcrystal <player|off>",
                "Show a player's crystal model reading.", true);
    }

    @Override
    public void execute(CommandSender sender, String[] args) {
        Player watcher = (Player) sender;
        if (args.length == 0 || args[0].equalsIgnoreCase("off")
                || args[0].equalsIgnoreCase("stop")) {
            plugin.displays().stop(watcher);
            return;
        }

        PlayerData target = plugin.data().byName(args[0]);
        if (target == null) {
            replyKey(sender, "shared.player-offline");
            return;
        }

        double probability = target.crystal().probability();
        String value = Double.isNaN(probability) ? "-" : Msg.probability(probability);
        reply(sender, "<white>Crystal probability <accent>" + value
                + "<white> | buffer <accent>" + Msg.round(target.crystal().buffer(), 1)
                + "<white> | <accent>" + target.name());
    }

    @Override
    public List<String> complete(CommandSender sender, String[] args) {
        if (args.length != 1) {
            return List.of();
        }
        List<String> options = new ArrayList<>(onlineNames(args[0]));
        if ("off".startsWith(args[0].toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT))) {
            options.add("off");
        }
        return options;
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/me/everyone/oculusai/command/sub/DataCommand.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.command.sub;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture;
import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;
import me.everyone.oculusai.command.SubCommand;
import me.everyone.oculusai.player.PlayerData;
import me.everyone.oculusai.storage.DatasetStore;
import me.everyone.oculusai.core.Msg;
import org.bukkit.OfflinePlayer;
import org.bukkit.command.CommandSender;

public final class DataCommand extends SubCommand {

    public DataCommand(OculusAI plugin) {
        super(plugin, "data", List.of("dataset"), "oculusai.data",
                "/ai ml data add|rem|train|stop|list ...", "Record and label training data.", false);
    }

    @Override
    public void execute(CommandSender sender, String[] args) {
        if (args.length == 0) {
            usage(sender);
            return;
        }

        switch (args[0].toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)) {
            case "add" -> add(sender, args);
            case "rem", "remove" -> remove(sender, args);
            case "train", "start" -> start(sender, args);
            case "stop" -> stop(sender);
            case "list" -> list(sender);
            case "delete" -> delete(sender, args);
            default -> usage(sender);
        }
    }

    private void add(CommandSender sender, String[] args) {
        if (args.length < 3 || !DatasetStore.isLabel(args[1])) {
            reply(sender, "<white>Usage: <accent>/ai ml data add cheater|legit &lt;player&gt;");
            return;
        }
        PlayerData data = plugin.data().byName(args[2]);
        if (data == null) {
            reply(sender, "<white>That player is not online.");
            return;
        }

        String label = args[1].toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        plugin.datasets().enrol(data, label);
        reply(sender, "<white>Signed up <accent>" + data.name() + "<white> as <accent>" + label
                + "<white>." + (plugin.datasets().collecting()
                ? " <white>Recording already running, they joined it."
                : " <white>Start with <accent>/ai ml data train<white>."));
    }

    private void remove(CommandSender sender, String[] args) {
        if (args.length < 2) {
            reply(sender, "<white>Usage: <accent>/ai ml data rem &lt;player&gt;");
            return;
        }
        // The roster keeps a player after they log off, so the admin who wants
        // somebody off it is usually looking at somebody who is not online.
        DatasetStore.RosterEntry entry = rosterEntry(args[1]);
        if (entry == null) {
            reply(sender, "<white>Nobody called <accent>" + args[1] + "<white> is on the roster.");
            return;
        }
        reply(sender, plugin.datasets().unenrol(entry.uuid())
                ? "<white>Removed <accent>" + entry.name() + "<white> from the roster."
                : "<white>They were not on it.");
    }

    private void start(CommandSender sender, String[] args) {
        // Умолчание - обе схемы сразу. Схемы различаются не колонками, а тем,
        // что лежит под строкой, и одна запись годится для обеих: выбирать в
        // момент записи нечего, а выбрав одну, оператор узнаёт об этом через
        // полчаса боёв, когда моделям другого вида учиться уже не на чем.
        int schema = DatasetStore.SCHEMA_BOTH;
        if (args.length > 1) {
            schema = DatasetStore.parseSchema(args[1]);
            if (schema == -1) {
                reply(sender, "<white>Usage: <accent>/ai ml data train [both|old|new|auto]");
                return;
            }
        }
        if (plugin.datasets().roster().isEmpty()) {
            reply(sender, "<white>Nobody is signed up. <accent>/ai ml data add cheater|legit &lt;player&gt;");
            return;
        }
        plugin.datasets().setSchema(schema);
        int started = plugin.datasets().start(sender);
        int resolved = plugin.datasets().effectiveSchema();
        String shown = schema == DatasetStore.SCHEMA_AUTO
                ? DatasetStore.schemaName(resolved) + " (auto)"
                : DatasetStore.schemaName(schema);
        reply(sender, "<white>Recording <accent>" + started + "<white> player(s) as <accent>"
                + shown
                + "<white>. Windows are only taken while they fight - "
                + "<accent>/ai ml data stop<white> saves everything.");
        if (schema == DatasetStore.SCHEMA_BOTH) {
            reply(sender, "<white>  One capture, two sessions: <accent>old<white> trains"
                    + " the column models, <accent>new<white> the trajectory one.");
        }
    }

    private void stop(CommandSender sender) {
        Map<String, CompletableFuture<Integer>> results = plugin.datasets().stop();
        if (results.isEmpty()) {
            reply(sender, "<white>Stopped. Nothing captured - windows are only taken"
                    + " while the players are actually fighting.");
            return;
        }

        reply(sender, "<white>Stopped, sending <accent>" + results.size() + "<white> session(s)...");
        results.forEach((name, future) -> future.thenAccept(stored -> reply(sender, stored == null
                ? "<accent>" + name + "<white>: the service refused the session."
                : "<accent>" + name + "<white>: <accent>" + stored + "<white> windows saved.")));
    }

    private void list(CommandSender sender) {
        var roster = plugin.datasets().roster();
        if (roster.isEmpty()) {
            reply(sender, "<white>Roster is empty.");
            return;
        }
        reply(sender, "<white>Roster " + (plugin.datasets().collecting()
                ? "(recording)" : "(idle)") + ":");
        for (DatasetStore.RosterEntry entry : roster) {
            PlayerData data = plugin.data().get(entry.uuid());
            String captured = data == null ? "offline" : data.recordedCount() + " windows";
            sender.sendMessage(Msg.parse(accented(
                    "<white> - <accent>" + entry.name()
                            + "<white> - " + entry.label()
                            + " - " + captured)));
        }
    }

    private void delete(CommandSender sender, String[] args) {
        if (args.length < 3 || !DatasetStore.isLabel(args[1])) {
            reply(sender, "<white>Usage: <accent>/ai ml data delete cheater|legit &lt;player&gt;");
            return;
        }
        String label = args[1].toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        // Stored data outlives the session, so the player whose data is being
        // dropped is often not online any more.
        DatasetStore.RosterEntry entry = rosterEntry(args[2]);
        if (entry != null) {
            deleteStored(sender, entry.uuid(), entry.name(), label);
            return;
        }
        UUID uuid = uuidOf(args[2]);
        if (uuid == null) {
            reply(sender, "<white>Nobody called <accent>" + args[2] + "<white> is known to this server.");
            return;
        }
        deleteStored(sender, uuid, args[2], label);
    }

    private void deleteStored(CommandSender sender, UUID uuid, String name, String label) {
        plugin.datasets().remove(uuid.toString(), label).thenAccept(removed ->
                reply(sender, removed == null
                        ? "<white>The service did not answer or refused the change."
                        : "<white>Deleted <accent>" + removed + "<white> stored <accent>" + label
                        + "<white> windows for <accent>" + name + "<white>."));
    }

    /** The roster entry a name belongs to, online or not.
     *
     * <p>The name is looked for on the roster first, then among the players
     * the server still knows about: that way a rename does not strand the
     * entry, and a player who already left can still be taken off the
     * roster. */
    private DatasetStore.RosterEntry rosterEntry(String name) {
        DatasetStore.RosterEntry entry = plugin.datasets().entryByName(name);
        if (entry != null) {
            return entry;
        }
        UUID uuid = uuidOf(name);
        return uuid == null ? null : plugin.datasets().entry(uuid);
    }

    /** The UUID of a player, online or not.
     *
     * <p>Only the cached name is asked for: a fresh lookup would go out to the
     * Mojang API and hold the server thread while it waits. */
    private UUID uuidOf(String name) {
        if (name == null || name.isBlank()) {
            return null;
        }
        PlayerData data = plugin.data().byName(name);
        if (data != null) {
            return data.uuid();
        }
        try {
            OfflinePlayer cached = plugin.getServer().getOfflinePlayerIfCached(name);
            return cached == null ? null : cached.getUniqueId();
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException refused) {
            // The server turns down names it cannot look up, a name that is
            // empty or too long for a profile for instance.
            return null;
        }
    }

    /** The names on the roster that start with what has been typed. */
    private List<String> rosterNames(String partial) {
        String lower = partial.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        List<String> names = new ArrayList<>();
        for (DatasetStore.RosterEntry entry : plugin.datasets().roster()) {
            if (entry.name() != null && entry.name().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).startsWith(lower)) {
                names.add(entry.name());
            }
        }
        return names;
    }

    private void usage(CommandSender sender) {
        reply(sender, "<accent>1. <white>Sign the cast up:");
        reply(sender, "   <accent>/ai ml data add cheater &lt;player&gt;");
        reply(sender, "   <accent>/ai ml data add legit &lt;player&gt;");
        reply(sender, "<accent>2. <white>Run it: <accent>/ai ml data train <white>... they fight ... <accent>/ai ml data stop");
        reply(sender, "   <white>Stopping sends every capture to the service straight away.");
        reply(sender, "   <white>By default one capture becomes two sessions, one per schema:");
        reply(sender, "   <accent>old<white> is the window columns, which the column models read;");
        reply(sender, "   <accent>new<white> is those plus the raw ticks, which the trajectory model reads.");
        reply(sender, "   <white>Name one - <accent>/ai ml data train old<white> - only to record just it.");
        reply(sender, "   <white>Two or three short sessions per player beats one long one.");
        reply(sender, "<white>Also: <accent>list<white>, <accent>rem &lt;player&gt;<white> (off the roster),");
        reply(sender, "<white><accent>delete cheater|legit &lt;player&gt;<white> (drop stored data).");
        reply(sender, "<white>Train the model in <accent>/oai dashboard<white>.");
    }

    @Override
    public List<String> complete(CommandSender sender, String[] args) {
        if (args.length == 1) {
            List<String> options = new ArrayList<>(List.of("add", "rem", "train", "stop", "list", "delete"));
            options.removeIf(option -> !option.startsWith(args[0].toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)));
            return options;
        }

        if (args.length == 2 && (args[0].equalsIgnoreCase("train") || args[0].equalsIgnoreCase("start"))) {
            List<String> versions = new ArrayList<>(List.of("both", "old", "new", "auto"));
            versions.removeIf(version -> !version.startsWith(args[1].toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)));
            return versions;
        }

        boolean needsLabel = args[0].equalsIgnoreCase("add") || args[0].equalsIgnoreCase("delete");
        if (args.length == 2) {
            if (args[0].equalsIgnoreCase("rem") || args[0].equalsIgnoreCase("remove")) {
                // Only the roster, and not the players who happen to be
                // online: rem answers "nobody called that is on the roster"
                // for anybody else, so offering those names was offering
                // rejections. The roster keeps a player after they log off,
                // which is the usual case for taking somebody off it.
                return rosterNames(args[1]);
            }
            if (!needsLabel) {
                return knownNames(args[1]);
            }
            List<String> labels = new ArrayList<>(List.of(DatasetStore.CHEATER, DatasetStore.LEGIT));
            labels.removeIf(label -> !label.startsWith(args[1].toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)));
            return labels;
        }
        if (args.length == 3 && needsLabel) {
            // Signing up needs a player who is here; dropping stored data
            // does not.
            return args[0].equalsIgnoreCase("delete") ? knownNames(args[2]) : onlineNames(args[2]);
        }
        return List.of();
    }

    /** The names that can be picked: the players online and the ones the
     *  server still knows about, the roster included. */
    private List<String> knownNames(String partial) {
        List<String> names = new ArrayList<>(rosterNames(partial));
        for (String name : onlineNames(partial)) {
            if (!names.contains(name)) {
                names.add(name);
            }
        }
        return names;
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/me/everyone/oculusai/command/sub/ForgetCommand.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.command.sub;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;
import me.everyone.oculusai.command.SubCommand;
import me.everyone.oculusai.player.PlayerData;
import org.bukkit.command.CommandSender;

public final class ForgetCommand extends SubCommand {

    public ForgetCommand(OculusAI plugin) {
        super(plugin, "forget", List.of("clear", "reset"), "oculusai.alerts",
                "/oai forget <player>", "Drop the current suspicion and start over.", false);
    }

    @Override
    public void execute(CommandSender sender, String[] args) {
        if (args.length == 0) {
            replyKey(sender, "forget.usage", Map.of("value", usageText()));
            return;
        }

        PlayerData data = plugin.data().byName(args[0]);
        if (data == null) {
            replyKey(sender, "shared.player-offline");
            return;
        }

        plugin.punishments().forget(data.uuid());
        // Only here. The same method runs on every quit and on every bypass
        // toggle, and neither of those is anybody saying "wipe this player".
        plugin.banCounter().forget(data.uuid());
        plugin.analysis().forget(data.uuid());
        // Журнал теперь переживает перезапуск, поэтому забытый игрок должен
        // уходить и оттуда: иначе он остаётся в списке подозрительных с
        // буфером, которого у него больше нет.
        plugin.journal().forget(data.uuid());
        // И записанные секунды тоже: реплей это доказательство подозрения, а
        // снятое подозрение не должно оставлять за собой записей.
        plugin.replays().forget(data.uuid());
        data.recording(false, null);
        data.clearRecorded();
        data.clearWindow();
        data.resetBuffer();

        replyKey(sender, "forget.done", Map.of("player", data.name()));
    }

    @Override
    public List<String> complete(CommandSender sender, String[] args) {
        return args.length == 1 ? onlineNames(args[0]) : List.of();
    }
}
```

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.command.sub;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;
import me.everyone.oculusai.command.SubCommand;
import me.everyone.oculusai.command.Commands;
import me.everyone.oculusai.core.Msg;
import org.bukkit.command.CommandSender;

public final class HelpCommand extends SubCommand {

    private final Commands commands;

    public HelpCommand(OculusAI plugin, Commands commands) {
        super(plugin, "help", List.of("?"), null, "/oai help", "Show this list.", false);
        this.commands = commands;
    }

    @Override
    public void execute(CommandSender sender, String[] args) {
        sender.sendMessage(plugin.lang().text("help.divider"));
        sender.sendMessage(plugin.config().prefix() + plugin.lang().text("help.header", Map.of(
                "version", plugin.getDescription().getVersion(),
                "status", plugin.lang().text(plugin.api().reachable() ? "help.status.up" : "help.status.down"))));
        for (SubCommand command : commands.subCommands()) {
            if (command.permission() != null && !sender.hasPermission(command.permission())) {
                continue;
            }
            sender.sendMessage(Msg.parse(accented("<accent>" + command.usageText()
                    + " <white>- "
                    + plugin.lang().textOr("help.command." + command.name(), command.description()))));
        }
        sender.sendMessage(plugin.lang().text("help.divider"));
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/me/everyone/oculusai/command/sub/HistoryCommand.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.command.sub;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;
import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;
import me.everyone.oculusai.command.SubCommand;
import me.everyone.oculusai.player.PlayerData;
import org.bukkit.command.CommandSender;
import org.bukkit.entity.Player;

public final class HistoryCommand extends SubCommand {

    public HistoryCommand(OculusAI plugin) {
        super(plugin, "history", List.of("hist", "log"), "oculusai.journal",
                "/oai history [ник]", "Browse a player's detection history.", true);
    }

    @Override
    public void execute(CommandSender sender, String[] args) {
        PlayerData target;
        if (args.length == 0) {
            target = plugin.data().get((Player) sender);
            if (target == null) {
                replyKey(sender, "history.no-data");
                return;
            }
        } else {
            target = plugin.data().byName(args[0]);
            if (target == null) {
                UUID stored = plugin.history().resolve(args[0]);
                if (stored == null) {
                    replyKey(sender, "history.unknown-player",
                            Map.of("player", args[0]));
                    return;
                }
                plugin.menus().openHistory((Player) sender, stored, args[0]);
                return;
            }
        }

        plugin.menus().openHistory((Player) sender, target);
    }

    @Override
    public List<String> complete(CommandSender sender, String[] args) {
        if (args.length != 1) {
            return List.of();
        }
        List<String> options = new ArrayList<>(onlineNames(args[0]));
        String prefix = args[0].toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        for (UUID uuid : plugin.history().tracked()) {
            String name = plugin.history().nameOf(uuid);
            if (name != null && name.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).startsWith(prefix)
                    && !options.contains(name)) {
                options.add(name);
            }
        }
        return options;
    }
}
```

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.command.sub;

import java.util.List;
import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;
import me.everyone.oculusai.command.SubCommand;
import org.bukkit.command.CommandSender;

/** Switches what /oai prob shows.
 *
 * <p>On by default: the command prints the smoothed probability that feeds the
 * buffer. With it off the command prints the model's raw probability instead.
 * The buffer keeps integrating in both modes, so Aim alerts and punishments do
 * not change. Running the command again puts the smoothed view back. */
public final class MathCommand extends SubCommand {

    public MathCommand(OculusAI plugin) {
        super(plugin, "math", List.of("buffer"), "oculusai.command",
                "/oai math", "Show the raw model probability instead of the smoothed one.", false);
    }

    @Override
    public void execute(CommandSender sender, String[] args) {
        boolean math = plugin.detection().toggleMath();
        // textOr, not text: a server whose language file predates this command
        // must still see a real message rather than the key name.
        sender.sendMessage(plugin.config().prefix() + plugin.lang().textOr(
                math ? "math.enabled" : "math.disabled",
                math ? "<white>Prob shows the smoothed reading. The buffer, "
                        + "Aim alerts and punishments work as usual."
                     : "<white>Prob shows the raw model probability. The buffer "
                        + "and checks keep running."));
    }

    @Override
    public List<String> complete(CommandSender sender, String[] args) {
        return List.of();
    }
}
```

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.command.sub;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;
import me.everyone.oculusai.command.SubCommand;
import org.bukkit.command.CommandSender;
import org.bukkit.entity.Player;

/** Entry point for all interactive menus. */
public final class MenuCommand extends SubCommand {
    public MenuCommand(OculusAI plugin) {
        super(plugin, "menu", List.of(), "oculusai.command",
                "/oai menu [dashboard|journal|checks|settings|sessions]",
                "Open a menu.", true);
    }

    @Override
    public void execute(CommandSender sender, String[] args) {
        Player player = (Player) sender;
        String menu = args.length == 0 ? "dashboard" : args[0].toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        switch (menu) {
            case "dashboard", "main" -> plugin.menus().openDashboard(player);
            case "journal" -> plugin.menus().openJournal(player);
            case "checks" -> plugin.menus().openChecks(player);
            case "settings" -> plugin.menus().openSettings(player);
            case "sessions" -> plugin.menus().openSessions(player);
            default -> reply(sender, "<white>Unknown menu. Use <accent>dashboard, journal, checks, settings<white> or <accent>sessions<white>.");
        }
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/me/everyone/oculusai/command/sub/MlCommand.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.command.sub;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.LinkedHashSet;
import java.util.Set;
import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;
import me.everyone.oculusai.command.SubCommand;
import me.everyone.oculusai.network.ApiClient.ModelChoice;
import org.bukkit.command.CommandSender;
import org.bukkit.command.ConsoleCommandSender;

/** Routes ML captures through the selected dataset type. */
public final class MlCommand extends SubCommand {
    private static final List<String> TYPES = List.of("default", "crystal", "both");
    private final DataCommand aim;
    private final CrystalDataCommand crystal;
    private String type;

    public MlCommand(OculusAI plugin) {
        super(plugin, "ml", List.of("dataset", "data"), null,
                "/ai ml <data|datatype|change> ...", "Record training data or switch aim models.", false);
        aim = new DataCommand(plugin);
        crystal = new CrystalDataCommand(plugin);
        type = plugin.getConfig().getString("ml.datatype", "default");
        if (!TYPES.contains(type)) {
            type = "default";
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void execute(CommandSender sender, String[] args) {
        if (args.length == 0) {
            if (canUseDatasets(sender)) {
                reply(sender, "<white>Usage: <accent>/ai ml data add|train|stop|rem|list");
                reply(sender, "<white>Dataset: <accent>/ai ml datatype default|crystal|both");
            }
            reply(sender, "<white>Model: <accent>/ai ml change [model]");
            return;
        }
        String action = args[0].toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        String[] rest = Arrays.copyOfRange(args, 1, args.length);
        if (action.equals("change")) {
            changeModel(sender, rest);
            return;
        }
        if (!canUseDatasets(sender)) {
            reply(sender, "<white>Usage: <accent>/ai ml change [model]");
            return;
        }
        if (action.equals("datatype")) {
            if (rest.length == 1 && TYPES.contains(rest[0].toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT))) {
                type = rest[0].toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
                plugin.getConfig().set("ml.datatype", type);
                plugin.saveConfig();
            } else if (rest.length != 0) {
                reply(sender, "<white>Usage: <accent>/ai ml datatype default|crystal|both");
                return;
            }
            reply(sender, "<white>Dataset type: <accent>" + type);
            return;
        }
        if (action.equals("data") || action.equals("default") || action.equals("crystal")) {
            String selected = action.equals("data") ? type : action;
            if (rest.length == 0) {
                reply(sender, "<white>Usage: <accent>/ai ml data add|train|stop|rem|list");
                return;
            }
            if (selected.equals("crystal") && rest[0].equalsIgnoreCase("delete")) {
                reply(sender, "<white>Deleting stored sessions is available in the dashboard.");
                return;
            }
            if (!selected.equals("crystal")) {
                aim.execute(sender, rest);
            }
            if (!selected.equals("default") && !rest[0].equalsIgnoreCase("delete")) {
                crystal.execute(sender, rest);
            }
            return;
        }
        reply(sender, "<white>Usage: <accent>/ai ml data|datatype|change");
    }

    private boolean canUseDatasets(CommandSender sender) {
        return plugin.api().datasetAccess() && (sender instanceof ConsoleCommandSender
                || (sender.hasPermission("oculusai.command") && sender.hasPermission("oculusai.data")));
    }

    private void changeModel(CommandSender sender, String[] args) {
        List<ModelChoice> choices = plugin.api().allowedModels();
        if (args.length == 1 && !(sender instanceof ConsoleCommandSender)
                && !sender.hasPermission("oculusai.command")) {
            replyKey(sender, "command.no-permission");
            return;
        }
        if (args.length == 1) {
            for (ModelChoice choice : choices) {
                if (!choice.command().equalsIgnoreCase(args[0])) {
                    continue;
                }
                if (!choice.allowed()) {
                    reply(sender, "<white>This model is locked by the server plan.");
                    return;
                }
                if (choice.id().equals(plugin.api().activeModelChoice())) {
                    reply(sender, "<white>Already active: <accent>" + choice.command());
                    return;
                }
                plugin.api().changeModel(choice).whenComplete((ok, failure) ->
                        plugin.mainThread().run(() -> {
                            if (failure != null || !Boolean.TRUE.equals(ok)) {
                                reply(sender, "<white>Model change rejected by the service.");
                                return;
                            }
                            reply(sender, "<white>Active model: <accent>" + choice.command());
                        }));
                return;
            }
        }
        String active = choices.stream().filter(choice -> choice.id().equals(plugin.api().activeModelChoice()))
                .map(ModelChoice::command).findFirst().orElse("—");
        String available = String.join(", ", choices.stream().map(ModelChoice::command).toList());
        reply(sender, "<white>Active: <accent>" + active + "<white>. Allowed: <accent>"
                + (available.isEmpty() ? "—" : available));
    }

    @Override
    public List<String> complete(CommandSender sender, String[] args) {
        if (args.length == 1) {
            return filter(canUseDatasets(sender) ? List.of("data", "datatype", "change")
                    : List.of("change"), args[0]);
        }
        if (args.length < 2) {
            return List.of();
        }

        String action = args[0].toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        if (action.equals("change")) {
            return args.length == 2
                    ? filter(plugin.api().allowedModels().stream().map(ModelChoice::command).toList(), args[1])
                    : List.of();
        }
        if (!canUseDatasets(sender)) {
            return List.of();
        }
        if (action.equals("datatype")) {
            return args.length == 2 ? filter(TYPES, args[1]) : List.of();
        }
        if (!List.of("data", "default", "crystal").contains(action)) {
            return List.of();
        }
        String mode = action.equals("data") ? type : action;
        String[] rest = Arrays.copyOfRange(args, 1, args.length);
        Set<String> choices = new LinkedHashSet<>();
        if (!mode.equals("crystal")) {
            choices.addAll(aim.complete(sender, rest));
        }
        if (!mode.equals("default")) {
            choices.addAll(crystal.complete(sender, rest));
        }
        return List.copyOf(choices);
    }

    private static List<String> filter(List<String> options, String typed) {
        String lower = typed.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        return options.stream()
                .filter(option -> option.startsWith(lower))
                .toList();
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/me/everyone/oculusai/command/sub/NpcCommand.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.command.sub;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;
import me.everyone.oculusai.command.SubCommand;
import me.everyone.oculusai.npc.NpcOptions;
import org.bukkit.command.CommandSender;
import org.bukkit.entity.Player;

public final class NpcCommand extends SubCommand {

    public NpcCommand(OculusAI plugin) {
        super(plugin, "npc", List.of("dummy", "sparring"), "oculusai.npc",
                "/oai npc [count|clear] [hp:<n>] [still] [mortal]",
                "Spawn a sparring dummy that attacks you.", true);
    }

    @Override
    public void execute(CommandSender sender, String[] args) {
        Player player = (Player) sender;

        if (args.length > 0 && (args[0].equalsIgnoreCase("clear") || args[0].equalsIgnoreCase("off"))) {
            plugin.npcs().clearOwned(player.getUniqueId());
            replyKey(sender, "npc.cleared");
            return;
        }

        int requested = 1;
        double health = -1.0D;
        boolean stationary = false;
        boolean invulnerable = true;

        for (String arg : args) {
            if (arg.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).startsWith("hp:")) {
                try {
                    health = Double.parseDouble(arg.substring(3));
                } catch (NumberFormatException ignored) {
                    replyKey(sender, "npc.usage", Map.of("value", usageText()));
                    return;
                }
                continue;
            }
            if (arg.equalsIgnoreCase("still") || arg.equalsIgnoreCase("stationary")) {
                stationary = true;
                continue;
            }
            if (arg.equalsIgnoreCase("mortal") || arg.equalsIgnoreCase("vulnerable")) {
                invulnerable = false;
                continue;
            }
            try {
                requested = Integer.parseInt(arg);
            } catch (NumberFormatException ignored) {
                replyKey(sender, "npc.usage", Map.of("value", usageText()));
                return;
            }
        }

        NpcOptions options = new NpcOptions(health, stationary, invulnerable);
        int spawned = plugin.testServer().spawnDummies(player, requested, options);
        if (spawned == 0) {
            replyKey(sender, plugin.npcs().supported() ? "npc.full" : "npc.unsupported");
            return;
        }
        replyKey(sender, "npc.spawned", Map.of("value", Integer.toString(spawned)));
    }

    @Override
    public List<String> complete(CommandSender sender, String[] args) {
        if (args.length == 0) {
            return List.of();
        }
        return List.of("1", "3", "clear", "hp:50", "still", "mortal");
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/me/everyone/oculusai/command/sub/PlayerCommand.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.command.sub;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;
import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;
import me.everyone.oculusai.command.SubCommand;
import me.everyone.oculusai.player.PlayerData;
import me.everyone.oculusai.core.Msg;
import org.bukkit.command.CommandSender;

public final class PlayerCommand extends SubCommand {

    public PlayerCommand(OculusAI plugin) {
        super(plugin, "player", List.of("pl", "info"), "oculusai.alerts",
                "/oai player <nick>", "View a player's suspicion data.", false);
    }

    @Override
    public void execute(CommandSender sender, String[] args) {
        if (args.length == 0) {
            replyKey(sender, "player-cmd.usage", Map.of("value", "/oai player <nick>"));
            return;
        }

        PlayerData data = plugin.data().byName(args[0]);
        if (data == null) {
            replyKey(sender, "shared.player-offline");
            return;
        }

        plugin.platform().onEntity(data.player(), () -> show(sender, data));
    }

    private void show(CommandSender sender, PlayerData data) {
        var player = data.player();
        String brand = player.getClientBrandName();
        if (brand != null) {
            brand = brand.replaceAll("[^\\p{L}\\p{N}_.:/+ -]", "").strip();
            brand = brand.substring(0, Math.min(brand.length(), 32));
        }
        int sensitivity = data.estimatedSensitivity();
        String top = data.topProbabilities().stream().map(Msg::probability)
                .collect(Collectors.joining(" / "));
        long seconds = Math.max(0, System.currentTimeMillis() - data.sessionStartedAt()) / 1000;
        String duration = seconds >= 3600 ? "%dh %02dm".formatted(seconds / 3600, seconds / 60 % 60)
                : "%dm %02ds".formatted(seconds / 60, seconds % 60);

        replyKey(sender, "player-cmd.header", Map.of("player", data.name()));
        replyKey(sender, "player-cmd.session-summary", Map.of(
                "time", duration, "brand", brand == null || brand.isEmpty() ? "—" : brand,
                "ping", Integer.toString(player.getPing()),
                "sensitivity", sensitivity < 0 ? "—" : "~" + sensitivity + "%"));
        replyKey(sender, "player-cmd.detection-summary", Map.of(
                "buffer", Msg.round(data.buffer(), 1), "max", Msg.round(plugin.config().bufferMax(), 0),
                "current", data.windowsAnalysed() == 0 ? "—" : Msg.probability(
                        data.displayProbability(!plugin.detection().mathEnabled())),
                "windows", Integer.toString(data.windowsAnalysed())));
        replyKey(sender, "player-cmd.top-summary", Map.of("top", top.isEmpty() ? "—" : top));
    }

    @Override
    public List<String> complete(CommandSender sender, String[] args) {
        if (args.length != 1) return List.of();
        return onlineNames(args[0]);
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/me/everyone/oculusai/command/sub/ProbCommand.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.command.sub;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;
import me.everyone.oculusai.command.SubCommand;
import me.everyone.oculusai.player.PlayerData;
import me.everyone.oculusai.core.Msg;
import org.bukkit.command.CommandSender;
import org.bukkit.entity.Player;

public final class ProbCommand extends SubCommand {

    public ProbCommand(OculusAI plugin) {
        super(plugin, "prob", List.of("watch", "p"), "oculusai.alerts",
                "/oai prob <default|crystal|both> <player>",
                "Show a player's model readings.", true);
    }

    @Override
    public void execute(CommandSender sender, String[] args) {
        Player watcher = (Player) sender;

        if (args.length == 1 && args[0].equalsIgnoreCase("off")) {
            plugin.displays().stop(watcher);
            return;
        }

        if (args.length != 2 || !isMode(args[0])) {
            reply(sender, "<white>Использование: <accent>/ai prob default|crystal|both <ник>");
            return;
        }

        String mode = args[0].toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);

        PlayerData target = plugin.data().byName(args[1]);
        if (target == null) {
            replyKey(sender, "shared.player-offline");
            return;
        }

        if (mode.equals("default") || mode.equals("both")) {
            plugin.displays().watch(watcher, target);
            replyKey(sender, "prob.watching", Map.of(
                    "player", target.name(),
                    "buffer", Msg.round(target.buffer(), 1),
                    "probability", Msg.probability(shownProbability(target)),
                    "windows", Integer.toString(target.windowsAnalysed())));
        }
        if (mode.equals("crystal") || mode.equals("both")) {
            double crystal = target.crystal().probability();
            reply(sender, "<white>Crystal probability: <accent>"
                    + (Double.isNaN(crystal) ? "-" : Msg.probability(crystal))
                    + "<white> | buffer <accent>" + Msg.round(target.crystal().buffer(), 1)
                    + "<white> | <accent>" + target.name());
        }
        if (mode.equals("default") && target.windowsAnalysed() == 0) {
            replyKey(sender, "prob.no-data");
        }
    }

    /** The model's raw answer when /oai math is off, the smoothed one that
     *  feeds the buffer otherwise. The buffer number is unaffected. */
    private double shownProbability(PlayerData target) {
        return target.displayProbability(!plugin.detection().mathEnabled());
    }

    @Override
    public List<String> complete(CommandSender sender, String[] args) {
        if (args.length == 1) {
            List<String> modes = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
            for (String mode : List.of("default", "crystal", "both", "off")) {
                if (mode.startsWith(args[0].toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT))) modes.add(mode);
            }
            return modes;
        }
        if (args.length != 2 || !isMode(args[0])) {
            return List.of();
        }
        return onlineNames(args[1]);
    }

    private static boolean isMode(String value) {
        return value.equalsIgnoreCase("default") || value.equalsIgnoreCase("crystal")
                || value.equalsIgnoreCase("both");
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/me/everyone/oculusai/command/sub/PunishCommand.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.command.sub;

import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;
import me.everyone.oculusai.command.SubCommand;
import org.bukkit.command.CommandSender;
import org.bukkit.entity.Player;

/** Kick or ban by hand, through the anticheat's own send-off.
 *
 * <p>The point is the show. A server that punishes cheats with a visible
 * effect should not break the pattern the moment a human is the one deciding:
 * {@code /oai kick} and {@code /oai ban} throw the player up, spill their
 * inventory and remove them exactly like a detection does, so players cannot
 * tell the plugin's judgement from the staff's - which is the whole reason an
 * admin would use these instead of vanilla /kick and /ban. */
public final class PunishCommand extends SubCommand {

    private final boolean ban;

    private PunishCommand(OculusAI plugin, String name, List<String> aliases, boolean ban,
                          String description) {
        super(plugin, name, aliases, "oculusai.punish",
                "/oai " + name + " <player> [reason]", description, false);
        this.ban = ban;
    }

    public static PunishCommand kick(OculusAI plugin) {
        return new PunishCommand(plugin, "kick", List.of(), false,
                "Kick a player with the anticheat's send-off.");
    }

    public static PunishCommand ban(OculusAI plugin) {
        return new PunishCommand(plugin, "ban", List.of(), true,
                "Ban a player with the anticheat's send-off.");
    }

    @Override
    public void execute(CommandSender sender, String[] args) {
        if (args.length == 0) {
            replyKey(sender, "manual.usage", Map.of("value", usageText()));
            return;
        }

        Player target = plugin.getServer().getPlayerExact(args[0]);
        if (target == null) {
            // Only online players: the send-off needs somebody to play it on.
            // An offline ban is vanilla /ban and already works.
            replyKey(sender, "shared.player-offline");
            return;
        }
        if (sender instanceof Player player && player.getUniqueId().equals(target.getUniqueId())) {
            replyKey(sender, "manual.self");
            return;
        }

        // No reason typed means the one the plugin uses on its own, so a
        // server that worded punishment.kick-message gets that wording here
        // too rather than a second hardcoded string.
        String reason = args.length > 1
                ? String.join(" ", Arrays.copyOfRange(args, 1, args.length)).trim()
                : plugin.config().punishmentKickMessage();

        if (!plugin.punishments().manual(target, ban, reason, sender.getName())) {
            replyKey(sender, "shared.player-offline");
            return;
        }
        replyKey(sender, ban ? "manual.banned" : "manual.kicked", Map.of(
                "player", target.getName(),
                "reason", reason));
    }

    @Override
    public List<String> complete(CommandSender sender, String[] args) {
        return args.length == 1 ? onlineNames(args[0]) : List.of();
    }
}
```

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.command.sub;

import java.util.List;
import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;
import me.everyone.oculusai.command.SubCommand;
import org.bukkit.command.CommandSender;

/** Asks the service about a newer build right now, instead of waiting for the
 *  timer. The answer is the same line everybody else gets in chat, so there is
 *  one wording for "a new version is out" and not a second one here. */
public final class UpdateCommand extends SubCommand {

    public UpdateCommand(OculusAI plugin) {
        super(plugin, "update", List.of("version", "ver"), "oculusai.command",
                "/oai update", "Check for a newer build of the anticheat.", false);
    }

    @Override
    public void execute(CommandSender sender, String[] args) {
        if (!plugin.config().updateEnabled()) {
            // The check is one HTTP call and would work, but answering it
            // while the operator has turned checks off would be answering a
            // question they asked the config not to ask.
            replyKey(sender, "update.disabled");
            return;
        }
        plugin.updates().checkNow(sender);
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/me/everyone/oculusai/config/Config.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.config;


import me.everyone.oculusai.core.Service;
import java.util.Locale;
import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;
import me.everyone.oculusai.check.punishment.Animations;
import org.bukkit.Sound;
import org.bukkit.configuration.file.FileConfiguration;

public final class Config implements Service {

    public static final String DEFAULT_KICK_MESSAGE = "[oculusai.space] You are suspected of using cheats. "
            + "If you believe this is a mistake, please contact a server administrator.";
    private static final int DEFAULT_AIM_SMOOTH_WINDOWS = 2;
    private static final double DEFAULT_BUFFER_GAIN = 8.0D;
    private static final double DEFAULT_BUFFER_DECAY = 1.5D;
    private static final double DEFAULT_BUFFER_MAX = 20.0D;
    private static final double DEFAULT_ALERT_AT = 11.0D;
    private static final double DEFAULT_PUNISH_AT = 15.0D;
    private static final long DEFAULT_AIM_ALERT_COOLDOWN_MS = 2_000L;

    private final OculusAI plugin;

    private String prefix = "";
    private String language = "ru";
    private String apiUrl = "https://oculusai.space";
    private String arenaUrl = apiUrl;
    private int apiTimeoutMs = 1500;
    private String apiKey = "";

    private boolean punishmentEnabled = false;

    private void load() {
        FileConfiguration config = plugin.getConfig();

        prefix = config.getString("prefix", "");
        language = config.getString("language", "ru");
        // Read before api.url: an empty url falls back to this, so the site has
        // to be the one from this config and not the one from the last load.
        site = stripTrailingSlash(config.getString("api.site", "https://oculusai.space"));
        String url = config.getString("api.url", "");
        // Empty means "the public service": a fresh install should reach the
        // real API without editing anything, and a local instance is the case
        // that sets the field.
        apiUrl = sanitizeUrl(url == null || url.isBlank() ? site : url);
        String arena = config.getString("api.arena-url", "");
        arenaUrl = arena == null || arena.isBlank() ? apiUrl : sanitizeUrl(arena);
        apiTimeoutMs = Math.max(250, Math.min(60_000,
                config.getInt("api.timeout-ms", 1500)));
        apiKey = config.getString("api.key", "");
        datasetKey = config.getString("api.dataset-key", "");

        analysisEnabled = config.getBoolean("analysis.enabled", true);
        windowTicks = Math.max(3, config.getInt("analysis.window-ticks", 20));
        minAttacks = config.getInt("analysis.min-attacks", 1);
        combatTicks = config.getInt("analysis.combat-ticks", 40);
        minRotation = config.getDouble("analysis.min-rotation", 5.0D);
        minAttackRotation = config.getDouble("analysis.min-attack-rotation", 2.5D);
        runningHorizon = Math.max(0, config.getInt("analysis.running-horizon", 15));
        smoothWindows = Math.max(1, config.getInt("buffer.smooth-windows", DEFAULT_AIM_SMOOTH_WINDOWS));
        updateEnabled = config.getBoolean("update.enabled", true);
        updateDownload = config.getBoolean("update.download", true);
        updateCheckHours = Math.max(1, config.getInt("update.check-hours", 6));
        // Нулём выключается только повтор: о новой версии всё равно сообщается
        // один раз за проверку.
        updateRemindSeconds = Math.max(0, config.getInt("update.remind-seconds", 15));

        suspicion = clamp(config.getDouble("buffer.suspicion", 0.5D), 0.0D, 1.0D);
        gain = Math.max(0.01D, config.getDouble("buffer.gain", DEFAULT_BUFFER_GAIN));
        decay = Math.max(0.01D, config.getDouble("buffer.decay", DEFAULT_BUFFER_DECAY));
        bufferLeak = clamp(config.getDouble("buffer.leak", 0.4D), 0.0D, 0.95D);
        bufferMax = Math.max(0.1D, config.getDouble("buffer.max", DEFAULT_BUFFER_MAX));
        bufferMaxStep = Math.max(0.0D, config.getDouble("buffer.max-step", 0.0D));
        alertAt = Math.max(0.0D, config.getDouble("buffer.alert-at", DEFAULT_ALERT_AT));
        punishAt = Math.max(alertAt, config.getDouble("buffer.punish-at", DEFAULT_PUNISH_AT));
        alertCooldownMs = Math.max(0L, config.getLong("buffer.alert-cooldown-ms", DEFAULT_AIM_ALERT_COOLDOWN_MS));
        alertSound = config.getString("buffer.alert-sound", "BLOCK_NOTE_BLOCK_BELL");
        alertSoundVolume = (float) config.getDouble("buffer.alert-sound-volume", 1.0D);
        alertSoundPitch = (float) config.getDouble("buffer.alert-sound-pitch", 1.2D);
        alertSymbol = config.getString("display.alert-symbol", "⚠");

        punishmentEnabled = config.getBoolean("punishment.enabled", false);
        firstJoinGraceMs = Math.max(0, config.getInt("punishment.time-for-suspicion", 300)) * 1000L;
        punishmentCommand = config.getString("punishment.command", "");
        punishmentBroadcast = config.getString("punishment.broadcast", "");
        punishmentCooldownMs = Math.max(0L,
                config.getLong("punishment.cooldown-ms", 60_000L));
        punishmentSkipWhileRecording =
                config.getBoolean("punishment.skip-while-recording", true);
        punishmentStrip = config.getBoolean("punishment.strip", false);
        punishmentBanAfter = Math.max(0, config.getInt("punishment.ban-after", 0));
        punishmentBanCommand = config.getString("punishment.ban-command", "");
        String kickMessage = config.getString("punishment.kick-message", DEFAULT_KICK_MESSAGE);
        punishmentKickMessage = kickMessage.isBlank() || kickMessage.trim().equals("Cheat detected")
                ? DEFAULT_KICK_MESSAGE : kickMessage;
        punishmentAnimation = Animations.normalise(config.getString("punishment.animation", Animations.DEFAULT));

        progressSeconds = config.getInt("recording.progress-seconds", 15);
        monitorPvpSeconds = Math.max(1, config.getInt("monitor.pvp-seconds", 5));
        monitorEnabled = config.getBoolean("monitor.enabled", false);
        actionBarFormat = config.getString("display.actionbar", "");
        hologramLines = config.getInt("display.hologram-lines", 6);
        hologramSeconds = config.getInt("display.hologram-seconds", 30);
        hologramOffset = config.getDouble("display.hologram-offset", 1.1D);

        historyKeep = Math.max(1, config.getInt("history.keep", 2000));
        historyFlushSeconds = Math.max(1, config.getInt("history.flush-seconds", 30));
        historyMaxPlayers = Math.max(0, config.getInt("history.max-players", 5000));
        historyRetentionDays = Math.max(0, config.getInt("history.retention-days", 30));

        testServerEnabled = config.getBoolean("test-server.enabled", false);
        testServerWorld = config.getString("test-server.world", "oculusai_test");
        testServerScoreboardTicks = Math.max(20, config.getInt("test-server.scoreboard-refresh-ticks", 100));
        testServerModelRefreshSeconds = Math.max(5, config.getInt("test-server.model-refresh-seconds", 30));

        checksEnabled = config.getBoolean("checks.enabled", true);
        checkTestMode = config.getBoolean("checks.test-mode", true);
        checkAlertCooldownMs = Math.max(0L, config.getLong("checks.alert-cooldown-ms", 5000L));
        checkConfirmations = Math.max(1, config.getInt("checks.confirmations", 2));
        wallCheckEnabled = config.getBoolean("checks.wall.enabled", true);
        wallCheckMaxDistance = Math.max(0.5D, config.getDouble("checks.wall.max-distance", 6.0D));
        checkWallCooldownMs = Math.max(0L, config.getLong(
                "checks.wall.cooldown-ms", checkAlertCooldownMs));
        checkWallTestOnly = config.getBoolean("checks.wall.test-only", false);
        hitboxCheckEnabled = config.getBoolean("checks.hitbox.enabled", true);
        hitboxMaxDistance = Math.max(0.5D,
                config.getDouble("checks.hitbox.max-distance", 6.0D));
        hitboxMargin = Math.max(0.0D, Math.min(0.5D,
                config.getDouble("checks.hitbox.hitbox-margin", 0.1D)));
        // The attack packet has no rotation of its own, so a legitimate flick
        // can leave the server one look behind the client. Keep this small:
        // it is a timing tolerance, not a replacement for aiming at the box.
        hitboxMaxAngle = Math.max(0.0D, Math.min(45.0D,
                config.getDouble("checks.hitbox.max-angle", 25.0D)));
        hitboxDebug = config.getBoolean("checks.hitbox.debug", false);
        checkHitboxCooldownMs = Math.max(0L, config.getLong(
                "checks.hitbox.cooldown-ms", checkAlertCooldownMs));
        checkHitboxTestOnly = config.getBoolean("checks.hitbox.test-only", false);
        checkAimEnabled = config.getBoolean("checks.aim.enabled", true);
        // The old key was global even though only the aim check used it. Keep
        // reading it as a fallback so an existing config.yml keeps working.
        checkAimSmoothWindows = Math.max(1,
                config.getInt("checks.aim.smooth-windows", smoothWindows));
        checkAimConfirmations = Math.max(1, config.getInt("checks.aim.confirmations", 1));
        checkAimCooldownMs = Math.max(0L, config.getLong(
                "checks.aim.cooldown-ms", alertCooldownMs));
        checkAimTestOnly = config.getBoolean("checks.aim.test-only", false);
        checkAimResetAfterCombat = config.getBoolean("checks.aim.reset-after-combat", true);
        // Never shorter than the combat window itself: a reset that can fire
        // while the player is still counted as fighting is the bug this key
        // exists to fix.
        checkAimResetAfterMs = Math.max(combatMs(),
                config.getLong("checks.aim.reset-after-ms", 8000L));

        replayEnabled = config.getBoolean("replay.enabled", true);
        // A second is the floor because a replay shorter than that shows
        // nothing, and thirty is the ceiling because the buffer is memory per
        // suspect: at twenty frames a second, thirty is six hundred frames
        // each holding a couple of dozen actors.
        replaySeconds = Math.max(1, Math.min(30, config.getInt("replay.seconds", 8)));
        // The radius is the scene and the entity scan at once, so it is
        // capped: 32 blocks is a 65-block cube, a quarter of a million
        // blocks, which is not a replay but a world download.
        replayRadius = Math.max(2, Math.min(32, config.getInt("replay.radius", 10)));
        replayCombatMs = Math.max(1000L, config.getLong("replay.combat-ms", 4000L));
        replayMaxKb = Math.max(64, Math.min(8192, config.getInt("replay.max-kb", 1024)));

        packEnabled = config.getBoolean("resource-pack.enabled", true);
        packUrl = config.getString("resource-pack.url", "").trim();
        packSha1 = config.getString("resource-pack.sha1", "auto").trim();
        packArenaOnly = !"all".equalsIgnoreCase(config.getString("resource-pack.send-to", "arena").trim());
        packRequired = config.getBoolean("resource-pack.required", false);
        packPrompt = config.getString("resource-pack.prompt", "");

    }

    private String stripTrailingSlash(String url) {
        return url != null && url.endsWith("/") ? url.substring(0, url.length() - 1) : url;
    }

    /** A malformed URL in config must not throw from every request later. */
    private String sanitizeUrl(String value) {
        String candidate = stripTrailingSlash(value == null ? "" : value.trim());
        try {
            java.net.URI uri = java.net.URI.create(candidate);
            String scheme = uri.getScheme();
            if (uri.getHost() != null
                    && ("https".equalsIgnoreCase(scheme) || "http".equalsIgnoreCase(scheme))) {
                return candidate;
            }
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException ignored) {
        }
        plugin.getLogger().warning("api.url is not a valid http(s) URL; using "
                + "https://oculusai.space");
        return "https://oculusai.space";
    }

    private static double clamp(double value, double min, double max) {
        if (Double.isNaN(value)) {
            return min;
        }
        return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, value));
    }

    private Sound parseSound(String value, Sound fallback) {
        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
            return fallback;
        }
        try {
            return Sound.valueOf(value.trim().toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT));
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException ignored) {
            return fallback;
        }
    }
```

`src/main/java/me/everyone/oculusai/config/Configuration.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.config;

import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;
import me.everyone.oculusai.core.Service;

public final class Configuration implements Service {

    private final Config settings;
    private final Themes theme;
    private final Language language;
    private final HudConfig hud;

    public Configuration(OculusAI plugin) {
        this.settings = new Config(plugin);
        this.theme = new Themes(plugin);
        this.language = new Language(plugin);
        this.hud = new HudConfig(plugin);
    }

    @Override
    public void enable() {
        settings.enable();
        theme.enable();
        language.enable();
        hud.enable();
    }

    @Override
    public void disable() {
        hud.disable();
        language.disable();
        theme.disable();
        settings.disable();
    }

    @Override
    public void reload() {
        settings.reload();
        theme.reload();
        language.reload();
        hud.reload();
    }

    public Config settings() {
        return settings;
    }

    public Themes theme() {
        return theme;
    }

    public Language language() {
        return language;
    }

    public HudConfig hud() {
        return hud;
    }
}
```
