`src/main/java/me/everyone/oculusai/config/HudConfig.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.config;


import me.everyone.oculusai.core.Service;
import java.io.File;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;
import org.bukkit.configuration.file.YamlConfiguration;

public final class HudConfig implements Service {

    /** The passenger sits at this height above the player's feet. */
    private static final double HOLOGRAM_BASE = 1.15D;
    /** Never put the text inside the player's head. */
    private static final double MIN_HOLOGRAM_HEIGHT = 2.25D;
    /** High enough to clear any fight, low enough not to look detached. */
    private static final double MAX_HOLOGRAM_HEIGHT = 5.15D;

    /** Средняя за последние окна и сами окна, каждое в цвете
     *  детекта. Числа - как их выдала модель, не проценты. */
    static final String COMPACT_FORMAT = "<white>AVG %avg% <dark_gray>| %recent%";
    /** Прежние умолчания: до 2.3 и первый вариант с AVG. */
    static final java.util.List<String> LEGACY_COMPACT_FORMATS = java.util.List.of(
            "<white>%probability% %bar%", "<white>AVG: %avg% <dark_gray>| %recent%");
    /** Строка над хотбаром: ник, показание и буфер. */
    static final String ACTION_BAR_FORMAT = "%arrow% <white>%player% <dark_gray>| <white>%probability% "
            + "<dark_gray>| <white>%buffer%<dark_gray>/<white>%max_buffer%";
    static final String LEGACY_ACTION_BAR_FORMAT = "%arrow% <white>%player% <dark_gray>| <gray>%probability% "
            + "<dark_gray>| <white>%buffer%<dark_gray>/<white>%max_buffer%";

    private final OculusAI plugin;

    private String actionBarFormat = "";
    private List<String> hologramFormat = List.of();
    private int hologramLines = 6;
    private boolean hologramCompact = true;
    private String hologramCompactFormat = "";
    private int staleSeconds = 3;
    private String staleFormat = "";
    private int hologramSeconds = 300;
    private double hologramOffset = 1.1D;

    public HudConfig(OculusAI plugin) {
        this.plugin = plugin;
    }

    @Override
    public void enable() {
        load();
    }

    @Override
    public void reload() {
        load();
    }

    private void load() {
        File file = new File(plugin.getDataFolder(), "probcfg.yml");
        if (!file.isFile()) {
            plugin.saveResource("probcfg.yml", false);
        }

        YamlConfiguration config = YamlConfiguration.loadConfiguration(file);
        // A triangle for where the buffer is heading, then the name, then the
        // two numbers. The name stays here - unlike the hologram, this line
        // does not hang over the player it is about.
        String configuredActionBar = config.getString("actionbar", ACTION_BAR_FORMAT);
        actionBarFormat = LEGACY_ACTION_BAR_FORMAT.equals(configuredActionBar)
                ? ACTION_BAR_FORMAT : withoutGroups(configuredActionBar);
        boolean changed = !actionBarFormat.equals(configuredActionBar);
        if (changed) {
            config.set("actionbar", actionBarFormat);
        }
        hologramFormat = config.getStringList("hologram.format").stream()
                .map(HudConfig::withoutGroups).filter(line -> !line.isEmpty()).toList();
        if (hologramFormat.isEmpty()) {
            hologramFormat = List.of(
                    "<gray>⚡ <white>%probability% <dark_gray>| <gray>❤ buffer <white>%buffer%<dark_gray>/<white>%max_buffer%",
                    "<gray>♫ %bar%",
                    "<dark_gray>♬ trend <gray>%trend%",
                    "<dark_gray>☹ %state%",
                    "<dark_gray>♠ windows <white>%windows%");
        }
        hologramLines = Math.max(1, config.getInt("hologram.lines", 5));
        // One line by default. Six lines of hologram over a player's head in a
        // fight is a wall between the watcher and what they are watching, and
        // the two numbers that decide anything - the reading and the buffer -
        // fit on one line with room to spare. The multi-line `format` above is
        // still there for anyone who sets compact to false.
        hologramCompact = config.getBoolean("hologram.compact", true);
        // No name on the hologram: it floats over the player, whose own
        // nameplate is right under it. No labels and no buffer figure either -
        // the reading and the length of the bar say the same thing shorter.
        hologramCompactFormat = withoutGroups(config.getString("hologram.compact-format", COMPACT_FORMAT));
        // Нетронутый прежний формат из jar - это не выбор владельца, а
        // умолчание, которое сменилось: такой меняется на новое и пишется
        // обратно. Свой формат остаётся как есть.
        if (hologramCompactFormat.isEmpty() || LEGACY_COMPACT_FORMATS.contains(hologramCompactFormat)) {
            hologramCompactFormat = COMPACT_FORMAT;
            config.set("hologram.compact-format", COMPACT_FORMAT);
            changed = true;
        }
        if (changed) {
            try {
                config.save(file);
            } catch (IOException exception) {
                plugin.getLogger().log(Level.WARNING, "Could not update probcfg.yml", exception);
            }
        }
        // A window lands about every half second during a fight, so three
        // seconds of silence is a stop rather than a gap.
        staleSeconds = Math.max(1, config.getInt("hologram.stale-seconds", 3));
        staleFormat = withoutGroups(config.getString("hologram.stale-format", "&cno analysing"));
        hologramSeconds = Math.max(1, config.getInt("hologram.seconds", 300));
        hologramOffset = config.getDouble("hologram.offset", 1.1D);
    }

    static String withoutGroups(String format) {
        if (!format.contains("%groups%")) {
            return format;
        }
        return format.replaceAll("\\s*(?:<dark_gray>)?[|·]\\s*%groups%", "")
                .replaceAll("%groups%\\s*(?:<dark_gray>)?[|·]\\s*", "")
                .replace("%groups%", "").strip();
    }

    public String actionBarFormat() {
        return actionBarFormat;
    }

    public int hologramLines() {
        return hologramLines;
    }

    public List<String> hologramFormat() {
        return hologramFormat;
    }

    public boolean hologramCompact() {
        return hologramCompact;
    }

    public String hologramCompactFormat() {
        return hologramCompactFormat;
    }

    public long staleMs() {
        return staleSeconds * 1000L;
    }

    public String staleFormat() {
        return staleFormat;
    }

    public int hologramSeconds() {
        return hologramSeconds;
    }

    public double hologramOffset() {
        return hologramOffset;
    }

    /** The actual Y of the top hologram line above the target's feet. The
     *  clamp is what keeps a low offset from putting text in the player. */
    public double hologramHeight() {
        return Math.max(MIN_HOLOGRAM_HEIGHT, hologramOffset + HOLOGRAM_BASE);
    }

    public double minHologramHeight() {
        return MIN_HOLOGRAM_HEIGHT;
    }

    public double maxHologramHeight() {
        return MAX_HOLOGRAM_HEIGHT;
    }

    /** Moves the hologram up or down and saves the new offset to probcfg.yml.
     *  Returns false when the file could not be written. */
    public boolean adjustHologramHeight(double delta) {
        return setHologramHeight(hologramHeight() + delta);
    }

    public boolean setHologramHeight(double height) {
        double clamped = Math.max(MIN_HOLOGRAM_HEIGHT,
                Math.min(MAX_HOLOGRAM_HEIGHT, round2(height)));
        double offset = round2(clamped - HOLOGRAM_BASE);

        File file = new File(plugin.getDataFolder(), "probcfg.yml");
        if (!file.isFile()) {
            plugin.saveResource("probcfg.yml", false);
        }

        List<String> lines;
        try {
            lines = Files.readAllLines(file.toPath(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        } catch (IOException exception) {
            plugin.getLogger().log(Level.WARNING,
                    "Could not read " + file.getAbsolutePath() + " to change the hologram height",
                    exception);
            return false;
        }

        String value = Double.toString(offset);
        int hologramLine = -1;
        boolean replaced = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < lines.size(); i++) {
            String line = lines.get(i);
            String trimmed = line.strip();
            if (trimmed.equals("hologram:")) {
                hologramLine = i;
                continue;
            }
            if (hologramLine < 0) {
                continue;
            }
            if (!line.isEmpty() && !Character.isWhitespace(line.charAt(0))) {
                break;
            }
            if (trimmed.startsWith("offset:")) {
                int at = line.indexOf("offset:");
                lines.set(i, line.substring(0, at) + "offset: " + value);
                replaced = true;
                break;
            }
        }

        if (!replaced) {
            if (hologramLine < 0) {
                lines.add("");
                lines.add("hologram:");
                hologramLine = lines.size() - 1;
            }
            lines.add(hologramLine + 1, "  offset: " + value);
        }

        try {
            Files.write(file.toPath(), lines, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        } catch (IOException exception) {
            plugin.getLogger().log(Level.WARNING,
                    "Could not save the hologram height in " + file.getAbsolutePath(), exception);
            return false;
        }
        hologramOffset = offset;
        return true;
    }

    private static double round2(double value) {
        return Math.round(value * 100.0D) / 100.0D;
    }
}

```

`src/main/java/me/everyone/oculusai/config/Language.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.config;


import me.everyone.oculusai.core.Service;
import java.io.File;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.io.Reader;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;
import me.everyone.oculusai.core.Msg;
import org.bukkit.configuration.file.YamlConfiguration;

public final class Language implements Service {

    /** The old aim reason printed both placeholders literally because the
     *  check used to return it without a placeholder map. Existing language
     *  files keep custom translations, but this known bundled value is safe
     *  to replace with the current line. */
    private static final String LEGACY_AIM_REASON = "prob %probability%, buffer %buffer%";
    /** The old HitBox reason described the target's dimensions. The check no
     *  longer produces those values, so an unchanged language file would show
     *  the placeholders literally. */
    private static final String LEGACY_HITBOX_REASON_EN =
            "target hitbox %width%x%height% exceeds %max-width%x%max-height%";
    private static final String LEGACY_HITBOX_REASON_RU =
            "хитбокс цели %width%x%height% больше %max-width%x%max-height%";
    private static final String LEGACY_HITBOX_DESC_EN =
            "<gray>Hits a target whose hitbox is larger than allowed.";
    private static final String LEGACY_HITBOX_DESC_RU =
            "<gray>Удар по цели с увеличенным хитбоксом.";
    /** Прежнее имя нейросетевой проверки. Строку, где оно стоит нетронутым,
     *  можно смело заменить новым из jar; переведённую руками - нельзя. */
    private static final List<String> LEGACY_AIM_NAMES =
            List.of("Neuro Aim", "<light_purple>Neuro Aim");
    private static final List<String> REMOVED_KEYS = List.of(
            "check-settings.nolookhit",
            "check-settings.hitbox.max-width",
            "check-settings.hitbox.max-height",
            "check.name.nolookhit",
            "check.desc.nolookhit",
            "check.reason.nolookhit",
            "checks.name.nolookhit",
            "event.check-nolookhit",
            "connect.asking",
            "forget.dropped",
            "update.notes",
            // Команды guide, report, animations, checks и diag убраны: то же
            // самое делается из меню.
            "guide",
            "report",
            "animations",
            "checks",
            "help.command.checks");

    /** Строки, которые менялись между версиями. Совпадающее значение - это
     *  нетронутый текст из прежнего jar, и его можно заменить новым; строку,
     *  переписанную владельцем сервера, миграция не трогает. */
    private static final Map<String, List<String>> LEGACY_MESSAGES = Map.of(
            "update.available", List.of(
                    "<gold>Вышла новая версия <white><bold>%version%<gold> — обновите античит. "
                            + "<gray>Сейчас стоит <white>%current%<gray>.",
                    "<gold>Version <white><bold>%version%<gold> is out — update the anticheat. "
                            + "<gray>This server runs <white>%current%<gray>."),
            "update.download", List.of(
                    " <yellow>[Скачать]",
                    " <yellow>[Download]"),
            "prob.watching", List.of(
                    "<gray>Смотришь за <white>%player%<gray>. Буфер <white>%buffer%<gray>, "
                            + "последний reading <white>%probability%<gray>, окон проанализировано "
                            + "<white>%windows%",
                    "<gray>Watching <white>%player%<gray>. Buffer <white>%buffer%<gray>, "
                            + "last reading <white>%probability%<gray>, windows analysed "
                            + "<white>%windows%"),
            "bypass.enabled", List.of(
                    "<green>Античит выключен для <white>%player%<green>.",
                    "<green>Anticheat disabled for <white>%player%<green>."),
            "bypass.disabled", List.of(
                    "<green>Античит снова включён для <white>%player%<green>.",
                    "<green>Anticheat enabled for <white>%player%<green>."),
            "forget.done", List.of(
                    "<gray>Сброшен <white>%player%<gray>: буфер <white>%buffer%<gray> -> "
                            + "<white>0%dropped%<gray>. Подозрение начинается заново.",
                    "<gray>Forgot <white>%player%<gray>: buffer <white>%buffer%<gray> -> "
                            + "<white>0%dropped%<gray>. Suspicion starts again from nothing."),
            "connect.open", List.of(
                    "<gray>Открой ссылку под своим аккаунтом, чтобы привязать сервер:",
                    "<gray>Open this link while signed in to bind the server:"));

    private final OculusAI plugin;
    private YamlConfiguration lang;
    private YamlConfiguration defaults;
    /** Every value each key has shipped with before, from lang/legacy/. */
    private YamlConfiguration legacy;

    public Language(OculusAI plugin) {
        this.plugin = plugin;
    }

    @Override
    public void enable() {
        load();
    }

    @Override
    public void reload() {
        load();
    }

    private void load() {
        File folder = new File(plugin.getDataFolder(), "lang");
        if (!folder.exists() && !folder.mkdirs()) {
            plugin.getLogger().warning("Could not create lang folder at " + folder.getAbsolutePath());
        }
        ensureBundledFile("lang/en.yml");
        ensureBundledFile("lang/ru.yml");

        String selected = plugin.config().language();
        File file = new File(folder, selected + ".yml");
        if (!file.isFile()) {
            plugin.getLogger().warning("Language " + selected + " not found, falling back to en.yml");
            file = new File(folder, "en.yml");
        }
        lang = loadConfiguration(file, "lang/" + file.getName());
        defaults = loadBundled("lang/" + file.getName());
        legacy = loadBundled("lang/legacy/" + file.getName());
        adoptNewKeys(file);
    }

    private void ensureBundledFile(String path) {
        File file = new File(plugin.getDataFolder(), path);
        if (file.isFile()) {
            return;
        }

        File parent = file.getParentFile();
        if (parent != null && !parent.exists() && !parent.mkdirs()) {
            plugin.getLogger().warning("Could not create parent folder for " + file.getAbsolutePath());
            return;
        }

        try (InputStream input = plugin.getResource(path)) {
            if (input == null) {
                plugin.getLogger().warning("Bundled resource " + path + " is missing from the plugin jar");
                return;
            }
            Files.copy(input, file.toPath(), StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
        } catch (IOException exception) {
            plugin.getLogger().log(Level.WARNING,
                    "Could not write bundled resource " + path + " to " + file.getAbsolutePath(), exception);
        }
    }

    private YamlConfiguration loadConfiguration(File file, String bundledPath) {
        if (file.isFile()) {
            try (Reader reader = Files.newBufferedReader(file.toPath(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
                YamlConfiguration configuration = new YamlConfiguration();
                configuration.load(reader);
                return configuration;
            } catch (Exception exception) {
                plugin.getLogger().log(java.util.logging.Level.WARNING,
                        "Language file " + file.getAbsolutePath() + " is invalid; backing it up and restoring " + bundledPath, exception);
                backupBrokenFile(file);
                ensureBundledFile(bundledPath);
            }
        }

        try (InputStream input = plugin.getResource(bundledPath)) {
            if (input == null) {
                plugin.getLogger().warning("Bundled language " + bundledPath + " is missing; using empty configuration");
                return new YamlConfiguration();
            }
            return YamlConfiguration.loadConfiguration(new InputStreamReader(input, StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        } catch (IOException exception) {
            plugin.getLogger().log(java.util.logging.Level.WARNING,
                    "Could not read bundled language " + bundledPath + "; using empty configuration", exception);
            return new YamlConfiguration();
        }
    }

    private void backupBrokenFile(File file) {
        if (!file.isFile()) {
            return;
        }

        File backup = new File(file.getParentFile(), file.getName() + ".broken");
        try {
            Files.copy(file.toPath(), backup.toPath(), StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
            Files.deleteIfExists(file.toPath());
        } catch (IOException exception) {
            plugin.getLogger().log(java.util.logging.Level.WARNING,
                    "Could not back up broken language file " + file.getAbsolutePath(), exception);
        }
    }

    private YamlConfiguration loadBundled(String bundledPath) {
        try (InputStream input = plugin.getResource(bundledPath)) {
            if (input == null) {
                plugin.getLogger().warning("Bundled language " + bundledPath + " is missing; using empty defaults");
                return new YamlConfiguration();
            }
            return YamlConfiguration.loadConfiguration(new InputStreamReader(input, StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        } catch (IOException exception) {
            plugin.getLogger().log(java.util.logging.Level.WARNING,
                    "Could not read bundled language " + bundledPath + "; using empty defaults", exception);
            return new YamlConfiguration();
        }
    }

    /** Заменяет прежние bundled-тексты новыми, но только когда значение
     *  осталось ровно таким, каким его выпустил jar. Возвращает число
     *  заменённых строк. */
    static int migrateMessages(YamlConfiguration lang, YamlConfiguration defaults) {
        int migrated = 0;
        for (Map.Entry<String, List<String>> entry : LEGACY_MESSAGES.entrySet()) {
            String current = lang.getString(entry.getKey());
            String bundled = defaults.getString(entry.getKey());
            if (current != null && bundled != null && !bundled.equals(current)
                    && entry.getValue().contains(current)) {
                lang.set(entry.getKey(), bundled);
                migrated++;
            }
        }
        return migrated;
    }

    /** Обновляет каждую строку, которая всё ещё равна тексту из какого-то
     *  прежнего jar, на текущий текст из этого.
     *
     *  <p>lang/legacy/ собран из истории репозитория: для каждого ключа - все
     *  значения, с которыми он когда-либо выходил. Совпадение означает, что
     *  владелец сервера строку не трогал, и замена ничего у него не отнимает;
     *  переписанную руками строку не найти в истории, и она остаётся как есть.
     *  Без этого смена оформления доходила бы только до новых серверов: файл
     *  языка копируется один раз, а дальше в него лишь добавляются ключи. */
    static int migrateHistory(YamlConfiguration lang, YamlConfiguration defaults,
                              YamlConfiguration legacy) {
        if (legacy == null) {
            return 0;
        }
        int migrated = 0;
        for (String key : legacy.getKeys(true)) {
            if (!legacy.isList(key) || !lang.isString(key)) {
                continue;
            }
            String current = lang.getString(key);
            String bundled = defaults.getString(key);
            if (current != null && bundled != null && !bundled.equals(current)
                    && legacy.getStringList(key).contains(current)) {
                lang.set(key, bundled);
                migrated++;
            }
        }
        return migrated;
    }

    /** Меняет нетронутое прежнее имя нейросетевой проверки на новое из jar.
     *  Возвращает, сколько строк заменено. */
    static int migrateAimNames(YamlConfiguration lang, YamlConfiguration defaults) {
        int migrated = 0;
        for (String key : lang.getKeys(true)) {
            // Секции и числа пропускаются до contains: List.of на null не
            // отвечает false, а бросает NPE - и плагин не включался вовсе.
            if (!lang.isString(key)) {
                continue;
            }
            String current = lang.getString(key);
            String bundled = defaults.getString(key);
            if (current != null && LEGACY_AIM_NAMES.contains(current)
                    && bundled != null && !bundled.equals(current)) {
                lang.set(key, bundled);
                migrated++;
            }
        }
        return migrated;
    }

    private void adoptNewKeys(File file) {
        if (defaults == null || lang == null || !file.isFile()) {
            return;
        }

        int added = 0;
        for (String key : defaults.getKeys(true)) {
            if (defaults.isConfigurationSection(key) || lang.contains(key)) {
                continue;
            }
            String parent = key.contains(".") ? key.substring(0, key.lastIndexOf('.')) : "";
            if (!parent.isEmpty() && lang.contains(parent) && !lang.isConfigurationSection(parent)) {
                continue;
            }
            lang.set(key, defaults.get(key));
            added++;
        }

        int removed = 0;
        for (String key : REMOVED_KEYS) {
            if (lang.contains(key)) {
                lang.set(key, null);
                removed++;
            }
        }

        int migrated = 0;
        String currentAimReason = lang.getString("check.reason.aim");
        String bundledAimReason = defaults.getString("check.reason.aim");
        if (LEGACY_AIM_REASON.equals(currentAimReason)
                && bundledAimReason != null && !bundledAimReason.equals(currentAimReason)) {
            lang.set("check.reason.aim", bundledAimReason);
            migrated++;
        }

        String currentHitboxReason = lang.getString("check.reason.hitbox");
        String bundledHitboxReason = defaults.getString("check.reason.hitbox");
        if (bundledHitboxReason != null && !bundledHitboxReason.equals(currentHitboxReason)
                && (LEGACY_HITBOX_REASON_EN.equals(currentHitboxReason)
                || LEGACY_HITBOX_REASON_RU.equals(currentHitboxReason)
                || containsOldHitboxPlaceholders(currentHitboxReason))) {
            lang.set("check.reason.hitbox", bundledHitboxReason);
            migrated++;
        }

        String currentHitboxDesc = lang.getString("check.desc.hitbox");
        String bundledHitboxDesc = defaults.getString("check.desc.hitbox");
        if (bundledHitboxDesc != null && !bundledHitboxDesc.equals(currentHitboxDesc)
                && (LEGACY_HITBOX_DESC_EN.equals(currentHitboxDesc)
                || LEGACY_HITBOX_DESC_RU.equals(currentHitboxDesc))) {
            lang.set("check.desc.hitbox", bundledHitboxDesc);
            migrated++;
        }


        migrated += migrateMessages(lang, defaults);

        migrated += migrateHistory(lang, defaults, legacy);

        migrated += migrateAimNames(lang, defaults);

        // Строка алерта - только ник и проверка. Раньше здесь дописывался
        // %metrics% в любую строку без него; это вернуло бы проб с буфером
        // в строку, где их убрали намеренно.

        if (added == 0 && removed == 0 && migrated == 0) {
            return;
        }
        try {
            lang.save(file);
            plugin.getLogger().info("Language " + file.getName() + " updated: "
                    + added + " new keys, " + removed + " removed, "
                    + migrated + " migrated values");
        } catch (IOException exception) {
            plugin.getLogger().log(Level.WARNING,
                    "Could not save new language keys into " + file.getAbsolutePath()
                            + "; they still resolve from the bundled defaults", exception);
        }
    }

    private boolean containsOldHitboxPlaceholders(String value) {
        return value != null && (value.contains("%width%")
                || value.contains("%height%")
                || value.contains("%max-width%")
                || value.contains("%max-height%"));
    }

    public String text(String key) {
        return Msg.parse(themed(raw(key, key)));
    }

    public String text(String key, Map<String, String> placeholders) {
        return Msg.parse(themed(raw(key, key)), placeholders);
    }

    public String plain(String key) {
        return Msg.strip(themed(raw(key, key)));
    }

    public String textOr(String key, String fallback) {
        return Msg.parse(themed(raw(key, fallback)));
    }

    /** Resolves the theme's {@code <accent>} tag before the message is
     *  colourized. Msg only knows fixed colour names, so an unexpanded
     *  {@code <accent>} would otherwise be dropped and the text would come out
     *  in whatever colour was active before it. */
    private String themed(String value) {
        Themes themes = plugin.theme();
        return themes == null ? value : themes.resolveAccent(value);
    }

    private String raw(String key, String fallback) {
        if (lang != null && lang.contains(key)) {
            return lang.getString(key, fallback);
        }
        if (defaults != null && defaults.contains(key)) {
            return defaults.getString(key, fallback);
        }
        return fallback;
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/me/everyone/oculusai/config/Themes.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.config;


import me.everyone.oculusai.core.Service;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;
import me.everyone.oculusai.core.Msg;

public final class Themes implements Service {

    public record Theme(String id, String primary, String secondary, String accent, String accentSoft) {
    }

    private final OculusAI plugin;
    private final Map<String, Theme> themes = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    private volatile Theme current;

    public Themes(OculusAI plugin) {
        this.plugin = plugin;
        registerDefaults();
    }

    @Override
    public void enable() {
        load();
    }

    @Override
    public void reload() {
        load();
    }

    private void load() {
        String id = plugin.getConfig().getString("theme.name", "aurora");
        current = themes.getOrDefault(id, themes.get("aurora"));
    }

    private void registerDefaults() {
        themes.put("aurora", new Theme("aurora", "#8e7bff", "#38bdf8", "#ffd166", "#b8f2e6"));
        themes.put("ember", new Theme("ember", "#ff6b6b", "#ff9f1c", "#ffe66d", "#f7b267"));
        themes.put("ocean", new Theme("ocean", "#00c6ff", "#0072ff", "#80ffdb", "#72efdd"));
        themes.put("rose", new Theme("rose", "#ff4d8d", "#ff8fab", "#ffd6e0", "#ffc2d1"));
        themes.put("mint", new Theme("mint", "#06d6a0", "#1b9aaa", "#f4f1bb", "#94d2bd"));
        themes.put("midnight", new Theme("midnight", "#577590", "#277da1", "#90be6d", "#4d908e"));
    }

    public Theme current() {
        return current;
    }

    public List<Theme> themes() {
        return List.copyOf(themes.values());
    }

    public Theme cycle() {
        List<Theme> ordered = themes();
        int index = Math.max(0, ordered.indexOf(current));
        Theme next = ordered.get((index + 1) % ordered.size());
        plugin.getConfig().set("theme.name", next.id());
        plugin.saveConfig();
        current = next;
        return current;
    }

    public String title(String suffix) {
        String name = "<gradient:" + current.primary() + ":" + current.secondary()
                + "><bold>ᴏᴄᴜʟᴜsᴀɪ</bold></gradient>";
        return Msg.parse(suffix.isEmpty() ? name : name + " <dark_gray>- <white>" + suffix);
    }

    /** Заменяет тег {@code <accent>} на цвет акцента текущей темы.
     *
     *  <p>Msg знает только фиксированные имена цветов, и нераскрытый
     *  {@code <accent>} он бы молча выбросил - текст остался бы в предыдущем
     *  цвете. Раскрывается до разбора, и для строк из языка, и для ответов,
     *  собранных в коде. */
    public String resolveAccent(String value) {
        if (value == null || current == null) {
            return value;
        }
        return value
                .replace("</accent>", "")
                .replace("<accent>", "<" + current.accent() + ">");
    }

    public String accent(String text) {
        return Msg.parse("<" + current.accent() + ">" + text);
    }

    public String accentSoft(String text) {
        return Msg.parse("<" + current.accentSoft() + ">" + text);
    }

    public String prefix(String template) {
        if (template == null || template.isBlank() || !template.contains("%primary%")) {
            return Msg.parse("<gradient:" + current.primary() + ":" + current.secondary()
                    + "><bold>ᴏᴄᴜʟᴜsᴀɪ</bold></gradient> <dark_gray>» <white>");
        }
        return Msg.parse(template
                .replace("%primary%", current.primary())
                .replace("%secondary%", current.secondary())
                .replace("%accent%", current.accent())
                .replace("%accent_soft%", current.accentSoft()));
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/me/everyone/oculusai/core/AsyncWorker.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.core;

import java.util.concurrent.Executor;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
import java.util.concurrent.ScheduledExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.ScheduledFuture;
import java.util.concurrent.ThreadFactory;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

public final class AsyncWorker {

    private final Logger logger;
    private final ScheduledExecutorService executor;

    public AsyncWorker(Logger logger) {
        this.logger = logger;
        ThreadFactory factory = runnable -> {
            Thread thread = new Thread(runnable, "OculusAI-Worker");
            thread.setDaemon(true);
            return thread;
        };
        this.executor = Executors.newSingleThreadScheduledExecutor(factory);
    }

    public Executor executor() {
        return executor;
    }

    public void execute(Runnable task) {
        executor.execute(guard(task));
    }

    public ScheduledFuture<?> schedule(Runnable task, long delay, TimeUnit unit) {
        return executor.schedule(guard(task), delay, unit);
    }

    public ScheduledFuture<?> repeat(Runnable task, long initialDelay, long period, TimeUnit unit) {
        return executor.scheduleWithFixedDelay(guard(task), initialDelay, period, unit);
    }

    public void shutdown() {
        executor.shutdown();
        try {
            if (!executor.awaitTermination(5L, TimeUnit.SECONDS)) {
                executor.shutdownNow();
            }
        } catch (InterruptedException interrupted) {
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
            executor.shutdownNow();
        }
    }

    private Runnable guard(Runnable task) {
        return () -> {
            try {
                task.run();
            } catch (Throwable failure) {
                logger.log(Level.SEVERE, "Uncaught worker failure", failure);
            }
        };
    }
}
```

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.core;

import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;
import org.bukkit.Bukkit;

public final class MainThread {

    private final OculusAI plugin;

    public MainThread(OculusAI plugin) {
        this.plugin = plugin;
    }

    public boolean isCurrent() {
        return Bukkit.isPrimaryThread();
    }

    public void run(Runnable action) {
        if (isCurrent()) {
            action.run();
        } else {
            plugin.ticks().after(0L, action);
        }
    }

    public void after(Runnable action, long ticks) {
        plugin.ticks().after(ticks, action);
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/me/everyone/oculusai/core/Msg.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.core;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.regex.Matcher;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;
import net.md_5.bungee.api.ChatColor;

public final class Msg {

    private static final Pattern TAG = Pattern.compile("<(/?)([^<>]+)>");
    private static final Map<String, String> TOKENS = createTokens();
    private static final String LEGACY_CODES = "0123456789abcdefklmnorx";

    private Msg() {
    }

    public static String parse(String input) {
        return colourize(input == null ? "" : input);
    }

    public static String parse(String input, Map<String, String> placeholders) {
        return colourize(fill(input, placeholders));
    }

    public static String fill(String input, Map<String, String> placeholders) {
        if (input == null || input.isEmpty()) {
            return "";
        }
        String result = input;
        for (Map.Entry<String, String> entry : placeholders.entrySet()) {
            result = result.replace('%' + entry.getKey() + '%', entry.getValue());
        }
        return result;
    }

    public static String strip(String input) {
        return parse(input == null ? "" : input).replaceAll("\u00a7[0-9a-fk-orx]", "");
    }

    private static String colourize(String input) {
        String gradiented = applyGradients(input);
        StringBuilder out = new StringBuilder();
        Matcher matcher = TAG.matcher(gradiented);
        int cursor = 0;
        while (matcher.find()) {
            out.append(gradiented, cursor, matcher.start());
            String slash = matcher.group(1);
            String token = matcher.group(2).trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
            out.append(resolveTag(slash, token));
            cursor = matcher.end();
        }
        out.append(gradiented.substring(cursor));
        return legacy(out.toString());
    }

    /** Turns `&c` into a colour, and unescapes the HTML-style escapes.
     *
     * <p>Both halves have to happen here and in this order. `&amp;` starts
     * with an ampersand followed by `a`, which is itself a valid colour code,
     * so translating codes first would eat the escape and leave `§amp;`. The
     * escape is taken out of the way, codes are translated, and the literal
     * ampersand goes back last.
     *
     * <p>`&` is supported because every other plugin's config accepts it and
     * an operator writing `&cno analysing` is not going to guess that this one
     * wanted `<red>`. */
    private static String legacy(String input) {
        String out = input
                .replace("&lt;", "\u0000LT\u0000")
                .replace("&gt;", "\u0000GT\u0000")
                .replace("&amp;", "\u0000AMP\u0000");
        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder(out.length());
        for (int i = 0; i < out.length(); i++) {
            char current = out.charAt(i);
            if (current == '&' && i + 1 < out.length()
                    && LEGACY_CODES.indexOf(Character.toLowerCase(out.charAt(i + 1))) >= 0) {
                builder.append('\u00a7').append(Character.toLowerCase(out.charAt(i + 1)));
                i++;
                continue;
            }
            builder.append(current);
        }
        return builder.toString()
                .replace("\u0000LT\u0000", "<")
                .replace("\u0000GT\u0000", ">")
                .replace("\u0000AMP\u0000", "&");
    }

    private static String resolveTag(String slash, String token) {
        if (!slash.isEmpty()) {
            return closingTag(token);
        }
        if ("newline".equals(token)) {
            return "\n";
        }
        if (token.startsWith("#")) {
            return colour(token);
        }
        return TOKENS.getOrDefault(token, "");
    }

    private static final Pattern GRADIENT =
            Pattern.compile("<gradient:(#?[a-fA-F0-9]{6}):(#?[a-fA-F0-9]{6})>(.*?)</gradient>", Pattern.DOTALL);

    private static String applyGradients(String input) {
        StringBuilder out = new StringBuilder();
        Matcher matcher = GRADIENT.matcher(input);
        int cursor = 0;
        while (matcher.find()) {
            out.append(input, cursor, matcher.start());
            out.append(gradient(matcher.group(3), matcher.group(1), matcher.group(2)));
            cursor = matcher.end();
        }
        out.append(input.substring(cursor));
        return out.toString();
    }

    private static String gradient(String text, String fromHex, String toHex) {
        int from = parseHex(fromHex);
        int to = parseHex(toHex);
        int visible = visibleLength(text);
        StringBuilder out = new StringBuilder();
        int index = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < text.length(); i++) {
            char c = text.charAt(i);
            if (c == '<') {
                int end = text.indexOf('>', i);
                if (end > i) {
                    out.append(text, i, end + 1);
                    i = end;
                    continue;
                }
            }
            if (visible > 1) {
                double t = (double) index / (visible - 1);
                out.append(hexColour(lerp(from, to, t)));
            }
            out.append(c);
            index++;
        }
        return out.toString();
    }

    private static int visibleLength(String text) {
        int count = 0;
        boolean inTag = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < text.length(); i++) {
            char c = text.charAt(i);
            if (c == '<') {
                inTag = true;
            } else if (c == '>') {
                inTag = false;
            } else if (!inTag) {
                count++;
            }
        }
        return count;
    }

    private static int parseHex(String hex) {
        String cleaned = hex.startsWith("#") ? hex.substring(1) : hex;
        try {
            return Integer.parseInt(cleaned, 16);
        } catch (NumberFormatException ignored) {
            return 0xFFFFFF;
        }
    }

    private static String hexColour(int rgb) {
        return String.format(Locale.ROOT, "§x§%x§%x§%x§%x§%x§%x",
                (rgb >> 20) & 0xF, (rgb >> 16) & 0xF, (rgb >> 12) & 0xF,
                (rgb >> 8) & 0xF, (rgb >> 4) & 0xF, rgb & 0xF);
    }

    private static int lerp(int from, int to, double t) {
        int r = (int) Math.round(((from >> 16) & 0xFF) + (((to >> 16) & 0xFF) - ((from >> 16) & 0xFF)) * t);
        int g = (int) Math.round(((from >> 8) & 0xFF) + (((to >> 8) & 0xFF) - ((from >> 8) & 0xFF)) * t);
        int b = (int) Math.round((from & 0xFF) + ((to & 0xFF) - (from & 0xFF)) * t);
        return (r << 16) | (g << 8) | b;
    }

    private static String closingTag(String token) {
        return switch (token) {
            case "bold", "italic", "underlined", "underline", "strikethrough", "st",
                    "obfuscated", "magic", "gradient", "reset" -> ChatColor.RESET.toString();
            default -> "";
        };
    }

    private static String colour(String token) {
        try {
            return ChatColor.of(token).toString();
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException ignored) {
            return "";
        }
    }

    private static Map<String, String> createTokens() {
        Map<String, String> tokens = new HashMap<>();
        tokens.put("black", ChatColor.BLACK.toString());
        tokens.put("dark_blue", ChatColor.DARK_BLUE.toString());
        tokens.put("dark_green", ChatColor.DARK_GREEN.toString());
        tokens.put("dark_aqua", ChatColor.DARK_AQUA.toString());
        tokens.put("dark_red", ChatColor.DARK_RED.toString());
        tokens.put("dark_purple", ChatColor.DARK_PURPLE.toString());
        tokens.put("gold", ChatColor.GOLD.toString());
        tokens.put("gray", ChatColor.GRAY.toString());
        tokens.put("grey", ChatColor.GRAY.toString());
        tokens.put("dark_gray", ChatColor.DARK_GRAY.toString());
        tokens.put("dark_grey", ChatColor.DARK_GRAY.toString());
        tokens.put("blue", ChatColor.BLUE.toString());
        tokens.put("green", ChatColor.GREEN.toString());
        tokens.put("aqua", ChatColor.AQUA.toString());
        tokens.put("red", ChatColor.RED.toString());
        tokens.put("light_purple", ChatColor.LIGHT_PURPLE.toString());
        tokens.put("yellow", ChatColor.YELLOW.toString());
        tokens.put("white", ChatColor.WHITE.toString());
        tokens.put("bold", ChatColor.BOLD.toString());
        tokens.put("italic", ChatColor.ITALIC.toString());
        tokens.put("underlined", ChatColor.UNDERLINE.toString());
        tokens.put("underline", ChatColor.UNDERLINE.toString());
        tokens.put("strikethrough", ChatColor.STRIKETHROUGH.toString());
        tokens.put("st", ChatColor.STRIKETHROUGH.toString());
        tokens.put("obfuscated", ChatColor.MAGIC.toString());
        tokens.put("magic", ChatColor.MAGIC.toString());
        tokens.put("reset", ChatColor.RESET.toString());
        return tokens;
    }

    public static String round(double value, int decimals) {
        return String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%." + decimals + "f", value);
    }

    /** A model probability, printed as the number the model actually produced.
     *
     *  <p>This used to be a percentage, which rounded 0.954 and 0.9999 to the
     *  same "95%" and 0.004 to "0%" - and those are the readings somebody is
     *  comparing when they watch a buffer climb. Three decimals is the
     *  resolution the thresholds are written in: suspicion, alert and punish
     *  are all set as fractions in config.yml, so the display and the setting
     *  are now in the same units. */
    public static String probability(double fraction) {
        if (Double.isNaN(fraction)) {
            return "-";
        }
        return String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%.3f", fraction);
    }

    public static String heatColour(double fraction) {
        double clamped = Math.max(0.0D, Math.min(1.0D, fraction));
        int red = (int) Math.round(80 + 175 * clamped);
        int green = (int) Math.round(220 - 190 * clamped);
        return String.format(Locale.ROOT, "#%02x%02x%02x", red, green, 70);
    }

    public static String bar(double fraction, int width) {
        double clamped = Math.max(0.0D, Math.min(1.0D, fraction));
        int filled = (int) Math.round(clamped * width);
        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder("<").append(heatColour(clamped)).append('>');
        builder.append("|".repeat(filled));
        builder.append("<dark_gray>").append(".".repeat(width - filled));
        return builder.toString();
    }
}

```

`src/main/java/me/everyone/oculusai/core/Platform.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.core;

import java.lang.reflect.InvocationTargetException;
import java.lang.reflect.Method;
import java.lang.reflect.Modifier;
import java.util.function.Consumer;
import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;
import org.bukkit.Bukkit;
import org.bukkit.Location;
import org.bukkit.entity.Entity;
import org.bukkit.entity.Player;

/** Which server this is running on, and how to get onto the right thread.
 *
 * <p>Paper has one thread that owns every entity in every world, so a single
 * repeating task can read the lot. Folia splits the world into regions, each
 * ticked by its own thread, and an entity may only be touched from the thread
 * that currently owns it; there is no thread from which all of them are legal.
 * Code that wants to touch a player therefore has to say so, and this class is
 * the only place that knows which server it is talking to.
 *
 * <p>Three places to be, then, and every feature here has to name one: the
 * global region, which owns no entity and no block; an entity's own region,
 * which owns that entity and whatever it is standing in; and a location's
 * region, which owns the blocks and the entities of an area. Anything that
 * needs two of them at once has to pass a snapshot between them rather than
 * reach across - which is what the holograms, the manikin and the spectator
 * follow now do, and why they used to be switched off here instead.
 *
 * <p>Folia's schedulers are reached by reflection rather than by compiling
 * against them. The plugin ships one jar per Minecraft generation, not one per
 * server fork, and paper-api has none of these types: a direct call would turn
 * a Folia-only class into a hard requirement and stop the jar loading on the
 * Paper servers that are the overwhelming majority. Reflection keeps the Paper
 * path exactly what it was and costs one lookup per scheduled task.
 */
public final class Platform {

    /** A scheduled task, however this server chose to represent one. */
    public interface Cancellable {
        void cancel();
    }

    private final OculusAI plugin;
    private final boolean folia;

    public Platform(OculusAI plugin) {
        this.plugin = plugin;
        this.folia = detect();
    }

    /** True on Folia and its derivatives. */
    public boolean folia() {
        return folia;
    }

    private static boolean detect() {
        try {
            // The regionised server class exists only where the world is
            // actually split into regions. Checking for the scheduler method
            // instead would also match the compatibility shims some forks
            // expose while still ticking on one thread.
            Class.forName("io.papermc.paper.threadedregions.RegionizedServer");
            return true;
        } catch (ClassNotFoundException absent) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    /** Runs an action every {@code periodTicks}, not tied to any one entity.
     *
     * <p>This is the plugin's heartbeat. On Folia it lands on the global
     * region thread, which owns no entities: whatever it does with a player
     * has to be handed to {@link #onEntity} first. */
    public Cancellable globalRepeating(long initialDelayTicks, long periodTicks, Runnable action) {
        long delay = Math.max(1L, initialDelayTicks);
        long period = Math.max(1L, periodTicks);
        if (!folia) {
            var task = plugin.getServer().getScheduler()
                    .runTaskTimer(plugin, action, delay, period);
            return task::cancel;
        }
        Object scheduler = invoke(Bukkit.class, "getGlobalRegionScheduler", null);
        Object task = invoke(scheduler, "runAtFixedRate",
                new Class<?>[] {org.bukkit.plugin.Plugin.class, Consumer.class, long.class, long.class},
                plugin, (Consumer<Object>) ignored -> action.run(), delay, period);
        return () -> invoke(task, "cancel", null);
    }

    /** Runs an action once on the thread that owns no entity and no block.
     *
     * <p>Нужно тому, что Folia разрешает только там: {@code dispatchCommand}
     * - именно такой случай, он требует global-поток и бросает
     * {@code IllegalStateException: Dispatching command async} с любого
     * другого. Регионального потока при этом достаточно много: команда,
     * набранная игроком, исполняется на потоке его региона, а не на global.
     *
     * <p>Отличается от {@link #globalRepeating} только тем, что выполняется
     * один раз. На Paper global-региона нет вовсе, и это обычный заход на
     * главный поток - inline, если мы уже на нём. */
    public void onGlobal(Runnable action) {
        if (action == null) {
            return;
        }
        if (!folia) {
            plugin.mainThread().run(action);
            return;
        }
        Object scheduler = invoke(Bukkit.class, "getGlobalRegionScheduler", null);
        invoke(scheduler, "run",
                new Class<?>[] {org.bukkit.plugin.Plugin.class, Consumer.class},
                plugin, (Consumer<Object>) ignored -> action.run());
    }

    /** Runs an action on the thread that owns this entity, as soon as it can.
     *
     * <p>On Paper that is the main thread, and if the caller is already on it
     * the action runs inline - the behaviour {@code MainThread} always had. On
     * Folia it goes to the entity's own scheduler, which also means it is
     * simply dropped if the entity is gone by then, which is what we want for
     * every caller here: a sound for a player who logged off, a kick for a
     * player already removed. */
    public void onEntity(Entity entity, Runnable action) {
        if (entity == null) {
            return;
        }
        if (!folia) {
            plugin.mainThread().run(action);
            return;
        }
        Object scheduler = invoke(entity, "getScheduler", null);
        invoke(scheduler, "run",
                new Class<?>[] {org.bukkit.plugin.Plugin.class, Consumer.class, Runnable.class},
                plugin, (Consumer<Object>) ignored -> action.run(), null);
    }

    /** Runs an action every {@code periodTicks} on the thread owning this
     *  entity, for as long as the entity exists. */
    public Cancellable entityRepeating(Entity entity, long initialDelayTicks, long periodTicks,
                                       Runnable action) {
        long delay = Math.max(1L, initialDelayTicks);
        long period = Math.max(1L, periodTicks);
        if (!folia) {
            var task = plugin.getServer().getScheduler()
                    .runTaskTimer(plugin, action, delay, period);
            return task::cancel;
        }
        Object scheduler = invoke(entity, "getScheduler", null);
        Object task = invoke(scheduler, "runAtFixedRate",
                new Class<?>[] {org.bukkit.plugin.Plugin.class, Consumer.class, Runnable.class,
                        long.class, long.class},
                plugin, (Consumer<Object>) ignored -> action.run(), null, delay, period);
        return () -> {
            if (task != null) {
                invoke(task, "cancel", null);
            }
        };
    }

    /** Runs an action on the thread that owns this place in the world.
     *
     * <p>The missing third scheduler, and the reason several features were
     * simply off on Folia. {@link #globalRepeating} runs where no entity is
     * legal and {@link #onEntity} runs where exactly one is; neither can read
     * a block, an arbitrary chunk, or the entities standing in an area. Folia
     * ties all of those to the region that owns the location, which is what
     * this hands the work to.
     *
     * <p>On Paper it is the main thread, like everything else. */
    public void onRegion(Location where, Runnable action) {
        if (where == null || where.getWorld() == null) {
            return;
        }
        if (!folia) {
            plugin.mainThread().run(action);
            return;
        }
        Object scheduler = invoke(Bukkit.class, "getRegionScheduler", null);
        invoke(scheduler, "execute",
                new Class<?>[] {org.bukkit.plugin.Plugin.class, org.bukkit.World.class,
                        int.class, int.class, Runnable.class},
                plugin, where.getWorld(), where.getBlockX() >> 4, where.getBlockZ() >> 4,
                action);
    }

    /** Runs an action every {@code periodTicks} on the thread owning this
     *  place. Used for upkeep of a fixed area - the test arena's mobs and
     *  scoreboards - which belongs to one region however many players walk
     *  through it. */
    public Cancellable regionRepeating(Location where, long initialDelayTicks,
                                       long periodTicks, Runnable action) {
        long delay = Math.max(1L, initialDelayTicks);
        long period = Math.max(1L, periodTicks);
        if (where == null || where.getWorld() == null) {
            return () -> { };
        }
        if (!folia) {
            var task = plugin.getServer().getScheduler()
                    .runTaskTimer(plugin, action, delay, period);
            return task::cancel;
        }
        Object scheduler = invoke(Bukkit.class, "getRegionScheduler", null);
        Object task = invoke(scheduler, "runAtFixedRate",
                new Class<?>[] {org.bukkit.plugin.Plugin.class, Location.class, Consumer.class,
                        long.class, long.class},
                plugin, where, (Consumer<Object>) ignored -> action.run(), delay, period);
        return () -> {
            if (task != null) {
                invoke(task, "cancel", null);
            }
        };
    }

    /** Whether the caller's thread owns this entity right now.
     *
     * <p>Always true on Paper, where one thread owns everything. On Folia it
     * is the question anything touching a second entity has to ask, and the
     * only honest way to ask it: region ownership is not a property of the
     * entity, it is a property of the entity *and* the asking thread. */
    public boolean owns(Entity entity) {
        if (entity == null) {
            return false;
        }
        if (!folia) {
            return plugin.mainThread().isCurrent();
        }
        Object answer = invoke(Bukkit.getServer(), "isOwnedByCurrentRegion",
                new Class<?>[] {Entity.class}, entity);
        return answer instanceof Boolean owned && owned;
    }

    /** Whether the caller's thread owns this chunk right now. Same question
     *  as {@link #owns(Entity)}, asked of a place: a block read is only legal
     *  from the region that owns the chunk it is in. */
    public boolean owns(org.bukkit.World world, int chunkX, int chunkZ) {
        if (world == null) {
            return false;
        }
        if (!folia) {
            return plugin.mainThread().isCurrent();
        }
        Object answer = invoke(Bukkit.getServer(), "isOwnedByCurrentRegion",
                new Class<?>[] {org.bukkit.World.class, int.class, int.class},
                world, chunkX, chunkZ);
        return answer instanceof Boolean owned && owned;
    }

    /** Moves a player, and runs something once they have arrived.
     *
     * <p>Always the asynchronous teleport, on both servers. On Folia a plain
     * {@code teleport} across a region boundary is refused outright; on Paper
     * the asynchronous one is the same teleport with the chunk load waited on
     * rather than forced, which is what anybody wants anyway. The callback
     * lands on the thread that owns the player at their destination, which is
     * exactly where a caller wanting to touch them next has to be. */
    public void teleport(Player player, Location destination, Runnable arrived) {
        if (player == null || destination == null) {
            return;
        }
        player.teleportAsync(destination).thenAccept(moved -> {
            if (moved && arrived != null) {
                onEntity(player, arrived);
            }
        });
    }

    /** Finds a method that can actually be called.
     *
     * <p>Not the same thing as finding a method. Folia's schedulers hand back
     * implementations whose classes are not public -
     * {@code FoliaEntityScheduler$EntityScheduledTask} is the one that
     * mattered - and a public method on a non-public class cannot be invoked
     * reflectively at all: the lookup succeeds and the call fails with
     * IllegalAccessException. Every {@code cancel()} on this server went that
     * way, which meant no scheduled task could be stopped: the punishment
     * show cancelled its frame task, threw instead, never reached the line
     * that disconnects, and left the cheater frozen in mid-air rather than
     * kicked. The animation ran, the kick never came, and nothing in the
     * plugin said why.
     *
     * <p>So the method is taken from the public interface that declares it,
     * which is the thing the server actually promises. Opening up the
     * implementation is the last resort and works only because Paper is on
     * the class path rather than in a module of its own. */
    private static Method lookup(Class<?> owner, String name, Class<?>[] signature)
            throws NoSuchMethodException {
        Method direct = signature == null ? owner.getMethod(name) : owner.getMethod(name, signature);
        if (Modifier.isPublic(direct.getDeclaringClass().getModifiers())) {
            return direct;
        }
        for (Class<?> type : supertypes(owner)) {
            if (!Modifier.isPublic(type.getModifiers())) {
                continue;
            }
            try {
                return signature == null ? type.getMethod(name) : type.getMethod(name, signature);
            } catch (NoSuchMethodException notHere) {
                // A supertype that does not declare it; keep looking.
            }
        }
        direct.setAccessible(true);
        return direct;
    }

    /** Every interface and superclass of a type, nearest first. */
    private static java.util.Set<Class<?>> supertypes(Class<?> type) {
        // A set, because add() is also the "have I seen this already" test
        // here: a type reached through two different interfaces must not be
        // queued twice.
        java.util.Set<Class<?>> found = new java.util.LinkedHashSet<>();
        java.util.Deque<Class<?>> queue = new java.util.ArrayDeque<>();
        queue.add(type);
        while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
            Class<?> next = queue.poll();
            for (Class<?> parent : next.getInterfaces()) {
                if (found.add(parent)) {
                    queue.add(parent);
                }
            }
            Class<?> superclass = next.getSuperclass();
            if (superclass != null && superclass != Object.class && found.add(superclass)) {
                queue.add(superclass);
            }
        }
        return found;
    }

    /** Calls a method that only exists on Folia.
     *
     * <p>Anything going wrong here is a mismatch between this code and the
     * server's own API, not a condition a caller could handle, so it is thrown
     * rather than swallowed: a Folia scheduler that silently did nothing would
     * leave the plugin looking enabled and analysing nobody. */
    private static Object invoke(Object target, String name, Class<?>[] signature, Object... args) {
        boolean isStatic = target instanceof Class<?>;
        Class<?> owner = isStatic ? (Class<?>) target : target.getClass();
        try {
            Method method = lookup(owner, name, signature);
            return method.invoke(isStatic ? null : target, args);
        } catch (NoSuchMethodException | IllegalAccessException | SecurityException failure) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "This server's " + name + " does not look like Folia's", failure);
        } catch (InvocationTargetException failure) {
            Throwable cause = failure.getCause();
            if (cause instanceof RuntimeException runtime) {
                throw runtime;
            }
            if (cause instanceof Error error) {
                throw error;
            }
            throw new IllegalStateException("Folia's " + name + " failed", cause);
        }
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/me/everyone/oculusai/core/ServiceHost.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.core;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

public final class ServiceHost {

    private final Logger logger;
    private final Map<Class<? extends Service>, Service> services = new LinkedHashMap<>();

    public ServiceHost(Logger logger) {
        this.logger = logger;
    }

    public <T extends Service> T add(T service) {
        services.put(service.getClass(), service);
        return service;
    }

    public void enableAll() {
        for (Service service : services.values()) {
            try {
                service.enable();
            } catch (Throwable failure) {
                logger.log(Level.SEVERE, "Failed to enable " + service.name(), failure);
                disableAll();
                throw failure;
            }
        }
    }

    public void disableAll() {
        List<Service> reversed = new ArrayList<>(services.values());
        Collections.reverse(reversed);
        for (Service service : reversed) {
            try {
                service.disable();
            } catch (Throwable failure) {
                logger.log(Level.SEVERE, "Failed to disable " + service.name(), failure);
            }
        }
    }

    public void reloadAll() {
        for (Service service : services.values()) {
            try {
                service.reload();
            } catch (Throwable failure) {
                logger.log(Level.SEVERE, "Failed to reload " + service.name(), failure);
            }
        }
    }

    public void clear() {
        services.clear();
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/me/everyone/oculusai/core/TickLoop.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.core;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArrayList;
import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;

public final class TickLoop implements Service {

    private final OculusAI plugin;
    private final List<Timer> timers = new CopyOnWriteArrayList<>();
    private Platform.Cancellable task;
    private volatile long tick;

    public TickLoop(OculusAI plugin) {
        this.plugin = plugin;
    }

    @Override
    public void enable() {
        tick = 0L;
        // On Folia this is the global region thread: it owns no entities, so
        // anything a timer does to a player has to go through
        // Platform.onEntity first.
        task = plugin.platform().globalRepeating(1L, 1L, this::runTick);
    }

    @Override
    public void disable() {
        if (task != null) {
            task.cancel();
            task = null;
        }
        timers.clear();
    }

    public Handle every(long periodTicks, Runnable action) {
        return every(periodTicks, periodTicks, action);
    }

    public Handle every(long initialDelayTicks, long periodTicks, Runnable action) {
        return schedule(Math.max(0L, initialDelayTicks), Math.max(1L, periodTicks), action);
    }

    public Handle after(long delayTicks, Runnable action) {
        return schedule(Math.max(0L, delayTicks), 0L, action);
    }

    public void runNow(Runnable action) {
        plugin.mainThread().run(action);
    }

    private Handle schedule(long delayTicks, long periodTicks, Runnable action) {
        Timer timer = new Timer(tick + delayTicks, periodTicks, action);
        timers.add(timer);
        return timer;
    }

    private void runTick() {
        long now = ++tick;
        for (Timer timer : timers) {
            if (timer.cancelled) {
                timers.remove(timer);
                continue;
            }
            if (timer.due > now) {
                continue;
            }
            try {
                timer.action.run();
            } catch (Throwable failure) {
                plugin.getLogger().log(java.util.logging.Level.SEVERE, "Uncaught tick task failure", failure);
            }
            if (timer.period == 0L) {
                timers.remove(timer);
            } else {
                timer.due = now + timer.period;
            }
        }
    }

    private final class Timer implements Handle {

        private final long period;
        private final Runnable action;
        private long due;
        private volatile boolean cancelled;

        private Timer(long due, long period, Runnable action) {
            this.due = due;
            this.period = period;
            this.action = action;
        }

        @Override
        public void cancel() {
            cancelled = true;
        }
    }

    public interface Handle {
        void cancel();
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/me/everyone/oculusai/core/Values.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.core;

import me.everyone.oculusai.config.Config;

/** One colour language for probability and buffer everywhere they are shown.
 *
 * <p>Chat alerts and the monitor used to print both values in the same grey as
 * the surrounding text, so the number that mattered was the hardest thing to
 * find. The thresholds are the same ones the checks use: grey below suspicion,
 * yellow at the alert line, red at the punishment line. */
public final class Values {

    private Values() {
    }

    public static String probability(Config config, double probability) {
        if (Double.isNaN(probability)) {
            return "<dark_gray><bold>-";
        }
        String colour;
        if (probability < config.suspicion()) {
            colour = "gray";
        } else if (probability < 0.7D) {
            colour = "yellow";
        } else if (probability < 0.9D) {
            colour = "gold";
        } else {
            colour = "red";
        }
        // Bold: in a chat full of grey the number is the thing being read.
        // The tag that follows it in inline() clears the bold again.
        return "<" + colour + "><bold>" + Msg.probability(probability);
    }

    public static String buffer(Config config, double buffer) {
        String colour;
        if (buffer >= config.punishAt()) {
            colour = "red";
        } else if (buffer >= config.alertAt()) {
            colour = "gold";
        } else if (buffer > 0.0D) {
            colour = "green";
        } else {
            colour = "dark_gray";
        }
        return "<" + colour + "><bold>" + Msg.round(buffer, 1);
    }

    /** How many of the newest readings the hologram lists after AVG. */
    public static final int RECENT = 5;

    /** Средняя из последних {@link #RECENT} показаний, в цвете детекта. */
    public static String average(java.util.List<me.everyone.oculusai.player.PlayerData.Reading> readings) {
        if (readings.isEmpty()) {
            return "<gray>-";
        }
        int from = Math.max(0, readings.size() - RECENT);
        double total = 0.0D;
        for (int i = from; i < readings.size(); i++) {
            total += readings.get(i).probability();
        }
        double mean = total / (readings.size() - from);
        return "<" + Msg.heatColour(mean) + ">"
                + String.format(java.util.Locale.ROOT, "%.2f", Math.max(0.0D, Math.min(1.0D, mean)));
    }

    /** Последние показания слева направо, от старого к новому, каждое в цвете
     *  детекта. Коротко - ".28", а не "0.283": пять показаний по пять знаков
     *  над головой не влезали в строку голограммы и переносились. */
    public static String recent(java.util.List<me.everyone.oculusai.player.PlayerData.Reading> readings) {
        if (readings.isEmpty()) {
            return "<dark_gray>-";
        }
        StringBuilder line = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = Math.max(0, readings.size() - RECENT); i < readings.size(); i++) {
            double value = readings.get(i).probability();
            if (line.length() > 0) {
                line.append(' ');
            }
            line.append('<').append(Msg.heatColour(value)).append('>').append(shortValue(value));
        }
        return line.toString();
    }

    /** ".28", "1.0" и "-" для пропуска. */
    public static String shortValue(double value) {
        if (!Double.isFinite(value)) {
            return "-";
        }
        double clamped = Math.max(0.0D, Math.min(1.0D, value));
        if (clamped >= 0.995D) {
            return "1.0";
        }
        return String.format(java.util.Locale.ROOT, "%.2f", clamped).substring(1);
    }

    /** The compact "p 82% | buf 4.1/10.0" block used by alerts. */
    public static String inline(Config config, double probability, double buffer) {
        return "<gray>p " + probability(config, probability)
                + " <dark_gray>| <gray>buf " + buffer(config, buffer)
                + "<dark_gray>/<gray>" + Msg.round(config.bufferMax(), 1);
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/me/everyone/oculusai/detection/AimGeometry.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.detection;

import me.everyone.oculusai.player.EntityTracker;

/** Где было перекрестие относительно цели - в каждом тике, а не только в ударе.
 *
 *  <p>Самый сильный признак доводки прицела - не само вращение, а угол от
 *  перекрестия до хитбокса и то, как он менялся. У человека ошибка падает
 *  неровно и перелетает за цель; у аимбота она схлопывается в ноль за один тик
 *  и там держится. Различает их именно кривая, а не её последнее значение.
 *
 *  <p>До появления этого класса такой угол считался в двух местах - по одному
 *  в каждом мостике версии, - и только в тике атаки, потому что цель написана
 *  в пакете атаки. Здесь он один, и считается он каждый тик: по ближайшему
 *  игроко-подобному, когда никто ничего не сказал о цели.
 *
 *  <p>Ничего не кэширует и ни на что не ссылается: это арифметика над тем, что
 *  трекер уже знает. Вызывается из мостика на каждый пакет движения, то есть
 *  двадцать раз в секунду на игрока в бою, поэтому здесь нет ни аллокаций в
 *  цикле, ни обращений к Bukkit. */
public final class AimGeometry {

    /** Насколько далеко вообще искать цель.
     *
     *  <p>Дальше этого рука уже не ведётся по игроку: дальность удара в
     *  ваниле около трёх блоков, и запас здесь на то, чтобы видеть подход и
     *  доводку до удара, а не только сам удар. Слишком большой радиус вреден -
     *  он начинает подбирать того, кто просто стоит в стороне, и канал смены
     *  цели превращается в шум. */
    public static final double SEARCH_BLOCKS = 12.0D;

    /** Что в этом тике знал бы о цели тот, кто смотрит на экран. */
    public record TickAim(
            /** Угол до центра хитбокса, градусы. NaN - цели рядом нет. */
            double centreAngle,
            /** Угол до ближайшей точки хитбокса: 0, если перекрестие уже на
             *  цели. Это та величина, которую аимбот фактически и
             *  минимизирует, и у неё есть дно - в отличие от угла до центра,
             *  который у стоящего в упор велик даже при идеальном прицеле. */
            double edgeAngle,
            /** Метры до цели. Угловые величины без неё не читаются: один
             *  градус в упор и один градус с десяти блоков - это разный
             *  промах в блоках. */
            double distance,
            /** Id цели, или -1. Сам в признаки не идёт - по нему считается
             *  смена цели. */
            int targetId,
            /** Сколько игроко-подобных рядом, кроме себя. */
            int targetsNear,
            /** Горизонтальная скорость, блоков в тик. Страйф-флик легита и
             *  доводка выглядят одинаково, пока не видно, что под игроком
             *  едет земля: человек крутит камеру, потому что бежит боком. */
            double speed) {

        public static final TickAim NONE =
                new TickAim(Double.NaN, Double.NaN, Double.NaN, -1, 0, 0.0D);
    }

    private AimGeometry() {
    }

    /** Угол между взглядом и направлением на точку, градусы.
     *
     *  <p>Это та же арифметика, что считала {@code aimError} в мостиках, и
     *  она здесь затем, чтобы определение было одно: угол до центра хитбокса
     *  в тике удара и он же в остальных тиках должны быть одним числом, иначе
     *  модель учится на стыке двух определений. */
    public static double angleTo(EntityTracker.Tracked self, EntityTracker.Tracked target,
                                 double yawDegrees, double pitchDegrees) {
        if (self == null || target == null) {
            return Double.NaN;
        }
        double eyeY = self.y() + self.height() * EYE_RATIO;
        double toX = target.x() - self.x();
        double toY = target.centreY() - eyeY;
        double toZ = target.z() - self.z();
        double length = Math.sqrt(toX * toX + toY * toY + toZ * toZ);
        if (length < 0.1D) {
            return Double.NaN;
        }

        double yaw = Math.toRadians(yawDegrees);
        double pitch = Math.toRadians(pitchDegrees);
        double cosPitch = Math.cos(pitch);
        double lookX = -cosPitch * Math.sin(yaw);
        double lookY = -Math.sin(pitch);
        double lookZ = cosPitch * Math.cos(yaw);

        double dot = (toX * lookX + toY * lookY + toZ * lookZ) / length;
        return Math.toDegrees(Math.acos(Math.max(-1.0D, Math.min(1.0D, dot))));
    }

    /** Весь тиковый контекст прицела по ближайшей цели. */
    public static TickAim of(EntityTracker tracker, int selfId,
                             double yawDegrees, double pitchDegrees) {
        if (tracker == null) {
            return TickAim.NONE;
        }
        EntityTracker.Tracked self = tracker.get(selfId);
        if (self == null) {
            return TickAim.NONE;
        }
        double speed = speedOf(tracker, selfId);
        EntityTracker.Near near = tracker.nearestPlayerLike(self, selfId, SEARCH_BLOCKS);
        if (near == null) {
            return new TickAim(Double.NaN, Double.NaN, Double.NaN, -1, 0, speed);
        }

        double centre = angleTo(self, near.entry(), yawDegrees, pitchDegrees);
        return new TickAim(centre,
                edgeAngle(centre, near.entry(), near.distance()),
                near.distance(),
                near.entityId(),
                tracker.countPlayerLike(self, selfId, SEARCH_BLOCKS),
                speed);
    }

    /** Горизонтальная скорость по двум последним позициям трекера.
     *
     *  <p>По истории трекера, а не по {@code player.getVelocity()}: вектор
     *  скорости у Bukkit - это то, что сервер собирается применить, а здесь
     *  нужно то, что игрок уже прошёл. Нормируется на тик, потому что между
     *  выборками трекера не ровно 50 мс, и делить надо на настоящее время. */
    private static double speedOf(EntityTracker tracker, int selfId) {
        java.util.List<EntityTracker.Tracked> recent = tracker.recent(selfId);
        if (recent.size() < 2) {
            return 0.0D;
        }
        EntityTracker.Tracked now = recent.get(recent.size() - 1);
        EntityTracker.Tracked before = recent.get(recent.size() - 2);
        long elapsed = now.at() - before.at();
        if (elapsed <= 0L) {
            return 0.0D;
        }
        double dx = now.x() - before.x();
        double dz = now.z() - before.z();
        return Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz) * 50.0D / elapsed;
    }

    /** Угол до края хитбокса: угол до центра минус его угловой радиус.
     *
     *  <p>Приближение, и сознательное. Точный ответ - угол между взглядом и
     *  ближайшей точкой параллелепипеда, и он требует проекции луча на три
     *  плоскости; разница с этим приближением есть только когда перекрестие
     *  стоит у самого угла хитбокса, то есть там, где обе величины и так
     *  близки к нулю. Угловой радиус берётся по половине ширины, а не по
     *  диагонали: ширина - это то, что надо накрыть по горизонтали, а по
     *  вертикали цель выше, чем шире, и завышенный радиус обнулял бы угол
     *  тогда, когда рука на цель ещё не наведена. */
    private static double edgeAngle(double centreAngle, EntityTracker.Tracked target,
                                    double distance) {
        if (Double.isNaN(centreAngle) || distance < 0.1D) {
            return Double.NaN;
        }
        double radius = Math.toDegrees(Math.atan2(target.width() / 2.0D, distance));
        return Math.max(0.0D, centreAngle - radius);
    }

    /** Та же доля, что в трекере: глаза относительно высоты хитбокса. */
    private static final double EYE_RATIO = 1.62D / 1.8D;
}
```
