`src/main/java/me/everyone/oculusai/detection/crystal/Crystals.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.detection.crystal;

import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;
import me.everyone.oculusai.core.Service;
import me.everyone.oculusai.player.PlayerData;
import org.bukkit.Location;
import org.bukkit.Material;
import org.bukkit.block.Block;
import org.bukkit.entity.EnderCrystal;
import org.bukkit.entity.Entity;
import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
import org.bukkit.entity.Projectile;
import org.bukkit.event.EventHandler;
import org.bukkit.event.EventPriority;
import org.bukkit.event.HandlerList;
import org.bukkit.event.Listener;
import org.bukkit.event.block.Action;
import org.bukkit.World;
import org.bukkit.block.data.type.RespawnAnchor;
import org.bukkit.event.block.BlockBreakEvent;
import org.bukkit.event.block.BlockPlaceEvent;
import org.bukkit.event.entity.EntityDamageByEntityEvent;
import org.bukkit.event.entity.EntityDamageEvent;
import org.bukkit.event.entity.EntityResurrectEvent;
import org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerInteractEvent;
import org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerItemHeldEvent;
import org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack;
import org.bukkit.util.Vector;

/** Кристалльные события игроков - в их {@link CrystalTimeline}.
 *
 * <p>Через события Bukkit, а не пакеты: так одинаково на 1.16.5 и 1.21 и без
 * разбора пакета постановки, который между версиями отличается. Чего так не
 * увидеть - удара по кристаллу, которого клиент ещё не мог видеть, - то
 * будет отдельной проверкой на пакетах.
 *
 * <p>Урон от взрыва записывается тому, кто разбил кристалл: по другим - как
 * нанесённый, по себе - как полученный. Кто разбил, помнится по кристаллу
 * несколько секунд - взрыв приходит сразу после удара.
 */
public final class Crystals implements Service, Listener {

    private static final long BREAKER_MS = 5_000L;
    private static final int BREAKER_LIMIT = 4_096;

    private final OculusAI plugin;
    /** Кристалл -> (кто разбил, когда). */
    private final Map<UUID, Breaker> breakers = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

    private record Breaker(UUID player, long at) {
    }

    /** Подорванный якорь: кто, где и когда - чтобы урон от его взрыва
     *  записать тому, кто подорвал. */
    private record Detonation(UUID player, String world, double x, double y, double z, long at) {
    }

    private final java.util.Deque<Detonation> detonations = new java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentLinkedDeque<>();
    /** Урон от взрыва якоря приходит в том же тике; расстояние - радиус
     *  взрыва с запасом. */
    private static final long DETONATION_MS = 1_500L;
    private static final double DETONATION_RANGE = 12.0D;

    public Crystals(OculusAI plugin) {
        this.plugin = plugin;
    }

    @Override
    public void enable() {
        plugin.getServer().getPluginManager().registerEvents(this, plugin);
    }

    @Override
    public void disable() {
        HandlerList.unregisterAll(this);
        breakers.clear();
        detonations.clear();
        CrystalTimeline.clearAnchors();
    }

    private CrystalTimeline timeline(Player player) {
        PlayerData data = plugin.data().get(player);
        return data == null ? null : data.crystal();
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.MONITOR, ignoreCancelled = true)
    public void onPlace(PlayerInteractEvent event) {
        if (event.getAction() != Action.RIGHT_CLICK_BLOCK) {
            return;
        }
        ItemStack item = event.getItem();
        Block block = event.getClickedBlock();
        if (item == null || item.getType() != Material.END_CRYSTAL || block == null) {
            return;
        }
        if (block.getType() != Material.OBSIDIAN && block.getType() != Material.BEDROCK) {
            return;
        }
        CrystalTimeline timeline = timeline(event.getPlayer());
        if (timeline == null) {
            return;
        }
        Location point = block.getLocation().add(0.5D, 1.0D, 0.5D);
        timeline.placed(angle(event.getPlayer(), point), distance(event.getPlayer(), point));
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.MONITOR, ignoreCancelled = true)
    public void onDamage(EntityDamageByEntityEvent event) {
        Entity victim = event.getEntity();
        if (victim instanceof EnderCrystal crystal) {
            Player breaker = playerOf(event.getDamager());
            if (breaker == null) {
                return;
            }
            remember(crystal.getUniqueId(), breaker.getUniqueId());
            CrystalTimeline timeline = timeline(breaker);
            if (timeline != null) {
                // Удар рукой, а не стрелой: только у него есть пакет удара,
                // по которому видно, мог ли клиент знать о кристалле.
                if (event.getDamager() == breaker && timeline.hitBeforeSeen(crystal.getEntityId())) {
                    PlayerData data = plugin.data().get(breaker);
                    if (data != null) {
                        plugin.checks().onCrystalUnseenHit(data);
                    }
                }
                // Центр кристалла - на блок выше его основания.
                Location centre = crystal.getLocation().add(0.0D, 1.0D, 0.0D);
                timeline.broken(angle(breaker, centre), distance(breaker, centre));
            }
            return;
        }
        if (event.getDamager() instanceof EnderCrystal crystal && victim instanceof Player hurt) {
            Breaker breaker = breakers.get(crystal.getUniqueId());
            if (breaker == null || System.currentTimeMillis() - breaker.at() > BREAKER_MS) {
                return;
            }
            Player owner = plugin.getServer().getPlayer(breaker.player());
            if (owner == null) {
                return;
            }
            CrystalTimeline timeline = timeline(owner);
            if (timeline == null) {
                return;
            }
            if (owner.getUniqueId().equals(hurt.getUniqueId())) {
                timeline.damageTaken(event.getFinalDamage());
            } else {
                timeline.damageDealt(event.getFinalDamage());
            }
        }
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.MONITOR, ignoreCancelled = true)
    public void onAnchorPlace(BlockPlaceEvent event) {
        if (event.getBlockPlaced().getType() != Material.RESPAWN_ANCHOR) {
            return;
        }
        CrystalTimeline timeline = timeline(event.getPlayer());
        if (timeline != null) {
            Location centre = event.getBlockPlaced().getLocation().add(0.5D, 0.5D, 0.5D);
            timeline.anchorPlaced(angle(event.getPlayer(), centre), distance(event.getPlayer(), centre));
        }
    }

    /** Заряд светокамнем и подрыв. Якорь взрывается от нажатия везде, кроме
     *  Незера: там он ставит точку возрождения. */
    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.MONITOR, ignoreCancelled = true)
    public void onAnchorUse(PlayerInteractEvent event) {
        if (event.getAction() != Action.RIGHT_CLICK_BLOCK) {
            return;
        }
        Block block = event.getClickedBlock();
        if (block == null || block.getType() != Material.RESPAWN_ANCHOR
                || !(block.getBlockData() instanceof RespawnAnchor anchor)) {
            return;
        }
        Player player = event.getPlayer();
        CrystalTimeline timeline = timeline(player);
        if (timeline == null) {
            return;
        }
        Location centre = block.getLocation().add(0.5D, 0.5D, 0.5D);
        double angle = angle(player, centre);
        double distance = distance(player, centre);
        String world = block.getWorld().getName();
        ItemStack item = event.getItem();
        boolean glowstone = item != null && item.getType() == Material.GLOWSTONE;
        if (glowstone && anchor.getCharges() < anchor.getMaximumCharges()) {
            timeline.anchorCharged(angle, distance);
            CrystalTimeline.anchorArmed(world, block.getX(), block.getY(), block.getZ());
            return;
        }
        if (anchor.getCharges() > 0 && block.getWorld().getEnvironment() != World.Environment.NETHER) {
            timeline.anchorExploded(angle, distance);
            CrystalTimeline.anchorGone(world, block.getX(), block.getY(), block.getZ());
            long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
            detonations.removeIf(old -> now - old.at() > DETONATION_MS);
            detonations.add(new Detonation(player.getUniqueId(), world,
                    centre.getX(), centre.getY(), centre.getZ(), now));
        }
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.MONITOR, ignoreCancelled = true)
    public void onAnchorBreak(BlockBreakEvent event) {
        Block block = event.getBlock();
        if (block.getType() == Material.RESPAWN_ANCHOR) {
            CrystalTimeline.anchorGone(block.getWorld().getName(), block.getX(), block.getY(), block.getZ());
        }
    }

    /** Урон от взрыва якоря - тому, кто его подорвал. Кристаллы сюда не
     *  попадают: их взрыв - ENTITY_EXPLOSION и разбирается в onDamage. */
    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.MONITOR, ignoreCancelled = true)
    public void onBlockBlast(EntityDamageEvent event) {
        if (event.getCause() != EntityDamageEvent.DamageCause.BLOCK_EXPLOSION
                || !(event.getEntity() instanceof Player hurt) || detonations.isEmpty()) {
            return;
        }
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        Location at = hurt.getLocation();
        for (Detonation detonation : detonations) {
            if (now - detonation.at() > DETONATION_MS
                    || !detonation.world().equals(at.getWorld().getName())
                    || Math.abs(detonation.x() - at.getX()) > DETONATION_RANGE
                    || Math.abs(detonation.y() - at.getY()) > DETONATION_RANGE
                    || Math.abs(detonation.z() - at.getZ()) > DETONATION_RANGE) {
                continue;
            }
            Player owner = plugin.getServer().getPlayer(detonation.player());
            CrystalTimeline timeline = owner == null ? null : timeline(owner);
            if (timeline == null) {
                return;
            }
            if (owner.getUniqueId().equals(hurt.getUniqueId())) {
                timeline.damageTaken(event.getFinalDamage());
            } else {
                timeline.damageDealt(event.getFinalDamage());
            }
            return;
        }
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.MONITOR, ignoreCancelled = true)
    public void onSlot(PlayerItemHeldEvent event) {
        CrystalTimeline timeline = timeline(event.getPlayer());
        if (timeline != null) {
            timeline.slotSwitched();
        }
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.MONITOR, ignoreCancelled = true)
    public void onTotem(EntityResurrectEvent event) {
        if (event.getEntity() instanceof Player player) {
            CrystalTimeline timeline = timeline(player);
            if (timeline != null) {
                timeline.totemPopped();
            }
        }
    }

    private void remember(UUID crystal, UUID player) {
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        if (breakers.size() > BREAKER_LIMIT) {
            breakers.values().removeIf(entry -> now - entry.at() > BREAKER_MS);
        }
        breakers.put(crystal, new Breaker(player, now));
    }

    private static Player playerOf(Entity damager) {
        if (damager instanceof Player player) {
            return player;
        }
        if (damager instanceof Projectile projectile && projectile.getShooter() instanceof Player player) {
            return player;
        }
        return null;
    }

    /** Угол между взглядом и направлением на точку, градусы. */
    static double angle(Player player, Location point) {
        Location eye = player.getEyeLocation();
        Vector to = point.toVector().subtract(eye.toVector());
        double length = to.length();
        if (length < 0.1D) {
            return Double.NaN;
        }
        Vector look = eye.getDirection();
        double dot = to.dot(look) / (length * look.length());
        return Math.toDegrees(Math.acos(Math.max(-1.0D, Math.min(1.0D, dot))));
    }

    static double distance(Player player, Location point) {
        return player.getEyeLocation().toVector().distance(point.toVector());
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/me/everyone/oculusai/network/ApiClient.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.network;


import me.everyone.oculusai.core.Service;
import me.everyone.oculusai.core.TickLoop;
import com.google.gson.JsonArray;
import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
import com.google.gson.JsonParser;
import java.lang.reflect.Method;
import java.net.URI;
import java.net.http.HttpClient;
import java.net.http.HttpRequest;
import java.net.http.HttpResponse;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture;
import java.util.concurrent.ScheduledFuture;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong;
import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;
import me.everyone.oculusai.player.PlayerData;
import org.bukkit.Location;
import org.bukkit.World;
import org.bukkit.entity.Player;

public final class ApiClient implements Service {

    private final AtomicBoolean reachable = new AtomicBoolean(true);
    private final AtomicLong throttledLoggedAt = new AtomicLong(0L);
    private final AtomicLong probes = new AtomicLong(0L);
    private static final long THROTTLE_LOG_INTERVAL_MS = 60_000L;
    // Probe often, pull settings rarely. Recovery is what the short period is
    // for: while the service is down nothing is analysed, so thirty seconds of
    // it after every blip is thirty seconds of unchecked combat.
    private static final long PROBE_PERIOD_TICKS = 20L * 5L;
    /** Counting who is being analysed is a walk over the tracked players, so
     *  it is done every few seconds rather than every tick. The poll that
     *  sends it is minutes apart anyway. */
    private static final long PRESENCE_SAMPLE_TICKS = 20L * 5L;
    private static final int SETTINGS_EVERY_PROBES = 6;
    // Training is minutes of work behind one request. The ordinary timeout is
    // a second and a half, so sending /train on it guarantees a timeout, and a
    // timeout is what marks the service unreachable - which is why analysis
    // used to pause for every training run the plugin started itself. The run
    // is fire-and-forget from here: the service keeps going whatever this
    // client does, so the call gets room to answer and is not allowed to vote
    // on whether the service is up.
    private static final long TRAIN_TIMEOUT_MS = 10L * 60L * 1000L;

    /** How long a dataset push may take. A capture of a few hundred windows
     *  is a quarter of a megabyte of JSON, and the service has to write it
     *  down before it answers. */
    private static final long DATASET_TIMEOUT_MS = 60L * 1000L;

    private final OculusAI plugin;
    private HttpClient client;
    private ScheduledFuture<?> probeTask;
    private volatile List<Exclusion> exclusions = List.of();
    /** Which dataset schemas the service will accept. Empty until the first
     *  settings fetch lands, which is why the dataset manager treats empty as
     *  "assume only what has always worked" rather than as "nothing works". */
    private volatile Set<Integer> serviceSchemas = Set.of();
    /** Читает ли версия на слоте сырые тики. Спрашивается у сервиса, а не
     *  угадывается: какая версия стоит на слоте, знает только он. */
    /** Нужны ли модели сырые тики; null - сервис ещё не сказал. */
    private volatile Boolean predictWantsTicks;
    /** Стоит ли на сервисе кристалльная модель (настройка crystal_model). */
    private volatile boolean crystalModel;
    /** What the service last said this key is entitled to. Read from the
     *  settings poll: the plan can lapse between restarts, and until this
     *  arrived the only way to find out which model was answering was to ask
     *  somebody with the panel open. */
    private volatile String servicePlan = "";
    private volatile String serviceModel = "";
    private volatile List<ModelChoice> allowedModels = List.of(
            new ModelChoice("fast", "fast", "Monolith Fast", true),
            new ModelChoice("pro", "pro", "Monolith Pro", true));
    private volatile String activeModelId = "";
    private volatile String activeModelChoice = "";
    private volatile String activeModelName = "";
    private volatile boolean datasetAccess;
    private volatile boolean modelDemoted;
    /** Last counts taken on the main thread, for the settings poll to send.
     *  Volatile because the sampler and the poll are different threads. */
    private volatile int onlinePlayers;
    private volatile int analysedPlayers;
    private TickLoop.Handle presenceTask;

    private record Exclusion(String world, String region) {}

    public ApiClient(OculusAI plugin) {
        this.plugin = plugin;
    }

    @Override
    public void enable() {
        client = HttpClient.newBuilder()
                .version(HttpClient.Version.HTTP_1_1)
                .connectTimeout(Duration.ofMillis(plugin.config().apiTimeoutMs()))
                .executor(plugin.worker().executor())
                .build();
        long period = PROBE_PERIOD_TICKS * 50L;
        probeTask = plugin.worker().repeat(this::probe, period, period, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);
        presenceTask = plugin.ticks().every(PRESENCE_SAMPLE_TICKS, this::samplePresence);
        refreshSettings();
    }

    @Override
    public void disable() {
        if (probeTask != null) {
            probeTask.cancel(false);
            probeTask = null;
        }
        if (presenceTask != null) {
            presenceTask.cancel();
            presenceTask = null;
        }
        onlinePlayers = 0;
        analysedPlayers = 0;
    }

    public record Prediction(double probability, String modelId) {}

    /** Scores one window.
     *
     *  <p>The player's UUID rides along because the service's recurrent
     *  models read a session rather than a window: each window is judged on
     *  top of what the model has already seen from this player, and without
     *  a name there is nothing to attach that state to. A service running a
     *  window-only model ignores the field, so sending it costs nothing.
     *
     *  <p>The raw window rides along for the same reason: the service's
     *  trajectory model reads the ticks themselves rather than the columns
     *  computed from them, and there is nothing in the feature map it can be
     *  reconstructed from - a mean is not a sequence. A service running a
     *  column model ignores the field. It is the one part of this request
     *  that is not small - twenty ticks on six channels is a hundred and
     *  twenty numbers against seventeen columns - so it is sent only when
     *  there is a window to send. */
    public CompletableFuture<Prediction> predict(UUID player, UUID combatId, Map<String, Double> features,
                                                 double[] ticks, int tickChannels) {
        JsonObject body = new JsonObject();
        JsonObject values = new JsonObject();
        features.forEach(values::addProperty);
        body.add("features", values);
        if (player != null) {
            body.addProperty("uuid", player.toString());
        }
        body.addProperty("combat_id", combatId.toString());
        String devModel = player == null ? "" : plugin.testServer().devModel(player);
        String arenaSession = player == null ? "" : plugin.testServer().arenaSession(player);
        body.addProperty("expected_model_id", devModel.isEmpty() ? activeModelId : devModel);
        if (ticks != null && ticks.length > 0 && tickChannels > 0) {
            // Без ёмкости: конструктор с ней появился в Gson 2.8.1, а сборка
            // под 1.16 несёт тот Gson, который приходит с её сервером.
            JsonArray window = new JsonArray();
            for (double value : ticks) {
                window.add(value);
            }
            body.add("ticks", window);
            body.addProperty("tick_channels", tickChannels);
        }

        String endpoint = devModel.isEmpty() ? plugin.config().apiUrl() : plugin.config().arenaUrl();
        HttpRequest.Builder request = builder(endpoint, "/predict", plugin.config().apiKey())
                .header("Content-Type", "application/json")
                .POST(HttpRequest.BodyPublishers.ofString(body.toString()));
        if (!arenaSession.isEmpty() && endpoint.equals(plugin.config().arenaUrl())) {
            request.header("X-OculusAI-Arena-Session", arenaSession);
        }
        return send(request.build(), true).thenApply(response -> {
            if (response == null || !response.has("probability")) {
                return null;
            }
            String modelId = response.has("model_id") && !response.get("model_id").isJsonNull()
                    ? response.get("model_id").getAsString() : "";
            return new Prediction(response.get("probability").getAsDouble(), modelId);
        });
    }

    public boolean excluded(Player player) {
        String world = player.getWorld().getName();
        for (Exclusion exclusion : exclusions) {
            if (!exclusion.world().equalsIgnoreCase(world)) {
                continue;
            }
            if (exclusion.region().isBlank() || inWorldGuardRegion(player, exclusion.region())) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    private boolean inWorldGuardRegion(Player player, String wanted) {
        try {
            Object worldGuard = Class.forName("com.sk89q.worldguard.WorldGuard")
                    .getMethod("getInstance").invoke(null);
            Object platform = worldGuard.getClass().getMethod("getPlatform").invoke(worldGuard);
            Object container = platform.getClass().getMethod("getRegionContainer").invoke(platform);
            Object manager = container.getClass().getMethod("get", World.class)
                    .invoke(container, player.getWorld());
            if (manager == null) return false;
            Object vector = Class.forName("com.sk89q.worldedit.bukkit.BukkitAdapter")
                    .getMethod("asBlockVector", Location.class)
                    .invoke(null, player.getLocation());
            Object set = manager.getClass().getMethod("getApplicableRegions", vector.getClass())
                    .invoke(manager, vector);
            Method iterator = set.getClass().getMethod("iterator");
            Object it = iterator.invoke(set);
            while ((Boolean) it.getClass().getMethod("hasNext").invoke(it)) {
                Object region = it.getClass().getMethod("next").invoke(it);
                String id = (String) region.getClass().getMethod("getId").invoke(region);
                if (id.equalsIgnoreCase(wanted)) return true;
            }
        } catch (ReflectiveOperationException | LinkageError ignored) {
        }
        return false;
    }

    /** Нужны ли модели на слоте сырые тики окна в каждом предсказании.
     *
     *  <p>Окно из 32 тиков на 16 каналов - это 512 чисел, порядка шести
     *  килобайт JSON, и уходит оно раз в секунду на каждого, кто дрался.
     *  Колоночная модель их не читает, так что по умолчанию - до первого
     *  ответа настроек - они не шлются: лишний трафик хуже, чем один лишний
     *  цикл предсказания без тиков, а траекторная модель на запрос без них
     *  отвечает понятной ошибкой, а не тихо неверной вероятностью. */
    /** Слать ли тики в /predict. Пока настроек нет, - да: лишние тики модель,
     *  которая их не читает, просто пропустит, а без них модель на тиках
     *  отвечает 422, и первые секунды после запуска анализ стоял. */
    public boolean predictWantsTicks() {
        Boolean wants = predictWantsTicks;
        return wants == null || wants;
    }

    /** Есть ли чем оценивать кристалльные окна. Нет - они не отправляются. */
    public boolean crystalModel() {
        return crystalModel;
    }

    /** Кристалльное окно - модели кристалльного слота. Вероятность или null,
     *  если сервис не ответил или модели нет. */
    public CompletableFuture<Double> predictCrystal(UUID player, Map<String, Double> features,
                                                    double[] ticks, int tickChannels) {
        JsonObject body = new JsonObject();
        JsonObject values = new JsonObject();
        features.forEach(values::addProperty);
        body.add("features", values);
        if (player != null) {
            body.addProperty("uuid", player.toString());
        }
        JsonArray window = new JsonArray();
        for (double value : ticks) {
            window.add(value);
        }
        body.add("ticks", window);
        body.addProperty("tick_channels", tickChannels);
        return postVoting("/predict/crystal", body).thenApply(response ->
                response == null || !response.has("probability")
                        ? null : response.get("probability").getAsDouble());
    }

    public Set<Integer> serviceSchemas() {
        return serviceSchemas;
    }

    /** The plan the service is serving this key under, as of the last poll.
     *  Empty until the first one answers. */
    public String servicePlan() {
        return servicePlan;
    }

    /** Which model actually answers for this key - "fast" or "pro". */
    public String serviceModel() {
        return serviceModel;
    }

    /** True when the key is asking for a better model than the plan now
     *  reaches: the subscription lapsed and Fast is answering. */
    public boolean modelDemoted() {
        return modelDemoted;
    }

    /** Counts the two figures the service cannot work out for itself.
     *
     *  <p>On the main thread, because that is the only place the online player
     *  list may be read: it is a live view of a collection the server mutates
     *  on its own thread, and walking it from the HTTP worker is how a plugin
     *  earns a ConcurrentModificationException in somebody else's crash
     *  report. The numbers are left in two fields for the poll to pick up. */
    private void samplePresence() {
        onlinePlayers = plugin.getServer().getOnlinePlayers().size();
        int analysing = 0;
        long stale = plugin.hudConfig().staleMs();
        for (PlayerData data : plugin.data().all()) {
            if (data.analysing(stale)) {
                analysing++;
            }
        }
        analysedPlayers = analysing;
    }

    /** How many players this server has, and how many of them the anticheat is
     *  scoring right now.
     *
     *  <p>Reported on the settings poll rather than on a schedule of its own:
     *  that poll already happens, and a second timer for two integers would be
     *  a second thing to go wrong. The service cannot derive either number -
     *  a window of combat deliberately carries no identity - so if the server
     *  does not say, nobody knows. */
    private String presenceQuery() {
        return "?players=" + onlinePlayers + "&analysing=" + analysedPlayers;
    }

    public record ModelChoice(String id, String command, String name, boolean allowed) {}

    public boolean datasetAccess() {
        return datasetAccess;
    }

    public String activeModelName() {
        return activeModelName;
    }

    public List<ModelChoice> allowedModels() {
        return allowedModels;
    }

    public String activeModelChoice() {
        return activeModelChoice;

    public boolean acceptsModel(UUID player, String modelId) {
        String devModel = plugin.testServer().devModel(player);
        String expected = devModel.isEmpty() ? activeModelId : devModel;
        return modelId.isEmpty() || expected.isEmpty() || modelId.equals(expected);
    }

    private void updateActiveModel(JsonObject response, String idField, String choiceField, String nameField) {
        if (response.has(choiceField)) {
            activeModelChoice = response.get(choiceField).getAsString();
        }
        if (response.has(nameField)) {
            activeModelName = response.get(nameField).isJsonNull() ? "" : response.get(nameField).getAsString();
        }
        if (response.has(idField)) {
            String previous = activeModelId;
            activeModelId = response.get(idField).isJsonNull() ? "" : response.get(idField).getAsString();
            if (!previous.isEmpty() && !previous.equals(activeModelId)) {
                for (var data : plugin.data().all()) {
                    plugin.platform().onEntity(data.player(), () -> {
                        data.resetAimBuffer();
                        plugin.alerts().reset(data.uuid(), "aim");
                    });
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public CompletableFuture<Boolean> changeModel(ModelChoice choice) {
        JsonObject body = new JsonObject();
        body.addProperty("model_id", choice.id());
        return post("/plugin/model", body).thenApply(response -> {
            if (response == null || !response.has("model_id")) {
                refreshSettings();
                return false;
            }
            updateActiveModel(response, "model_id", "model_choice", "model_name");
            predictWantsTicks = response.get("predict_wants_ticks").getAsBoolean();
            return true;
        });
    }

    private void refreshSettings() {
        send(builder("/plugin/dataset-access", plugin.config().datasetKey()).GET().build(), false)
                .thenAccept(response -> datasetAccess = response != null && response.has("allowed")
                        && response.get("allowed").getAsBoolean());
        get("/plugin/settings" + presenceQuery()).thenAccept(response -> {
            if (response == null) return;
            if (response.has("allowed_models")) {
                List<ModelChoice> choices = new ArrayList<>();
                response.getAsJsonArray("allowed_models").forEach(element -> {
                    JsonObject choice = element.getAsJsonObject();
                    choices.add(new ModelChoice(choice.get("id").getAsString(),
                            choice.get("command").getAsString(), choice.get("name").getAsString(),
                            !choice.has("allowed") || choice.get("allowed").getAsBoolean()));
                });
                if (!choices.isEmpty()) {
                    allowedModels = List.copyOf(choices);
                }
            }
            updateActiveModel(response, "active_model_id", "active_model_choice", "active_model_name");
            if (response.has("feature_versions")) {
                Set<Integer> schemas = new java.util.LinkedHashSet<>();
                response.getAsJsonArray("feature_versions").forEach(element -> {
                    try {
                        schemas.add(element.getAsInt());
                    } catch (RuntimeException notANumber) {
                        // A schema list with junk in it is the service's
                        // problem; take the entries that parse.
                    }
                });
                serviceSchemas = Set.copyOf(schemas);
            }
            if (response.has("plan")) {
                servicePlan = response.get("plan").getAsString();
            }
            if (response.has("model_tier")) {
                serviceModel = response.get("model_tier").getAsString();
            }
            modelDemoted = response.has("model_demoted")
                    && response.get("model_demoted").getAsBoolean();
            predictWantsTicks = response.has("predict_wants_ticks")
                    && response.get("predict_wants_ticks").getAsBoolean();
            crystalModel = response.has("crystal_model")
                    && response.get("crystal_model").getAsBoolean();
            if (!response.has("analysis_exclusions")) return;
            List<Exclusion> loaded = new ArrayList<>();
            response.getAsJsonArray("analysis_exclusions").forEach(element -> {
                if (!element.isJsonObject()) return;
                JsonObject item = element.getAsJsonObject();
                String world = item.has("world") ? item.get("world").getAsString().trim() : "";
                String region = item.has("region") ? item.get("region").getAsString().trim() : "";
                if (!world.isBlank()) loaded.add(new Exclusion(world, region));
            });
            exclusions = List.copyOf(loaded);
        });
    }

    public record CaptureResult(int status, JsonObject response, String detail) {
        public boolean rejected() {
            return status == 400 || status == 413 || status == 415 || status == 422;
        }
    }

    public CompletableFuture<CaptureResult> addSamples(UploadQueue.Batch batch) {
        List<double[]> rows = batch.rows();
        List<double[]> context = batch.context();
        List<double[]> ticks = batch.ticks();
        JsonObject body = new JsonObject();
        body.addProperty("label", batch.label());
        body.addProperty("player", batch.player());
        body.addProperty("uuid", batch.uuid());
        body.addProperty("enabled", batch.enabled());
        body.addProperty("source", batch.source());
        body.addProperty("person", batch.person() == null ? "" : batch.person());
        body.addProperty("feature_version", batch.featureVersion());

        if (context != null && context.size() == rows.size() && anyScored(context)) {
            body.add("scores", column(context, 0));
            body.add("buffers", column(context, 1));
        }

        JsonArray names = new JsonArray();
        batch.featureNames().forEach(names::add);
        body.add("feature_names", names);

        JsonArray samples = new JsonArray();
        for (double[] row : rows) {
            JsonArray sample = new JsonArray();
            for (double value : row) {
                sample.add(value);
            }
            samples.add(sample);
        }
        body.add("samples", samples);

        if (ticks != null && !ticks.isEmpty() && ticks.size() == rows.size()) {
            JsonArray windows = new JsonArray();
            for (double[] window : ticks) {
                JsonArray flat = new JsonArray();
                for (double value : window) {
                    flat.add(value);
                }
                windows.add(flat);
            }
            body.add("ticks", windows);
            JsonArray channels = new JsonArray();
            batch.tickChannels().forEach(channels::add);
            body.add("tick_channels", channels);
        }

        body.addProperty("capture_id", batch.captureId().toString());
        HttpRequest request = datasetRequest("/samples", body);
        return client.sendAsync(request, HttpResponse.BodyHandlers.ofString())
                .thenApply(response -> {
                    int status = response.statusCode();
                    JsonObject json = status / 100 == 2
                            ? new JsonParser().parse(response.body()).getAsJsonObject() : null;
                    return new CaptureResult(status, json, abbreviate(response.body()));
                })
                .exceptionally(failure -> new CaptureResult(0, null, failure.getClass().getSimpleName()));
    }

    static JsonArray column(List<double[]> context, int index) {
        JsonArray array = new JsonArray();
        for (double[] pair : context) {
            if (Double.isNaN(pair[index])) {
                array.add((Number) null);
            } else {
                array.add(pair[index]);
            }
        }
        return array;
    }

    static boolean anyScored(List<double[]> context) {
        for (double[] pair : context) {
            if (!Double.isNaN(pair[0])) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

        return postDataset("/samples/remove", body);
    }

    /** The newest published build for this jar's flavour. Does not vote on
     *  reachability: a version check failing says nothing about whether the
     *  service can answer a prediction, and must never pause analysis. */
    public CompletableFuture<JsonObject> latestBuild(String flavour) {
        String path = "/plugin/latest?flavour="
                + java.net.URLEncoder.encode(flavour, java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8);

    /** Sends one replay up for the panel to play back.
     *
     *  <p>On the dataset timeout rather than the ordinary one. A replay is a
     *  few hundred kilobytes that the service has to write to disk before it
     *  answers, and the ordinary timeout is a second and a half: sending this
     *  on it would time out on a slow link, and a timeout on the predict path
     *  is what marks the service unreachable. This one does not vote. */
    public CompletableFuture<JsonObject> uploadReplay(JsonObject replay) {
        HttpRequest.Builder builder = builder("/replays", plugin.config().apiKey())
                .timeout(Duration.ofMillis(Math.max(plugin.config().apiTimeoutMs(),
                        DATASET_TIMEOUT_MS)))
                .header("Content-Type", "application/json")
                .POST(HttpRequest.BodyPublishers.ofString(replay.toString()));
        return send(builder.build(), false);
    }

    private CompletableFuture<JsonObject> post(String path, JsonObject body) {
        HttpRequest.Builder builder = builder(path, plugin.config().apiKey())
                .header("Content-Type", "application/json")
                .POST(HttpRequest.BodyPublishers.ofString(body.toString()));

    /** Only prediction is allowed to decide that the service is down. */
    private CompletableFuture<JsonObject> postVoting(String path, JsonObject body) {
        HttpRequest.Builder builder = builder(path, plugin.config().apiKey())
                .header("Content-Type", "application/json")
                .POST(HttpRequest.BodyPublishers.ofString(body.toString()));
        return send(builder.build(), true);
    }

    private CompletableFuture<JsonObject> postDataset(String path, JsonObject body) {
        return send(datasetRequest(path, body), false);
    }

    private HttpRequest datasetRequest(String path, JsonObject body) {
        // A dataset push is not a question, it is a delivery: a few hundred
        // windows, a quarter of a megabyte of JSON, and the service writes a
        // CSV and answers. The ordinary timeout is a second and a half, which
        // a big capture can easily outlast - and a timeout is read as "the
        // service is down", so the capture ends up in the retry queue for a
        // reason that has nothing to do with the service being down.
        HttpRequest.Builder builder = builder(path, plugin.config().datasetKey())
                .timeout(Duration.ofMillis(Math.max(plugin.config().apiTimeoutMs(),
                        DATASET_TIMEOUT_MS)))
                .header("Content-Type", "application/json")
                .POST(HttpRequest.BodyPublishers.ofString(body.toString()));
        return builder.build();
    }

    private CompletableFuture<JsonObject> get(String path) {
        return send(builder(path, plugin.config().apiKey()).GET().build(), false);
    }

    private void probe() {
        if (probes.getAndIncrement() % SETTINGS_EVERY_PROBES == 0) {
            refreshSettings();
        }
        if (reachable.get()) {
            return;
        }
        health().thenAccept(response -> {
            if (response != null) {
                markReachable(true);
            }
        });
    }

    private CompletableFuture<JsonObject> health() {
        return send(builder("/health", plugin.config().apiKey()).GET().build(), true);
    }

    private HttpRequest.Builder builder(String path, String key) {
        return builder(plugin.config().apiUrl(), path, key);
    }

    private HttpRequest.Builder builder(String endpoint, String path, String key) {
        HttpRequest.Builder builder = HttpRequest.newBuilder()
                .uri(URI.create(endpoint + path))
                .timeout(Duration.ofMillis(plugin.config().apiTimeoutMs()));
        if (key != null && !key.isBlank()) {
            builder.header("X-OculusAI-Key", key);
        }
        return builder;
    }

    /** ``votes`` is whether this request may change {@link #reachable}.
     *  Only prediction and the health probe are allowed to: an event report,
     *  settings refresh or link/pair request failing says nothing about
     *  whether the model can answer. */
    private CompletableFuture<JsonObject> send(HttpRequest request, boolean votes) {
        return client.sendAsync(request, HttpResponse.BodyHandlers.ofString())
                .thenApply(response -> {
                    if (votes) {
                        int status = response.statusCode();
                        if (status / 100 == 2 || status == 429) {
                            markReachable(true);
                        } else if (status >= 500) {
                            // A 500 from the health/predict endpoint is the
                            // service saying it cannot answer. A 4xx is a
                            // request/key problem, not a reason to declare the
                            // whole service unreachable.
                            markReachable(false);
                        }
                    }
                    if (response.statusCode() == 429) {
                        noteThrottled(response.body());
                        return null;
                    }
                    if (response.statusCode() == 409 && request.uri().getPath().endsWith("/predict")) {
                        refreshSettings();
                        return null;
                    }
                    if (response.statusCode() == 422 && request.uri().getPath().endsWith("/predict")
                            && response.body() != null
                            && (response.body().contains("тик") || response.body().contains("tick"))) {
                        // Модель на слоте читает тики, а настройки об этом ещё
                        // не дошли (или устарели): со следующего окна они едут.
                        predictWantsTicks = Boolean.TRUE;
                    }
                    if (response.statusCode() / 100 != 2) {
                        plugin.getLogger().warning("Service answered " + response.statusCode()
                                + " for " + request.uri().getPath() + ": "
                                + abbreviate(response.body()));
                        if (response.statusCode() == 403
                                && response.body() != null
                                && response.body().contains("\"001\"")) {
                            plugin.getLogger().warning("The service does not accept this key"
                                    + " from this address: the server address in the panel is not"
                                    + " the one this server connects from. /oai connect rebinds it.");
                        }
                        return null;
                    }
                    return new JsonParser().parse(response.body()).getAsJsonObject();
                })
                .exceptionally(throwable -> {
                    if (votes) {
                        markReachable(false);
                    }
                    return null;
                });
    }

    private void noteThrottled(String body) {
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        long last = throttledLoggedAt.get();
        if (now - last < THROTTLE_LOG_INTERVAL_MS || !throttledLoggedAt.compareAndSet(last, now)) {
            return;
        }
        plugin.getLogger().warning("Service is rate limiting this key: " + abbreviate(body)
                + " (checks are skipped while over the limit)");
    }

    private void markReachable(boolean value) {
        if (reachable.getAndSet(value) == value) {
            return;
        }
        if (value) {
            plugin.getLogger().info("Service at " + plugin.config().apiUrl() + " is answering again");
        } else {
            plugin.getLogger().warning("Service at " + plugin.config().apiUrl()
                    + " is not answering; analysis is paused");
        }
    }

    private String abbreviate(String body) {
        if (body == null) {
            return "";
        }
        String trimmed = body.strip();
        return trimmed.length() <= 200 ? trimmed : trimmed.substring(0, 197) + "...";
    }

    public boolean reachable() {
        return reachable.get();
    }
}
```

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.network;

import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;
import me.everyone.oculusai.core.Service;

public final class Network implements Service {

    private final ApiClient api;
    private final UploadQueue uploads;

    public Network(OculusAI plugin) {
        this.api = new ApiClient(plugin);
        this.uploads = new UploadQueue(plugin);
    }

    @Override
    public void enable() {
        api.enable();
        uploads.enable();
    }

    @Override
    public void disable() {
        uploads.disable();
        api.disable();
    }

    public ApiClient api() {
        return api;
    }

    public UploadQueue uploads() {
        return uploads;
    }
}
```
