`src/main/java/me/everyone/oculusai/network/Updater.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.network;


import me.everyone.oculusai.core.Service;
import me.everyone.oculusai.core.TickLoop;
import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.io.OutputStream;
import java.net.URI;
import java.net.http.HttpClient;
import java.net.http.HttpRequest;
import java.net.http.HttpResponse;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption;
import java.security.MessageDigest;
import java.security.NoSuchAlgorithmException;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
import java.util.concurrent.ScheduledFuture;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference;
import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;
import me.everyone.oculusai.core.Msg;
import net.md_5.bungee.api.chat.ClickEvent;
import net.md_5.bungee.api.chat.HoverEvent;
import net.md_5.bungee.api.chat.TextComponent;
import net.md_5.bungee.api.chat.hover.content.Text;
import org.bukkit.command.CommandSender;
import org.bukkit.entity.Player;

/** Asks the service whether a newer build exists, and stages it if so.
 *
 * <p>Staged, never swapped. The jar is written into the server's update folder,
 * which the server applies on its next start - replacing a jar underneath a
 * running plugin is how classloaders end up half in one version and half in
 * another. So an update here is always "ready on restart", and the restart is
 * the operator's.
 *
 * <p>Finding a new build is useless if nobody reads the line that says so.
 * The service is asked on a slow timer - a build is published a few times a
 * month, not a few times an hour - but the answer is repeated to admins in
 * chat on a fast one, so somebody who logs in long after the check still gets
 * told. The repeat stops the moment the server runs the newest build.
 *
 * <p>Three things gate a download, because this path writes executable code
 * into a server directory. The URL must be https and must point at a host this
 * class was built to trust. The digest the service named must match what
 * arrived, byte for byte, or the file is discarded. And the whole thing is off
 * if the operator says so, in which case the check still runs and still
 * reports, it just hands over a link instead of a file.
 */
public final class Updater implements Service {

    /** Where a build may come from. Not configurable on purpose: a setting
     *  that lets a config file nominate an arbitrary download host is a
     *  setting that turns a leaked panel into remote code execution. */
    private static final Set<String> ALLOWED_HOSTS =
            Set.of("github.com", "objects.githubusercontent.com");

    /** A jar is a few hundred kilobytes. Ten megabytes is far past anything
     *  legitimate and stops a bad answer from filling the disk. */
    private static final long MAX_BYTES = 10L * 1024L * 1024L;

    private static final long FIRST_CHECK_TICKS = 20L * 45L;

    private final OculusAI plugin;
    private final AtomicReference<String> staged = new AtomicReference<>();
    /** The newest version the service named, once it turned out to be newer
     *  than this jar. Held so the reminder can repeat it without asking the
     *  service again, and cleared when this jar becomes that version. */
    private final AtomicReference<String> pending = new AtomicReference<>();
    /** The release notes that came with it, first line only. */
    private final AtomicReference<String> notes = new AtomicReference<>("");
    /** The main-thread timer that repeats the line in chat. Runs only while
     *  something is pending: an up-to-date server schedules nothing. Volatile
     *  because it is started from the thread the service answers on and read
     *  from the main thread the timer itself runs on. */
    private volatile TickLoop.Handle reminder;
    private HttpClient client;
    private ScheduledFuture<?> task;
    /** Downloads are minutes of blocking I/O. They must not occupy the shared
     *  worker: that worker also runs detection, history flushes and the
     *  service calls, and one 10 MB jar used to stall all of them. */
    private ExecutorService downloads;

    public Updater(OculusAI plugin) {
        this.plugin = plugin;
    }

    @Override
    public void enable() {
        if (!plugin.config().updateEnabled()) {
            return;
        }
        client = HttpClient.newBuilder()
                .connectTimeout(Duration.ofSeconds(15))
                .followRedirects(HttpClient.Redirect.NORMAL)
                .build();
        downloads = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor(runnable -> {
            Thread thread = new Thread(runnable, "OculusAI-update-download");
            thread.setDaemon(true);
            return thread;
        });
        long period = Math.max(1L, plugin.config().updateCheckHours()) * 20L * 60L * 60L;
        task = plugin.worker().repeat(this::check, FIRST_CHECK_TICKS * 50L, period * 50L,
                TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);
    }

    @Override
    public void reload() {
        // The check interval, the download switch and the reminder interval
        // all come from config.yml, so a reload has to rebuild the timers
        // rather than keep running on the old numbers. What was already found
        // is kept: the new build has not gone anywhere.
        String found = pending.get();
        String waiting = staged.get();
        disable();
        pending.set(found);
        staged.set(waiting);
        enable();
        if (found != null) {
            startReminder();
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void disable() {
        if (task != null) {
            task.cancel(false);
            task = null;
        }
        stopReminder();
        pending.set(null);
        notes.set("");
        if (downloads != null) {
            downloads.shutdownNow();
            downloads = null;
        }
    }

    /** The version waiting in the update folder, if a check found one. */
    public String stagedVersion() {
        return staged.get();
    }

    private void check() {
        String current = plugin.buildVersion();
        String flavour = plugin.buildFlavour();
        if (flavour.isBlank()) {
            return;
        }

        plugin.api().latestBuild(flavour).thenAccept(answer -> consider(answer, current));
    }

    private void consider(JsonObject answer, String current) {
        if (answer == null || !answer.has("version")) {
            return;
        }
        String newest = answer.get("version").getAsString().trim();
        if (newest.isEmpty() || newest.equals(current) || !newer(newest, current)) {
            return;
        }
        if (newest.equals(staged.get())) {
            // Already downloaded and waiting for a restart. The reminder keeps
            // saying so, so there is nothing new to announce.
            startReminder();
            return;
        }

        notes.set(firstLine(answer.has("notes") ? answer.get("notes").getAsString() : ""));
        boolean first = !newest.equals(pending.getAndSet(newest));
        if (first) {
            announce(newest, false);
        }
        startReminder();

        String url = answer.has("url") ? answer.get("url").getAsString() : "";
        String digest = answer.has("sha256") ? answer.get("sha256").getAsString() : "";

        if (!plugin.config().updateDownload() || url.isBlank() || digest.isBlank()) {
            return;
        }
        if (!trusted(url)) {
            plugin.getLogger().warning("Refusing the update at " + url
                    + ": only https downloads from " + String.join(", ", ALLOWED_HOSTS)
                    + " are accepted.");
            return;
        }
        ExecutorService executor = downloads;
        if (executor == null) {
            return;
        }
        try {
            executor.execute(() -> {
                if (download(url, digest)) {
                    staged.set(newest);
                    announce(newest, true);
                }
            });
        } catch (java.util.concurrent.RejectedExecutionException stopping) {
            // The plugin is disabling; leaving the old build alone is correct.
        }
    }

    static boolean trusted(String url) {
        if (!url.startsWith("https://")) {
            return false;
        }
        try {
            String host = URI.create(url).getHost();
            return host != null && ALLOWED_HOSTS.contains(host.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT));
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException invalid) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    /** Dotted-number comparison, newest wins; anything unparseable is treated
     *  as not newer, so a malformed answer can never trigger a download. */
    static boolean newer(String candidate, String current) {
        int[] left = parse(candidate);
        int[] right = parse(current);
        if (left == null || right == null) {
            return false;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < Math.max(left.length, right.length); i++) {
            int a = i < left.length ? left[i] : 0;
            int b = i < right.length ? right[i] : 0;
            if (a != b) {
                return a > b;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    private static int[] parse(String version) {
        String core = version.split("-", 2)[0].trim();
        if (core.isEmpty()) {
            return null;
        }
        String[] parts = core.split("\\.");
        int[] out = new int[parts.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
            try {
                out[i] = Integer.parseInt(parts[i]);
            } catch (NumberFormatException notANumber) {
                return null;
            }
        }
        return out;
    }

    private boolean download(String url, String expected) {
        Path jar = plugin.pluginJar();
        if (jar == null) {
            return false;
        }
        Path folder = plugin.getServer().getUpdateFolderFile().toPath();
        Path temporary = null;
        try {
            Files.createDirectories(folder);
            temporary = Files.createTempFile(folder, "oculusai-", ".part");

            HttpRequest request = HttpRequest.newBuilder(URI.create(url))
                    .timeout(Duration.ofMinutes(2))
                    .GET()
                    .build();
            HttpResponse<InputStream> response =
                    client.send(request, HttpResponse.BodyHandlers.ofInputStream());
            if (response.statusCode() / 100 != 2) {
                plugin.getLogger().warning("Update download answered "
                        + response.statusCode() + "; keeping the current build.");
                return false;
            }
            // The original URL was checked before the request. Redirects may
            // have taken us somewhere else, so check where the bytes actually
            // came from as well.
            if (response.uri() == null || !trusted(response.uri().toString())) {
                plugin.getLogger().warning("Update download redirected to an untrusted "
                        + "location; refusing the file.");
                return false;
            }

            MessageDigest sha = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256");
            long total = 0L;
            try (InputStream in = response.body();
                 OutputStream out = Files.newOutputStream(temporary)) {
                byte[] chunk = new byte[16 * 1024];
                int read;
                while ((read = in.read(chunk)) > 0) {
                    total += read;
                    if (total > MAX_BYTES) {
                        plugin.getLogger().warning(
                                "Update download is over " + (MAX_BYTES / 1024 / 1024)
                                + " MB; refusing it.");
                        return false;
                    }
                    sha.update(chunk, 0, read);
                    out.write(chunk, 0, read);
                }
            }

            String actual = hex(sha.digest());
            if (!actual.equalsIgnoreCase(expected)) {
                plugin.getLogger().warning("Update digest does not match what the service named"
                        + " (expected " + expected + ", got " + actual + "); discarding it.");
                return false;
            }

            // The server applies an update only when the staged file carries the
            // same name as the installed jar.
            Path destination = folder.resolve(jar.getFileName().toString());
            Files.move(temporary, destination, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
            temporary = null;
            return true;
        } catch (IOException | InterruptedException | NoSuchAlgorithmException error) {
            plugin.getLogger().warning("Could not stage the update: " + error.getMessage());
            if (error instanceof InterruptedException) {
                Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
            }
            return false;
        } finally {
            if (temporary != null) {
                try {
                    Files.deleteIfExists(temporary);
                } catch (IOException ignored) {
                    // A leftover .part is noise, not a failure worth reporting.
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private static String hex(byte[] bytes) {
        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder(bytes.length * 2);
        for (byte value : bytes) {
            builder.append(Character.forDigit((value >> 4) & 0xF, 16));
            builder.append(Character.forDigit(value & 0xF, 16));
        }
        return builder.toString();
    }

    // ----------------------------------------------------------------- telling
    //  people about it

    /** Turns the reminder on. Idempotent: a check that finds the same build
     *  again must not stack a second timer onto the first. */
    private void startReminder() {
        if (reminder != null) {
            return;
        }
        long seconds = plugin.config().updateRemindSeconds();
        if (seconds <= 0L) {
            // Nought means "say it once". The announcement has already gone
            // out by the time this is reached.
            return;
        }
        reminder = plugin.ticks().every(seconds * 20L, this::remind);
    }

    private void stopReminder() {
        if (reminder != null) {
            reminder.cancel();
            reminder = null;
        }
    }

    /** The repeat, on the main thread. Chat only - the console heard it once
     *  from {@link #announce} and does not need it every quarter minute. */
    private void remind() {
        String version = pending.get();
        if (version == null) {
            stopReminder();
            return;
        }
        // The jar may have been replaced by a restart since the last check:
        // nothing to nag about then, and the line would be wrong.
        if (!newer(version, plugin.buildVersion())) {
            pending.set(null);
            staged.set(null);
            stopReminder();
            return;
        }
        TextComponent message = line(version, version.equals(staged.get()));
        for (Player online : plugin.getServer().getOnlinePlayers()) {
            if (online.hasPermission("oculusai.alerts")) {
                online.spigot().sendMessage(message);
            }
        }
    }

    /** The one line everybody gets, built from the language file so the
     *  wording lives beside every other message rather than in this class. */
    private TextComponent line(String version, boolean stagedNow) {
        Map<String, String> values = Map.of(
                "version", version,
                "current", plugin.buildVersion());
        String body = plugin.lang().text(stagedNow ? "update.staged" : "update.available",
                values);

        TextComponent message = new TextComponent(TextComponent.fromLegacyText(
                Msg.parse(plugin.config().prefix()) + body));

        // A staged build needs no link: it is already on disk, and clicking
        // through to download it by hand is how an operator ends up with two.
        String site = plugin.config().site();
        if (!stagedNow && !site.isBlank()) {
            TextComponent link = new TextComponent(TextComponent.fromLegacyText(
                    plugin.lang().text("update.download")));
            link.setClickEvent(new ClickEvent(ClickEvent.Action.OPEN_URL, site));
            link.setHoverEvent(new HoverEvent(HoverEvent.Action.SHOW_TEXT,
                    new Text(TextComponent.fromLegacyText(
                            plugin.lang().text("update.hover")))));
            message.addExtra(link);
        }
        return message;
    }

    /** The first announcement: the console log, and chat for whoever is on. */
    private void announce(String version, boolean stagedNow) {
        plugin.getLogger().info(stagedNow
                ? "OculusAI " + version + " is downloaded and will be applied on the next restart."
                : "OculusAI " + version + " is out; this server runs " + plugin.buildVersion() + ".");

        plugin.mainThread().run(() -> {
            TextComponent message = line(version, stagedNow);
            for (Player online : plugin.getServer().getOnlinePlayers()) {
                if (online.hasPermission("oculusai.alerts")) {
                    online.spigot().sendMessage(message);
                }
            }
        });
    }

    /** Notes are free text written by whoever published the build. One line is
     *  what fits in chat, and a stray newline would otherwise split the
     *  message into two the client renders separately. */
    static String firstLine(String value) {
        if (value == null) {
            return "";
        }
        String line = value.strip();
        int newline = line.indexOf('\n');
        if (newline >= 0) {
            line = line.substring(0, newline).strip();
        }
        return line.length() > 120 ? line.substring(0, 117) + "..." : line;
    }

    /** The version a check has found, or null while this jar is the newest
     *  thing the service knows about. */
    public String pendingVersion() {
        return pending.get();
    }

    /** Asks the service now and answers the sender, for /oai update. Runs the
     *  call off the main thread, like the timer does, and replies on it. */
    public void checkNow(CommandSender sender) {
        String flavour = plugin.buildFlavour();
        if (flavour.isBlank()) {
            // A jar built outside Gradle has no flavour stamped into it, so
            // there is no way to know which of the two builds to compare with.
            sender.sendMessage(plugin.config().prefix()
                    + plugin.lang().text("update.unknown-build"));
            return;
        }
        sender.sendMessage(plugin.config().prefix() + plugin.lang().text("update.checking"));
        String current = plugin.buildVersion();
        plugin.api().latestBuild(flavour).thenAccept(answer -> {
            consider(answer, current);
            plugin.mainThread().run(() -> {
                String found = pending.get();
                if (found == null) {
                    sender.sendMessage(plugin.config().prefix()
                            + plugin.lang().text("update.current",
                                    Map.of("version", current)));
                } else if (sender instanceof Player player) {
                    player.spigot().sendMessage(line(found, found.equals(staged.get())));
                } else {
                    sender.sendMessage(line(found, found.equals(staged.get())).toLegacyText());
                }
            });
        });
    }

    /** For the diagnostics command. */
    public List<String> describe() {
        String waiting = staged.get();
        return List.of(
                "version " + plugin.buildVersion() + " (" + plugin.buildFlavour() + ")",
                "checks " + (plugin.config().updateEnabled()
                        ? "every " + plugin.config().updateCheckHours() + "h" : "off"),
                "downloads " + (plugin.config().updateDownload() ? "on" : "off"),
                "reminder " + (plugin.config().updateRemindSeconds() > 0
                        ? "every " + plugin.config().updateRemindSeconds() + "s while out of date"
                        : "once per check"),
                pending.get() == null ? "up to date" : pending.get() + " available",
                waiting == null ? "nothing staged" : waiting + " staged for the next restart");
    }
}

```

`src/main/java/me/everyone/oculusai/network/UploadQueue.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.network;


import me.everyone.oculusai.core.Service;
import com.google.gson.JsonArray;
import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
import com.google.gson.JsonParser;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.DirectoryStream;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.ArrayDeque;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Deque;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture;
import java.util.concurrent.ScheduledFuture;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;

/**
 * Captures that did not reach the service, kept until they do.
 *
 * A recording is work somebody did with their hands: half an hour of a player
 * fighting under a label. Before this, a failed upload meant that half hour
 * was gone - the request answered 403 or the service was down, {@code commit}
 * got a null, and the rows lived on only until the next restart. Now the batch
 * lands here instead and is offered again every {@link #RETRY_SECONDS}
 * seconds.
 *
 * The queue lives on disk as well as in memory. A capture that was made by
 * hand and has not reached the service must not die because the server was
 * restarted in the middle of an outage - that is exactly the moment an outage
 * is most likely. Each held capture is written next to the plugin's data as a
 * JSON file, and the queue is rebuilt from those files when the plugin starts.
 *
 * A stable capture ID makes retries safe. Invalid payloads are kept in
 * a separate directory so they cannot block subsequent captures.
 */
public final class UploadQueue implements Service {

    /** Between attempts. Long enough not to hammer a service that is down,
     *  short enough that a blip costs a few seconds rather than a capture. */
    public static final int RETRY_SECONDS = 5;

    /** The queue is held in memory, so it cannot be allowed to grow without
     *  limit: a service that is down for an hour during a long recording
     *  session would otherwise push the server into the garbage collector. */
    private static final int MAX_BATCHES = 64;

    /** What a single failed send was, in full, so the retry is the same
     *  request rather than a reconstruction of it. */
    public record Batch(String label, String player, String uuid,
                        List<String> featureNames, List<double[]> rows,
                        boolean enabled, String source, String person,
                        List<double[]> context, int featureVersion,
                        List<double[]> ticks, List<String> tickChannels, UUID captureId) {

        public Batch(String label, String player, String uuid,
                     List<String> featureNames, List<double[]> rows,
                     boolean enabled, String source, String person,
                     List<double[]> context, int featureVersion,
                     List<double[]> ticks, List<String> tickChannels) {
            this(label, player, uuid, featureNames, rows, enabled, source, person,
                    context, featureVersion, ticks, tickChannels, UUID.randomUUID());
        }

        /** Партия без сырых окон - так выглядит всё, что писалось до их
         *  появления, и так же читается с диска старая очередь. */
        public Batch(String label, String player, String uuid,
                     List<String> featureNames, List<double[]> rows,
                     boolean enabled, String source, String person,
                     List<double[]> context, int featureVersion) {
            this(label, player, uuid, featureNames, rows, enabled, source, person,
                    context, featureVersion, List.of(), List.of());
        }
    }

    /** A batch on its way out and the file that carries it. */
    private record Held(Batch batch, Path file) {
    }

    private final OculusAI plugin;
    private final Deque<Held> pending = new ArrayDeque<>();
    /** One flight at a time: the task fires every five seconds whether or not
     *  the previous attempt has answered, and two attempts at the same batch
     *  would send it twice. */
    private final AtomicBoolean sending = new AtomicBoolean();
    private ScheduledFuture<?> task;

    public UploadQueue(OculusAI plugin) {
        this.plugin = plugin;
    }

    @Override
    public void enable() {
        restore();
        long period = RETRY_SECONDS * 1000L;
        task = plugin.worker().repeat(this::flush, period, period, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);
    }

    @Override
    public void disable() {
        if (task != null) {
            task.cancel(false);
            task = null;
        }
        int lost = size();
        if (lost > 0) {
            plugin.getLogger().warning("Shutting down with " + lost
                    + " capture(s) still unsent; they are kept on disk and will be sent"
                    + " after the restart");
        }
    }

    /** Where the held captures are kept. */
    private Path folder() {
        Path folder = plugin.getDataFolder().toPath().resolve("unsent");
        try {
            Files.createDirectories(folder);
        } catch (IOException failure) {
            plugin.getLogger().log(Level.WARNING,
                    "Could not create the folder for unsent captures", failure);
        }
        return folder;
    }

    public CompletableFuture<Integer> submit(Batch batch) {
        if (batch.rows().isEmpty()) {
            return CompletableFuture.completedFuture(0);
        }
        return CompletableFuture.supplyAsync(() -> write(batch), plugin.worker().executor())
                .thenCompose(file -> plugin.api().addSamples(batch).thenApply(result -> {
                    if (result.response() != null) {
                        delete(file);
                        return result.response().has("stored")
                                ? result.response().get("stored").getAsInt() : batch.rows().size();
                    }
                    if (!result.rejected() || !archive(file, "HTTP " + result.status() + ": " + result.detail())) {
                        offer(batch, file);
                    }
                    return null;
                }));
    }

    private void offer(Batch batch, Path file) {
        if (batch.rows().isEmpty()) {
            return;
        }
        int waiting;
        boolean dropped = false;
        synchronized (pending) {
            // The oldest goes, not the newest: a capture made twenty minutes
            // ago is the one most likely to be stale, and dropping what just
            // happened would punish the person still recording.
            if (pending.size() >= MAX_BATCHES) {
                Held oldest = pending.pollFirst();
                dropped = true;
                if (oldest != null) {
                    archive(oldest.file(), "retry queue capacity reached");
                }
            }
            pending.addLast(new Held(batch, file));
            waiting = pending.size();
        }
        if (dropped) {
            plugin.getLogger().severe("Unsent captures hit the limit of " + MAX_BATCHES
                    + "; the oldest was moved out of the retry queue. The service has been unreachable"
                    + " for a long time - check that api.url is reachable");
        }
        plugin.getLogger().warning("Capture for " + batch.player() + " (" + batch.rows().size()
                + " windows) was not accepted; retrying every " + RETRY_SECONDS
                + "s, " + waiting + " waiting");
    }

    private boolean archive(Path file, String reason) {
        if (file == null) {
            return false;
        }
        try {
            Path rejected = Files.createDirectories(folder().resolve("rejected"));
            Path destination = rejected.resolve(file.getFileName());
            Files.move(file, destination);
            try {
                Files.writeString(destination.resolveSibling(destination.getFileName() + ".reason.txt"), reason);
            } catch (IOException failure) {
                plugin.getLogger().log(Level.WARNING, "Could not save capture rejection reason", failure);
            }
            plugin.getLogger().warning("Capture " + destination.getFileName()
                    + " moved to rejected: " + reason);
            return true;
        } catch (IOException failure) {
            plugin.getLogger().log(Level.WARNING, "Could not archive rejected capture", failure);
            return false;
        }
    }

    /** How many captures are still waiting. */
    public int size() {
        synchronized (pending) {
            return pending.size();
        }
    }

    /** How many windows are waiting across every held capture. */
    public int windows() {
        synchronized (pending) {
            return pending.stream().mapToInt(held -> held.batch().rows().size()).sum();
        }
    }

    /** Offers the oldest batch again. Called on the timer. */
    public void flush() {
        if (!sending.compareAndSet(false, true)) {
            return;
        }
        Held held;
        synchronized (pending) {
            held = pending.peekFirst();
        }
        if (held == null) {
            sending.set(false);
            return;
        }
        Batch batch = held.batch();

        plugin.api().addSamples(batch)
                .whenComplete((result, failure) -> {
                    try {
                        if (result == null || (result.response() == null
                                && !(result.rejected() && archive(held.file(),
                                "HTTP " + result.status() + ": " + result.detail())))) {
                            return;
                        }
                        int left;
                        synchronized (pending) {
                            // Removed by identity, not by position: nothing else
                            // takes from the head, but a batch offered while this
                            // one was in flight must not be dropped by mistake.
                            pending.remove(held);
                            left = pending.size();
                        }
                        if (result.rejected()) {
                            return;
                        }
                        delete(held.file());
                        plugin.getLogger().info("Held capture for " + batch.player()
                                + " (" + batch.rows().size() + " windows) went through"
                                + (left == 0 ? "" : "; " + left + " still waiting"));
                    } catch (RuntimeException error) {
                        plugin.getLogger().log(Level.WARNING,
                                "Error finishing a held capture", error);
                    } finally {
                        sending.set(false);
                    }
                });
    }

    /** Writes a held capture down, so a restart does not lose it. */
    private Path write(Batch batch) {
        Path folder = folder();
        String stamp = java.time.LocalDateTime.now().toString().replace(':', '-');
        Path file = folder.resolve(stamp + "-" + safe(batch.player()) + "-" + batch.captureId() + ".json");
        Path temporary = file.resolveSibling(file.getFileName() + ".tmp");
        JsonObject json = new JsonObject();
        json.addProperty("capture_id", batch.captureId().toString());
        json.addProperty("label", batch.label());
        json.addProperty("player", batch.player());
        json.addProperty("uuid", batch.uuid());
        json.addProperty("enabled", batch.enabled());
        json.addProperty("source", batch.source());
        json.addProperty("person", batch.person());
        json.addProperty("feature_version", batch.featureVersion());
        JsonArray names = new JsonArray();
        batch.featureNames().forEach(names::add);
        json.add("feature_names", names);
        json.add("samples", numbers(batch.rows()));
        if (batch.context() != null && batch.context().size() == batch.rows().size()) {
            json.add("context", numbers(batch.context()));
        }
        if (batch.ticks() != null && batch.ticks().size() == batch.rows().size()) {
            json.add("ticks", numbers(batch.ticks()));
            JsonArray channels = new JsonArray();
            batch.tickChannels().forEach(channels::add);
            json.add("tick_channels", channels);
        }
        try {
            Files.writeString(temporary, json.toString(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            Files.move(temporary, file);
        } catch (IOException failure) {
            delete(temporary);
            plugin.getLogger().log(Level.SEVERE,
                    "Could not save an unsent capture to disk", failure);
        }
        return file;
    }

    /** Puts back everything that was on disk when the server stopped. */
    private void restore() {
        Path folder = folder();
        List<Path> files = new ArrayList<>();
        try (DirectoryStream<Path> stream = Files.newDirectoryStream(folder, "*.json")) {
            for (Path path : stream) {
                files.add(path);
            }
        } catch (IOException failure) {
            plugin.getLogger().log(Level.WARNING,
                    "Could not read the folder of unsent captures", failure);
            return;
        }
        files.sort(Path::compareTo);
        int restored = 0;
        for (Path path : files) {
            Batch batch = read(path);
            if (batch == null) {
                continue;
            }
            synchronized (pending) {
                pending.addLast(new Held(batch, path));
            }
            restored++;
        }
        if (restored > 0) {
            plugin.getLogger().info("Restored " + restored
                    + " unsent capture(s) from disk; they will be sent again");
        }
    }

    private Batch read(Path path) {
        try {
            JsonObject json = new JsonParser()
                    .parse(Files.readString(path, StandardCharsets.UTF_8))
                    .getAsJsonObject();
            List<String> names = new ArrayList<>();
            for (var element : json.getAsJsonArray("feature_names")) {
                names.add(element.getAsString());
            }
            List<double[]> rows = doubles(json.getAsJsonArray("samples"));
            List<double[]> context = json.has("context")
                    ? doubles(json.getAsJsonArray("context")) : List.of();
            List<double[]> ticks = json.has("ticks")
                    ? doubles(json.getAsJsonArray("ticks")) : List.of();
            List<String> channels = new ArrayList<>();
            if (json.has("tick_channels")) {
                for (var element : json.getAsJsonArray("tick_channels")) {
                    channels.add(element.getAsString());
                }
            }
            return new Batch(json.get("label").getAsString(),
                    json.get("player").getAsString(),
                    json.has("uuid") ? json.get("uuid").getAsString() : "",
                    names, rows,
                    !json.has("enabled") || json.get("enabled").getAsBoolean(),
                    json.has("source") ? json.get("source").getAsString() : "manual",
                    json.has("person") ? json.get("person").getAsString() : "",
                    context,
                    json.has("feature_version") ? json.get("feature_version").getAsInt() : 5,
                    ticks, channels, json.has("capture_id")
                    ? UUID.fromString(json.get("capture_id").getAsString())
                    : UUID.nameUUIDFromBytes(path.getFileName().toString().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)));
        } catch (Exception failure) {
            plugin.getLogger().log(Level.WARNING,
                    "Could not read an unsent capture: " + path.getFileName(), failure);
            return null;
        }
    }

    private static List<double[]> doubles(JsonArray array) {
        List<double[]> rows = new ArrayList<>(array.size());
        for (var element : array) {
            JsonArray values = element.getAsJsonArray();
            double[] row = new double[values.size()];
            for (int i = 0; i < row.length; i++) {
                row[i] = values.get(i).isJsonNull() ? Double.NaN : values.get(i).getAsDouble();
            }
            rows.add(row);
        }
        return rows;
    }

    private static JsonArray numbers(List<double[]> rows) {
        JsonArray array = new JsonArray();
        for (double[] row : rows) {
            JsonArray values = new JsonArray();
            for (double value : row) {
                if (Double.isNaN(value)) {
                    values.add((Number) null);
                } else {
                    values.add(value);
                }
            }
            array.add(values);
        }
        return array;
    }

    private static String safe(String value) {
        return (value == null ? "unknown" : value).replaceAll("[^A-Za-z0-9_-]", "_");
    }

    private void delete(Path file) {
        if (file == null) {
            return;
        }
        try {
            Files.deleteIfExists(file);
        } catch (IOException failure) {
            plugin.getLogger().log(Level.WARNING,
                    "Could not delete a sent capture: " + file.getFileName(), failure);
        }
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/me/everyone/oculusai/npc/ArenaAccess.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.npc;

import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
import java.net.InetAddress;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;
import me.everyone.oculusai.core.Msg;
import org.bukkit.Bukkit;
import org.bukkit.Location;
import org.bukkit.World;
import org.bukkit.WorldCreator;
import org.bukkit.generator.ChunkGenerator;
import net.md_5.bungee.api.ChatColor;
import net.md_5.bungee.api.chat.ClickEvent;
import net.md_5.bungee.api.chat.TextComponent;
import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
import org.bukkit.event.EventHandler;
import org.bukkit.event.EventPriority;
import org.bukkit.event.Listener;
import org.bukkit.event.block.BlockBreakEvent;
import org.bukkit.event.block.BlockPlaceEvent;
import org.bukkit.event.entity.EntityDamageByEntityEvent;
import org.bukkit.event.entity.EntityDamageEvent;
import org.bukkit.event.player.AsyncPlayerPreLoginEvent;
import org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerCommandPreprocessEvent;
import org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerDropItemEvent;
import org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerInteractEntityEvent;
import org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerInteractEvent;
import org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerMoveEvent;
import org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerTeleportEvent;
import org.spigotmc.event.player.PlayerSpawnLocationEvent;
import org.bukkit.event.inventory.InventoryClickEvent;

final class ArenaAccess implements Listener {
    private static final String WAITING_WORLD = "oculusai_signin";
    private final OculusAI plugin;
    private Location waiting;
    private final Map<UUID, Connection> connections = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private final Map<UUID, Remembered> remembered = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

    private record Remembered(InetAddress address, String session, long until) {}

    record Profile(String session, String email, String role, String devModel, boolean devWantsTicks) {}

    private static final class Connection {
        final long started = System.nanoTime();
        String session = "";
        boolean resuming;
        boolean polling;
        volatile Profile profile;
    }

    ArenaAccess(OculusAI plugin) {
        this.plugin = plugin;
    }

    boolean enabled() {
        return plugin.config().testServerEnabled()
                && plugin.getConfig().getBoolean("test-server.require-site-login");
    }

    void prepare() {
        if (!enabled()) return;
        World world = Bukkit.getWorld(WAITING_WORLD);
        if (world == null && !plugin.platform().folia()) {
            world = new WorldCreator(WAITING_WORLD)
                    .generateStructures(false)
                    .generator(new ChunkGenerator() {
                        @Override
                        public ChunkData generateChunkData(World world, java.util.Random random,
                                                           int x, int z, BiomeGrid biomes) {
                            return createChunkData(world);
                        }

                        @Override
                        public Location getFixedSpawnLocation(World world, java.util.Random random) {
                            return waitingLocation(world);
                        }
                    }).createWorld();
        }
        if (world != null) {
            world.setSpawnFlags(false, false);
            world.setStorm(false);
            world.setTime(18000);
            world.setGameRule(org.bukkit.GameRule.DO_DAYLIGHT_CYCLE, false);
            world.setGameRule(org.bukkit.GameRule.DO_WEATHER_CYCLE, false);
            waiting = waitingLocation(world);
        } else {
            plugin.getLogger().severe("The official test server sign-in world could not be loaded.");
        }
    }

    private static Location waitingLocation(World world) {
        return new Location(world, 0.5, 160, 0.5);
    }

    void join(Player player) {
        UUID id = player.getUniqueId();
        long now = System.nanoTime();
        remembered.values().removeIf(login -> login.until() <= now);
        Remembered login = remembered.remove(id);
        Connection connection = new Connection();
        if (login != null && login.address().equals(address(player))) {
            connection.session = login.session();
            connection.resuming = true;
        }
        connections.put(id, connection);
        player.setGravity(false);
        player.setFallDistance(0);
        if (!plugin.platform().folia()) {
            for (Player other : Bukkit.getOnlinePlayers()) {
                if (other == player) continue;
                player.hidePlayer(plugin, other);
                other.hidePlayer(plugin, player);
            }
        }
        if (!connection.resuming) prompt(player);
        refresh(player);
    }

    private void prompt(Player player) {
        player.sendMessage(message("<gray>Подтверди вход по ссылке в чате."));
    }

    private static InetAddress address(Player player) {
        return player.getAddress() == null ? null : player.getAddress().getAddress();
    }

    void enter(Player player) {
        player.setGravity(true);
        player.setFallDistance(0);
        if (!plugin.platform().folia()) {
            for (Player other : Bukkit.getOnlinePlayers()) {
                if (other == player || locked(other)) continue;
                player.showPlayer(plugin, other);
                other.showPlayer(plugin, player);
            }
        }
    }

    private String style(String text) {
        return Msg.parse(plugin.theme().resolveAccent(text));
    }

    private String message(String text) {
        return plugin.config().prefix() + style(text);
    }

    Profile profile(UUID id) {
        Connection connection = connections.get(id);
        return enabled() && connection != null ? connection.profile : null;
    }

    private boolean locked(Player player) {
        return enabled() && profile(player.getUniqueId()) == null;
    }

    void forget(Player player) {
        UUID id = player.getUniqueId();
        Connection connection = connections.remove(id);
        if (connection != null) {
            player.setGravity(true);
            InetAddress address = address(player);
            if (connection.profile != null && address != null) {
                remembered.put(id, new Remembered(address, connection.session,
                        System.nanoTime() + TimeUnit.HOURS.toNanos(12)));
            }
        }
    }

    void clear() {
        connections.clear();
        remembered.clear();
    }

    void refresh(Player player) {
        if (!enabled()) {
            return;
        }
        UUID id = player.getUniqueId();
        Connection connection = connections.computeIfAbsent(id, ignored -> new Connection());
        if (connection.profile == null && System.nanoTime() - connection.started > TimeUnit.MINUTES.toNanos(3)) {
            player.kickPlayer(message("<gray>Время входа истекло. Зайди снова, чтобы получить код."));
            return;
        }
        if (connection.polling) {
            return;
        }
        connection.polling = true;
        boolean start = connection.session.isEmpty();
        JsonObject body = new JsonObject();
        body.addProperty("uuid", id.toString());
        body.addProperty("player", player.getName());
        body.addProperty("session", connection.session);
        plugin.api().arenaLogin(start, body).thenAccept(response -> plugin.platform().onEntity(player, () -> {
            if (!player.isOnline() || connections.get(id) != connection) {
                return;
            }
            connection.polling = false;
            if (response == null) {
                return;
            }
            if (start) {
                connection.session = text(response, "session");
                String code = text(response, "code");
                String challenge = text(response, "challenge");
                if (!connection.session.isEmpty() && !code.isEmpty() && !challenge.isEmpty()) {
                    TextComponent chat = new TextComponent(TextComponent.fromLegacyText(plugin.config().prefix() + " "));
                    TextComponent link = new TextComponent("Открыть oculusai.space");
                    link.setColor(ChatColor.WHITE);
                    link.setUnderlined(true);
                    link.setClickEvent(new ClickEvent(ClickEvent.Action.OPEN_URL,
                            plugin.config().site() + "/arena-login#" + challenge));
                    chat.addExtra(link);
                    player.spigot().sendMessage(chat);
                    TextComponent codeMessage = new TextComponent(
                            TextComponent.fromLegacyText(message("<gray>Код входа <accent>" + code) + " "));
                    TextComponent copy = new TextComponent("[Копировать]");
                    copy.setColor(ChatColor.WHITE);
                    copy.setUnderlined(true);
                    copy.setClickEvent(new ClickEvent(ClickEvent.Action.COPY_TO_CLIPBOARD, code));
                    codeMessage.addExtra(copy);
                    player.spigot().sendMessage(codeMessage);
                }
                return;
            }
            switch (text(response, "state")) {
                case "ready" -> {
                    boolean first = connection.profile == null;
                    connection.profile = new Profile(connection.session, text(response, "email"),
                            text(response, "role"), text(response, "dev_model"),
                            response.has("dev_wants_ticks") && response.get("dev_wants_ticks").getAsBoolean());
                    if (first) {
                        player.sendMessage(message(connection.resuming
                                ? "<white>С возвращением. <gray>Загрузка арены…"
                                : "<accent>Вход подтверждён. <gray>Загрузка арены…"));
                        connection.resuming = false;
                        plugin.testServer().enterArena(player);
                    }
                }
                case "expired" -> {
                    if (connection.resuming) {
                        connection.resuming = false;
                        connection.session = "";
                        prompt(player);
                        refresh(player);
                        return;
                    }
                    connection.profile = null;
                    player.kickPlayer(message("<gray>Сессия завершена. Зайди снова, чтобы получить код."));
                }
                default -> { }
            }
        }));
    }

    private static String text(JsonObject object, String field) {
        return object.has(field) && !object.get(field).isJsonNull() ? object.get(field).getAsString() : "";
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.HIGHEST)
    public void verifyMinecraft(AsyncPlayerPreLoginEvent event) {
        if (!enabled()) return;
        String bind = plugin.getServer().getIp();
        boolean localOffline = plugin.getConfig().getBoolean("test-server.allow-local-offline")
                && ("127.0.0.1".equals(bind) || "::1".equals(bind))
                && event.getAddress().isLoopbackAddress();
        if (waiting == null || (!plugin.getServer().getOnlineMode() && !localOffline)) {
            event.disallow(AsyncPlayerPreLoginEvent.Result.KICK_OTHER,
                    message("<gray>Официальный сервер временно недоступен."));
        }
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.HIGHEST)
    public void onSpawn(PlayerSpawnLocationEvent event) {
        if (enabled() && waiting != null) {
            event.setSpawnLocation(waiting.clone());
        }
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.HIGHEST, ignoreCancelled = true)
    public void onTeleport(PlayerTeleportEvent event) {
        if (locked(event.getPlayer()) && event.getTo() != null && waiting != null
                && !waiting.equals(event.getTo())) {
            event.setCancelled(true);
        }
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.LOWEST, ignoreCancelled = true)
    public void onMove(PlayerMoveEvent event) {
        var to = event.getTo();
        var from = event.getFrom();
        if (locked(event.getPlayer()) && to != null
                && (from.getX() != to.getX() || from.getY() != to.getY() || from.getZ() != to.getZ())) {
            event.setCancelled(true);
        }
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.LOWEST, ignoreCancelled = true)
    public void onCommand(PlayerCommandPreprocessEvent event) {
        if (locked(event.getPlayer())) {
            event.setCancelled(true);
            event.getPlayer().sendMessage(message("<gray>Подтверди вход по ссылке в чате."));
        }
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.LOWEST, ignoreCancelled = true)
    public void onInteract(PlayerInteractEvent event) {
        if (locked(event.getPlayer())) event.setCancelled(true);
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.LOWEST, ignoreCancelled = true)
    public void onInteractEntity(PlayerInteractEntityEvent event) {
        if (locked(event.getPlayer())) event.setCancelled(true);
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.LOWEST, ignoreCancelled = true)
    public void onBreak(BlockBreakEvent event) {
        if (locked(event.getPlayer())) event.setCancelled(true);
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.LOWEST, ignoreCancelled = true)
    public void onPlace(BlockPlaceEvent event) {
        if (locked(event.getPlayer())) event.setCancelled(true);
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.LOWEST, ignoreCancelled = true)
    public void onDrop(PlayerDropItemEvent event) {
        if (locked(event.getPlayer())) event.setCancelled(true);
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.LOWEST, ignoreCancelled = true)
    public void onInventory(InventoryClickEvent event) {
        if (event.getWhoClicked() instanceof Player player && locked(player)) event.setCancelled(true);
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.LOWEST, ignoreCancelled = true)
    public void onDamage(EntityDamageEvent event) {
        if (event.getEntity() instanceof Player victim && locked(victim)
                || event instanceof EntityDamageByEntityEvent attack
                    && attack.getDamager() instanceof Player attacker && locked(attacker)) {
            event.setCancelled(true);
        }
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/me/everyone/oculusai/npc/CitadelArena.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.npc;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture;
import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;
import org.bukkit.Chunk;
import org.bukkit.Location;
import org.bukkit.Material;
import org.bukkit.NamespacedKey;
import org.bukkit.World;
import org.bukkit.block.BlockFace;
import org.bukkit.block.Sign;
import org.bukkit.block.data.Rotatable;
import org.bukkit.persistence.PersistentDataType;

/** A versioned training field built outside the original spawn area. */
final class CitadelArena {
    private static final int ORIGIN = 1024;
    private static final int RADIUS = 32;
    private static final int CRYSTAL_MIN_X = -29;
    private static final int CRYSTAL_MAX_X = -13;
    private static final int CRYSTAL_MIN_Z = 9;
    private static final int CRYSTAL_MAX_Z = 24;
    private static final Material WALL = Material.POLISHED_BLACKSTONE_BRICKS;
    private static final Material BORDER = Material.POLISHED_BLACKSTONE;

    private final OculusAI plugin;
    private final World world;
    private final int floor;
    private final NamespacedKey marker;

    CitadelArena(OculusAI plugin, World world) {
        this.plugin = plugin;
        this.world = world;
        this.floor = Math.min(world.getMaxHeight() - 12, world.getSpawnLocation().getBlockY() - 1);
        this.marker = new NamespacedKey(plugin, "citadel_layout_v1");
    }

    Location spawn() {
        return new Location(world, ORIGIN + 0.5D, floor + 1, ORIGIN + 27.5D, 180, 0);
    }

    boolean crystalBuildingArea(Location location) {
        return world.equals(location.getWorld()) && crystalFootprint(
                location.getBlockX() - ORIGIN, location.getBlockZ() - ORIGIN)
                && location.getBlockY() > floor && location.getBlockY() <= floor + 6;
    }

    private static boolean crystalFootprint(int x, int z) {
        return x >= CRYSTAL_MIN_X && x <= CRYSTAL_MAX_X
                && z >= CRYSTAL_MIN_Z && z <= CRYSTAL_MAX_Z;
    }

    void clearPracticeBlocks() {
        for (int cx = (ORIGIN + CRYSTAL_MIN_X) >> 4; cx <= (ORIGIN + CRYSTAL_MAX_X) >> 4; cx++) {
            for (int cz = (ORIGIN + CRYSTAL_MIN_Z) >> 4; cz <= (ORIGIN + CRYSTAL_MAX_Z) >> 4; cz++) {
                int startX = cx << 4;
                int startZ = cz << 4;
                plugin.platform().onRegion(new Location(world, startX, floor, startZ), () -> {
                    if (!world.isChunkLoaded(startX >> 4, startZ >> 4)) {
                        return;
                    }
                    for (int x = Math.max(startX, ORIGIN + CRYSTAL_MIN_X);
                         x <= Math.min(startX + 15, ORIGIN + CRYSTAL_MAX_X); x++) {
                        for (int z = Math.max(startZ, ORIGIN + CRYSTAL_MIN_Z);
                             z <= Math.min(startZ + 15, ORIGIN + CRYSTAL_MAX_Z); z++) {
                            for (int y = floor + 1; y <= floor + 6; y++) {
                                var block = world.getBlockAt(x, y, z);
                                if (block.getType() == Material.OBSIDIAN) {
                                    block.setType(Material.AIR, false);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                });
            }
        }
    }

    List<Location> stations() {
        return List.of(at(-16, -22, -90), at(-16, -5, -90),
                at(16, -22, 90), at(16, -5, 90));
    }

    private Location at(int x, int z, float yaw) {
        return new Location(world, ORIGIN + x + 0.5D, floor + 1, ORIGIN + z + 0.5D, yaw, 0);
    }

    CompletableFuture<Void> build() {
        List<CompletableFuture<Void>> sections = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int cx = (ORIGIN - RADIUS) >> 4; cx <= (ORIGIN + RADIUS) >> 4; cx++) {
            for (int cz = (ORIGIN - RADIUS) >> 4; cz <= (ORIGIN + RADIUS) >> 4; cz++) {
                if (plugin.platform().folia()) {
                    sections.add(world.getChunkAtAsync(cx, cz).thenCompose(this::buildOnRegion));
                } else {
                    buildChunk(world.getChunkAt(cx, cz));
                }
            }
        }
        return CompletableFuture.allOf(sections.toArray(CompletableFuture[]::new));
    }

    private CompletableFuture<Void> buildOnRegion(Chunk chunk) {
        CompletableFuture<Void> result = new CompletableFuture<>();
        Location location = new Location(world, chunk.getX() << 4, floor, chunk.getZ() << 4);
        plugin.platform().onRegion(location, () -> {
            try {
                buildChunk(chunk);
                result.complete(null);
            } catch (RuntimeException failure) {
                result.completeExceptionally(failure);
            }
        });
        return result;
    }

    private void buildChunk(Chunk chunk) {
        if (chunk.getPersistentDataContainer().has(marker, PersistentDataType.BYTE)) {
            return;
        }
        int minX = (chunk.getX() << 4) - ORIGIN;
        int minZ = (chunk.getZ() << 4) - ORIGIN;
        for (int x = Math.max(-RADIUS, minX); x <= Math.min(RADIUS, minX + 15); x++) {
            for (int z = Math.max(-RADIUS, minZ); z <= Math.min(RADIUS, minZ + 15); z++) {
                paintColumn(x, z);
            }
        }
        chunk.getPersistentDataContainer().set(marker, PersistentDataType.BYTE, (byte) 1);
    }

    private void paintColumn(int x, int z) {
        int ax = Math.abs(x);
        int az = Math.abs(z);
        boolean duel = ax <= 20 && z >= -28 && z <= 4;
        boolean crystal = crystalFootprint(x, z);
        boolean movement = x >= 13 && x <= 29 && z >= 9 && z <= 24;

        block(x, -1, z, BORDER);
        for (int y = 1; y <= 7; y++) {
            block(x, y, z, Material.AIR);
        }
        Material ground = ((x + z) & 3) == 0 ? Material.STONE_BRICKS : Material.SMOOTH_STONE;
        if (duel) {
            boolean rim = ax == 20 || z == -28 || z == 4;
            boolean cross = (ax == 0 && z >= -19 && z <= -5) || (z == -12 && ax <= 7);
            ground = rim ? BORDER : cross ? Material.GILDED_BLACKSTONE : Material.POLISHED_ANDESITE;
        } else if (crystal) {
            ground = (x == CRYSTAL_MIN_X || x == CRYSTAL_MAX_X
                    || z == CRYSTAL_MIN_Z || z == CRYSTAL_MAX_Z)
                    ? Material.CRYING_OBSIDIAN : Material.OBSIDIAN;
        } else if (movement) {
            ground = (x == 13 || x == 29 || z == 9 || z == 24)
                    ? Material.DARK_PRISMARINE : Material.POLISHED_ANDESITE;
        } else if (ax <= 4) {
            ground = ax == 4 ? Material.GILDED_BLACKSTONE : Material.POLISHED_BLACKSTONE;
        }
        block(x, 0, z, ground);

        if (ax == RADIUS || az == RADIUS) {
            boolean tower = (ax == RADIUS && (z & 7) == 0) || (az == RADIUS && (x & 7) == 0);
            for (int y = 1; y <= (tower ? 5 : 3); y++) {
                block(x, y, z, tower ? Material.POLISHED_BASALT : WALL);
            }
            if (tower) {
                block(x, 6, z, Material.SOUL_LANTERN);
            }
        } else if ((ax == 6 && (z == 7 || z == 25)) || (ax == 22 && z == -26)) {
            block(x, 1, z, WALL);
            block(x, 2, z, Material.POLISHED_BASALT);
            block(x, 3, z, Material.SOUL_LANTERN);
        } else if (movement && x >= 17 && x <= 25 && z >= 12 && z <= 19) {
            int height = Math.min(3, 1 + (z - 12) / 2);
            for (int y = 1; y <= height; y++) {
                block(x, y, z, Material.POLISHED_BASALT);
            }
        } else if (movement && x >= 26 && x <= 27 && z >= 20 && z <= 22) {
            block(x, 1, z, WALL);
            block(x, 2, z, WALL);
        }

        if (x == 3 && z == 6) {
            sign(x, z, "DUEL COURT", "NPC / sword / crits");
        } else if (x == -21 && z == 26) {
            sign(x, z, "CRYSTAL LAB", "Obsidian floor");
        } else if (x == 21 && z == 26) {
            sign(x, z, "MOVEMENT LAB", "Steps / cover");
        }
    }

    private void block(int x, int y, int z, Material material) {
        world.getBlockAt(ORIGIN + x, floor + y, ORIGIN + z).setType(material, false);
    }

    private void sign(int x, int z, String title, String subtitle) {
        var block = world.getBlockAt(ORIGIN + x, floor + 1, ORIGIN + z);
        block.setType(Material.DARK_OAK_SIGN, false);
        Rotatable direction = (Rotatable) block.getBlockData();
        direction.setRotation(BlockFace.SOUTH);
        block.setBlockData(direction, false);
        if (block.getState() instanceof Sign sign) {
            sign.setLine(0, title);
            sign.setLine(2, subtitle);
            sign.update();
        }
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/me/everyone/oculusai/npc/Npc.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.npc;

import com.comphenix.protocol.wrappers.WrappedGameProfile;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.UUID;
import me.everyone.oculusai.npc.NpcOptions;
import org.bukkit.Location;
import org.bukkit.World;

public final class Npc {

    enum Footwork { STRAFE, PRESS, RETREAT }

    public static final double WIDTH = 0.6D;
    public static final double HEIGHT = 1.8D;

    private final int entityId;
    private final UUID uuid;
    private final String name;
    private final WrappedGameProfile profile;
    private final UUID owner;
    private final World world;

    private final Set<UUID> viewers = new HashSet<>();

    private double x;
    private double y;
    private double z;
    private float yaw;
    private float pitch;

    private double maxHealth;
    private double health;
    private NpcOptions options;

    private long nextAttackTick;
    private long deathTick = -1L;
    private final double groundY;
    private long changeMovementTick;
    private long nextJumpTick;
    private long recoverUntil;
    private Footwork footwork = Footwork.STRAFE;
    private double strafeDirection = 1.0D;
    private double orbitRadius = 2.4D;
    private double velocityX;
    private double velocityY;
    private double velocityZ;
    private double verticalMovement;

    public Npc(int entityId, UUID uuid, String name, WrappedGameProfile profile,
               UUID owner, Location location, NpcOptions options) {
        this.entityId = entityId;
        this.uuid = uuid;
        this.name = name;
        this.profile = profile;
        this.owner = owner;
        this.world = location.getWorld();
        this.x = location.getX();
        this.y = location.getY();
        this.z = location.getZ();
        this.yaw = location.getYaw();
        this.pitch = location.getPitch();
        this.groundY = location.getY();
        applyOptions(options);
        this.health = this.maxHealth;
    }

    public void applyOptions(NpcOptions options) {
        this.options = options;
        double requested = options.health() > 0 ? options.health() : 20.0D;
        this.maxHealth = requested;
        this.health = Math.min(this.health <= 0 ? requested : this.health, requested);
    }

    public int entityId() {
        return entityId;
    }

    public UUID uuid() {
        return uuid;
    }

    public String name() {
        return name;
    }

    public WrappedGameProfile profile() {
        return profile;
    }

    public UUID owner() {
        return owner;
    }

    public World world() {
        return world;
    }

    public Set<UUID> viewers() {
        return viewers;
    }

    public double x() {
        return x;
    }

    public double y() {
        return y;
    }

    public double z() {
        return z;
    }

    public float yaw() {
        return yaw;
    }

    public float pitch() {
        return pitch;
    }

    public void position(double x, double y, double z) {
        verticalMovement = y - this.y;
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.z = z;
    }

    public void rotation(float yaw, float pitch) {
        this.yaw = yaw;
        this.pitch = pitch;
    }

    public Location location() {
        return new Location(world, x, y, z, yaw, pitch);
    }

    public double health() {
        return health;
    }

    public double maxHealth() {
        return maxHealth;
    }

    public void health(double health) {
        this.health = health;
    }

    public NpcOptions options() {
        return options;
    }

    public void swung(long tick, long cooldown) {
        nextAttackTick = tick + cooldown;
    }

    public long nextAttackTick() {
        return nextAttackTick;
    }

    public boolean dying() {
        return deathTick >= 0L;
    }

    public long deathTick() {
        return deathTick;
    }

    public void deathTick(long tick) {
        this.deathTick = tick;
    }

    public void planMovement(long tick) {
        if (tick < changeMovementTick) {
            return;
        }
        var random = java.util.concurrent.ThreadLocalRandom.current();
        int roll = random.nextInt(10);
        footwork = roll < 5 ? Footwork.STRAFE : roll < 8 ? Footwork.PRESS : Footwork.RETREAT;
        if (random.nextInt(4) != 0) {
            strafeDirection = -strafeDirection;
        }
        orbitRadius = random.nextDouble(2.2D, 2.75D);
        changeMovementTick = tick + random.nextInt(8, 19);
    }

    public double strafeDirection() { return strafeDirection; }
    public double orbitRadius() { return orbitRadius; }
    public double groundY() { return groundY; }
    public double velocityX() { return velocityX; }
    public double velocityZ() { return velocityZ; }
    public Footwork footwork() { return footwork; }
    public boolean recovering(long tick) { return tick < recoverUntil; }

    public void steer(double x, double z) {
        velocityX += (x - velocityX) * 0.45D;
        velocityZ += (z - velocityZ) * 0.45D;
    }

    public void knockBack(double x, double z, long tick) {
        velocityX = x;
        velocityZ = z;
        recoverUntil = tick + 5;
        if (!airborne()) {
            velocityY = 0.24D;
        }
    }

    public boolean airborne() { return y > groundY + 0.0002D || velocityY > 0.0D; }
    public boolean falling() { return y > groundY + 0.05D && verticalMovement < 0.0D; }

    public void tryJump(long tick) {
        if (!airborne() && tick >= nextJumpTick) {
            velocityY = 0.42D;
            nextJumpTick = tick + java.util.concurrent.ThreadLocalRandom.current().nextInt(24, 44);
        }
    }

    public double verticalStep() {
        if (!airborne()) {
            velocityY = 0;
            return 0;
        }
        double delta = Math.max(groundY - y, velocityY);
        velocityY = (velocityY - 0.08D) * 0.98D;
        return delta;
    }
}
```
