`src/main/java/me/everyone/oculusai/npc/Npcs.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.npc;


import me.everyone.oculusai.core.Service;
import me.everyone.oculusai.core.TickLoop;
import com.comphenix.protocol.PacketType;
import com.comphenix.protocol.ProtocolLibrary;
import com.comphenix.protocol.ProtocolManager;
import com.comphenix.protocol.events.ListenerPriority;
import com.comphenix.protocol.events.PacketAdapter;
import com.comphenix.protocol.events.PacketEvent;
import com.comphenix.protocol.events.PacketListener;
import com.comphenix.protocol.wrappers.WrappedGameProfile;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import java.util.concurrent.ThreadLocalRandom;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;
import me.everyone.oculusai.ui.menu.DummyMenu;
import me.everyone.oculusai.npc.NpcOptions;
import me.everyone.oculusai.npc.Npc;
import me.everyone.oculusai.npc.NpcPackets;
import me.everyone.oculusai.npc.NpcProtocol;
import me.everyone.oculusai.packet.UseActions;
import me.everyone.oculusai.player.EntityTracker;
import org.bukkit.Bukkit;
import org.bukkit.GameMode;
import org.bukkit.Location;
import org.bukkit.Particle;
import org.bukkit.Sound;
import org.bukkit.SoundCategory;
import org.bukkit.Tag;
import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
import org.bukkit.event.EventHandler;
import org.bukkit.event.EventPriority;
import org.bukkit.event.Listener;
import org.bukkit.event.entity.PlayerDeathEvent;
import org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerChangedWorldEvent;
import org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerJoinEvent;
import org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerQuitEvent;
import org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerRespawnEvent;
import org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerTeleportEvent;
import org.bukkit.potion.PotionEffectType;
import org.bukkit.util.Vector;

public final class Npcs implements Service, Listener {

    private static final int MAX_NPCS = 5;
    private static final int VIEW_DISTANCE_SQUARED = 64 * 64;
    private static final int TARGET_RANGE_SQUARED = 48 * 48;

    private static final int ENTITY_ID_BASE = Integer.MAX_VALUE - 4096;

    private static final double WALK_SPEED = 0.21D;
    private static final double PRESS_SPEED = 0.28D;
    private static final double REACH = 3.2D;
    private static final long ATTACK_COOLDOWN_TICKS = 12L;
    private static final double ATTACK_DAMAGE = 2.0D;
    private static final double HIT_DAMAGE = 6.0D;
    private static final double KNOCKBACK = 0.29D;
    private static final long DEATH_LINGER_TICKS = 20L;
    private static final double EYE_HEIGHT = 1.62D;
    /** How old a position sample may be before its player is ignored. The
     *  tracker takes one every tick, so this only ever excludes somebody on
     *  their way out. */
    private static final long SAMPLE_MAX_AGE_MS = 1_000L;

    private final OculusAI plugin;
    private final Map<UUID, Npc> npcs = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private final AtomicInteger ids = new AtomicInteger(ENTITY_ID_BASE);
    private final AtomicInteger names = new AtomicInteger();

    private NpcProtocol protocol;
    private ProtocolManager protocolManager;
    private PacketListener listener;
    private TickLoop.Handle task;
    private long ticks;

    public Npcs(OculusAI plugin) {
        this.plugin = plugin;
    }

    @Override
    public void enable() {
        protocol = new NpcPackets();
        protocolManager = ProtocolLibrary.getProtocolManager();
        plugin.getServer().getPluginManager().registerEvents(this, plugin);

        listener = new PacketAdapter(plugin, ListenerPriority.HIGHEST,
                PacketType.Play.Client.USE_ENTITY) {
            @Override
            public void onPacketReceiving(PacketEvent event) {
                try {
                    handleUse(event);
                } catch (Throwable throwable) {
                    plugin.getLogger().log(Level.SEVERE,
                            "Error reading an NPC interaction", throwable);
                }
            }
        };
        protocolManager.addPacketListener(listener);

        task = plugin.ticks().every(1L, this::tick);
    }

    /** Whether this server can run a manikin at all.
     *
     *  <p>True on both now. It used to be false on Folia, because the tick
     *  chased a player and hit them, and both of those read an entity owned by
     *  whatever region it had walked into. The manikin itself is not an entity
     *  - it is a few packets and a position this class keeps - so what it
     *  needed was to stop reading players: it takes their positions from the
     *  tracker's samples, and hands the one thing it does to a player, damage,
     *  to that player's own thread. */
    public boolean supported() {
        return true;
    }

    /** Where a player is, read from wherever that is legal.
     *
     *  <p>On Paper, from the player. On Folia, from the sample their own
     *  region thread took - the manikin's tick runs on the global region,
     *  which owns nobody. Null when nobody has sampled them recently, which
     *  means the manikin ignores them: a target it cannot locate is a target
     *  it cannot chase. */
    private Location positionOf(Player player) {
        if (player == null || !player.isOnline()) {
            return null;
        }
        if (!plugin.platform().folia()) {
            return player.getLocation();
        }
        EntityTracker.Tracked sample = plugin.tracker().get(player.getEntityId());
        if (sample == null || System.currentTimeMillis() - sample.at() > SAMPLE_MAX_AGE_MS) {
            return null;
        }
        org.bukkit.World world = plugin.getServer().getWorld(sample.worldId());
        return world == null ? null
                : new Location(world, sample.x(), sample.y(), sample.z());
    }

    @Override
    public void disable() {
        if (task != null) {
            task.cancel();
            task = null;
        }
        if (listener != null && protocolManager != null) {
            protocolManager.removePacketListener(listener);
            listener = null;
        }
        clearAll();
    }

    public int spawn(Player owner, int count, NpcOptions options) {
        if (!supported()) {
            return 0;
        }
        long active = npcs.values().stream().filter(npc -> npc.owner() != null).count();
        int allowed = Math.min(Math.max(1, count), MAX_NPCS - (int) active);
        if (allowed <= 0) {
            return 0;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < allowed; i++) {
            Location spot = owner.getLocation().clone()
                    .add(owner.getLocation().getDirection().setY(0).normalize().multiply(2.5D));
            spot.setYaw(owner.getLocation().getYaw() + 180.0F);
            spot.setPitch(0.0F);

            UUID uuid = UUID.randomUUID();
            String name = "Dummy" + names.incrementAndGet();
            Npc npc = new Npc(ids.decrementAndGet(), uuid, name,
                    profileFor(owner, uuid, name), owner.getUniqueId(), spot, options);
            npcs.put(uuid, npc);
            refreshViewers(npc);
        }
        return allowed;
    }

    public void spawnStation(Location location, String name) {
        UUID uuid = UUID.randomUUID();
        Npc npc = new Npc(ids.decrementAndGet(), uuid, name,
                new WrappedGameProfile(uuid, name), null, location,
                new NpcOptions(-1, true, true));
        npcs.put(uuid, npc);
    }

    public void clearOwned(UUID owner) {
        plugin.platform().onGlobal(() -> {
            for (Npc npc : npcs.values()) {
                if (owner.equals(npc.owner())) {
                    remove(npc.uuid());
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private WrappedGameProfile profileFor(Player owner, UUID uuid, String name) {
        WrappedGameProfile profile = new WrappedGameProfile(uuid, name);
        try {
            WrappedGameProfile source = WrappedGameProfile.fromPlayer(owner);
            profile.getProperties().putAll(source.getProperties());
        } catch (Throwable ignored) {
        }
        return profile;
    }

    public void clearAll() {
        for (Npc npc : new ArrayList<>(npcs.values())) {
            destroy(npc);
        }
        npcs.clear();
    }

    public void remove(UUID id) {
        Npc npc = npcs.remove(id);
        if (npc != null) {
            destroy(npc);
        }
    }

    private void destroy(Npc npc) {
        for (UUID viewerId : new ArrayList<>(npc.viewers())) {
            Player viewer = Bukkit.getPlayer(viewerId);
            if (viewer != null) {
                protocol.despawn(viewer, npc);
            }
        }
        npc.viewers().clear();
        plugin.tracker().forget(npc.entityId());
    }

    public int count() {
        return npcs.size();
    }

    public boolean isNpc(UUID id) {
        return npcs.containsKey(id);
    }

    public NpcOptions optionsOf(UUID id) {
        Npc npc = npcs.get(id);
        return npc == null ? null : npc.options();
    }

    public void updateOptions(UUID id, NpcOptions options) {
        Npc npc = npcs.get(id);
        if (npc != null && npc.owner() != null) {
            npc.applyOptions(options);
        }
    }

    private void tick() {
        ticks++;
        for (Npc npc : npcs.values()) {
            if (npc.dying()) {
                if (ticks - npc.deathTick() >= DEATH_LINGER_TICKS) {
                    remove(npc.uuid());
                }
                continue;
            }
            refreshViewers(npc);
            Player target = npc.options().stationary() ? null : target(npc);
            Location at = target == null ? null : positionOf(target);
            if (target != null && at != null) {
                step(npc, at);
                if (face(npc, at)) {
                    attack(npc, target, at);
                }
            } else if (npc.airborne()) {
                moveSafely(npc, 0, npc.verticalStep(), 0);
            }
            broadcastLook(npc);
            plugin.tracker().track(npc.entityId(), npc.x(), npc.y(), npc.z(),
                    Npc.WIDTH, Npc.HEIGHT, npc.world());
        }
    }

    private Player target(Npc npc) {
        if (npc.owner() == null) {
            return null;
        }
        Player owner = Bukkit.getPlayer(npc.owner());
        Location at = positionOf(owner);
        return at != null && npc.world().equals(at.getWorld())
                && at.distanceSquared(npc.location()) <= TARGET_RANGE_SQUARED ? owner : null;
    }

    private boolean face(Npc npc, Location at) {
        double dx = at.getX() - npc.x();
        double dy = (at.getY() + 1.40D) - (npc.y() + EYE_HEIGHT);
        double dz = at.getZ() - npc.z();
        double flat = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz);
        float yaw = (float) Math.toDegrees(Math.atan2(-dx, dz));
        float pitch = (float) -Math.toDegrees(Math.atan2(dy, Math.max(0.01D, flat)));
        float yawStep = (float) Math.IEEEremainder(yaw - npc.yaw(), 360);
        float pitchStep = pitch - npc.pitch();
        npc.rotation(npc.yaw() + bounded(yawStep, 24F), npc.pitch() + bounded(pitchStep, 15F));
        return Math.abs(yawStep) <= 34F && Math.abs(pitchStep) <= 25F;
    }

    private static float bounded(float value, float limit) {
        return Math.max(-limit, Math.min(limit, value));
    }

    private void step(Npc npc, Location at) {
        double dx = at.getX() - npc.x();
        double dz = at.getZ() - npc.z();
        double distance = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz);
        if (npc.recovering(ticks) || distance < 0.0001D) {
            npc.steer(0, 0);
            moveSafely(npc, npc.velocityX(), npc.verticalStep(), npc.velocityZ());
            return;
        }

        npc.planMovement(ticks);
        boolean chasing = distance > REACH + 0.35D;
        double spacing = chasing ? 1.0D : (distance - npc.orbitRadius()) * 0.75D;
        double forward = switch (npc.footwork()) {
            case PRESS -> spacing + 0.31D;
            case RETREAT -> spacing - 0.47D;
            case STRAFE -> spacing;
        };
        forward = Math.max(-0.85D, Math.min(1.0D, forward));
        double strafe = npc.strafeDirection() * (chasing ? 0.18D : 0.86D);
        double speed = chasing || npc.footwork() == Npc.Footwork.PRESS ? PRESS_SPEED : WALK_SPEED;

        double nx = dx / distance;
        double nz = dz / distance;
        double moveX = (nx * forward - nz * strafe) * speed;
        double moveZ = (nz * forward + nx * strafe) * speed;
        double length = Math.max(1.0D, Math.hypot(forward, strafe));
        npc.steer(moveX / length, moveZ / length);
        if (distance <= REACH && npc.footwork() != Npc.Footwork.RETREAT
                && Math.abs(at.getY() - npc.groundY()) < 0.6D && ticks + 7 >= npc.nextAttackTick()
                && canOccupy(npc, npc.x(), npc.y() + 1.3D, npc.z())) {
            npc.tryJump(ticks);
        }
        double moveY = npc.verticalStep();
        moveSafely(npc, npc.velocityX(), moveY, npc.velocityZ());
    }

    private void moveSafely(Npc npc, double x, double y, double z) {
        if (!canOccupy(npc, npc.x() + x, npc.y() + y, npc.z() + z)) {
            if (x != 0 && canOccupy(npc, npc.x() + x, npc.y() + y, npc.z())) {
                z = 0;
            } else if (z != 0 && canOccupy(npc, npc.x(), npc.y() + y, npc.z() + z)) {
                x = 0;
            } else {
                x = 0;
                z = 0;
                if (!canOccupy(npc, npc.x(), npc.y() + y, npc.z())) {
                    y = 0;
                }
            }
        }
        move(npc, x, y, z);
    }

    private boolean canOccupy(Npc npc, double x, double y, double z) {
        if (plugin.platform().folia()) {
            // The packet entity is owned by the global tick, which cannot read terrain.
            return true;
        }
        var world = npc.world();
        for (double dx : new double[] {-0.28D, 0.28D}) {
            for (double dz : new double[] {-0.28D, 0.28D}) {
                Location feet = new Location(world, x + dx, y + 0.02D, z + dz);
                if (!world.isChunkLoaded(feet.getBlockX() >> 4, feet.getBlockZ() >> 4)
                        || !feet.getBlock().isPassable()
                        || !feet.add(0, 1.65D, 0).getBlock().isPassable()) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return !new Location(world, x, npc.groundY() - 0.12D, z).getBlock().isPassable();
    }

    private void move(Npc npc, double dx, double dy, double dz) {
        double stepX = quantise(dx);
        double stepY = quantise(dy);
        double stepZ = quantise(dz);
        npc.position(npc.x() + stepX, npc.y() + stepY, npc.z() + stepZ);
        if (stepX == 0 && stepY == 0 && stepZ == 0) {
            return;
        }
        for (Player viewer : viewersOf(npc)) {
            protocol.move(viewer, npc, stepX, stepY, stepZ);
        }
    }

    private static double quantise(double blocks) {
        return Math.round(blocks * 4096.0D) / 4096.0D;
    }

    private void attack(Npc npc, Player target, Location at) {
        if (ticks < npc.nextAttackTick() || npc.recovering(ticks)) {
            return;
        }
        if (at.distance(npc.location()) > REACH) {
            return;
        }
        if (npc.airborne() && !npc.falling()) {
            return;
        }
        boolean critical = npc.falling();
        npc.swung(ticks, ATTACK_COOLDOWN_TICKS + ThreadLocalRandom.current().nextInt(7));
        for (Player viewer : viewersOf(npc)) {
            protocol.swing(viewer, npc);
        }
        // The one thing the manikin does to a player, and the only part of
        // this that has to be on the player's own thread.
        Location attackSpot = npc.location();
        plugin.platform().onEntity(target, () -> {
            Location current = target.getLocation();
            if (!npcs.containsKey(npc.uuid()) || target.isDead() || target.getGameMode() == GameMode.CREATIVE
                    || target.getGameMode() == GameMode.SPECTATOR
                    || !attackSpot.getWorld().equals(current.getWorld()) || current.distance(attackSpot) > REACH) {
                return;
            }
            if (!plugin.platform().folia()) {
                Location eye = attackSpot.clone().add(0, EYE_HEIGHT, 0);
                Vector sight = current.clone().add(0, 1.0D, 0).toVector().subtract(eye.toVector());
                if (sight.lengthSquared() > 1.0e-4D
                        && eye.getWorld().rayTraceBlocks(eye, sight, sight.length()) != null) {
                    return;
                }
            }
            if (critical) {
                playCriticalSound(target, attackSpot);
                target.spawnParticle(Particle.CRIT, current.clone().add(0, 1, 0), 8, 0.25D, 0.35D, 0.25D);
            } else {
                target.playSound(attackSpot, Sound.ENTITY_PLAYER_ATTACK_STRONG, SoundCategory.PLAYERS, 1.0F, 1.0F);
            }
            double health = target.getHealth() + target.getAbsorptionAmount();
            target.damage(critical ? ATTACK_DAMAGE * 1.5D : ATTACK_DAMAGE);
            if (!target.isDead() && target.getHealth() + target.getAbsorptionAmount() < health) {
                Vector push = current.toVector().subtract(attackSpot.toVector()).setY(0);
                if (push.lengthSquared() > 1.0e-4D) {
                    target.setVelocity(target.getVelocity().multiply(0.5D)
                            .add(push.normalize().multiply(0.28D)).setY(0.26D));
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private static void playCriticalSound(Player listener, Location source) {
        listener.playSound(source, Sound.ENTITY_PLAYER_ATTACK_CRIT, SoundCategory.PLAYERS, 1.0F, 1.0F);
    }

    private void broadcastLook(Npc npc) {
        for (Player viewer : viewersOf(npc)) {
            protocol.look(viewer, npc);
        }
    }

    private List<Player> viewersOf(Npc npc) {
        List<Player> players = new ArrayList<>(npc.viewers().size());
        for (UUID id : npc.viewers()) {
            Player viewer = Bukkit.getPlayer(id);
            if (viewer != null && viewer.isOnline()) {
                players.add(viewer);
            }
        }
        return players;
    }

    private void refreshViewers(Npc npc) {
        for (Player player : Bukkit.getOnlinePlayers()) {
            Location at = positionOf(player);
            boolean shouldSee = at != null && npc.world().equals(at.getWorld())
                    && at.distanceSquared(npc.location()) <= VIEW_DISTANCE_SQUARED;
            boolean sees = npc.viewers().contains(player.getUniqueId());
            if (shouldSee && !sees) {
                npc.viewers().add(player.getUniqueId());
                protocol.spawn(player, npc, tabName(player, npc));
                protocol.equip(player, npc);
                protocol.look(player, npc);
            } else if (!shouldSee && sees) {
                npc.viewers().remove(player.getUniqueId());
                protocol.despawn(player, npc);
            }
        }
        npc.viewers().removeIf(id -> Bukkit.getPlayer(id) == null);
    }

    private String tabName(Player player, Npc npc) {
        return plugin.resourcePack().botPrefix(player) + npc.name();
    }

    public void refreshTab(Player player) {
        plugin.platform().onGlobal(() -> {
            for (Npc npc : npcs.values()) {
                if (npc.viewers().contains(player.getUniqueId())) {
                    protocol.tabName(player, npc, tabName(player, npc));
                }
            }
        });
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.MONITOR)
    public void onQuit(PlayerQuitEvent event) {
        UUID id = event.getPlayer().getUniqueId();
        clearOwned(id);
        for (Npc npc : npcs.values()) {
            npc.viewers().remove(id);
        }
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.MONITOR)
    public void onWorldChange(PlayerChangedWorldEvent event) {
        clearOwned(event.getPlayer().getUniqueId());
        forget(event.getPlayer());
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.MONITOR)
    public void onDeath(PlayerDeathEvent event) {
        clearOwned(event.getEntity().getUniqueId());
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.MONITOR)
    public void onRespawn(PlayerRespawnEvent event) {
        forget(event.getPlayer());
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.MONITOR)
    public void onJoin(PlayerJoinEvent event) {
        forget(event.getPlayer());
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.MONITOR, ignoreCancelled = true)
    public void onTeleport(PlayerTeleportEvent event) {
        Location to = event.getTo();
        if (to == null || to.getWorld() == null) {
            return;
        }
        if (!to.getWorld().equals(event.getFrom().getWorld())
                || event.getFrom().distanceSquared(to) > 16.0D) {
            if (!to.getWorld().equals(event.getFrom().getWorld())
                    || event.getFrom().distanceSquared(to) > TARGET_RANGE_SQUARED) {
                clearOwned(event.getPlayer().getUniqueId());
            }
            forget(event.getPlayer());
        }
    }

    private void forget(Player player) {
        UUID id = player.getUniqueId();
        for (Npc npc : npcs.values()) {
            npc.viewers().remove(id);
        }
    }

    private void handleUse(PacketEvent event) {
        if (event.isCancelled()) {
            return;
        }
        int entityId = event.getPacket().getIntegers().read(0);
        Npc npc = byEntityId(entityId);
        if (npc == null) {
            return;
        }

        String action = UseActions.of(event.getPacket());
        Player player = event.getPlayer();
        if (npc.owner() != null && !npc.owner().equals(player.getUniqueId())) {
            event.setCancelled(true);
            return;
        }

        // Onto the attacker's own thread, not the main one: everything either
        // branch touches is this player - a sound, their position, their
        // inventory screen - and on Folia the global region may touch none of
        // it.
        if ("ATTACK".equals(action)) {
            // Save the player's combat state with the attack packet. The
            // scheduled callback can run after the next movement packet
            // lands the player or changes their sprint state.
            Location from = player.getLocation();
            float charge = player.getAttackCooldown();
            boolean fallingAttack = charge > 0.9F && player.getFallDistance() > 0
                    && !player.isOnGround() && !player.isSprinting() && !player.isInWater()
                    && !player.isInsideVehicle() && !player.hasPotionEffect(PotionEffectType.BLINDNESS);
            plugin.platform().onEntity(player, () -> {
                if (!player.isOnline() || !player.getWorld().equals(from.getWorld())
                        || !plugin.platform().owns(from.getWorld(), from.getBlockX() >> 4, from.getBlockZ() >> 4)) {
                    return;
                }
                boolean critical = fallingAttack && !Tag.CLIMBABLE.isTagged(from.getBlock().getType());
                plugin.platform().onGlobal(() -> hit(npc, player, from, charge, critical));
            });
            return;
        }
        if (npc.owner() != null && player.isSneaking() && player.hasPermission("oculusai.npc")) {
            event.setCancelled(true);
            plugin.platform().onEntity(player, () -> new DummyMenu(plugin, player, npc.uuid()).open());
        }
    }

    private static Sound hitSound() {
        for (String name : new String[] {"ENTITY_PLAYER_HURT", "ENTITY_PLAYER_ATTACK_STRONG"}) {
            try {
                return Sound.valueOf(name);
            } catch (IllegalArgumentException ignored) {
            }
        }
        return Sound.values()[0];
    }

    private Npc byEntityId(int entityId) {
        for (Npc npc : npcs.values()) {
            if (npc.entityId() == entityId) {
                return npc;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    /** A blow landing on the manikin, from an attacker standing at
     *  {@code from}. Runs where the manikin is ticked. */
    private void hit(Npc npc, Player attacker, Location from, float charge, boolean critical) {
        if (npc.dying() || !npcs.containsKey(npc.uuid()) || !npc.world().equals(from.getWorld())
                || npc.location().distanceSquared(from) > 16.0D) {
            return;
        }
        Location impact = npc.location().add(0, 1, 0);
        plugin.platform().onEntity(attacker, () -> {
            if (critical) {
                // Vanilla locates the attack sound at the attacker. Keep the
                // critical particles on the dummy's hitbox.
                playCriticalSound(attacker, attacker.getLocation());
                attacker.spawnParticle(Particle.CRIT, impact, 12, 0.3D, 0.35D, 0.3D);
            } else {
                attacker.playSound(impact, hitSound(), 1.0F, 1.0F);
            }
        });
        for (Player viewer : viewersOf(npc)) {
            // Older clients can play a hurt sound from the hurt packet.
            // The attacker already gets the critical sound and particles.
            if (critical && viewer.getUniqueId().equals(attacker.getUniqueId())) {
                continue;
            }
            protocol.hurt(viewer, npc);
        }

        double dx = npc.x() - from.getX();
        double dz = npc.z() - from.getZ();
        double flat = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz);
        if (npc.owner() != null && !npc.options().stationary() && flat > 0.0001D) {
            npc.knockBack(dx / flat * KNOCKBACK, dz / flat * KNOCKBACK, ticks);
        }

        if (npc.options().invulnerable()) {
            return;
        }
        double multiplier = (0.2D + charge * charge * 0.8D) * (critical ? 1.5D : 1.0D);
        npc.health(npc.health() - HIT_DAMAGE * multiplier);
        if (npc.health() > 0) {
            return;
        }
        npc.deathTick(ticks);
        for (Player viewer : viewersOf(npc)) {
            protocol.death(viewer, npc);
        }
        attacker.sendMessage(plugin.config().prefix()
                + plugin.lang().text("npc.killed", Map.of("value", npc.name())));
    }
}
```

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.npc;


import me.everyone.oculusai.core.Service;
import me.everyone.oculusai.core.TickLoop;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

import java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArrayList;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;
import me.everyone.oculusai.storage.DatasetStore;
import me.everyone.oculusai.npc.NpcOptions;

import me.everyone.oculusai.core.Msg;
import org.bukkit.Bukkit;

import org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerJoinEvent;
import org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerQuitEvent;
import org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerRespawnEvent;
import org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack;
import org.bukkit.inventory.PlayerInventory;
import org.bukkit.inventory.meta.ItemMeta;
import org.bukkit.potion.PotionEffect;
import org.bukkit.potion.PotionEffectType;
import me.everyone.oculusai.ui.Sidebar;
import me.everyone.oculusai.ui.TabStyle;

public final class TestServer implements Service, Listener {

    private final OculusAI plugin;

    private World world;
    private final List<Entity> welcomeGuide = new CopyOnWriteArrayList<>();
    private final java.util.Map<UUID, EnderCrystal> arenaCrystals = new java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private static final double MAX_CRYSTAL_DAMAGE = 6.0D;
    private static final String BUILD_PERMISSION = "oculusai.testserver.build";
    private CitadelArena citadel;
    private TickLoop.Handle crystalSweep;
    private volatile Location citadelSpawn;
    private CompletableFuture<Void> arenaBuild = CompletableFuture.completedFuture(null);
    private TickLoop.Handle scoreboardTask;
    private Runnable unregisterTabStyle = () -> {};
    private me.everyone.oculusai.core.Platform.Cancellable mobSweep;
    /** So the "no scoreboards here" line is logged once rather than per
     *  player per refresh. */
    private final java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean scoreboardWarned =
            new java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean();
    /** How far around the arena's spawn the mob sweep reaches on Folia. One
     *  region's worth; the arena is a flat square and nothing lives outside
     *  it. */
    private static final double PURGE_RADIUS = 96.0D;
    private final ArenaAccess access;
    /** Сайдбар каждого игрока - один на всё время, обновляется на месте. */
    private final java.util.Map<UUID, Sidebar> sidebars = new java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap<>();

    public TestServer(OculusAI plugin) {
        this.plugin = plugin;
        this.access = new ArenaAccess(plugin);
    }

    @Override
    public void enable() {
        if (!plugin.config().testServerEnabled()) {
            return;
        }

        plugin.getServer().getPluginManager().registerEvents(this, plugin);
        world = flatWorld();
        if (world == null) {
            // Folia with no arena world present. Said once, plainly: this is a
            // thing the admin can fix in a minute, and silence here reads as
            // the arena being broken.
            plugin.getLogger().warning("The test arena is on but world \""
                    + plugin.config().testServerWorld() + "\" is not loaded, and Folia"
                    + " cannot create a world while running. Folia loads the world named"
                    + " by level-name in server.properties and its nether and end, and"
                    + " nothing else - a world folder sitting in the server directory is"
                    + " never picked up. So either make the arena that world"
                    + " (level-name=" + plugin.config().testServerWorld() + ", which is"
                    + " what a dedicated test box wants anyway), or set"
                    + " test-server.enabled: false.");
            return;
        }
        Location sweepCenter = world.getSpawnLocation();
        if (plugin.getConfig().getBoolean("test-server.built-in-arena", false)) {
            CitadelArena arena = new CitadelArena(plugin, world);
            citadel = arena;
            sweepCenter = arena.spawn();
            try {
                arenaBuild = arena.build().handle((ignored, failure) -> {
                    if (failure == null) {
                        citadelSpawn = arena.spawn();
                        plugin.platform().onGlobal(() -> {
                            int number = 1;
                            for (Location station : arena.stations()) {
                                plugin.npcs().spawnStation(station, "Target" + number++);
                            }
                            plugin.getLogger().info("Citadel Duel Court: four training targets registered");
                        });
                        createWelcomeGuide(citadelSpawn);
                        plugin.getLogger().info("Citadel arena ready at " + citadelSpawn.getBlockX()
                                + ", " + citadelSpawn.getBlockY() + ", " + citadelSpawn.getBlockZ());
                    } else {
                        plugin.getLogger().log(Level.WARNING, "Could not build the Citadel arena", failure);
                    }
                    return null;
                });
            } catch (RuntimeException failure) {
                plugin.getLogger().log(Level.WARNING, "Could not build the Citadel arena", failure);
            }
        }
        unregisterTabStyle = TabStyle.register(plugin);
        access.prepare();
        Bukkit.getPluginManager().registerEvents(access, plugin);

        int ticks = plugin.config().testServerScoreboardTicks();
        scoreboardTask = plugin.ticks().every(ticks, this::refreshAll);
        crystalSweep = plugin.ticks().every(200L, this::clearCrystals);

        // The mobs are swept where they stand. On Paper that is the one thread
        // that owns the world; on Folia it is the arena's own region, and the
        // sweep is bounded to the ring around spawn that a region may legally
        // read. Spawning is cancelled outright anyway - this is for whatever
        // was already standing there.
        Location at = sweepCenter;
        plugin.platform().onRegion(at, () -> purge(at));
        mobSweep = plugin.platform().regionRepeating(at, 20L, 20L, () -> purge(at));
    }

    @Override
    public void disable() {
        if (crystalSweep != null) {
            crystalSweep.cancel();
            crystalSweep = null;
        }
        arenaCrystals.clear();
        for (Entity line : welcomeGuide) {
            plugin.platform().onEntity(line, line::remove);
        }
        welcomeGuide.clear();
        if (scoreboardTask != null) {
            scoreboardTask.cancel();
            scoreboardTask = null;
        }
        sidebars.clear();
        unregisterTabStyle.run();
        unregisterTabStyle = () -> {};
        if (mobSweep != null) {
            mobSweep.cancel();
            mobSweep = null;
        }
        org.bukkit.event.HandlerList.unregisterAll(access);
        access.clear();
        clearDummies();
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.MONITOR)
    public void onJoin(PlayerJoinEvent event) {
        if (!plugin.config().testServerEnabled() || world == null) {
            return;
        }
        Player player = event.getPlayer();
        if (access.enabled()) {
            access.join(player);
            applyScoreboard(player);
        } else {
            plugin.ticks().after(20L, () -> resetPlayer(player));
        }
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.MONITOR)
    public void onQuit(PlayerQuitEvent event) {
        access.forget(event.getPlayer());
        sidebars.remove(event.getPlayer().getUniqueId());
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.HIGH)
    public void onDeath(PlayerDeathEvent event) {
        if (!plugin.config().testServerEnabled() || world == null) {
            return;
        }
        event.getDrops().clear();
        event.setDroppedExp(0);
        event.setKeepInventory(true);
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.HIGH)
    public void onRespawn(PlayerRespawnEvent event) {
        if (!plugin.config().testServerEnabled() || world == null) {
            return;
        }
        event.setRespawnLocation(spawnLocation());
        Player player = event.getPlayer();
        plugin.mainThread().run(() -> resetPlayer(player));
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.NORMAL, ignoreCancelled = true)
    public void onCreatureSpawn(CreatureSpawnEvent event) {
        if (!plugin.config().testServerEnabled() || world == null
                || !event.getEntity().getWorld().equals(world)) {
            return;
        }
        if (event.getSpawnReason() != CreatureSpawnEvent.SpawnReason.CUSTOM) {
            event.setCancelled(true);
        }
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.HIGHEST, ignoreCancelled = true)
    public void onCrystalExplode(EntityExplodeEvent event) {
        if (inArena(event.getLocation().getWorld()) && event.getEntity() instanceof EnderCrystal) {
            event.blockList().clear();
            event.setYield(0);
        }
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.HIGHEST, ignoreCancelled = true)
    public void onPlaceBlock(BlockPlaceEvent event) {
        var block = event.getBlockPlaced();
        if (inArena(block.getWorld()) && (citadel == null || block.getType() != Material.OBSIDIAN
                || !citadel.crystalBuildingArea(block.getLocation())
                || !event.getPlayer().hasPermission(BUILD_PERMISSION))) {
            event.setCancelled(true);
        }
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.HIGHEST, ignoreCancelled = true)
    public void onBreakBlock(BlockBreakEvent event) {
        var block = event.getBlock();
        if (inArena(block.getWorld()) && (citadel == null || block.getType() != Material.OBSIDIAN
                || !citadel.crystalBuildingArea(block.getLocation())
                || !event.getPlayer().hasPermission(BUILD_PERMISSION))) {
            event.setCancelled(true);
        }
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.HIGHEST, ignoreCancelled = true)
    public void onCrystalPlace(EntityPlaceEvent event) {
        if (event.getEntity() instanceof EnderCrystal crystal && inArena(crystal.getWorld())) {
            if (citadel == null || !citadel.crystalBuildingArea(crystal.getLocation())
                    || (event.getPlayer() != null && !event.getPlayer().hasPermission(BUILD_PERMISSION))) {
                event.setCancelled(true);
            } else {
                arenaCrystals.put(crystal.getUniqueId(), crystal);
            }
        }
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.MONITOR, ignoreCancelled = true)
    public void onCrystalSpawn(EntitySpawnEvent event) {
        if (event.getEntity() instanceof EnderCrystal crystal && inArena(crystal.getWorld())) {
            arenaCrystals.put(crystal.getUniqueId(), crystal);
        }
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.MONITOR)
    public void onChunkLoad(ChunkLoadEvent event) {
        if (inArena(event.getWorld())) {
            for (Entity entity : event.getChunk().getEntities()) {
                if (entity instanceof EnderCrystal crystal) {
                    arenaCrystals.put(crystal.getUniqueId(), crystal);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private void clearCrystals() {
        if (citadel != null && citadelSpawn != null) {
            citadel.clearPracticeBlocks();
        }
        if (!plugin.platform().folia()) {
            // Includes crystals restored before the plugin registered its listeners.
            for (EnderCrystal crystal : world.getEntitiesByClass(EnderCrystal.class)) {
                crystal.remove();
            }
            arenaCrystals.clear();
            return;
        }
        arenaCrystals.forEach((id, crystal) -> {
            if (arenaCrystals.remove(id, crystal)) {
                plugin.platform().onEntity(crystal, () -> {
                    if (inArena(crystal.getWorld())) {
                        crystal.remove();
                    }
                });
            }
        });
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.HIGHEST, ignoreCancelled = true)
    public void onCrystalDamage(EntityDamageByEntityEvent event) {
        if (event.getDamager() instanceof EnderCrystal && event.getEntity() instanceof Player player
                && inArena(player.getWorld())) {
            event.setDamage(Math.min(event.getDamage(), MAX_CRYSTAL_DAMAGE));
        }
    }

    private boolean inArena(World candidate) {
        return plugin.config().testServerEnabled() && world != null && world.equals(candidate);
    }

    private void createWelcomeGuide(Location spawn) {
        Location center = spawn.clone().add(0, 1.65D, -3.0D);
        List<String> text = List.of(
                "<gradient:#d6a85d:#f6dc9e><bold>OCULUSAI  /  CITADEL</bold></gradient>",
                "<accent>/ai npc <white>— спарринг с ботом",
                "<accent>/ai npc still <white>— неподвижная мишень",
                "<accent>/ai npc clear <white>— убрать своих ботов"
        );
        plugin.platform().onRegion(center, () -> {
            welcomeGuide.addAll(ArenaGuide.spawn(center, text.stream()
                    .map(line -> Msg.parse(plugin.theme().resolveAccent(line))).toList()));
            plugin.getLogger().info("Citadel welcome guide ready");
        });
    }

    private static final int REGEN_AMPLIFIER = 254;

    void enterArena(Player player) {
        resetPlayer(player);
    }

    private void resetPlayer(Player player) {
        // Asynchronous teleport on both servers: the arena is another world
        // than the one a player joins into, and on Folia a plain teleport
        // between them is refused outright.
        arenaBuild.thenRun(() -> plugin.platform().onEntity(player, () -> {
            if (!player.isOnline()) {
                return;
            }
            plugin.platform().teleport(player, spawnLocation(), () -> {
                if (access.enabled()) access.enter(player);
                kitOut(player);
                if (citadelSpawn != null) {
                    player.sendMessage(plugin.config().prefix() + Msg.parse(plugin.theme().resolveAccent(
                            "<accent>/ai npc <white>— спарринг · <accent>/ai npc still <white>— мишень")));
                }
            });
        }));
    }

    private void kitOut(Player player) {
        player.setGameMode(GameMode.SURVIVAL);
        player.setHealth(player.getMaxHealth());
        player.setFoodLevel(20);
        player.setSaturation(20.0F);
        player.setFireTicks(0);
        player.getInventory().clear();
        giveKit(player.getInventory());
        applyEternalRegen(player);
        applyScoreboard(player);
    }

    private void applyEternalRegen(Player player) {
        player.addPotionEffect(new PotionEffect(PotionEffectType.REGENERATION,
                Integer.MAX_VALUE, REGEN_AMPLIFIER, true, false, false));
    }

    private Location spawnLocation() {
        Location arena = citadelSpawn;
        if (arena != null) {
            return arena.clone();
        }
        return world.getSpawnLocation().clone().add(0.5D, 0.0D, 0.5D);
    }

    private World flatWorld() {
        String name = plugin.config().testServerWorld();
        World existing = Bukkit.getWorld(name);
        if (existing != null) {
            existing.setSpawnFlags(false, false);
            return existing;
        }
        if (plugin.platform().folia()) {
            // Folia refuses to make a world after startup: every region thread
            // would have to be told about it mid-tick. And it loads only
            // level-name plus that world's nether and end, so there is no
            // "put the folder there and it appears" either - the arena has to
            // *be* the server's world. The caller says so and leaves it off.
            return null;
        }

        World created = new WorldCreator(name)
                .type(WorldType.FLAT)
                .environment(World.Environment.NORMAL)
                .generateStructures(false)
                .createWorld();
        if (created != null) {
            created.setStorm(false);
            created.setThundering(false);
            created.setTime(6000L);
            created.setSpawnFlags(false, false);
        }
        return created;
    }

    /** Clears mobs out of the arena. Runs on the thread that owns
     *  {@code around}, and reads no further than it may from there. */
    private void purge(Location around) {
        if (world == null || around == null) {
            return;
        }
        if (!plugin.platform().folia()) {
            for (LivingEntity entity : world.getLivingEntities()) {
                if (!(entity instanceof Player) && !welcomeGuide.contains(entity)) {
                    entity.remove();
                }
            }
            return;
        }
        // One region's worth around spawn. Asking the world for every living
        // entity is a read across every region there is, which is exactly what
        // Folia refuses - and an arena is one small flat place anyway.
        for (org.bukkit.entity.Entity entity
                : world.getNearbyEntities(around, PURGE_RADIUS, PURGE_RADIUS, PURGE_RADIUS)) {
            if (entity instanceof LivingEntity && !(entity instanceof Player) && !welcomeGuide.contains(entity)) {
                entity.remove();
            }
        }
    }

    private void giveKit(PlayerInventory inventory) {
        inventory.setHelmet(enchant(new ItemStack(Material.NETHERITE_HELMET)));
        inventory.setChestplate(enchant(new ItemStack(Material.NETHERITE_CHESTPLATE)));
        inventory.setLeggings(enchant(new ItemStack(Material.NETHERITE_LEGGINGS)));
        inventory.setBoots(enchant(new ItemStack(Material.NETHERITE_BOOTS)));

        ItemStack sword = new ItemStack(Material.NETHERITE_SWORD);
        ItemMeta swordMeta = sword.getItemMeta();
        swordMeta.addEnchant(enchantment("sharpness"), 5, true);
        swordMeta.addEnchant(enchantment("unbreaking"), 3, true);
        sword.setItemMeta(swordMeta);

        ItemStack bow = new ItemStack(Material.BOW);
        ItemMeta bowMeta = bow.getItemMeta();
        bowMeta.addEnchant(enchantment("power"), 5, true);
        bowMeta.addEnchant(enchantment("infinity"), 1, true);
        bowMeta.addEnchant(enchantment("unbreaking"), 3, true);
        bow.setItemMeta(bowMeta);

        inventory.addItem(
                sword,
                bow,
                new ItemStack(Material.ARROW, 64),
                new ItemStack(Material.OBSIDIAN, 64),
                new ItemStack(Material.END_CRYSTAL, 64),
                new ItemStack(Material.ENDER_PEARL, 16),
                new ItemStack(Material.GOLDEN_APPLE, 8),
                new ItemStack(Material.GOLDEN_CARROT, 64));
    }

    private ItemStack enchant(ItemStack armor) {
        ItemMeta meta = armor.getItemMeta();
        meta.addEnchant(enchantment("protection"), 4, true);
        meta.addEnchant(enchantment("unbreaking"), 3, true);
        meta.setUnbreakable(true);
        armor.setItemMeta(meta);
        return armor;
    }

    private Enchantment enchantment(String key) {
        return Enchantment.getByKey(NamespacedKey.minecraft(key));
    }


    public int spawnDummies(Player player, int count) {
        return spawnDummies(player, count, NpcOptions.DEFAULT);
    }

    public int spawnDummies(Player player, int count, NpcOptions options) {
        return plugin.npcs().spawn(player, count, options);
    }

    public void clearDummies() {
        plugin.npcs().clearAll();
    }

    public void removeDummy(UUID id) {
        plugin.npcs().remove(id);
    }

    public int dummyCount() {
        return plugin.npcs().count();
    }

    public boolean isDummy(UUID id) {
        return plugin.npcs().isNpc(id);
    }

    public NpcOptions optionsOf(UUID id) {
        return plugin.npcs().optionsOf(id);
    }

    public void updateOptions(UUID id, NpcOptions options) {
        plugin.npcs().updateOptions(id, options);
    }

    private void refreshAll() {
        for (Player player : plugin.getServer().getOnlinePlayers()) {
            // Each player's effects and scoreboard are that player's own, so
            // each goes to the thread that owns them. On Paper that is this
            // thread and the work runs inline, exactly as before.
            plugin.platform().onEntity(player, () -> {
                access.refresh(player);
                if (access.enabled() && access.profile(player.getUniqueId()) == null) {
                    applyScoreboard(player);
                    return;
                }
                if (!inArena(player.getWorld())) {
                    return;
                }
                refill(player.getInventory(), Material.OBSIDIAN);
                refill(player.getInventory(), Material.END_CRYSTAL);
                if (!player.hasPotionEffect(PotionEffectType.REGENERATION)) {
                    applyEternalRegen(player);
                }
                applyScoreboard(player);
            });
        }
    }

    private static void refill(PlayerInventory inventory, Material material) {
        int count = 0;
        for (ItemStack item : inventory.getStorageContents()) {
            if (item != null && item.getType() == material) {
                count += item.getAmount();
            }
        }
        ItemStack offHand = inventory.getItemInOffHand();
        if (offHand.getType() == material) {
            count += offHand.getAmount();
        }
        if (count < material.getMaxStackSize()) {
            inventory.addItem(new ItemStack(material, material.getMaxStackSize() - count));
        }
    }

    /** The arena's sidebar.
     *
     *  <p>Not on Folia: the whole scoreboard API is unsupported there, and
     *  {@code getScoreboardManager().getNewScoreboard()} throws rather than
     *  degrading - which it did, on every player, every five seconds, from
     *  inside the per-player refresh. Nothing is drawn instead: the action bar
     *  is where {@code /oai monitor} and the hologram readout already live,
     *  and the arena's sidebar is a convenience, not a finding. Said once in
     *  the log so an operator who misses it knows why. */
    private void applyScoreboard(Player player) {
        ArenaAccess.Profile profile = access.profile(player.getUniqueId());
        boolean pending = access.enabled() && profile == null;
        String title = plugin.resourcePack().logo(player) + plugin.theme().title("");
        String model = modelLabel(profile);
        if (plugin.platform().folia()) {
            if (scoreboardWarned.compareAndSet(false, true)) {
                plugin.getLogger().info("Folia has no scoreboards, so the test arena runs"
                        + " without its sidebar. Everything else in the arena works;"
                        + " /oai prob and /oai monitor say the same things.");
            }
            return;
        }
        boolean recording = plugin.datasets().collecting();
        // Логотип слева от заголовка - только тем, у кого загружен пак с ним:
        // у остальных на его месте был бы пустой квадрат.
        // Доска одна на игрока и не подменяется: новая доска на каждое
        // обновление - это сайдбар, который на миг пропадает, то есть мерцает.
        Sidebar sidebar = sidebars.computeIfAbsent(player.getUniqueId(), ignored -> new Sidebar(title));
        sidebar.title(title);
        sidebar.lines(pending ? List.of(
                " ",
                section("Вход на сервер"),
                sidebarValue("Сайт", "oculusai.space"),
                Msg.parse("<gray>  Открой ссылку в чате"),
                Msg.parse("<gray>  и введи код из Minecraft")) : arenaLines(player, profile, model, recording));
        sidebar.show(player);
    }

    private String modelLabel(ArenaAccess.Profile profile) {
        if (profile != null && !profile.devModel().isEmpty()) {
            return "Dev";
        }
        return "fast".equalsIgnoreCase(plugin.api().serviceModel()) ? "Fast" : "Pro";
    }

    private List<String> profileLines(ArenaAccess.Profile profile) {
        return List.of(section("Profile"), Msg.parse("<white>  ") + profile.email(),
                sidebarValue("Role", profile.role()));
    }

    private String section(String title) {
        return plugin.theme().accent("┃ ") + Msg.parse("<white><bold>" + title + "</bold>");
    }

    private String sidebarValue(String label, String value) {
        return Msg.parse("<gray>  " + label + " <dark_gray>» ") + plugin.theme().accent(value);
    }

    private List<String> arenaLines(Player player, ArenaAccess.Profile profile, String model, boolean recording) {
        List<String> lines = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        lines.add(" ");
        lines.add(section("Oculus"));
        lines.add(sidebarValue("AI model", model));
        lines.add(sidebarValue("PL ver", plugin.getDescription().getVersion()));
        if (profile != null) {
            lines.add(" ");
            lines.addAll(profileLines(profile));
        }
        if (recording) {
            lines.addAll(recordingLines(player));
        }
        lines.add(plugin.theme().accentSoft("  oculusai.space"));
        return lines;
    }

    public String arenaSession(UUID player) {
        ArenaAccess.Profile profile = access.profile(player);
        return profile == null ? "" : profile.session();
    }

    public String devModel(UUID player) {
        ArenaAccess.Profile profile = access.profile(player);
        return profile == null ? "" : profile.devModel();
    }

    public boolean devWantsTicks(UUID player) {
        ArenaAccess.Profile profile = access.profile(player);
        return profile != null && profile.devWantsTicks();
    }

    private java.util.List<String> recordingLines(Player viewer) {
        DatasetStore datasets = plugin.datasets();
        long elapsedSeconds = Math.max(0L,
                (System.currentTimeMillis() - datasets.collectingSinceMs()) / 1000L);

        DatasetStore.RosterEntry own = datasets.entry(viewer.getUniqueId());
        PlayerData ownData = own == null ? null : plugin.data().get(viewer.getUniqueId());
        return List.of(
                " ",
                section("Recording"),
                sidebarValue("Time", formatDuration(elapsedSeconds)),
                sidebarValue("Players", Integer.toString(datasets.roster().size())),
                sidebarValue("You", own == null ? "Not enrolled"
                        : Long.toString(ownData == null ? 0 : ownData.recordedCount())),
                sidebarValue("Windows", Long.toString(datasets.totalRecorded())));
    }

    private static String formatDuration(long totalSeconds) {
        long minutes = totalSeconds / 60L;
        long seconds = totalSeconds % 60L;
        return (minutes < 10 ? "0" : "") + minutes + ":" + (seconds < 10 ? "0" : "") + seconds;
    }

}
```

`src/main/java/me/everyone/oculusai/player/Bypass.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.player;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;
import me.everyone.oculusai.core.Service;
import org.bukkit.configuration.file.YamlConfiguration;
import org.bukkit.entity.Player;

/** Players the anticheat must not analyse, managed by /oai bypass.
 *
 * <p>The existing {@code oculusai.bypass} permission is a permanent grant and
 * cannot be removed without a permissions plugin. This service stores the
 * runtime exemption separately, so an admin can toggle one player without
 * touching the group permissions. UUIDs are stored because a later name change
 * must not make the exemption point at somebody else - or disappear. */
public final class Bypass implements Service {

    private static final String PERMISSION = "oculusai.bypass";

    /** What a toggle did, and whether it reached disk. */
    public record Toggle(boolean enabled, boolean saved) {
    }

    private final OculusAI plugin;
    private final Set<UUID> bypassed = ConcurrentHashMap.newKeySet();

    public Bypass(OculusAI plugin) {
        this.plugin = plugin;
    }

    @Override
    public void enable() {
        reload();
    }

    @Override
    public void disable() {
        bypassed.clear();
    }

    @Override
    public void reload() {
        bypassed.clear();
        File file = file();
        if (!file.isFile()) {
            return;
        }

        YamlConfiguration config = YamlConfiguration.loadConfiguration(file);
        for (String value : config.getStringList("players")) {
            try {
                bypassed.add(UUID.fromString(value));
            } catch (IllegalArgumentException malformed) {
                plugin.getLogger().warning("Ignoring a malformed UUID in bypass.yml: " + value);
            }
        }
    }

    /** True when either the permanent permission or the command-managed list
     *  exempts this player. Detection and checks use only this method. */
    public boolean isBypassed(Player player) {
        return player != null
                && (player.hasPermission(PERMISSION) || bypassed.contains(player.getUniqueId()));
    }

    /** True only for the command-managed exemption, so /oai diag can tell the
     *  two reasons apart. */
    public boolean managed(UUID uuid) {
        return uuid != null && bypassed.contains(uuid);
    }

    /** Adds or removes the exemption and saves the new list before returning.
     *  The in-memory state is applied even when saving fails, because the
     *  admin asked for the player to be exempt now; the result says so and the
     *  command can warn that the change will not survive a restart. */
    public Toggle toggle(UUID uuid) {
        boolean enabled = !bypassed.contains(uuid);
        Set<UUID> updated = new HashSet<>(bypassed);
        if (enabled) {
            updated.add(uuid);
        } else {
            updated.remove(uuid);
        }

        boolean saved = save(updated);
        bypassed.clear();
        bypassed.addAll(updated);
        clearState(uuid);
        return new Toggle(enabled, saved);
    }

    /** Drops evidence gathered before the switch. Without this, a player who
     *  was already near the alert line could be alerted immediately after the
     *  admin turns their anticheat back on. */
    private void clearState(UUID uuid) {
        PlayerData data = plugin.data().get(uuid);
        if (data != null) {
            // Same clean slate as a death: no stale probability, buffer or
            // attack history can leak across the switch.
            data.resetAfterDeath();
        }
        plugin.alerts().forget(uuid);
        plugin.punishments().forget(uuid);
    }

    private boolean save(Set<UUID> values) {
        List<String> ids = new ArrayList<>(values.size());
        for (UUID uuid : values) {
            ids.add(uuid.toString());
        }
        Collections.sort(ids);

        StringBuilder content = new StringBuilder();
        content.append("# Players exempted from analysis by /oai bypass.\n");
        content.append("# UUIDs are used so a name change does not lose the exemption.\n");
        if (ids.isEmpty()) {
            content.append("players: []\n");
        } else {
            content.append("players:\n");
            for (String id : ids) {
                content.append("- ").append(id).append('\n');
            }
        }

        try {
            Files.writeString(file().toPath(), content.toString(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            return true;
        } catch (IOException exception) {
            plugin.getLogger().log(Level.WARNING, "Could not save bypass.yml", exception);
            return false;
        }
    }

    private File file() {
        return new File(plugin.getDataFolder(), "bypass.yml");
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/me/everyone/oculusai/player/EntityTracker.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.player;


import me.everyone.oculusai.core.Platform;
import me.everyone.oculusai.core.Service;
import me.everyone.oculusai.core.TickLoop;
import java.util.ArrayDeque;
import java.util.Deque;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;
import org.bukkit.Location;
import org.bukkit.World;
import org.bukkit.entity.Player;

public final class EntityTracker implements Service {

    /** ``playerLike`` separates what may be analysed from what may not. Aim
     *  against a mob is not the same measurement as aim against a player: a
     *  zombie walks a straight line at a fixed speed and never strafes, so a
     *  perfectly ordinary player farming one produces the flat, precise
     *  rotation that the model was taught to read as a cheat. Dummies count as
     *  player-like - they are player-shaped NPCs and exist to be recorded
     *  against. */
    public record Tracked(double x, double y, double z, double width, double height,
                          boolean playerLike, UUID worldId, long at) {

        public double centreY() {
            return y + height / 2.0D;
        }
    }

    /** One second covers a client that is a few movement packets behind the
     *  server. WallCheck keeps its own shorter window; HitBox needs the wider
     *  one because an attack packet carries no target position of its own. */
    /** Глаза относительно высоты. Хитбокс игрока 1.8, глаза на 1.62 - для
     *  сника и для player-shaped NPC другой высоты доля честнее константы. */
    private static final double EYE_RATIO = 1.62D / 1.8D;

    private static final long HISTORY_MS = 1000L;
    private static final int HISTORY_LIMIT = 20;

    private final OculusAI plugin;
    private final Map<Integer, Tracked> tracked = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private final Map<Integer, Deque<Tracked>> history = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    /** Entity id to the online player, refreshed once per tick. WallCheck used
     *  to scan every online player on every hit to find this mapping. */
    private final Map<Integer, Player> players = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private TickLoop.Handle task;
    /** Folia only: one sampling task per player, on the thread owning them. */
    private final Map<UUID, Platform.Cancellable> followers = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

    public EntityTracker(OculusAI plugin) {
        this.plugin = plugin;
    }

    @Override
    public void enable() {
        // One sweep of every online player is a cross-region read, which Folia
        // forbids: there is no thread on which every player is legal. The same
        // work is therefore split up and each player sampled on the thread
        // that owns them. On Paper the single sweep stays, because one task
        // doing the rounds is cheaper than one task per player.
        if (plugin.platform().folia()) {
            for (Player player : plugin.getServer().getOnlinePlayers()) {
                follow(player);
            }
            return;
        }
        task = plugin.ticks().every(1L, this::sample);
    }

    /** Starts sampling one player on their own thread. Does nothing off
     *  Folia, where the single sweep already covers them. */
    public void follow(Player player) {
        if (!plugin.platform().folia() || player == null) {
            return;
        }
        Platform.Cancellable existing = followers.remove(player.getUniqueId());
        if (existing != null) {
            existing.cancel();
        }
        followers.put(player.getUniqueId(),
                plugin.platform().entityRepeating(player, 1L, 1L, () -> sample(player)));
    }

    /** Stops sampling one player. */
    public void unfollow(Player player) {
        if (player == null) {
            return;
        }
        Platform.Cancellable follower = followers.remove(player.getUniqueId());
        if (follower != null) {
            follower.cancel();
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void disable() {
        if (task != null) {
            task.cancel();
            task = null;
        }
        for (Platform.Cancellable follower : followers.values()) {
            follower.cancel();
        }
        followers.clear();
        tracked.clear();
        history.clear();
        players.clear();
    }

    private void sample() {
        // Players and dummies only. Mobs used to be sampled here as well, up
        // to a budget per tick, so that a swing at one could be scored - but a
        // swing at one is no longer analysed at all, so their positions were
        // being written twenty times a second and never read.
        for (Player player : plugin.getServer().getOnlinePlayers()) {
            sample(player);
        }
    }

    /** Records where one player is. Must run on the thread owning them. */
    private void sample(Player player) {
        Location location = player.getLocation();
        World world = location.getWorld();
        if (world == null) {
            return;
        }
        players.put(player.getEntityId(), player);
        remember(player.getEntityId(), new Tracked(
                location.getX(), location.getY(), location.getZ(),
                player.getWidth(), player.getHeight(), true, world.getUID(),
                System.currentTimeMillis()));
    }

    public void track(int entityId, double x, double y, double z, double width,
                      double height, World world) {
        track(entityId, x, y, z, width, height, true, world);
    }

    public void track(int entityId, double x, double y, double z, double width,
                      double height, boolean playerLike, World world) {
        if (world == null) {
            return;
        }
        remember(entityId, new Tracked(x, y, z, width, height, playerLike,
                world.getUID(), System.currentTimeMillis()));
    }

    private void remember(int entityId, Tracked entry) {
        tracked.put(entityId, entry);
        Deque<Tracked> entries = history.computeIfAbsent(entityId, key -> new ArrayDeque<>());
        synchronized (entries) {
            entries.addLast(entry);
            long cutoff = entry.at() - HISTORY_MS;
            while (entries.size() > 1
                    && (entries.peekFirst().at() < cutoff || entries.size() > HISTORY_LIMIT)) {
                entries.removeFirst();
            }
        }
    }

    /** Whether this entity may be analysed at all. An entity nobody is
     *  tracking answers false: unknown is not the same as a player, and
     *  guessing in favour of analysis is how a mob fight becomes a ban. */
    public boolean playerLike(int entityId) {
        Tracked entry = tracked.get(entityId);
        return entry != null && entry.playerLike();
    }

    public List<Tracked> recent(int entityId) {
        Deque<Tracked> entries = history.get(entityId);
        if (entries == null) {
            return List.of();
        }
        long cutoff = System.currentTimeMillis() - HISTORY_MS;
        synchronized (entries) {
            while (!entries.isEmpty() && entries.peekFirst().at() < cutoff) {
                entries.removeFirst();
            }
            return List.copyOf(entries);
        }
    }

    public void forget(int entityId) {
        tracked.remove(entityId);
        history.remove(entityId);
        players.remove(entityId);
    }

    /** The online player for this entity id, or null for a dummy/unknown. */
    public Player player(int entityId) {
        Player player = players.get(entityId);
        return player != null && player.isOnline() ? player : null;
    }

    public Tracked get(int entityId) {
        return tracked.get(entityId);
    }

    /** Отслеживаемая сущность вместе со своим id. */
    public record Near(int entityId, Tracked entry, double distance) {
    }

    /** Ближайший игроко-подобный к этой точке, в её же мире, кроме самого.
     *
     *  <p>Нужен затем, что до появления этого метода угол до цели считался
     *  только в тике удара: по пакету атаки, у которого цель написана. В
     *  остальных тиках окна цели не было известно вообще, и самый сильный
     *  признак аимбота - как шла ошибка прицела к хитбоксу - существовал
     *  одной точкой из тридцати двух.
     *
     *  <p>Ближайший, а не «тот, кого ударили»: в тике без удара никто не
     *  сказал, по кому велась рука, и ближайший - единственная догадка,
     *  которую можно сделать не заглядывая в будущее окна. На дуэли это тот
     *  же игрок; в свалке это меняется от тика к тику, и канал смены цели
     *  говорит об этом прямо, а не прячет. */
    public Near nearestPlayerLike(Tracked self, int selfId, double maxBlocks) {
        if (self == null) {
            return null;
        }
        double limit = maxBlocks * maxBlocks;
        Near best = null;
        for (Map.Entry<Integer, Tracked> entry : tracked.entrySet()) {
            if (entry.getKey() == selfId) {
                continue;
            }
            Tracked other = entry.getValue();
            if (!other.playerLike() || !other.worldId().equals(self.worldId())) {
                continue;
            }
            double dx = other.x() - self.x();
            double dy = other.centreY() - (self.y() + self.height() * EYE_RATIO);
            double dz = other.z() - self.z();
            double squared = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz;
            if (squared > limit) {
                continue;
            }
            if (best == null || squared < best.distance() * best.distance()) {
                best = new Near(entry.getKey(), other, Math.sqrt(squared));
            }
        }
        return best;
    }

    /** Сколько игроко-подобных рядом, кроме самого.
     *
     *  <p>Отличает «довёл до единственного» от «выбрал из трёх»: ровная
     *  доводка на дуэли и та же ровность, когда вокруг четверо, - это разные
     *  события, и без этого числа они выглядят одинаково. */
    public int countPlayerLike(Tracked self, int selfId, double maxBlocks) {
        if (self == null) {
            return 0;
        }
        double limit = maxBlocks * maxBlocks;
        int count = 0;
        for (Map.Entry<Integer, Tracked> entry : tracked.entrySet()) {
            if (entry.getKey() == selfId) {
                continue;
            }
            Tracked other = entry.getValue();
            if (!other.playerLike() || !other.worldId().equals(self.worldId())) {
                continue;
            }
            double dx = other.x() - self.x();
            double dy = other.centreY() - (self.y() + self.height() * EYE_RATIO);
            double dz = other.z() - self.z();
            if (dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz <= limit) {
                count++;
            }
        }
        return count;
    }

    public void forget(Player player) {
        forget(player.getEntityId());
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/me/everyone/oculusai/player/PlayerData.java`:
