```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.player;

import java.util.ArrayDeque;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.Deque;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;
import me.everyone.oculusai.detection.AttackMoment;
import me.everyone.oculusai.detection.FeatureSchemas;
import me.everyone.oculusai.detection.AimGeometry;
import me.everyone.oculusai.detection.RotationSample;
import me.everyone.oculusai.detection.MedianWindow;
import me.everyone.oculusai.detection.RunningStats;
import me.everyone.oculusai.detection.SuspicionBuffer;
import org.bukkit.entity.Player;

public final class PlayerData {

    private static final int MAX_HISTORY = 40;
    private static final int MAX_ATTACK_HISTORY = 40;
    private static final int MAX_READINGS = 240;
    private static final int MAX_SCALE_HISTORY = 300;
    private static final int MIN_SCALE_HISTORY = 20;

    public record Reading(long capturedAt, double probability, double buffer) {
    }

    private final UUID uuid;
    private final long sessionStartedAt = System.currentTimeMillis();
    private final List<Double> topProbabilities = new ArrayList<>(3);
    private final Deque<Integer> sensitivitySamples = new ArrayDeque<>();
    private volatile String name;
    private volatile Player player;
    private volatile int entityId;

    private volatile float lastYaw;
    private volatile float lastPitch;

    private final Deque<RotationSample> window = new ArrayDeque<>();
    private final Deque<Double> bufferHistory = new ArrayDeque<>();
    private volatile MedianWindow probabilitySmoothing;
    private final Deque<Reading> readings = new ArrayDeque<>();

    private final Deque<Double> scaleHistory = new ArrayDeque<>();
    private final Deque<AttackMoment> attackHistory = new ArrayDeque<>();
    private final RunningStats running;
    private volatile double buffer;
    private volatile double probability;
    /** The model's answer before smoothing or the buffer. /oai math shows this
     *  instead of {@link #probability}, which stays smoothed. */
    private volatile double rawProbability;
    private volatile long lastProbabilityMs;
    private volatile long lastAttackMs;
    // A six-window model has a complete history on its sixth prediction.
    private static final int AIM_WARMUP_WINDOWS = 5;
    private int aimWarmupRemaining = AIM_WARMUP_WINDOWS;
    private volatile UUID aimCombatId;
    private volatile String aimModelId = "";
    private volatile int windowsAnalysed;

    private volatile boolean recording;
    private volatile String recordingLabel;
    private final List<double[]> recorded = new ArrayList<>();
    /** Сырое окно под каждой записанной строкой: тики, из которых посчитаны
     *  колонки, сплющенные подряд. Пустой список - запись без тиков, так
     *  ведёт себя всё, что писалось до их появления. */
    private final List<double[]> recordedTicks = new ArrayList<>();
    /** Кристалльная история: те же тики плюс постановки и удары кристаллов. */
    private final me.everyone.oculusai.detection.crystal.CrystalTimeline crystal =
            new me.everyone.oculusai.detection.crystal.CrystalTimeline();
    private final List<String> recordedNames = new ArrayList<>();

    private volatile boolean attackedThisTick;
    private volatile double aimErrorThisTick = Double.NaN;
    private volatile AttackMoment momentThisTick;
    /** The server just told this client where it is: the next movement packet
     *  applies the teleport, and its rotation delta is the server's, not the
     *  player's. */
    private volatile boolean teleportPending;
    /** Ticks since the last attack, saturating at 255, 255 before any attack.
     *  A raw tick channel for the trajectory models: how the hits were spaced
     *  is a signal a window summary cannot carry. */
    private volatile int ticksSinceAttack = 255;
    /** Махнул рукой, никого не ударив. Килоаура обычно машет только по цели,
     *  человек промахивается и бьёт по воздуху. */
    private volatile boolean swungEmptyThisTick;
    /** Настоящие часы предыдущего тика: между пакетами движения не ровно 50
     *  мс, и ровность этого интервала сама по себе признак. */
    private volatile long lastSampleAtMs;
    private volatile long airborneSinceMs;
    private volatile long sprintDroppedAtMs;
    private volatile boolean sprinting;

    public PlayerData(Player player) {
        this(player, 0, 1);
    }

    public PlayerData(Player player, int runningHorizon) {
        this(player, runningHorizon, 1);
    }

    public PlayerData(Player player, int runningHorizon, int smoothWindows) {
        this.uuid = player.getUniqueId();
        this.running = new RunningStats(FeatureSchemas.AIM, runningHorizon);
        this.probabilitySmoothing = new MedianWindow(smoothWindows);
        bind(player);
    }

    public void bind(Player player) {
        this.name = player.getName();
        this.player = player;
        this.entityId = player.getEntityId();
        this.lastYaw = player.getLocation().getYaw();
        this.lastPitch = player.getLocation().getPitch();
    }

    public int entityId() {
        return entityId;
    }

    /** Applies a smoothness change to an already online player. */
    public void smoothWindows(int smoothWindows) {
        int size = Math.max(1, smoothWindows);
        if (probabilitySmoothing.size() != size) {
            probabilitySmoothing = new MedianWindow(size);
        }
    }

    public float lastYaw() {
        return lastYaw;
    }

    public float lastPitch() {
        return lastPitch;
    }

    /** Called when the server sends a position or rotation that the client
     *  must accept: a teleport, a respawn, a plugin moving the player.
     *
     *  <p>The next rotation packet the client sends applies the server's
     *  position, so the delta measured across it is the teleport's, not the
     *  player's. Leaving it in the window would teach the models that an
     *  ender pearl throws a 180-degree flick, and every window that crossed
     *  a teleport would read as one. The shard-2 contract handles exactly
     *  this: delta zero on the teleport tick, acceleration zero on it and
     *  the tick after. */
    public void noteTeleport() {
        teleportPending = true;
    }

    public void noteTeleportIfMoved(float yaw, float pitch) {
        if (Math.abs(yaw - lastYaw) > 0.001F || Math.abs(pitch - lastPitch) > 0.001F) {
            teleportPending = true;
        }
    }

    /** Marks the next sample as teleport-affected and clears the pending flag. */
    private boolean consumeTeleport() {
        if (!teleportPending) {
            return false;
        }
        teleportPending = false;
        return true;
    }

    public void addSample(float yaw, float pitch, int windowSize) {
        addSample(yaw, pitch, windowSize, AimGeometry.TickAim.NONE, true, false);
    }

    /** Один тик в окно, вместе со всем, что в нём было видно.
     *
     *  <p>Телепорт и счётчик тиков с прошлого удара проставляются здесь, и до
     *  этого не проставлялись нигде: {@code consumeTeleport} не вызывался, а
     *  {@code ticksSinceAttack} не увеличивался, так что оба канала уходили в
     *  запись константами - ноль и 255. Модель от такого канала не падает,
     *  она просто учится без него, и заметить это по метрикам нельзя. */
    public void addSample(float yaw, float pitch, int windowSize,
                          AimGeometry.TickAim aim, boolean onGround, boolean sprintingNow) {
        lastYaw = yaw;
        lastPitch = pitch;

        boolean attacked = attackedThisTick;
        // Ноль в тике удара, иначе на единицу больше прошлого, с упором в
        // 255 - тот же контракт, что читает сервис.
        ticksSinceAttack = attacked ? 0
                : (ticksSinceAttack >= 255 ? 255 : ticksSinceAttack + 1);

        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        long since = lastSampleAtMs == 0L ? 50L : now - lastSampleAtMs;
        lastSampleAtMs = now;

        boolean swung = swungEmptyThisTick;
        swungEmptyThisTick = false;

        RotationSample sample = new RotationSample(yaw, pitch, attacked,
                aimErrorThisTick, consumeTeleport(), ticksSinceAttack, momentThisTick,
                aim.centreAngle(), aim.edgeAngle(), aim.distance(),
                aim.targetId(), aim.targetsNear(),
                swung, onGround, sprintingNow, aim.speed(), since);
        attackedThisTick = false;
        aimErrorThisTick = Double.NaN;
        momentThisTick = null;
        crystal.onTick(sample);

        synchronized (window) {
            window.addLast(sample);
            while (window.size() > windowSize) {
                window.pollFirst();
            }
        }
    }

    public int windowSize() {
        synchronized (window) {
            return window.size();
        }
    }

    public long msSinceAttack() {
        return lastAttackMs == 0L ? -1L : System.currentTimeMillis() - lastAttackMs;
    }

    public List<RotationSample> snapshotWindow(int windowSize) {
        synchronized (window) {
            if (window.size() < windowSize) {
                return null;
            }
            return List.copyOf(window);
        }
    }

    public void clearWindow() {
        synchronized (window) {
            window.clear();
        }
        crystal.reset();
    }

    public me.everyone.oculusai.detection.crystal.CrystalTimeline crystal() {
        return crystal;
    }

    public void noteSprint(boolean nowSprinting) {
        if (sprinting && !nowSprinting) {
            sprintDroppedAtMs = System.currentTimeMillis();
        }
        sprinting = nowSprinting;
    }

    public int sprintDroppedTicks() {
        if (sprintDroppedAtMs == 0L) {
            return -1;
        }
        long elapsed = System.currentTimeMillis() - sprintDroppedAtMs;
        return elapsed > 1000L ? -1 : (int) (elapsed / 50L);
    }

    public void noteGround(boolean onGround) {
        if (onGround) {
            airborneSinceMs = 0L;
        } else if (airborneSinceMs == 0L) {
            airborneSinceMs = System.currentTimeMillis();
        }
    }

    public int airTicks() {
        if (airborneSinceMs == 0L) {
            return 0;
        }
        long elapsed = System.currentTimeMillis() - airborneSinceMs;
        return (int) Math.min(1200L, Math.max(0L, elapsed / 50L));
    }

    /** Пустой свинг: пакет анимации руки, за которым не пришла атака.
     *
     *  <p>Ставится флагом, а не пишется сразу: тик закрывается следующим
     *  пакетом движения, и до него неизвестно, прилетит ли за этим свингом
     *  удар. Сбрасывается тем же тиком, что его прочитал. */
    public void noteEmptySwing() {
        if (!attackedThisTick) {
            swungEmptyThisTick = true;
        }
    }

    public void markAttack(double aimError) {
        markAttack(aimError, 0.0F, true, false, false);
    }

    public void markAttack(double aimError, float fallDistance, boolean onGround,
                           boolean sprinting, boolean critBlocked) {
        attackedThisTick = true;
        aimErrorThisTick = aimError;
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        long interval = lastAttackMs == 0L ? -1L : Math.max(0L, now - lastAttackMs);
        AttackMoment moment = new AttackMoment(aimError, fallDistance, airTicks(),
                onGround, sprinting, critBlocked, interval, sprintDroppedTicks());
        momentThisTick = moment;
        lastAttackMs = now;
        synchronized (attackHistory) {
            attackHistory.addLast(moment);
            while (attackHistory.size() > MAX_ATTACK_HISTORY) {
                attackHistory.pollFirst();
            }
        }
    }

    public RunningStats running() {
        return running;
    }

    public List<AttackMoment> attackHistory() {
        synchronized (attackHistory) {
            return List.copyOf(attackHistory);
        }
    }

    public boolean inCombat(long combatMs) {
        return System.currentTimeMillis() - lastAttackMs <= combatMs;
    }

    /** Whether windows are actually arriving for this player right now.
     *
     * <p>False covers every reason a reading can stop, and they are all worth
     * showing rather than hiding behind a stale number: the player is out of
     * combat, is not swinging, their rotation is below the gate, their world is
     * excluded, they hold the bypass permission, or the service is not
     * answering. A probability left on screen from twenty seconds ago looks
     * exactly like a live one and is the thing most likely to mislead whoever
     * is watching.
     *
     * <p>A window arrives about every half second while a fight is going, so a
     * few seconds of silence is already a stop rather than a gap. */
    public boolean analysing(long staleMs) {
        return windowsAnalysed > 0
                && System.currentTimeMillis() - lastProbabilityMs <= staleMs;
    }

    /** True when the last reading is old enough that the buffer behind it is
     *  no longer evidence about what the player is doing now. */
    public boolean idle(long staleMs) {
        return lastProbabilityMs > 0L
                && System.currentTimeMillis() - lastProbabilityMs > staleMs;
    }

    /** The reading the buffer should integrate: see {@link MedianWindow}. */
    public double smooth(double value) {
        return probabilitySmoothing.add(value);
    }

    public void applyProbability(double value, double suspicion, double gain, double decay,
                                 double leak, double max, double maxStep) {
        buffer = SuspicionBuffer.add(buffer, value, suspicion, gain, decay, leak, max, maxStep);

        synchronized (bufferHistory) {
            bufferHistory.addLast(buffer);
            while (bufferHistory.size() > MAX_HISTORY) {
                bufferHistory.pollFirst();
            }
        }
        observeAimProbability(value);
    }

    public void observeAimProbability(double value) {
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        probability = value;
        lastProbabilityMs = now;
        windowsAnalysed++;
        synchronized (readings) {
            readings.addLast(new Reading(now, value, buffer));
            while (readings.size() > MAX_READINGS) {
                readings.pollFirst();
            }
        }
    }

    public void recordScale(double scale) {
        if (scale <= 0.0D) {
            return;
        }
        synchronized (scaleHistory) {
            scaleHistory.addLast(scale);
            while (scaleHistory.size() > MAX_SCALE_HISTORY) {
                scaleHistory.pollFirst();
            }
        }
    }

    public double baselineScale() {
        List<Double> sorted;
        synchronized (scaleHistory) {
            if (scaleHistory.size() < MIN_SCALE_HISTORY) {
                return 0.0D;
            }
            sorted = new ArrayList<>(scaleHistory);
        }
        Collections.sort(sorted);
        int middle = sorted.size() / 2;
        return sorted.size() % 2 == 1
                ? sorted.get(middle)
                : (sorted.get(middle - 1) + sorted.get(middle)) / 2.0D;
    }

    public List<Double> bufferHistory() {
        synchronized (bufferHistory) {
            return List.copyOf(bufferHistory);
        }
    }

    public List<Reading> readings() {
        synchronized (readings) {
            return List.copyOf(readings);
        }
    }

    /** The newest reading without copying the whole window. History uses this
     *  on every prediction; copying two hundred readings to read one was pure
     *  allocation on the server thread. */
    public Reading latestReading() {
        synchronized (readings) {
            return readings.peekLast();
        }
    }

    public void recording(boolean value, String label) {
        recording = value;
        recordingLabel = value ? label : null;
        if (!value) {
            return;
        }
        synchronized (recorded) {
            recorded.clear();
            recordedTicks.clear();
            recordedContext.clear();
            recordedNames.clear();
        }
    }

    public boolean recording() {
        return recording;
    }

    public String recordingLabel() {
        return recordingLabel;
    }

    private final List<double[]> recordedContext = new ArrayList<>();
    /** Bumped every time the capture is thrown away or committed.
     *
     *  <p>A window is written down the moment it is measured, and the model's
     *  answer for it arrives a round trip later. The answer is filled in by
     *  index, and between those two moments the capture may have been
     *  committed and cleared - so the index alone is not enough to say which
     *  row it belongs to. A score carrying the wrong epoch is dropped rather
     *  than written into whatever row now sits at that index. */
    private volatile int recordedEpoch;

    /** Writes one measured window down.
     *
     *  @return the row's index, for {@link #scoreRecorded} to fill in once the
     *          model has answered for it */
    public int record(List<String> names, double[] values) {
        return record(names, values, null, Double.NaN, Double.NaN);
    }

    public int record(List<String> names, double[] values, double[] ticks) {
        return record(names, values, ticks, Double.NaN, Double.NaN);
    }

    public int record(List<String> names, double[] values, double[] ticks,
                      double probability, double buffer) {
        synchronized (recorded) {
            if (recordedNames.isEmpty()) {
                recordedNames.addAll(names);
            }
            recorded.add(values);
            recordedTicks.add(ticks == null ? new double[0] : ticks);
            recordedContext.add(new double[]{probability, buffer});
            return recorded.size() - 1;
        }
    }

    /** Сырые окна записи, по одному на строку. */
    public List<double[]> recordedTicks() {
        synchronized (recorded) {
            return new ArrayList<>(recordedTicks);
        }
    }

    /** The epoch a row index is only valid within. */
    public int recordedEpoch() {
        return recordedEpoch;
    }

    /** Attaches the model's answer to a window that was already written down.
     *
     *  <p>What the dataset carries in its score and buffer columns: what the
     *  model said about this exact window at the time it was captured. The
     *  columns have been in the upload format from the start and have been
     *  going out empty, because analysis used to stop while recording.
     *
     *  <p>Silently does nothing for a stale epoch or an index that is no
     *  longer there. Both mean the capture was committed or dropped while the
     *  answer was in flight, which is ordinary, not an error. */
    public void scoreRecorded(int epoch, int index, double probability, double buffer) {
        if (index < 0) {
            return;
        }
        synchronized (recorded) {
            if (epoch != recordedEpoch || index >= recordedContext.size()) {
                return;
            }
            recordedContext.set(index, new double[]{probability, buffer});
        }
    }

    public List<double[]> recordedContext() {
        synchronized (recorded) {
            return List.copyOf(recordedContext);
        }
    }

    public List<double[]> recordedSamples() {
        synchronized (recorded) {
            return List.copyOf(recorded);
        }
    }

    public List<String> recordedFeatureNames() {
        synchronized (recorded) {
            return List.copyOf(recordedNames);
        }
    }

    public int recordedCount() {
        synchronized (recorded) {
            return recorded.size();
        }
    }

    public void clearRecorded() {
        synchronized (recorded) {
            recorded.clear();
            recordedTicks.clear();
            recordedContext.clear();
            recordedNames.clear();
            // Any score still in flight belongs to rows that no longer exist.
            recordedEpoch++;
        }
    }

    public UUID uuid() {
        return uuid;
    }

    public String name() {
        return name;
    }

    public Player player() {
        return player;
    }

    public double buffer() {
        return buffer;
    }

    public double probability() {
        return probability;
    }

    public void rawProbability(double value) {
        rawProbability = value;
        if (Double.isFinite(value) && value >= 0 && value <= 1) {
            synchronized (topProbabilities) {
                topProbabilities.add(value);
                topProbabilities.sort(Collections.reverseOrder());
                if (topProbabilities.size() > 3) {
                    topProbabilities.remove(3);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public long sessionStartedAt() {
        return sessionStartedAt;
    }

    public List<Double> topProbabilities() {
        synchronized (topProbabilities) {
            return List.copyOf(topProbabilities);
        }
    }

    public void sampleSensitivity(double rotationStep, double error) {
        // Vanilla Java's angular step is 8 * 0.15 * (0.6 * slider + 0.2)^3.
        if (!Double.isFinite(rotationStep) || !(error <= 0.025D)
                || rotationStep < 0.0095D || rotationStep > 0.615D) {
            return;
        }
        int percent = (int) Math.round(200 * (Math.cbrt(rotationStep / 1.2D) - 0.2D) / 0.6D);
        synchronized (sensitivitySamples) {
            sensitivitySamples.addLast(percent);
            if (sensitivitySamples.size() > 12) {
                sensitivitySamples.removeFirst();
            }
        }
    }

    public int estimatedSensitivity() {
        synchronized (sensitivitySamples) {
            if (sensitivitySamples.size() < 5) {
                return -1;
            }
            var sorted = sensitivitySamples.stream().sorted().toList();
            int median = sorted.get(sorted.size() / 2);
            long similar = sorted.stream().filter(value -> Math.abs(value - median) <= 2).count();
            return similar >= 5 && similar * 4 >= sorted.size() * 3 ? median : -1;
        }
    }

    public double rawProbability() {
        return rawProbability;
    }

    /** The probability a live display should print: the raw model answer in
     *  raw mode, the smoothed one otherwise. */
    public double displayProbability(boolean raw) {
        if (lastProbabilityMs == 0L) {
            return Double.NaN;
        }
        return raw ? rawProbability : probability;
    }

    public boolean warmingAim() {
        if (aimWarmupRemaining == 0) {
            return false;
        }
        aimWarmupRemaining--;
        return true;
    }

    public long lastProbabilityMs() {
        return lastProbabilityMs;
    }

    public int windowsAnalysed() {
        return windowsAnalysed;
    }

    public boolean worthKeeping() {
        return windowsAnalysed > 0
                || buffer > 0.0D
                || probability > 0.0D
                || recordedCount() > 0;
    }

    public UUID aimCombatId() {
        return aimCombatId;
    }

    public UUID beginAimCombat() {
        if (aimCombatId == null) {
            aimCombatId = UUID.randomUUID();
        }
        return aimCombatId;
    }

    public void resetBuffer() {
        crystal.resetBuffer();
        resetAimBuffer();
    }

    public void resetAimBuffer() {
        aimCombatId = null;
        aimModelId = "";
        resetAimEvidence();
    }

    public String aimModelId() {
        return aimModelId;
    }

    public boolean useAimModel(String modelId) {
        if (modelId.isEmpty() || modelId.equals(aimModelId)) {
            return false;
        }
        boolean changed = !aimModelId.isEmpty();
        aimModelId = modelId;
        if (changed) {
            resetAimEvidence();
        }
        return changed;
    }

    private void resetAimEvidence() {
        aimWarmupRemaining = AIM_WARMUP_WINDOWS;
        lastProbabilityMs = 0L;
        probability = 0.0D;
        rawProbability = 0.0D;
        buffer = 0.0D;
        probabilitySmoothing.reset();
        synchronized (bufferHistory) {
            bufferHistory.clear();
        }
    }

    public void resetAfterDeath() {
        clearWindow();
        resetBuffer();
        probability = 0.0D;
        rawProbability = 0.0D;
        lastProbabilityMs = 0L;
        lastAttackMs = 0L;
        windowsAnalysed = 0;
        attackedThisTick = false;
        aimErrorThisTick = Double.NaN;
        momentThisTick = null;
        airborneSinceMs = 0L;
        sprintDroppedAtMs = 0L;
        sprinting = false;
        synchronized (attackHistory) {
            attackHistory.clear();
        }
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/me/everyone/oculusai/player/PlayerListener.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.player;

import java.util.Locale;
import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;
import me.everyone.oculusai.player.PlayerData;
import org.bukkit.GameMode;
import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
import org.bukkit.event.EventHandler;
import org.bukkit.event.EventPriority;
import org.bukkit.event.Listener;
import org.bukkit.event.entity.PlayerDeathEvent;
import org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerGameModeChangeEvent;
import org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerChangedWorldEvent;
import org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerJoinEvent;
import org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerRespawnEvent;
import org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerKickEvent;
import org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerQuitEvent;

public final class PlayerListener implements Listener {

    private final OculusAI plugin;

    public PlayerListener(OculusAI plugin) {
        this.plugin = plugin;
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.MONITOR)
    public void onJoin(PlayerJoinEvent event) {
        plugin.data().add(event.getPlayer());
        plugin.journal().refreshFor(event.getPlayer());
        Player joining = event.getPlayer();
        // On Folia each player is sampled by their own task, which has to be
        // started here; off Folia one sweep already covers everybody.
        plugin.tracker().follow(joining);
        // A banned player cannot be here, so arriving while still flagged
        // means the ban was lifted: their count towards the next one starts
        // again from zero.
        plugin.banCounter().seen(joining.getUniqueId());
        plugin.worker().execute(() -> plugin.history().preload(
                joining.getUniqueId(), joining.getName()));

        // Folia samples replays per player, like the entity tracker.
        plugin.replays().follow(joining);

        // Holograms are packet entities in the viewer's client, and a client
        // that has just connected has none of them. Both directions matter:
        // this player may be a viewer whose AlwaysProb has to come back, and
        // everybody else's AlwaysProb needs a hologram over the new arrival.
        plugin.displays().resyncAlwaysProb(joining);
        plugin.displays().resyncAlwaysProb();
    }

    /** A respawn recreates the player entity client-side, so whatever was
     *  mounted on it is gone. Next tick, because at the time the event fires
     *  the player is still at the old location. */
    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.MONITOR)
    public void onRespawn(PlayerRespawnEvent event) {
        Player player = event.getPlayer();
        plugin.ticks().after(1L, () -> {
            plugin.displays().resyncAlwaysProb(player);
            plugin.displays().resyncAlwaysProb();
        });
    }

    /** A world change throws the client's whole entity store away. The old
     *  holograms are dead ids now; everybody watching needs a fresh set. */
    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.MONITOR)
    public void onChangedWorld(PlayerChangedWorldEvent event) {
        plugin.displays().resyncAlwaysProb(event.getPlayer());
        plugin.displays().resyncAlwaysProb();
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.MONITOR)
    public void onQuit(PlayerQuitEvent event) {
        cleanup(event.getPlayer(), false);
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.MONITOR)
    public void onKick(PlayerKickEvent event) {
        cleanup(event.getPlayer(), true);
    }

    private void cleanup(Player player, boolean dropState) {
        PlayerData leaving = plugin.data().get(player);
        if (leaving != null && leaving.recording() && leaving.recordedCount() > 0
                && leaving.recordingLabel() != null) {
            plugin.datasets().commit(leaving, leaving.recordingLabel());
        }

        PlayerData present = plugin.data().get(player);
        if (present != null && present.windowsAnalysed() > 0) {
            plugin.history().note(player.getUniqueId(), player.getName(),
                    dropState ? "kick" : "quit",
                    "buffer " + String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%.1f", present.buffer()));
        }

        plugin.tracker().unfollow(player);
        plugin.tracker().forget(player);
        plugin.replays().unfollow(player);
        plugin.displays().forget(player.getUniqueId());
        plugin.monitors().forget(player.getUniqueId());
        plugin.punishments().forget(player.getUniqueId());
        plugin.checks().forget(player.getUniqueId());
        plugin.journal().forgetWatcher(player.getUniqueId());
        if (dropState) {
            if (leaving != null) {
                leaving.resetBuffer();
            }
            // The buffered frames go with the session. A replay that mattered
            // was already frozen and uploaded by the punishment path; what is
            // left here is seconds of a fight nobody was punished for.
            plugin.replays().forget(player.getUniqueId());
            plugin.data().remove(player.getUniqueId());
        }
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.LOWEST, ignoreCancelled = true)
    public void onGameModeChange(PlayerGameModeChangeEvent event) {
        if (!plugin.journal().isVanished(event.getPlayer().getUniqueId())) {
            return;
        }
        if (event.getNewGameMode() == GameMode.SPECTATOR) {
            return;
        }
        event.setCancelled(true);
        event.getPlayer().sendMessage(plugin.config().prefix()
                + plugin.lang().text("vanish.gamemode-blocked"));
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.MONITOR)
    public void onDeath(PlayerDeathEvent event) {
        PlayerData data = plugin.data().get(event.getEntity());
        if (data == null) {
            return;
        }

        data.resetAfterDeath();
        plugin.analysis().forget(data.uuid());
        plugin.tracker().forget(event.getEntity());
        plugin.displays().forget(data.uuid());
        plugin.punishments().forget(data.uuid());
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/me/everyone/oculusai/player/PlayerRegistry.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.player;


import me.everyone.oculusai.core.Service;
import java.util.Collection;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;
import me.everyone.oculusai.player.PlayerData;
import me.everyone.oculusai.player.PlayerListener;
import org.bukkit.entity.Player;

public final class PlayerRegistry implements Service {

    private final OculusAI plugin;
    private final Map<UUID, PlayerData> players = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

    public PlayerRegistry(OculusAI plugin) {
        this.plugin = plugin;
    }

    @Override
    public void enable() {
        plugin.getServer().getPluginManager().registerEvents(new PlayerListener(plugin), plugin);
        for (Player player : plugin.getServer().getOnlinePlayers()) {
            add(player);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void disable() {
        players.clear();
    }

    public PlayerData add(Player player) {
        return players.compute(player.getUniqueId(), (uuid, existing) -> {
            if (existing == null) {
                return new PlayerData(player, plugin.config().runningHorizon(),
                        plugin.config().checkAimSmoothWindows());
            }
            existing.bind(player);
            return existing;
        });
    }

    public void remove(UUID uuid) {
        players.remove(uuid);
    }

    /** Re-applies settings that were captured when a player joined. */
    public void reconfigure() {
        int smoothWindows = plugin.config().checkAimSmoothWindows();
        for (PlayerData data : players.values()) {
            data.smoothWindows(smoothWindows);
        }
    }

    public PlayerData get(UUID uuid) {
        return players.get(uuid);
    }

    public PlayerData get(Player player) {
        return player == null ? null : players.get(player.getUniqueId());
    }

    public PlayerData byName(String name) {
        Player player = plugin.getServer().getPlayerExact(name);
        return player == null ? null : get(player);
    }

    public Collection<PlayerData> all() {
        return Collections.unmodifiableCollection(players.values());
    }

    public int size() {
        return players.size();
    }
}
```

```java
        this.registry = new PlayerRegistry(plugin);
        this.tracker = new EntityTracker(plugin);
        this.setup = new SetupNotifier(plugin);
    }

    public void enable() {
        registry.enable();
        tracker.enable();
        setup.enable();
    }

    @Override
    public void disable() {
        setup.disable();
        tracker.disable();
        registry.disable();
    }

    @Override
    public void reload() {
        registry.reconfigure();
        setup.disable();
        setup.enable();
    }

    public PlayerRegistry registry() {
        return registry;
    }

    public EntityTracker tracker() {
        return tracker;
    }

    public SetupNotifier setup() {
        return setup;
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/me/everyone/oculusai/player/SetupNotifier.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.player;


import me.everyone.oculusai.core.Service;
import me.everyone.oculusai.core.TickLoop;
import java.util.Map;
import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;
import me.everyone.oculusai.core.Msg;
import net.md_5.bungee.api.chat.ClickEvent;
import net.md_5.bungee.api.chat.HoverEvent;
import net.md_5.bungee.api.chat.TextComponent;
import net.md_5.bungee.api.chat.hover.content.Text;
import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
import org.bukkit.event.EventHandler;
import org.bukkit.event.EventPriority;
import org.bukkit.event.Listener;
import org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerJoinEvent;

public final class SetupNotifier implements Service, Listener {

    private static final long JOIN_DELAY_TICKS = 40L;
    private static final long REMINDER_TICKS = 20L * 60L * 10L;

    private final OculusAI plugin;
    private TickLoop.Handle reminder;

    public SetupNotifier(OculusAI plugin) {
        this.plugin = plugin;
    }

    @Override
    public void enable() {
        plugin.getServer().getPluginManager().registerEvents(this, plugin);
        if (plugin.config().connected()) {
            return;
        }
        console();
        reminder = plugin.ticks().every(REMINDER_TICKS, () -> {
            if (plugin.config().connected()) {
                stop();
                return;
            }
            console();
        });
    }

    @Override
    public void disable() {
        stop();
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.MONITOR)
    public void onJoin(PlayerJoinEvent event) {
        if (plugin.config().connected() || !event.getPlayer().hasPermission("oculusai.alerts")) {
            return;
        }
        plugin.mainThread().after(() -> notify(event.getPlayer()), JOIN_DELAY_TICKS);
    }

    public void notify(Player player) {
        if (plugin.config().connected() || !player.isOnline()) {
            return;
        }
        String site = plugin.config().site();
        player.sendMessage(plugin.config().prefix() + plugin.lang().text("setup.not-connected"));
        player.sendMessage(plugin.config().prefix() + plugin.lang().text("setup.how"));

        TextComponent link = new TextComponent(TextComponent.fromLegacyText(
                plugin.config().prefix() + Msg.parse(plugin.theme().resolveAccent("<accent><u>" + site))));
        link.setClickEvent(new ClickEvent(ClickEvent.Action.OPEN_URL, site));
        link.setHoverEvent(new HoverEvent(HoverEvent.Action.SHOW_TEXT,
                new Text(TextComponent.fromLegacyText(
                        Msg.parse(plugin.lang().text("setup.hover"))))));
        player.spigot().sendMessage(link);
        player.sendMessage(plugin.config().prefix()
                + plugin.lang().text("setup.command", Map.of("value", "/oai connect")));
    }

    private void console() {
        plugin.getLogger().warning(plugin.lang().plain("setup.not-connected"));
        plugin.getLogger().warning(plugin.lang().plain("setup.how") + " " + plugin.config().site());
        plugin.getLogger().warning(plugin.lang().plain("setup.command")
                .replace("%value%", "/oai connect"));
    }

    private void stop() {
        if (reminder != null) {
            reminder.cancel();
            reminder = null;
        }
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/me/everyone/oculusai/storage/CrystalDataset.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.storage;

import java.util.Collection;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;
import me.everyone.oculusai.core.Service;
import me.everyone.oculusai.detection.crystal.CrystalSchema;
import me.everyone.oculusai.network.UploadQueue;
import me.everyone.oculusai.player.PlayerData;

/** Запись кристалльного датасета (схема 8) - /oai datacrystal.
 *
 * <p>Свой список игроков, отдельный от /oai data: аимовый и кристалльный
 * пулы пишутся независимо и могут писаться одновременно. Окна копит
 * {@link me.everyone.oculusai.detection.crystal.CrystalTimeline} игрока, здесь -
 * только кто записывается и отправка.
 */
public final class CrystalDataset implements Service {

    public record Entry(UUID uuid, String name, String label) {
    }

    private final OculusAI plugin;
    private final Map<UUID, Entry> roster = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private volatile boolean collecting;

    public CrystalDataset(OculusAI plugin) {
        this.plugin = plugin;
    }

    @Override
    public void disable() {
        // Незакрытая запись не теряется молча: окна остаются у игроков до
        // следующего stop, а при выключении сервера - пропадают, как и
        // аимовые. Здесь просто перестаём копить.
        for (Entry entry : roster.values()) {
            PlayerData data = plugin.data().get(entry.uuid());
            if (data != null) {
                data.crystal().recording(false);
            }
        }
        collecting = false;
    }

    public void enrol(PlayerData data, String label) {
        roster.put(data.uuid(), new Entry(data.uuid(), data.name(), label));
        if (collecting) {
            data.crystal().recording(true);
        }
    }

    public boolean unenrol(UUID uuid) {
        Entry removed = roster.remove(uuid);
        PlayerData data = plugin.data().get(uuid);
        if (data != null) {
            data.crystal().recording(false);
        }
        return removed != null;
    }

    public Entry byName(String name) {
        for (Entry entry : roster.values()) {
            if (entry.name().equalsIgnoreCase(name)) {
                return entry;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    public Collection<Entry> roster() {
        return roster.values();
    }

    public boolean collecting() {
        return collecting;
    }

    /** Окон записано у этого игрока прямо сейчас; -1 - не в сети. */
    public int recorded(UUID uuid) {
        PlayerData data = plugin.data().get(uuid);
        return data == null ? -1 : data.crystal().recorded();
    }

    /** Начинает запись у всех из списка, кто в сети. */
    public int start() {
        collecting = true;
        int started = 0;
        for (Entry entry : roster.values()) {
            PlayerData data = plugin.data().get(entry.uuid());
            if (data != null) {
                data.crystal().recording(true);
                started++;
            }
        }
        return started;
    }

    /** Сервис ещё не знает схему 8 - отправлять нечего и некуда. */
    public boolean serviceAccepts() {
        Set<Integer> offered = plugin.api().serviceSchemas();
        return offered.isEmpty() || offered.contains(CrystalSchema.VERSION);
    }

    /** Останавливает запись и отправляет окна; имя -> сколько окон сохранено
     *  (null - сервис не ответил, окна ушли в очередь повторов). */
    public Map<String, CompletableFuture<Integer>> stop() {
        collecting = false;
        Map<String, CompletableFuture<Integer>> results = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        for (Entry entry : roster.values()) {
            PlayerData data = plugin.data().get(entry.uuid());
            if (data == null) {
                continue;
            }
            data.crystal().recording(false);
            List<List<double[]>> drained = data.crystal().drain();
            List<double[]> rows = drained.get(0);
            List<double[]> ticks = drained.get(1);
            if (rows.isEmpty()) {
                continue;
            }
            UploadQueue.Batch batch = new UploadQueue.Batch(entry.label(), entry.name(),
                    entry.uuid().toString(), CrystalSchema.COLUMNS, rows, true, "manual",
                    entry.uuid().toString(), List.of(), CrystalSchema.VERSION,
                    ticks, CrystalSchema.TICK_CHANNELS);
            results.put(entry.name(), plugin.uploads().submit(batch));
        }
        return results;
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/me/everyone/oculusai/storage/DatasetStore.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.storage;


import me.everyone.oculusai.core.Service;
import me.everyone.oculusai.core.TickLoop;
import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collection;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;
import me.everyone.oculusai.detection.Detection;
import me.everyone.oculusai.network.UploadQueue;
import me.everyone.oculusai.detection.FeatureSchemas;
import me.everyone.oculusai.player.PlayerData;
import me.everyone.oculusai.core.Msg;
import org.bukkit.command.CommandSender;

public final class DatasetStore implements Service {

    public static final String CHEATER = "cheater";
    public static final String LEGIT = "legit";

    /** Колонки окна: вход колоночных моделей. В панели - OLD. */
    public static final int SCHEMA_OLD = FeatureSchemas.COLUMNS;
    /** Колонки и сырые тики: вход траекторной модели. В панели - NEW. */
    public static final int SCHEMA_NEW = FeatureSchemas.TICKS;
    /** Обе схемы сразу, и это умолчание.
     *
     *  <p>Схем две, различаются они не колонками, а тем, что лежит под
     *  строкой, и одна запись годится для обеих - значит, выбирать между
     *  ними в момент записи не нужно и вредно: выбрав одну, оператор узнаёт
     *  о своей ошибке через полчаса боёв, когда модели другого вида учиться
     *  уже не на чем. Запись уходит двумя сессиями, по одной на схему. */
    public static final int SCHEMA_BOTH = 0;
    /** Записывать в ту схему, которую сервис тоже знает.
     *
     *  <p>Плагин и сервис разворачиваются отдельно, и плагин обновляет себя
     *  сам: сборка, просто решившая, что новая схема уже есть, ломала бы
     *  запись на каждом не обновлённом сервисе - и ломала бы как 422 на
     *  коммите, уже после того, как бой записан. */
    public static final int SCHEMA_AUTO = -2;

    public static final int FEATURE_VERSION = SCHEMA_OLD;
    /** Новейшая первой. Только то, во что запись действительно может лечь. */
    private static final int[] PREFERRED = {SCHEMA_NEW, SCHEMA_OLD};

    private static final int[] BOTH_SCHEMAS = {SCHEMA_OLD, SCHEMA_NEW};

    public record RosterEntry(UUID uuid, String name, String label, String person) {
    }

    private final OculusAI plugin;
    private final Map<UUID, RosterEntry> roster = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private volatile boolean collecting;
    private volatile long collectingSinceMs;
    private volatile CommandSender starter;
    private volatile int schema = SCHEMA_BOTH;
    private TickLoop.Handle progressTask;

    public DatasetStore(OculusAI plugin) {
        this.plugin = plugin;
    }

    @Override
    public void disable() {
        stopProgress();
        roster.clear();
        collecting = false;
        starter = null;
    }

    public static boolean isLabel(String value) {
        return CHEATER.equalsIgnoreCase(value) || LEGIT.equalsIgnoreCase(value);
    }

    public void enrol(PlayerData data, String label) {
        roster.put(data.uuid(), new RosterEntry(data.uuid(), data.name(), label,
                data.uuid().toString()));
        if (collecting) {
            data.running().reset();
            data.recording(true, label);
        }
    }

    public boolean unenrol(UUID uuid) {
        RosterEntry removed = roster.remove(uuid);
        PlayerData data = plugin.data().get(uuid);
        if (data != null) {
            data.recording(false, null);
            data.clearRecorded();
        }
        return removed != null;
    }

    public Collection<RosterEntry> roster() {
        return List.copyOf(roster.values());
    }

    public RosterEntry entry(UUID uuid) {
        return roster.get(uuid);
    }

    /** The roster entry of a player name, whoever is online and whoever is not.
     *
     * <p>The roster keeps a player after they log off, so the admin who wants
     * somebody off it is usually looking at somebody who is not online. The
     * match ignores case and surrounding spaces, because a name typed in chat
     * does not have to be spelled the way the roster remembers it. */
    public RosterEntry entryByName(String name) {
        if (name == null) {
            return null;
        }
        String needle = name.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        if (needle.isEmpty()) {
            return null;
        }
        for (RosterEntry entry : roster.values()) {
            if (entry.name() != null && entry.name().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).equals(needle)) {
                return entry;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    public boolean collecting() {
        return collecting;
    }

    public long collectingSinceMs() {
        return collectingSinceMs;
    }

    public int totalRecorded() {
        int total = 0;
        for (RosterEntry entry : roster.values()) {
            PlayerData data = plugin.data().get(entry.uuid());
            if (data != null) {
                total += data.recordedCount();
            }
        }
        return total;
    }

    public int start(CommandSender starter) {
        collecting = true;
        collectingSinceMs = System.currentTimeMillis();
        this.starter = starter;
        int started = 0;
        for (RosterEntry entry : roster.values()) {
            PlayerData data = plugin.data().get(entry.uuid());
            if (data != null && data.player().isOnline()) {
                data.running().reset();
                data.recording(true, entry.label());
                started++;
            }
        }
        startProgress();
        return started;
    }

    private void startProgress() {
        stopProgress();
        int seconds = plugin.config().progressSeconds();
        if (seconds <= 0 || starter == null) {
            return;
        }
        progressTask = plugin.ticks().every(seconds * 20L, () -> {
            if (!collecting) {
                return;
            }
            StringBuilder line = new StringBuilder("<white>Recording:");
            int total = 0;
            for (RosterEntry entry : roster.values()) {
                PlayerData data = plugin.data().get(entry.uuid());
                int captured = data == null ? 0 : data.recordedCount();
                total += captured;
                line.append(" <accent>").append(entry.name())
                        .append(" <white>").append(captured).append(",");
            }
            if (line.charAt(line.length() - 1) == ',') {
                line.setLength(line.length() - 1);
            }
            if (total == 0) {
                line.append(" — windows are only taken while they fight");
            }
            starter.sendMessage(plugin.config().prefix()
                    + Msg.parse(plugin.theme().resolveAccent(line.toString())));
        });
    }

    private void stopProgress() {
        if (progressTask != null) {
            progressTask.cancel();
            progressTask = null;
        }
    }

    public void setSchema(int schema) {
        this.schema = schema == SCHEMA_BOTH || schema == SCHEMA_AUTO
                || FeatureSchemas.known(schema)
                ? schema : SCHEMA_BOTH;
    }

    public int schema() {
        return schema;
    }

    /** The schema a capture will actually be written as.
     *
     * <p>Resolves SCHEMA_AUTO against what the service said it accepts. Before
     * the first settings fetch lands the set is empty, and then this answers
     * the columns, which every version of the service has understood - rather
     * than guessing upward at a schema the other side may not know. */
    public int effectiveSchema() {
        if (schema != SCHEMA_AUTO) {
            return schema;
        }
        Set<Integer> offered = plugin.api().serviceSchemas();
        for (int candidate : PREFERRED) {
            if (offered.contains(candidate)) {
                return candidate;
            }
        }
        return FEATURE_VERSION;
    }

    public static String schemaName(int schema) {
        return switch (schema) {
            case SCHEMA_NEW -> "new (v7, with ticks)";
            case SCHEMA_BOTH -> "old + new";
            case SCHEMA_AUTO -> "auto";
            default -> "old (v6, columns)";
        };
    }

    public static int parseSchema(String value) {
        if (value == null) {
            return -1;
        }
        return switch (value.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)) {
            case "old", "v6" -> SCHEMA_OLD;
            case "new", "v7" -> SCHEMA_NEW;
            case "both" -> SCHEMA_BOTH;
            case "auto" -> SCHEMA_AUTO;
            default -> -1;
        };
    }

    public Map<String, CompletableFuture<Integer>> stop() {
        collecting = false;
        stopProgress();
        starter = null;
        Map<String, CompletableFuture<Integer>> results = new LinkedHashMap<>();

        for (RosterEntry entry : roster.values()) {
            PlayerData data = plugin.data().get(entry.uuid());
            if (data == null) {
                continue;
            }
            data.recording(false, null);
            if (data.recordedCount() == 0) {
                continue;
            }
            try {
                results.put(entry.name(), commitSchema(data, entry.label(), entry.person()));
            } catch (RuntimeException failure) {
                plugin.getLogger().log(Level.SEVERE,
                        "Could not send the capture for " + entry.name()
                        + "; it is still held and /oai data stop can be run again", failure);
                results.put(entry.name(), CompletableFuture.completedFuture(null));
            }
        }
        return results;
    }

    public CompletableFuture<Integer> commit(PlayerData data, String label) {
        return commit(data, label, true, "manual", personOf(data));
    }

    public CompletableFuture<Integer> commit(PlayerData data, String label,
                                             boolean enabled, String source) {
        return commit(data, label, enabled, source, personOf(data));
    }

    private String personOf(PlayerData data) {
        RosterEntry entry = roster.get(data.uuid());
        return entry == null ? data.uuid().toString() : entry.person();
    }

    public CompletableFuture<Integer> commit(PlayerData data, String label,
                                             boolean enabled, String source, String person) {
        int version = schema == SCHEMA_BOTH ? FEATURE_VERSION : effectiveSchema();
        List<double[]> rows = data.recordedSamples();
        List<String> names = data.recordedFeatureNames();
        if (rows.isEmpty() || names.isEmpty()) {
            return CompletableFuture.completedFuture(0);
        }

        List<double[]> sliced = sliced(names, rows, version);
        List<double[]> context = data.recordedContext();
        // Сырые окна идут строка в строку с колонками: нарезка по схеме
        // меняет состав колонок, а не число окон.
        List<double[]> ticks = data.recordedTicks();
        // Cleared up front, because a failed send no longer leaves the rows
        // here: they go to the retry queue, and holding them in both places
        // would send the same capture twice the next time /oai data stop runs.
        data.clearRecorded();

        UploadQueue.Batch batch = new UploadQueue.Batch(label, data.name(),
                data.uuid().toString(), FeatureSchemas.names(version), sliced,
                enabled, source, person, context, version,
                ticks, Detection.TICK_CHANNELS);

        return plugin.uploads().submit(batch);
    }

    private CompletableFuture<Integer> commitSchema(PlayerData data, String label, String person) {
        if (schema != SCHEMA_BOTH) {
            return commit(data, label, true, "manual", person);
        }

        List<double[]> rows = data.recordedSamples();
        List<String> names = data.recordedFeatureNames();
        List<double[]> context = data.recordedContext();
        List<double[]> ticks = data.recordedTicks();
        data.clearRecorded();
        if (rows.isEmpty() || names.isEmpty()) {
            return CompletableFuture.completedFuture(0);
        }

        List<CompletableFuture<Integer>> sends = new ArrayList<>(BOTH_SCHEMAS.length);
        for (int version : BOTH_SCHEMAS) {
            // Схема, которую отправить нельзя, не отправляется вовсе.
            //
            // Обе причины ведут к одному: сервис ответил бы 422, а 422 от
            // /samples неотличим здесь от обрыва связи - батч ушёл бы в
            // очередь повторов и остался бы в ней навсегда, потому что
            // причина отказа сама не исчезнет. Пропустить половину записи -
            // это потеря одного пула; отправить её - это вечный цикл.
            //
            // Первая причина: схеме нужны тики, а их в записи нет.
            if (FeatureSchemas.needsTicks(version)
                    && (ticks.isEmpty() || ticks.size() != rows.size())) {
                plugin.getLogger().warning("Capture of " + data.name() + " has no raw ticks,"
                        + " so only " + schemaName(SCHEMA_OLD) + " was saved."
                        + " The trajectory model learns from nothing here.");
                continue;
            }
            // Вторая: сервис такой схемы не знает. Так выглядит обновлённый
            // плагин на ещё не обновлённом сервисе, и это нормальное
            // состояние - они разворачиваются отдельно. Колоночную половину
            // записи он возьмёт, её понимает любая версия сервиса, а
            // траекторную просто некуда положить, пока сервис не обновят.
            //
            // Пустое множество - это ещё не пришедший ответ настроек, а не
            // "сервис ничего не умеет": тогда отправляются обе, как раньше.
            Set<Integer> offered = plugin.api().serviceSchemas();
            if (!offered.isEmpty() && !offered.contains(version)) {
                plugin.getLogger().warning("The service does not accept "
                        + schemaName(version) + " yet, so this capture of " + data.name()
                        + " was saved without it. Update the service and record again"
                        + " if you need that pool.");
                continue;
            }
            UploadQueue.Batch batch = new UploadQueue.Batch(label, data.name(),
                    data.uuid().toString(), FeatureSchemas.names(version),
                    sliced(names, rows, version), true, "manual", person, context, version,
                    ticks, Detection.TICK_CHANNELS);
            sends.add(plugin.uploads().submit(batch));
        }

        return CompletableFuture.allOf(sends.toArray(new CompletableFuture[0]))
                .thenApply(ignored -> {
                    int total = 0;
                    for (CompletableFuture<Integer> send : sends) {
                        Integer stored = send.join();
                        if (stored != null) {
                            total += stored;
                        }
                    }
                    return total;
                });
    }

    private static List<double[]> sliced(List<String> names, List<double[]> rows, int version) {
        List<String> wanted = FeatureSchemas.names(version);
        int[] positions = new int[wanted.size()];
        for (int i = 0; i < positions.length; i++) {
            positions[i] = names.indexOf(wanted.get(i));
        }

        List<double[]> cut = new ArrayList<>(rows.size());
        for (double[] row : rows) {
            double[] values = new double[positions.length];
            for (int i = 0; i < positions.length; i++) {
                int at = positions[i];
                values[i] = at >= 0 && at < row.length ? row[at] : 0.0D;
            }
            cut.add(values);
        }
        return cut;
    }

    public CompletableFuture<Integer> remove(String uuid, String label) {
        return plugin.api().removeSamples(label, uuid).thenApply(response ->
                response == null || !response.has("removed") ? null : response.get("removed").getAsInt());
    }

    public CompletableFuture<JsonObject> train() {
        return plugin.api().train();
    }

    public CompletableFuture<JsonObject> status() {
        return plugin.api().status();
    }
}
```

```java
public enum HistorySort {

    SUSPICION;

    public HistorySort next() {
        return this == FRESHNESS ? SUSPICION : FRESHNESS;

    public String langKey() {
        return "history.sort." + name().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
```
