`src/main/java/me/everyone/oculusai/storage/HistoryStore.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.storage;


import me.everyone.oculusai.core.Service;
import com.google.gson.JsonArray;
import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
import com.google.gson.JsonParser;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.Reader;
import java.io.Writer;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption;
import java.util.ArrayDeque;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.Deque;
import java.util.LinkedHashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import java.util.concurrent.ScheduledFuture;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.stream.Stream;
import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;
import me.everyone.oculusai.player.PlayerData;

public final class HistoryStore implements Service {

    public record Event(long at, String type, String detail) {
    }

    /** Сколько раз с игроком что-то случилось за всё время.
     *
     *  Считается отдельно от ленты событий, а не выводится из неё: лента
     *  обрезана последними шестьюдесятью записями, и игрок, которого
     *  предупреждали триста раз, по ней выглядел бы как предупреждённый
     *  шестьдесят. Счётчик не обнуляется ничем, кроме /oai forget. */
    public record Tally(int alerts, int punishments, int quits, double peakProbability) {
    }

    private static final class Record {
        private volatile String name;
        private volatile long firstSeenAt;
        private volatile long lastSeenAt;
        private volatile double peakBuffer;
        private volatile double peakProbability;
        private volatile int windowsAnalysed;
        private volatile int alerts;
        private volatile int punishments;
        private volatile int quits;
        private volatile long lastAlertAt;
        private final Deque<PlayerData.Reading> readings = new ArrayDeque<>();
        private final Deque<Event> events = new ArrayDeque<>();
        private volatile boolean dirty;
        private long version;

        private Snapshot snapshot() {
            synchronized (this) {
                return new Snapshot(name, firstSeenAt, lastSeenAt, peakBuffer,
                        peakProbability, windowsAnalysed, alerts, punishments, quits,
                        lastAlertAt, List.copyOf(readings), List.copyOf(events), version);
            }
        }

        private void changed() {
            version++;
            dirty = true;
        }

        private void written(long snapshotVersion) {
            synchronized (this) {
                if (version == snapshotVersion) {
                    dirty = false;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private record Snapshot(String name, long firstSeenAt, long lastSeenAt,
                            double peakBuffer, double peakProbability, int windowsAnalysed,
                            int alerts, int punishments, int quits, long lastAlertAt,
                            List<PlayerData.Reading> readings, List<Event> events,
                            long version) {
    }

    private final OculusAI plugin;
    private final Map<UUID, Record> records = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private final Map<String, UUID> byName = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private final Map<UUID, String> names = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private final Map<UUID, Long> lastSeen = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private ScheduledFuture<?> flushTask;
    private volatile long lastPurgeAt;

    public HistoryStore(OculusAI plugin) {
        this.plugin = plugin;
    }

    @Override
    public void enable() {
        Path directory = directory();
        try {
            Files.createDirectories(directory);
        } catch (IOException failure) {
            plugin.getLogger().log(Level.SEVERE, "Could not create the history directory", failure);
            return;
        }
        loadIndex();

        // Retention is a directory scan; keep it off the enable path.
        plugin.worker().execute(() -> {
            lastPurgeAt = System.currentTimeMillis();
            purgeOldFiles();
        });

        long period = Math.max(20L, plugin.config().historyFlushSeconds() * 20L) * 50L;
        flushTask = plugin.worker().repeat(this::flushAll, period, period, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);
    }

    @Override
    public void disable() {
        if (flushTask != null) {
            flushTask.cancel(false);
            flushTask = null;
        }
        // The worker is still alive here (it is shut down after every service),
        // and shutdown waits for it. Writing the last dirty records there keeps
        // the server's stop from doing file I/O on the tick thread.
        plugin.worker().execute(() -> {
            flushAll();
            records.clear();
            byName.clear();
            names.clear();
            lastSeen.clear();
        });
    }

    /** Loads a stored record on the worker before the first prediction or
     *  before the history menu opens. Without this the first touch of a
     *  player read a JSON file on the tick thread. */
    public void preload(UUID uuid, String name) {
        load(uuid, name);
    }

    public void record(PlayerData data) {
        PlayerData.Reading newest = data.latestReading();
        if (newest == null) {
            return;
        }
        Record record = load(data.uuid(), data.name());
        synchronized (record) {
            if (!record.readings.isEmpty()
                    && record.readings.peekLast().capturedAt() == newest.capturedAt()
                    && record.readings.peekLast().buffer() == newest.buffer()) {
                return;
            }
            record.name = data.name();
            record.lastSeenAt = newest.capturedAt();
            record.windowsAnalysed = Math.max(record.windowsAnalysed, data.windowsAnalysed());
            record.peakBuffer = Math.max(record.peakBuffer, newest.buffer());
            record.peakProbability = Math.max(record.peakProbability, newest.probability());
            record.readings.addLast(newest);
            trim(record);
            record.changed();
        }
        remember(data.uuid(), data.name(), newest.capturedAt());
    }

    public void note(UUID uuid, String name, String type, String detail) {
        Record record = load(uuid, name);
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        synchronized (record) {
            record.name = name == null || name.isBlank() ? record.name : name;
            record.lastSeenAt = Math.max(record.lastSeenAt, now);
            switch (type) {
                case "alert" -> {
                    record.alerts++;
                    record.lastAlertAt = now;
                }
                case "punish" -> record.punishments++;
                case "quit", "kick" -> record.quits++;
                default -> {
                    if (type.startsWith("check-")) {
                        record.alerts++;
                        record.lastAlertAt = now;
                    }
                }
            }
            record.events.addLast(new Event(now, type,
                    detail == null ? "" : detail));
            while (record.events.size() > 60) {
                record.events.pollFirst();
            }
            record.changed();
        }
        remember(uuid, name, now);
        // No synchronous flush here: an alert on the main thread must not wait
        // for a JSON write. The worker flushes dirty records every period.
    }

    private void remember(UUID uuid, String name, long seenAt) {
        lastSeen.merge(uuid, seenAt, Math::max);
        if (name == null || name.isBlank()) {
            return;
        }
        names.put(uuid, name);
        byName.put(name.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT), uuid);
    }

    private void trim(Record record) {
        int keep = plugin.config().historyKeep();
        while (record.readings.size() > keep) {
            record.readings.pollFirst();
        }
    }

    public List<PlayerData.Reading> readings(UUID uuid) {
        Record record = records.get(uuid);
        if (record == null) {
            record = read(uuid);
            if (record == null) {
                return List.of();
            }
            records.put(uuid, record);
        }
        synchronized (record) {
            return List.copyOf(record.readings);
        }
    }

    public List<Event> events(UUID uuid) {
        Record record = records.get(uuid);
        if (record == null) {
            record = read(uuid);
            if (record == null) {
                return List.of();
            }
            records.put(uuid, record);
        }
        synchronized (record) {
            return List.copyOf(record.events);
        }
    }

    public String nameOf(UUID uuid) {
        String cached = names.get(uuid);
        if (cached != null) {
            return cached;
        }
        Record record = records.get(uuid);
        if (record == null) {
            record = read(uuid);
            if (record == null) {
                return null;
            }
            records.put(uuid, record);
        }
        return record.name;
    }

    public double peakBuffer(UUID uuid) {
        Record record = records.get(uuid);
        if (record == null) {
            record = read(uuid);
            if (record == null) {
                return 0.0D;
            }
            records.put(uuid, record);
        }
        return record.peakBuffer;
    }

    /** Счётчики за всё время. Для игрока, о котором нечего сказать, нули. */
    public Tally tally(UUID uuid) {
        Record record = records.get(uuid);
        if (record == null) {
            record = read(uuid);
            if (record == null) {
                return new Tally(0, 0, 0, 0.0D);
            }
            records.put(uuid, record);
        }
        return new Tally(record.alerts, record.punishments, record.quits,
                record.peakProbability);
    }

    public long lastAlertAt(UUID uuid) {
        Record record = records.get(uuid);
        if (record == null) {
            record = read(uuid);
            if (record == null) {
                return 0L;
            }
            records.put(uuid, record);
        }
        return record.lastAlertAt;
    }

    public long firstSeenAt(UUID uuid) {
        Record record = records.get(uuid);
        if (record == null) {
            record = read(uuid);
            if (record == null) {
                return 0L;
            }
            records.put(uuid, record);
        }
        return record.firstSeenAt;
    }

    public long lastSeenAt(UUID uuid) {
        Long cached = lastSeen.get(uuid);
        if (cached != null) {
            return cached;
        }
        Record record = records.get(uuid);
        return record == null ? 0L : record.lastSeenAt;
    }

    public int windowsAnalysed(UUID uuid) {
        Record record = records.get(uuid);
        if (record == null) {
            record = read(uuid);
            if (record == null) {
                return 0;
            }
            records.put(uuid, record);
        }
        return record.windowsAnalysed;
    }

    public boolean has(UUID uuid) {
        return records.containsKey(uuid) || Files.exists(fileOf(uuid));
    }

    public UUID resolve(String name) {
        if (name == null || name.isBlank()) {
            return null;
        }
        return byName.get(name.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT));
    }

    public List<UUID> tracked() {
        Set<UUID> unique = new LinkedHashSet<>(byName.values());
        List<UUID> all = new ArrayList<>(unique);
        all.sort(Comparator.comparingLong(
                id -> lastSeen.getOrDefault(id, 0L)).reversed());
        return all;
    }

    public void forget(UUID uuid) {
        records.remove(uuid);
        byName.entrySet().removeIf(entry -> entry.getValue().equals(uuid));
        names.remove(uuid);
        lastSeen.remove(uuid);
        try {
            Files.deleteIfExists(fileOf(uuid));
        } catch (IOException failure) {
            plugin.getLogger().log(Level.WARNING, "Could not delete the history of " + uuid, failure);
        }
        plugin.worker().execute(this::writeIndex);
    }

    private Path directory() {
        return plugin.getDataFolder().toPath().resolve("history");
    }

    private Path fileOf(UUID uuid) {
        return directory().resolve(uuid + ".json");
    }

    private Record load(UUID uuid, String name) {
        Record loaded = records.computeIfAbsent(uuid, id -> {
            Record stored = read(id);
            if (stored != null) {
                return stored;
            }
            Record fresh = new Record();
            fresh.name = name;
            fresh.firstSeenAt = System.currentTimeMillis();
            fresh.lastSeenAt = fresh.firstSeenAt;
            return fresh;
        });
        if (name != null && !name.isBlank()) {
            names.putIfAbsent(uuid, name);
        }
        return loaded;
    }

    private Record read(UUID uuid) {
        Path path = fileOf(uuid);
        if (!Files.exists(path)) {
            return null;
        }
        try (Reader reader = Files.newBufferedReader(path, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
            JsonObject root =
                new JsonParser().parse(reader).getAsJsonObject();
            Record record = new Record();
            record.name = root.has("name") ? root.get("name").getAsString() : uuid.toString();
            record.firstSeenAt = root.has("first_seen_at") ? root.get("first_seen_at").getAsLong() : 0L;
            record.lastSeenAt = root.has("last_seen_at") ? root.get("last_seen_at").getAsLong() : 0L;
            record.peakBuffer = root.has("peak_buffer") ? root.get("peak_buffer").getAsDouble() : 0.0D;
            record.peakProbability = root.has("peak_probability")
                    ? root.get("peak_probability").getAsDouble() : 0.0D;
            record.windowsAnalysed = root.has("windows") ? root.get("windows").getAsInt() : 0;
            // Файл, записанный до появления счётчиков, их не содержит: ноль -
            // честный ответ, выводить их задним числом из обрезанной ленты
            // значило бы выдумать число и показать его как измеренное.
            record.alerts = root.has("alerts") ? root.get("alerts").getAsInt() : 0;
            record.punishments = root.has("punishments") ? root.get("punishments").getAsInt() : 0;
            record.quits = root.has("quits") ? root.get("quits").getAsInt() : 0;
            record.lastAlertAt = root.has("last_alert_at") ? root.get("last_alert_at").getAsLong() : 0L;
            if (root.has("readings")) {
                for (var element : root.getAsJsonArray("readings")) {
                    JsonObject item = element.getAsJsonObject();
                    record.readings.addLast(new PlayerData.Reading(
                            item.get("t").getAsLong(),
                            item.get("p").getAsDouble(),
                            item.get("b").getAsDouble()));
                }
            }
            if (root.has("events")) {
                for (var element : root.getAsJsonArray("events")) {
                    JsonObject item = element.getAsJsonObject();
                    record.events.addLast(new Event(
                            item.get("t").getAsLong(),
                            item.get("type").getAsString(),
                            item.has("detail") ? item.get("detail").getAsString() : ""));
                }
            }
            trim(record);
            names.put(uuid, record.name);
            lastSeen.merge(uuid, record.lastSeenAt, Math::max);
            return record;
        } catch (IOException | RuntimeException failure) {
            plugin.getLogger().log(Level.WARNING,
                    "Could not read the history of " + uuid + "; starting a new one", failure);
            return null;
        }
    }

    /** Queues a single record for the worker. Kept public because history
     *  mutations outside this class (none today) must not write on the caller. */
    public void flush(UUID uuid) {
        plugin.worker().execute(() -> {
            Record record = records.get(uuid);
            if (record != null) {
                writeIfDirty(uuid, record);
            }
        });
    }

    private void flushAll() {
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        if (now - lastPurgeAt > TimeUnit.HOURS.toMillis(6)) {
            lastPurgeAt = now;
            purgeOldFiles();
        }
        for (Map.Entry<UUID, Record> entry : records.entrySet()) {
            writeIfDirty(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
        }
        writeIndex();
        pruneMemory();
    }

    private void writeIfDirty(UUID uuid, Record record) {
        if (!record.dirty) {
            return;
        }
        Snapshot snapshot = record.snapshot();
        JsonObject root = new JsonObject();
        JsonArray readings = new JsonArray();
        JsonArray events = new JsonArray();
        root.addProperty("name", snapshot.name() == null ? uuid.toString() : snapshot.name());
        root.addProperty("first_seen_at", snapshot.firstSeenAt());
        root.addProperty("last_seen_at", snapshot.lastSeenAt());
        root.addProperty("peak_buffer", snapshot.peakBuffer());
        root.addProperty("peak_probability", snapshot.peakProbability());
        root.addProperty("windows", snapshot.windowsAnalysed());
        root.addProperty("alerts", snapshot.alerts());
        root.addProperty("punishments", snapshot.punishments());
        root.addProperty("quits", snapshot.quits());
        root.addProperty("last_alert_at", snapshot.lastAlertAt());
        for (PlayerData.Reading reading : snapshot.readings()) {
            JsonObject item = new JsonObject();
            item.addProperty("t", reading.capturedAt());
            item.addProperty("p", reading.probability());
            item.addProperty("b", reading.buffer());
            readings.add(item);
        }
        for (Event event : snapshot.events()) {
            JsonObject item = new JsonObject();
            item.addProperty("t", event.at());
            item.addProperty("type", event.type());
            item.addProperty("detail", event.detail());
            events.add(item);
        }
        root.add("readings", readings);
        root.add("events", events);

        Path path = fileOf(uuid);
        Path temporary = path.resolveSibling(path.getFileName() + ".tmp");
        try {
            Files.createDirectories(path.getParent());
            try (Writer writer = Files.newBufferedWriter(temporary, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
                writer.write(root.toString());
            }
            Files.move(temporary, path, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
            record.written(snapshot.version());
        } catch (IOException failure) {
            plugin.getLogger().log(Level.WARNING, "Could not write the history of " + uuid, failure);
        }
    }

    /** Keeps the in-memory cache bounded. Only clean records are dropped: a
     *  dirty one is due to be written by the same pass, so dropping it here
     *  would lose data. A dropped record is re-read from disk next time. */
    private void pruneMemory() {
        int max = plugin.config().historyMaxPlayers();
        if (max <= 0 || records.size() <= max) {
            return;
        }
        List<Map.Entry<UUID, Record>> ordered = new ArrayList<>(records.entrySet());
        ordered.sort(Comparator.comparingLong(entry -> entry.getValue().lastSeenAt));
        for (Map.Entry<UUID, Record> entry : ordered) {
            if (records.size() <= max) {
                break;
            }
            if (!entry.getValue().dirty) {
                records.remove(entry.getKey());
            }
        }
    }

    /** Deletes history files older than the configured retention. Runs on the
     *  worker; records still loaded are left alone so an online player's
     *  in-memory data cannot be deleted from under them. */
    private void purgeOldFiles() {
        int days = plugin.config().historyRetentionDays();
        if (days <= 0) {
            return;
        }
        long cutoff = System.currentTimeMillis() - days * 24L * 60L * 60L * 1000L;
        try (Stream<Path> files = Files.list(directory())) {
            files.filter(path -> path.getFileName().toString().endsWith(".json"))
                    .filter(path -> !path.getFileName().toString().equals("index.json"))
                    .forEach(path -> {
                        try {
                            if (Files.getLastModifiedTime(path).toMillis() >= cutoff) {
                                return;
                            }
                            String stem = path.getFileName().toString().replace(".json", "");
                            UUID uuid = UUID.fromString(stem);
                            if (records.containsKey(uuid)) {
                                return;
                            }
                            byName.entrySet().removeIf(entry -> entry.getValue().equals(uuid));
                            names.remove(uuid);
                            lastSeen.remove(uuid);
                            Files.deleteIfExists(path);
                        } catch (IOException | IllegalArgumentException ignored) {
                            // One unreadable name must not stop the sweep.
                        }
                    });
            writeIndex();
        } catch (IOException failure) {
            plugin.getLogger().log(Level.WARNING, "Could not prune old history files", failure);
        }
    }

    private Path indexFile() {
        return directory().resolve("index.json");
    }

    private void writeIndex() {
        JsonObject root = new JsonObject();
        byName.forEach((name, uuid) -> {
            JsonObject row = new JsonObject();
            row.addProperty("uuid", uuid.toString());
            row.addProperty("name", names.getOrDefault(uuid, name));
            row.addProperty("last_seen_at", lastSeen.getOrDefault(uuid, 0L));
            root.add(name, row);
        });
        Path path = indexFile();
        Path temporary = path.resolveSibling(path.getFileName() + ".tmp");
        try {
            Files.createDirectories(directory());
            try (Writer writer = Files.newBufferedWriter(temporary, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
                writer.write(root.toString());
            }
            Files.move(temporary, path, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
        } catch (IOException failure) {
            plugin.getLogger().log(Level.WARNING, "Could not write the history index", failure);
        }
    }

    private void loadIndex() {
        Path path = indexFile();
        if (Files.exists(path)) {
            try (Reader reader = Files.newBufferedReader(path, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
                JsonObject root =
                new JsonParser().parse(reader).getAsJsonObject();
                for (Map.Entry<String, com.google.gson.JsonElement> entry : root.entrySet()) {
                    String key = entry.getKey();
                    com.google.gson.JsonElement value = entry.getValue();
                    if (value.isJsonPrimitive()) {
                        UUID uuid = UUID.fromString(value.getAsString());
                        byName.put(key, uuid);
                        names.putIfAbsent(uuid, key);
                        continue;
                    }
                    if (!value.isJsonObject()) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    JsonObject row = value.getAsJsonObject();
                    UUID uuid = UUID.fromString(row.get("uuid").getAsString());
                    byName.put(key, uuid);
                    if (row.has("name")) {
                        names.put(uuid, row.get("name").getAsString());
                    }
                    if (row.has("last_seen_at")) {
                        lastSeen.merge(uuid, row.get("last_seen_at").getAsLong(), Math::max);
                    }
                }
                return;
            } catch (IOException | RuntimeException failure) {
                plugin.getLogger().log(Level.WARNING,
                        "Could not read the history index; rebuilding it from the files", failure);
            }
        }
        rebuildIndex();
    }

    private void rebuildIndex() {
        try (Stream<Path> files = Files.list(directory())) {
            files.filter(path -> path.getFileName().toString().endsWith(".json"))
                    .filter(path -> !path.getFileName().toString().equals("index.json"))
                    .forEach(path -> {
                        String stem = path.getFileName().toString().replace(".json", "");
                        try {
                            UUID uuid = UUID.fromString(stem);
                            Record record = read(uuid);
                            if (record != null && record.name != null) {
                                byName.put(record.name.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT), uuid);
                                names.put(uuid, record.name);
                                lastSeen.merge(uuid, record.lastSeenAt, Math::max);
                            }
                        } catch (IllegalArgumentException ignored) {
                        }
                    });
        } catch (IOException failure) {
            plugin.getLogger().log(Level.WARNING, "Could not list stored histories", failure);
        }
        writeIndex();
    }
}

```

`src/main/java/me/everyone/oculusai/storage/JournalStore.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.storage;


import me.everyone.oculusai.core.Service;
import com.google.gson.JsonArray;
import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
import com.google.gson.JsonParser;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.Reader;
import java.io.Writer;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption;
import java.util.ArrayDeque;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collection;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.Deque;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import java.util.concurrent.ScheduledFuture;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;
import me.everyone.oculusai.player.PlayerData;
import org.bukkit.GameMode;
import org.bukkit.Location;
import org.bukkit.entity.Player;

public final class JournalStore implements Service {

    private record StaffState(GameMode gameMode, Location location) {
    }

    public record Snapshot(long capturedAt, double probability, double buffer) {
    }

    public static final double MODERATION_BUFFER = 2.0D;

    /** Сколько последних показаний держать при записи. Столько же, сколько
     *  показывает меню журнала: хранить больше незачем, меньше - значит
     *  терять график после перезапуска. */
    private static final int HISTORY_KEEP = 8;

    /** Как часто журнал пишется на диск. Падение сервера теряет не больше
     *  этого, а запись мелкая - несколько десятков строк. */
    private static final long FLUSH_SECONDS = 30L;

    public static final class Entry {
        private final UUID uuid;
        private volatile String name;
        private final long firstSeenAt;
        private volatile long lastSeenAt;
        private volatile double peakBuffer;
        private volatile double lastBuffer;
        private volatile double lastProbability;
        private volatile int windowsAnalysed;
        private final Deque<Snapshot> history = new ArrayDeque<>();

        /** Запись, прочитанная с диска. Игрока может не быть на сервере
         *  вовсе - журнал переживает и перезапуск, и его выход. */
        private Entry(UUID uuid, String name, long firstSeenAt, long lastSeenAt,
                      double peakBuffer, double lastBuffer, double lastProbability,
                      int windowsAnalysed, List<Snapshot> snapshots) {
            this.uuid = uuid;
            this.name = name;
            this.firstSeenAt = firstSeenAt;
            this.lastSeenAt = lastSeenAt;
            this.peakBuffer = peakBuffer;
            this.lastBuffer = lastBuffer;
            this.lastProbability = lastProbability;
            this.windowsAnalysed = windowsAnalysed;
            history.addAll(snapshots);
            while (history.size() > HISTORY_KEEP) {
                history.removeFirst();
            }
        }

        private Entry(PlayerData data) {
            long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
            this.uuid = data.uuid();
            this.name = data.name();
            this.firstSeenAt = now;
            this.lastSeenAt = now;
            this.peakBuffer = data.buffer();
            this.lastBuffer = data.buffer();
            this.lastProbability = data.probability();
            this.windowsAnalysed = data.windowsAnalysed();
            history.addLast(new Snapshot(now, data.probability(), data.buffer()));
        }

        private synchronized void update(PlayerData data) {
            long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
            name = data.name();
            lastSeenAt = now;
            lastBuffer = data.buffer();
            lastProbability = data.probability();
            windowsAnalysed = data.windowsAnalysed();
            if (data.buffer() > peakBuffer) {
                peakBuffer = data.buffer();
            }
            history.addLast(new Snapshot(now, data.probability(), data.buffer()));
            while (history.size() > HISTORY_KEEP) {
                history.removeFirst();
            }
        }

        public UUID uuid() {
            return uuid;
        }

        public String name() {
            return name;
        }

        public long firstSeenAt() {
            return firstSeenAt;
        }

        public long lastSeenAt() {
            return lastSeenAt;
        }

        public double peakBuffer() {
            return peakBuffer;
        }

        public double lastBuffer() {
            return lastBuffer;
        }

        public double lastProbability() {
            return lastProbability;
        }

        public int windowsAnalysed() {
            return windowsAnalysed;
        }

        public synchronized List<Snapshot> history() {
            return List.copyOf(history);
        }
    }

    private final OculusAI plugin;
    private final Map<UUID, Entry> entries = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private final Map<UUID, StaffState> vanished = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    /** Incremented on every mutation. The writer records the value it encoded
     *  and only clears the "clean up to here" marker if nothing changed while
     *  it was writing; otherwise the next pass writes the newer state too. */
    private final java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong changes =
            new java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong();
    private long written;
    private ScheduledFuture<?> flushTask;

    public JournalStore(OculusAI plugin) {
        this.plugin = plugin;
    }

    @Override
    public void enable() {
        read();
        long period = FLUSH_SECONDS * 1000L;
        flushTask = plugin.worker().repeat(this::write, period, period, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);
    }

    public void record(PlayerData data) {
        if (data.buffer() < MODERATION_BUFFER) {
            return;
        }
        entries.compute(data.uuid(), (uuid, existing) -> {
            if (existing == null) {
                return new Entry(data);
            }
            existing.update(data);
            return existing;
        });
        changes.incrementAndGet();
    }

    /** Убирает игрока из журнала - то, что делает /oai forget. */
    public void forget(UUID uuid) {
        if (entries.remove(uuid) != null) {
            changes.incrementAndGet();
            plugin.worker().execute(this::write);
        }
    }

    // -- сохранение -------------------------------------------------------
    //
    // Журнал это список тех, за кем стоит присмотреть, и перезапуск сервера
    // не повод присматривать заново: раньше список жил только в памяти, и
    // /stop стирал его целиком вместе с тем, кого набрали за вечер.

    private Path file() {
        return plugin.getDataFolder().toPath().resolve("journal.json");
    }

    /** Журнал в JSON. Отдельно от записи на диск, потому что формат - это то,
     *  что должно проверяться тестом, а файловая система в тесте не нужна. */
    static JsonObject encode(Collection<Entry> entries) {
        JsonArray rows = new JsonArray();
        for (Entry entry : entries) {
            JsonObject item = new JsonObject();
            item.addProperty("uuid", entry.uuid().toString());
            item.addProperty("name", entry.name() == null ? "" : entry.name());
            item.addProperty("first_seen_at", entry.firstSeenAt());
            item.addProperty("last_seen_at", entry.lastSeenAt());
            item.addProperty("peak_buffer", entry.peakBuffer());
            item.addProperty("last_buffer", entry.lastBuffer());
            item.addProperty("last_probability", entry.lastProbability());
            item.addProperty("windows", entry.windowsAnalysed());
            JsonArray history = new JsonArray();
            for (Snapshot snapshot : entry.history()) {
                JsonObject point = new JsonObject();
                point.addProperty("t", snapshot.capturedAt());
                point.addProperty("p", snapshot.probability());
                point.addProperty("b", snapshot.buffer());
                history.add(point);
            }
            item.add("history", history);
            rows.add(item);
        }
        JsonObject root = new JsonObject();
        root.add("entries", rows);
        return root;
    }

    /** Обратная сторона {@link #encode}. Пропускает запись, которую не смогла
     *  прочитать: одна битая строка не повод потерять весь журнал. */
    static Map<UUID, Entry> decode(JsonObject root) {
        Map<UUID, Entry> out = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        if (root == null || !root.has("entries")) {
            return out;
        }
        for (var element : root.getAsJsonArray("entries")) {
            try {
                JsonObject item = element.getAsJsonObject();
                UUID uuid = UUID.fromString(item.get("uuid").getAsString());
                List<Snapshot> history = new ArrayList<>();
                if (item.has("history")) {
                    for (var point : item.getAsJsonArray("history")) {
                        JsonObject snapshot = point.getAsJsonObject();
                        history.add(new Snapshot(snapshot.get("t").getAsLong(),
                                snapshot.get("p").getAsDouble(),
                                snapshot.get("b").getAsDouble()));
                    }
                }
                out.put(uuid, new Entry(uuid,
                        item.has("name") ? item.get("name").getAsString() : uuid.toString(),
                        item.get("first_seen_at").getAsLong(),
                        item.get("last_seen_at").getAsLong(),
                        item.get("peak_buffer").getAsDouble(),
                        item.has("last_buffer") ? item.get("last_buffer").getAsDouble() : 0.0D,
                        item.has("last_probability")
                                ? item.get("last_probability").getAsDouble() : 0.0D,
                        item.has("windows") ? item.get("windows").getAsInt() : 0,
                        history));
            } catch (RuntimeException ignored) {
                // Следующая запись может быть целой.
            }
        }
        return out;
    }

    private synchronized void write() {
        long snapshot = changes.get();
        if (snapshot == written) {
            return;
        }
        JsonObject root = encode(entries.values());

        Path path = file();
        Path temporary = path.resolveSibling(path.getFileName() + ".tmp");
        try {
            Files.createDirectories(path.getParent());
            try (Writer writer = Files.newBufferedWriter(temporary, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
                writer.write(root.toString());
            }
            Files.move(temporary, path, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
            written = snapshot;
        } catch (IOException failure) {
            plugin.getLogger().log(Level.WARNING, "Could not write the journal", failure);
        }
    }

    private void read() {
        Path path = file();
        if (!Files.exists(path)) {
            return;
        }
        try (Reader reader = Files.newBufferedReader(path, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
            entries.putAll(decode(new JsonParser().parse(reader).getAsJsonObject()));
        } catch (IOException | RuntimeException failure) {
            plugin.getLogger().log(Level.WARNING,
                    "Could not read the journal; starting an empty one", failure);
        }
    }

    public List<Entry> entries() {
        List<Entry> ordered = new ArrayList<>(entries.values());
        ordered.sort(Comparator.comparingLong(Entry::lastSeenAt).reversed()
                .thenComparing(Comparator.comparingDouble(Entry::peakBuffer).reversed()));
        return ordered;
    }

    public int size() {
        return entries.size();
    }

    /** Puts a watcher into spectator mode on a suspect.
     *
     *  @return false if this server cannot do it, so the caller can say so
     *          instead of reporting a spectate that never started. */
    public boolean observe(Player watcher, UUID targetId) {
        PlayerData data = plugin.data().get(targetId);
        if (data == null || !data.player().isOnline()) {
            return false;
        }
        Player target = data.player();
        if (plugin.platform().folia()) {
            // Two entities, and on Folia two threads may own them. So the
            // target's position is read where that is legal - the target's own
            // thread - and everything done to the watcher happens after they
            // have arrived, on the thread that owns them there.
            plugin.platform().onEntity(target, () -> {
                Location where = target.getLocation();
                plugin.platform().onEntity(watcher, () -> {
                    enterVanish(watcher);
                    watcher.setGameMode(GameMode.SPECTATOR);
                    plugin.platform().teleport(watcher, where,
                            () -> attachCamera(watcher, target, data));
                });
            });
            return true;
        }
        enterVanish(watcher);
        watcher.setGameMode(GameMode.SPECTATOR);
        watcher.teleport(target.getLocation());
        watcher.setSpectatorTarget(target);
        plugin.displays().watch(watcher, data);
        return true;
    }

    /** Locks the watcher's camera to the suspect, if this thread may.
     *
     *  <p>Called once the watcher has been teleported to the suspect, which is
     *  normally enough to put the two in the same region and make the camera
     *  attachable. When it is not - the suspect moved across a boundary in the
     *  meantime - the watcher stays an ordinary spectator standing where the
     *  suspect was, which is the same view a moment later rather than nothing
     *  at all. The hologram over the suspect's head says the rest. */
    private void attachCamera(Player watcher, Player target, PlayerData data) {
        if (target.isOnline() && plugin.platform().owns(target)) {
            watcher.setSpectatorTarget(target);
        }
        plugin.displays().watch(watcher, data);
    }

    public boolean enterVanish(Player watcher) {
        if (vanished.containsKey(watcher.getUniqueId())) {
            return false;
        }
        vanished.put(watcher.getUniqueId(),
                new StaffState(watcher.getGameMode(), watcher.getLocation().clone()));
        hideFromOthers(watcher);
        watcher.setGameMode(GameMode.SPECTATOR);
        plugin.displays().stop(watcher);
        return true;
    }

    public boolean leaveVanish(Player watcher) {
        StaffState state = vanished.remove(watcher.getUniqueId());
        if (state == null) {
            return false;
        }
        if (watcher.getGameMode() == GameMode.SPECTATOR) {
            watcher.setSpectatorTarget(null);
        }
        // Asynchronous on both servers: the way back can be a different world,
        // and on Folia a plain teleport across a region boundary is refused.
        // The game mode is restored on arrival, because setting it before the
        // teleport lands leaves a spectator falling through the floor of the
        // place they came from.
        plugin.platform().teleport(watcher, state.location(),
                () -> watcher.setGameMode(state.gameMode()));
        showToOthers(watcher);
        plugin.displays().stop(watcher);
        return true;
    }

    public boolean isVanished(UUID uuid) {
        return vanished.containsKey(uuid);
    }

    public void refreshFor(Player viewer) {
        for (UUID vanishedId : vanished.keySet()) {
            Player hidden = plugin.getServer().getPlayer(vanishedId);
            if (hidden != null && !Objects.equals(hidden.getUniqueId(), viewer.getUniqueId())) {
                plugin.platform().onEntity(viewer, () -> viewer.hidePlayer(plugin, hidden));
            }
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void disable() {
        if (flushTask != null) {
            flushTask.cancel(false);
            flushTask = null;
        }
        // The worker is still alive; shutdown waits for it, so the final
        // journal write does not have to block the server thread.
        plugin.worker().execute(this::write);
        List<UUID> active = new ArrayList<>(vanished.keySet());
        for (UUID uuid : active) {
            Player watcher = plugin.getServer().getPlayer(uuid);
            if (watcher != null) {
                leaveVanish(watcher);
            }
        }
    }

    public void forgetWatcher(UUID uuid) {
        vanished.remove(uuid);
    }

    /** Hides a vanished staff member from everybody else.
     *
     *  <p>Each player's visibility list is that player's own, so each change
     *  goes to that player's own thread. On Paper that is the main thread and
     *  the loop runs exactly as it always did. */
    private void hideFromOthers(Player watcher) {
        for (Player online : plugin.getServer().getOnlinePlayers()) {
            if (online.getUniqueId().equals(watcher.getUniqueId())) {
                continue;
            }
            plugin.platform().onEntity(online, () -> online.hidePlayer(plugin, watcher));
        }
    }

    private void showToOthers(Player watcher) {
        for (Player online : plugin.getServer().getOnlinePlayers()) {
            if (online.getUniqueId().equals(watcher.getUniqueId())) {
                continue;
            }
            plugin.platform().onEntity(online, () -> online.showPlayer(plugin, watcher));
        }
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/me/everyone/oculusai/storage/Storage.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.storage;

import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;
import me.everyone.oculusai.core.Service;

public final class Storage implements Service {

    private final DatasetStore datasets;
    private final HistoryStore history;
    private final JournalStore journal;

    public Storage(OculusAI plugin) {
        this.datasets = new DatasetStore(plugin);
        this.history = new HistoryStore(plugin);
        this.journal = new JournalStore(plugin);
    }

    @Override
    public void enable() {
        datasets.enable();
        history.enable();
        journal.enable();
    }

    @Override
    public void disable() {
        journal.disable();
        history.disable();
        datasets.disable();
    }

    public DatasetStore datasets() {
        return datasets;
    }

    public HistoryStore history() {
        return history;
    }

    public JournalStore journal() {
        return journal;
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/me/everyone/oculusai/storage/replay/ReplayFrame.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.storage.replay;

import java.util.List;

/** One tick of a replay: where the suspect was, what stood around them, and
 *  what landed.
 *
 *  <p>Frames are taken on the tick loop and kept in a ring buffer, so they
 *  have to be cheap to make and cheap to hold: a few hundred of them exist
 *  per player at any moment. Everything here is therefore primitives and
 *  immutable lists - no Bukkit handles. A frame holding a {@code Player}
 *  would pin a disconnected player's whole entity for as long as the buffer
 *  remembered them, and a frame holding a {@code Location} would be read at
 *  upload time rather than at capture time, which is the one thing a replay
 *  must never do: the point is what the world looked like *then*. */
public record ReplayFrame(int tick,
                          double x, double y, double z,
                          float yaw, float pitch,
                          int flags,
                          double probability, double buffer,
                          List<Actor> actors,
                          List<Hit> hits) {

    /** Sprinting, sneaking, on the ground, in water - packed because a frame
     *  is written 20 times a second and four booleans is four more fields in
     *  the JSON for every one of them. */
    public static final int FLAG_SPRINTING = 1;
    public static final int FLAG_SNEAKING = 1 << 1;
    public static final int FLAG_ON_GROUND = 1 << 2;
    public static final int FLAG_IN_WATER = 1 << 3;

    /** Anything near the suspect that moves: other players, crystals,
     *  projectiles, mobs.
     *
     *  @param id    the server's entity id, which is also how a {@link Hit}
     *               names its attacker and its victim
     *  @param type  index into the replay's type table, not a string: the
     *               same twenty words would otherwise be repeated in every
     *               frame of every actor
     *  @param health 0 for anything that has none */
    public record Actor(int id, int type, double x, double y, double z,
                        float yaw, float pitch, double health) {
    }

    /** One blow inside this tick. {@code crit} is the server's own judgement,
     *  not a guess from the fall distance: a replay that disagreed with the
     *  damage the server applied would be worse than no replay. */
    public record Hit(int attacker, int victim, boolean crit, double damage) {
    }
}

```

`src/main/java/me/everyone/oculusai/storage/replay/ReplayListener.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.storage.replay;

import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;
import org.bukkit.entity.Entity;
import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
import org.bukkit.event.EventHandler;
import org.bukkit.event.EventPriority;
import org.bukkit.event.Listener;
import org.bukkit.event.entity.EntityDamageByEntityEvent;

/** Feeds blows into the replay buffers.
 *
 *  <p>Positions come off the tick sampler, but a hit is an event and a tick
 *  is not: a blow landing between two frames would be missing from both.
 *  This records it against the tick it is drained on, which is the next one.
 *
 *  <p>Both ends of a blow are recorded. A replay is about a suspect, and
 *  whether they were the one hitting or the one being hit is exactly what
 *  somebody watching needs to see - a reach kick on a player who was being
 *  beaten by three people looks very different from one on a player who was
 *  chasing someone down.
 *
 *  <p>MONITOR and {@code ignoreCancelled}: a hit another plugin cancelled
 *  never happened as far as the server is concerned, and a replay showing
 *  blows that did not land would be a replay that disagrees with the damage
 *  the server applied. The anticheat's own checks cancel hits, so this is not
 *  hypothetical.
 */
final class ReplayListener implements Listener {

    private final OculusAI plugin;

    ReplayListener(OculusAI plugin) {
        this.plugin = plugin;
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.MONITOR, ignoreCancelled = true)
    public void onDamage(EntityDamageByEntityEvent event) {
        Entity damager = event.getDamager();
        Entity victim = event.getEntity();
        ReplayFrame.Hit hit = new ReplayFrame.Hit(damager.getEntityId(), victim.getEntityId(),
                crit(damager), event.getFinalDamage());

        if (damager instanceof Player attacker) {
            plugin.replays().note(attacker.getUniqueId(), hit);
        }
        if (victim instanceof Player hurt) {
            plugin.replays().note(hurt.getUniqueId(), hit);
        }
    }

    /** The same rule {@code AttackMoment} applies, so a replay and a feature
     *  row never disagree about whether a blow was critical. */
    private boolean crit(Entity damager) {
        return damager instanceof Player player
                && player.getFallDistance() > 0.0F
                && !player.isOnGround()
                && !player.isSprinting();
    }
}

```

`src/main/java/me/everyone/oculusai/storage/replay/ReplayRecorder.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.storage.replay;

import com.google.gson.JsonArray;
import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
import java.util.ArrayDeque;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Deque;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentLinkedQueue;
import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;
import me.everyone.oculusai.core.Platform;
import me.everyone.oculusai.core.Service;
import me.everyone.oculusai.core.TickLoop;
import me.everyone.oculusai.player.PlayerData;
import org.bukkit.Location;
import org.bukkit.entity.Entity;
import org.bukkit.entity.LivingEntity;
import org.bukkit.World;
import org.bukkit.entity.Player;

/** The last few seconds before a punishment, kept so somebody can watch them.
 *
 *  <p>A buffer and a probability are an argument nobody can check. This keeps
 *  a ring buffer of ticks per suspect - where they were, where they were
 *  looking, what stood around them, what landed - and when the punishment
 *  fires it freezes the buffer, takes one snapshot of the terrain and sends
 *  the lot to the service, which holds it for a day. The panel replays it.
 *
 *  <p>Three rules keep this from being a performance problem:
 *
 *  <ul>
 *    <li>only players actually in combat are recorded. Out of a fight there is
 *        nothing to see and nothing that will ever be punished, so an idle
 *        server records nobody at all;</li>
 *    <li>the buffer is bounded by time, not by events: {@code seconds * 20}
 *        frames, oldest dropped, so memory per suspect is fixed and known;</li>
 *    <li>the terrain - the only expensive read - happens once per punishment,
 *        not once per tick. Everything else in a frame is a field read off an
 *        entity that the server has already ticked.</li>
 *  </ul>
 *
 *  <p>Nothing here ever blocks the main thread on the network: the JSON is
 *  built on the owning thread (it must be - it reads entities) and handed to
 *  the HTTP worker.
 */
public final class ReplayRecorder implements Service {

    /** How many actors one frame may name. A frame is written twenty times a
     *  second; a hundred mobs in a farm would be a hundred rows twenty times
     *  a second, and the nearest two dozen are the ones a replay is about. */
    private static final int MAX_ACTORS = 24;
    /** The format the service and the viewer agree on. Bumped when the shape
     *  changes, never reused: an old viewer must be able to tell that it does
     *  not understand a new replay rather than draw it wrong. */
    private static final int FORMAT_VERSION = 1;

    private final OculusAI plugin;
    private final Map<UUID, Deque<ReplayFrame>> buffers = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    /** Blows seen by the listener since the last frame, per suspect. The
     *  listener runs on the server's own event thread and the sampler drains
     *  this on the tick loop, so it has to be a queue rather than a list. */
    private final Map<UUID, ConcurrentLinkedQueue<ReplayFrame.Hit>> pending =
            new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private final Map<UUID, Integer> ticks = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    /** Folia only: one sampler per player, on the thread that owns them. */
    private final Map<UUID, Platform.Cancellable> followers = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private TickLoop.Handle task;

    public ReplayRecorder(OculusAI plugin) {
        this.plugin = plugin;
    }

    @Override
    public void enable() {
        if (!plugin.config().replayEnabled()) {
            return;
        }
        plugin.getServer().getPluginManager().registerEvents(new ReplayListener(plugin), plugin);
        // Same split as EntityTracker: on Paper one task reads every player,
        // on Folia a player may only be read from the thread that owns them.
        if (plugin.platform().folia()) {
            for (Player player : plugin.getServer().getOnlinePlayers()) {
                follow(player);
            }
            return;
        }
        task = plugin.ticks().every(1L, this::sampleAll);
    }

    @Override
    public void disable() {
        if (task != null) {
            task.cancel();
            task = null;
        }
        followers.values().forEach(Platform.Cancellable::cancel);
        followers.clear();
        buffers.clear();
        pending.clear();
        ticks.clear();
    }

    @Override
    public void reload() {
        disable();
        enable();
    }

    /** Starts sampling one player on their own thread. Does nothing off
     *  Folia, where the single sweep already covers them. */
    public void follow(Player player) {
        if (!plugin.config().replayEnabled() || !plugin.platform().folia() || player == null) {
            return;
        }
        Platform.Cancellable existing = followers.remove(player.getUniqueId());
        if (existing != null) {
            existing.cancel();
        }
        followers.put(player.getUniqueId(),
                plugin.platform().entityRepeating(player, 1L, 1L, () -> sample(player)));
    }

    public void unfollow(Player player) {
        if (player == null) {
            return;
        }
        Platform.Cancellable existing = followers.remove(player.getUniqueId());
        if (existing != null) {
            existing.cancel();
        }
    }

    /** Drops everything remembered about a player. Called when they leave and
     *  when an operator forgets them: a replay is evidence about a suspicion,
     *  and a suspicion that has been cleared should leave nothing behind. */
    public void forget(UUID uuid) {
        buffers.remove(uuid);
        pending.remove(uuid);
        ticks.remove(uuid);
    }

    /** Records one blow. Called from the listener, on whatever thread the
     *  server fired the damage event on. */
    void note(UUID suspect, ReplayFrame.Hit hit) {
        if (!plugin.config().replayEnabled() || !buffers.containsKey(suspect)) {
            // Nothing is being recorded for this player - they are not in a
            // fight as far as the sampler is concerned - so the blow has
            // nowhere to go. Keeping it would mean an unbounded map of hits
            // for players nobody is watching.
            return;
        }
        pending.computeIfAbsent(suspect, id -> new ConcurrentLinkedQueue<>()).add(hit);
    }

    private void sampleAll() {
        for (PlayerData data : plugin.data().all()) {
            Player player = data.player();
            if (player != null && player.isOnline()) {
                sample(player);
            }
        }
    }

    private void sample(Player player) {
        PlayerData data = plugin.data().get(player);
        if (data == null || !player.isOnline()) {
            return;
        }
        // Out of combat there is nothing worth keeping, and a cleared buffer
        // means whatever was kept no longer describes a suspect. Both halves
        // matter: the first stops an idle server recording anything, the
        // second stops a fight from an hour ago being the one in the file.
        if (!data.inCombat(plugin.config().replayCombatMs())) {
            if (buffers.remove(player.getUniqueId()) != null) {
                pending.remove(player.getUniqueId());
                ticks.remove(player.getUniqueId());
            }
            return;
        }
        if (plugin.bypass().isBypassed(player)) {
            return;
        }

        UUID uuid = player.getUniqueId();
        int frames = Math.max(20, plugin.config().replaySeconds() * 20);
        Deque<ReplayFrame> buffer = buffers.computeIfAbsent(uuid, id -> new ArrayDeque<>());
        int tick = ticks.merge(uuid, 1, Integer::sum);

        Location where = player.getLocation();
        int flags = 0;
        if (player.isSprinting()) flags |= ReplayFrame.FLAG_SPRINTING;
        if (player.isSneaking()) flags |= ReplayFrame.FLAG_SNEAKING;
        if (player.isOnGround()) flags |= ReplayFrame.FLAG_ON_GROUND;
        if (player.getLocation().getBlock().isLiquid()) flags |= ReplayFrame.FLAG_IN_WATER;

        ReplayFrame frame = new ReplayFrame(tick,
                where.getX(), where.getY(), where.getZ(),
                where.getYaw(), where.getPitch(), flags,
                data.probability(), data.buffer(),
                actors(player), drain(uuid));

        synchronized (buffer) {
            buffer.addLast(frame);
            while (buffer.size() > frames) {
                buffer.removeFirst();
            }
        }
    }

    private List<ReplayFrame.Hit> drain(UUID uuid) {
        ConcurrentLinkedQueue<ReplayFrame.Hit> queue = pending.get(uuid);
        if (queue == null || queue.isEmpty()) {
            return List.of();
        }
        List<ReplayFrame.Hit> hits = new ArrayList<>(2);
        ReplayFrame.Hit hit;
        while ((hit = queue.poll()) != null) {
            hits.add(hit);
        }
        return List.copyOf(hits);
    }

    /** What stood near the suspect this tick.
     *
     *  <p>{@code getNearbyEntities} is a scan of the chunks around the player,
     *  which is why only players in combat get one and why the radius is the
     *  scene's radius rather than something generous. On Folia an entity at a
     *  region border can refuse to be read at all; a frame without actors is
     *  worth more than no replay, so that is caught and the frame goes out
     *  with the suspect alone in it. */
    private List<ReplayFrame.Actor> actors(Player player) {
        double radius = plugin.config().replayRadius();
        List<ReplayFrame.Actor> actors = new ArrayList<>();
        try {
            for (Entity entity : player.getNearbyEntities(radius, radius, radius)) {
                if (actors.size() >= MAX_ACTORS) {
                    break;
                }
                Location at = entity.getLocation();
                double health = entity instanceof LivingEntity living ? living.getHealth() : 0.0D;
                actors.add(new ReplayFrame.Actor(entity.getEntityId(),
                        types.index(entity.getType().name()),
                        at.getX(), at.getY(), at.getZ(),
                        at.getYaw(), at.getPitch(), health));
            }
        } catch (RuntimeException crossRegion) {
            // Folia, almost certainly. Nothing to do about it and nothing
            // worth logging twenty times a second.
            return List.of();
        }
        return List.copyOf(actors);
    }

    /** Entity type names, shared by every frame of every replay this run.
     *  The table travels with the replay, so an index means the same thing a
     *  day later when the panel reads it back. */
    private final TypeTable types = new TypeTable();

    private static final class TypeTable {

        private final Map<String, Integer> indices = new LinkedHashMap<>();

        synchronized int index(String name) {
            Integer known = indices.get(name);
            if (known != null) {
                return known;
            }
            int next = indices.size();
            indices.put(name, next);
            return next;
        }

        synchronized JsonArray toJson() {
            JsonArray array = new JsonArray();
            indices.keySet().forEach(array::add);
            return array;
        }
    }

    /** Freezes what is buffered for this player and sends it up.
     *
     *  <p>Called from the punishment path, before the send-off strips or kills
     *  anybody: the scene has to be the one that got them punished, not the
     *  one the punishment left behind. Does its reading on the owning thread
     *  and its sending on the HTTP worker. */
    public void capture(PlayerData data, String kind) {
        if (!plugin.config().replayEnabled()) {
            return;
        }
        Player player = data.player();
        if (player == null || !player.isOnline()) {
            return;
        }
        Deque<ReplayFrame> buffer = buffers.get(data.uuid());
        if (buffer == null) {
            return;
        }
        List<ReplayFrame> frozen;
        synchronized (buffer) {
            if (buffer.isEmpty()) {
                return;
            }
            frozen = List.copyOf(buffer);
        }

        plugin.platform().onEntity(player, () -> {
            JsonObject payload = build(data, player, kind, frozen);
            if (payload == null) {
                return;
            }
            plugin.api().uploadReplay(payload).thenAccept(answer -> {
                if (answer == null) {
                    plugin.getLogger().warning("Replay for " + data.name()
                            + " was not accepted by the service");
                    return;
                }
                String id = answer.has("id") ? answer.get("id").getAsString() : "";
                plugin.getLogger().info("Replay of " + data.name() + " stored as " + id);
            });
        });
    }

    private JsonObject build(PlayerData data, Player player, String kind,
                             List<ReplayFrame> frames) {
        JsonObject out = new JsonObject();
        out.addProperty("format", FORMAT_VERSION);
        out.addProperty("player", data.name());
        out.addProperty("uuid", data.uuid().toString());
        out.addProperty("kind", kind);
        out.addProperty("probability", round(data.probability(), 4));
        out.addProperty("buffer", round(data.buffer(), 3));
        out.addProperty("at", System.currentTimeMillis());
        out.addProperty("world", player.getWorld().getName());
        out.addProperty("radius", plugin.config().replayRadius());
        out.addProperty("self_id", player.getEntityId());

        try {
            // Every position the suspect was in, so the ground is captured
            // along the whole path rather than around the one spot they
            // happened to be standing on when the punishment fired.
            List<double[]> path = new ArrayList<>(frames.size());
            for (ReplayFrame frame : frames) {
                path.add(new double[]{frame.x(), frame.y(), frame.z()});
            }
            path.add(new double[]{player.getLocation().getX(),
                    player.getLocation().getY(), player.getLocation().getZ()});
            // On Folia, whatever of the path this thread owns. Off it, every
            // loaded chunk, which is what the filter answering null means.
            World world = player.getWorld();
            SceneCapture.ChunkFilter readable = plugin.platform().folia()
                    ? (chunkX, chunkZ) -> plugin.platform().owns(world, chunkX, chunkZ)
                    : null;
            JsonObject terrain = SceneCapture.terrain(world, path,
                    plugin.config().replayRadius(), readable);
            if (terrain != null) {
                out.add("terrain", terrain);
            }
        } catch (RuntimeException unreadable) {
            // A region boundary on Folia, or a world unloaded between the
            // punishment and this call. The frames are still worth having.
            plugin.getLogger().fine("Replay terrain for " + data.name()
                    + " could not be read: " + unreadable.getMessage());
        }

        JsonArray rows = new JsonArray();
        for (ReplayFrame frame : frames) {
            rows.add(frameJson(frame));
        }
        out.add("frames", rows);
        out.add("types", types.toJson());
        out.add("names", names(player, frames));

        int limit = plugin.config().replayMaxKb() * 1024;
        String encoded = out.toString();
        if (encoded.length() <= limit) {
            return out;
        }
        // Over the cap. The terrain is the biggest single thing and the least
        // important - the frames are the evidence - so it goes first, and
        // only then are frames trimmed from the front. Dropping the oldest
        // keeps the moment of the kick, which is the end.
        out.remove("terrain");
        while (out.toString().length() > limit && rows.size() > 20) {
            rows.remove(0);
        }
        if (out.toString().length() > limit) {
            plugin.getLogger().warning("Replay of " + data.name()
                    + " is over " + plugin.config().replayMaxKb() + " KB even trimmed; dropped");
            return null;
        }
        return out;
    }

    private JsonObject frameJson(ReplayFrame frame) {
        JsonObject out = new JsonObject();
        out.addProperty("t", frame.tick());
        JsonArray self = new JsonArray();
        self.add(round(frame.x(), 3));
        self.add(round(frame.y(), 3));
        self.add(round(frame.z(), 3));
        self.add(round(frame.yaw(), 2));
        self.add(round(frame.pitch(), 2));
        self.add(frame.flags());
        out.add("s", self);
        out.addProperty("p", round(frame.probability(), 4));
        out.addProperty("b", round(frame.buffer(), 3));

        if (!frame.actors().isEmpty()) {
            JsonArray actors = new JsonArray();
            for (ReplayFrame.Actor actor : frame.actors()) {
                JsonArray row = new JsonArray();
                row.add(actor.id());
                row.add(actor.type());
                row.add(round(actor.x(), 3));
                row.add(round(actor.y(), 3));
                row.add(round(actor.z(), 3));
                row.add(round(actor.yaw(), 2));
                row.add(round(actor.pitch(), 2));
                row.add(round(actor.health(), 1));
                actors.add(row);
            }
            out.add("a", actors);
        }

        if (!frame.hits().isEmpty()) {
            JsonArray hits = new JsonArray();
            for (ReplayFrame.Hit hit : frame.hits()) {
                JsonArray row = new JsonArray();
                row.add(hit.attacker());
                row.add(hit.victim());
                row.add(hit.crit() ? 1 : 0);
                row.add(round(hit.damage(), 2));
                hits.add(row);
            }
            out.add("h", hits);
        }
        return out;
    }

    /** Entity id to a name, for the ids that actually appear in the replay.
     *
     *  <p>Only players and named entities get one: the viewer labels a mob by
     *  its type, and a nameplate over every zombie in the scene would say
     *  nothing. Resolved from the live server, so an entity that died during
     *  the eight seconds is left unnamed rather than guessed at. */
    private JsonObject names(Player suspect, List<ReplayFrame> frames) {
        JsonObject out = new JsonObject();
        out.addProperty(Integer.toString(suspect.getEntityId()), suspect.getName());
        java.util.Set<Integer> seen = new java.util.HashSet<>();
        for (ReplayFrame frame : frames) {
            for (ReplayFrame.Actor actor : frame.actors()) {
                if (!seen.add(actor.id())) {
                    continue;
                }
                Player named = playerById(actor.id());
                if (named != null) {
                    out.addProperty(Integer.toString(actor.id()), named.getName());
                }
            }
        }
        return out;
    }

    private Player playerById(int entityId) {
        for (PlayerData data : plugin.data().all()) {
            if (data.entityId() == entityId) {
                return data.player();
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    private static double round(double value, int places) {
        if (Double.isNaN(value) || Double.isInfinite(value)) {
            return 0.0D;
        }
        double factor = Math.pow(10, places);
        return Math.round(value * factor) / factor;
    }
}

```

`src/main/java/me/everyone/oculusai/storage/replay/SceneCapture.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.storage.replay;

import com.google.gson.JsonArray;
import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
import java.lang.reflect.Method;
import org.bukkit.World;
import org.bukkit.block.Block;

/** The cube of blocks around a suspect, taken once.
 *
 *  <p>The terrain is the expensive half of a replay and the half that barely
 *  changes, so it is read exactly once - at the moment the punishment fires -
 *  rather than per frame. A 21x21x21 cube is 9261 blocks; stored as a
 *  material name each that is around 300 KB of JSON, which is why it goes out
 *  as a palette plus run lengths instead. Combat happens in the open, so the
 *  cube is mostly air and mostly one stone: the same capture comes to a few
 *  kilobytes.
 *
 *  <p>Read on the thread that owns the player, and only from chunks that are
 *  already loaded: pulling a chunk off disk to draw the scenery would stall
 *  the server for a picture nobody has asked to see yet. A missing chunk is
 *  written as air, which is what the viewer should show - we genuinely do not
 *  know what was there.
 *
 *  <p>On Folia the same applies to a chunk belonging to another region: the
 *  thread that owns the suspect may not read it. A fight that crossed a
 *  region boundary is therefore captured as far as the suspect's own region
 *  reaches, which for any fight that was a fight is all of it - and the
 *  frames, which are the evidence, are complete regardless. */
final class SceneCapture {

    /** Resolved once. 1.16's Bukkit has no getMinHeight: the API arrived in
     *  1.17, and {@code src/main} is compiled into both jars. Reflection here
     *  keeps the 1.21 jar reading its negative world floor while the 1.16 one
     *  carries on assuming zero, without a third source tree for one call. */
    private static final Method MIN_HEIGHT = minHeightMethod();

    private SceneCapture() {
    }

    private static Method minHeightMethod() {
        try {
            return World.class.getMethod("getMinHeight");
        } catch (NoSuchMethodException older) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    static int minHeight(World world) {
        if (MIN_HEIGHT == null) {
            return 0;
        }
        try {
            return (int) MIN_HEIGHT.invoke(world);
        } catch (ReflectiveOperationException | ClassCastException unexpected) {
            return 0;
        }
    }

    /** How many blocks one capture may read.
     *
     *  <p>This is a main-thread read, once per punishment, and the figure is
     *  what keeps a fight that crossed half a continent from stalling the
     *  server. A quarter of a million blocks is a box of roughly 60 by 60 by
     *  60, which covers any fight that was actually a fight. */
    private static final int MAX_BLOCKS = 250_000;

    /** The ground the suspect fought over, as the replay format carries it.
     *
     *  <p>Not a cube around one point. The capture used to be taken around
     *  wherever the player happened to be standing when the punishment fired,
     *  so a fight that moved - which is every fight - was replayed against
     *  the scenery of its last second, with the first six played out over
     *  empty air. The box is the whole path the suspect took during the
     *  recording, grown by the radius in every direction, so the ground is
     *  under them the whole way.
     *
     *  @param points every position in the recording, as {x, y, z}
     *  @param radius how far around the path to take */
    static JsonObject terrain(World world, java.util.List<double[]> points, int radius) {
        return terrain(world, points, radius, null);
    }

    /** The same, told which chunks the calling thread may read.
     *
     *  @param readable answers whether a chunk is this thread's to read, or
     *                  null when every loaded chunk is - which is Paper, and
     *                  was the only case this used to handle. On Folia the
     *                  path can cross a region boundary, and the capture used
     *                  to throw there and be dropped whole: a fight is now
     *                  captured as far as this thread owns it and the rest is
     *                  written as air, the same as an unloaded chunk. */
    static JsonObject terrain(World world, java.util.List<double[]> points, int radius,
                              ChunkFilter readable) {
        if (points.isEmpty()) {
            return null;
        }
        double minX = Double.MAX_VALUE, minY = Double.MAX_VALUE, minZ = Double.MAX_VALUE;
        double maxX = -Double.MAX_VALUE, maxY = -Double.MAX_VALUE, maxZ = -Double.MAX_VALUE;
        for (double[] point : points) {
            minX = Math.min(minX, point[0]);
            minY = Math.min(minY, point[1]);
            minZ = Math.min(minZ, point[2]);
            maxX = Math.max(maxX, point[0]);
            maxY = Math.max(maxY, point[1]);
            maxZ = Math.max(maxZ, point[2]);
        }

        int floor = minHeight(world);
        int ceiling = world.getMaxHeight();
        int originX = (int) Math.floor(minX) - radius;
        int originZ = (int) Math.floor(minZ) - radius;
        // One extra below: a player standing on a block is at its top face,
        // and without this the floor they were standing on is outside the box.
        int originY = Math.max(floor, (int) Math.floor(minY) - radius - 1);

        int sizeX = (int) Math.floor(maxX) + radius - originX + 1;
        int sizeY = Math.min(ceiling - originY, (int) Math.floor(maxY) + radius - originY + 2);
        int sizeZ = (int) Math.floor(maxZ) + radius - originZ + 1;
        sizeX = Math.max(1, sizeX);
        sizeY = Math.max(1, sizeY);
        sizeZ = Math.max(1, sizeZ);

        // A teleport, a fall down a shaft or an hour-long chase can make the
        // path box enormous. Rather than refuse to capture, the box is pulled
        // back towards the last position the suspect was in - the end of a
        // recording is the part that got them punished.
        if ((long) sizeX * sizeY * sizeZ > MAX_BLOCKS) {
            double[] last = points.get(points.size() - 1);
            int side = Math.max(radius * 2 + 1, (int) Math.cbrt(MAX_BLOCKS));
            originX = (int) Math.floor(last[0]) - side / 2;
            originZ = (int) Math.floor(last[2]) - side / 2;
            originY = Math.max(floor, (int) Math.floor(last[1]) - side / 2);
            sizeX = side;
            sizeZ = side;
            sizeY = Math.max(1, Math.min(side, ceiling - originY));
        }

        Palette palette = new Palette();
        Runs runs = new Runs();
        // x, then y, then z: the viewer walks the runs in this order, so the
        // two sides have to agree on it and nothing else about the layout.
        for (int dx = 0; dx < sizeX; dx++) {
            for (int dy = 0; dy < sizeY; dy++) {
                for (int dz = 0; dz < sizeZ; dz++) {
                    int x = originX + dx;
                    int y = originY + dy;
                    int z = originZ + dz;
                    runs.add(y >= ceiling ? 0
                            : palette.index(materialAt(world, x, y, z, readable)));
                }
            }
        }
        runs.finish();

        JsonObject out = new JsonObject();
        JsonArray dimensions = new JsonArray();
        dimensions.add(sizeX);
        dimensions.add(sizeY);
        dimensions.add(sizeZ);
        out.add("size", dimensions);
        JsonObject origin = new JsonObject();
        origin.addProperty("x", originX);
        origin.addProperty("y", originY);
        origin.addProperty("z", originZ);
        out.add("origin", origin);
        out.add("palette", palette.toJson());
        out.add("runs", runs.toJson());
        return out;
    }

    private static String materialAt(World world, int x, int y, int z, ChunkFilter readable) {
        if (!world.isChunkLoaded(x >> 4, z >> 4)) {
            return "AIR";
        }
        if (readable != null && !readable.readable(x >> 4, z >> 4)) {
            return "AIR";
        }
        Block block = world.getBlockAt(x, y, z);
        return block.getType().name();
    }

    /** Whether one chunk is the calling thread's to read. */
    interface ChunkFilter {
        boolean readable(int chunkX, int chunkZ);
    }

    /** Material names in first-seen order, with air pinned at zero so an
     *  all-air cube is one run of one index. */
    private static final class Palette {

        private final java.util.Map<String, Integer> indices = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();

        private Palette() {
            indices.put("AIR", 0);
        }

        int index(String material) {
            Integer known = indices.get(material);
            if (known != null) {
                return known;
            }
            int next = indices.size();
            indices.put(material, next);
            return next;
        }

        JsonArray toJson() {
            JsonArray array = new JsonArray();
            indices.keySet().forEach(array::add);
            return array;
        }
    }

    /** Run-length encoding as flat pairs: count, index, count, index. Flat
     *  rather than nested arrays because this is the one part of a replay
     *  with thousands of entries in it, and {@code [12,0,3,1]} is half the
     *  bytes of {@code [[12,0],[3,1]]}. */
    private static final class Runs {

        private final JsonArray array = new JsonArray();
        private int current = -1;
        private int count;

        void add(int index) {
            if (index == current) {
                count++;
                return;
            }
            finish();
            current = index;
            count = 1;
        }

        void finish() {
            if (count > 0) {
                array.add(count);
                array.add(current);
                count = 0;
            }
        }

        JsonArray toJson() {
            return array;
        }
    }
}
```
