```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.ui;


import me.everyone.oculusai.core.Service;
import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;
import me.everyone.oculusai.storage.HistorySort;
import me.everyone.oculusai.player.PlayerData;
import me.everyone.oculusai.ui.menu.ChecksMenu;
import me.everyone.oculusai.ui.menu.DashboardMenu;
import me.everyone.oculusai.ui.menu.HistoryMenu;
import me.everyone.oculusai.ui.menu.JournalMenu;
import me.everyone.oculusai.ui.gui.Menu;
import me.everyone.oculusai.ui.menu.SessionsMenu;
import me.everyone.oculusai.ui.menu.SettingsMenu;
import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
import org.bukkit.event.EventHandler;
import org.bukkit.event.Listener;
import org.bukkit.event.inventory.InventoryClickEvent;
import org.bukkit.event.inventory.InventoryDragEvent;
import org.bukkit.inventory.InventoryHolder;

public final class Menus implements Service, Listener {

    private final OculusAI plugin;
    private volatile JsonObject lastStatus;
    private volatile JsonObject lastSessions;
    private final Map<UUID, HistorySort> historySorts = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

    public Menus(OculusAI plugin) {
        this.plugin = plugin;
    }

    @Override
    public void disable() {
        historySorts.clear();
    }

    @Override
    public void enable() {
        plugin.getServer().getPluginManager().registerEvents(this, plugin);
    }

    public void openDashboard(Player player) {
        plugin.mainThread().run(
                () -> new DashboardMenu(plugin, player).open());
    }

    public void openSettings(Player player) {
        plugin.mainThread().run(
                () -> new SettingsMenu(plugin, player).open());
    }

    /** The registered-check list opened by /oai checks and the dashboard. */
    public void openChecks(Player player) {
        plugin.mainThread().run(
                () -> new ChecksMenu(plugin, player).open());
    }

    public void refreshStatus(Player player, Menu menu) {
        plugin.datasets().status().thenAccept(status -> {
            lastStatus = status;
            plugin.mainThread().run( menu::refresh);
        });
    }

    public void openSessions(Player player) {
        plugin.api().sessions().thenAccept(sessions -> {
            lastSessions = sessions;
            plugin.mainThread().run(
                    () -> new SessionsMenu(plugin, player).open());
        });
    }

    public void refreshSessions(Player player, Menu menu) {
        plugin.api().sessions().thenAccept(sessions -> {
            lastSessions = sessions;
            plugin.mainThread().run( menu::refresh);
        });
    }

    public void openJournal(Player player) {
        plugin.mainThread().run(
                () -> new JournalMenu(plugin, player).open());
    }

    public void openHistory(Player viewer, PlayerData target) {
        openHistory(viewer, target.uuid(), target.name());
    }

    public void openHistory(Player viewer, UUID targetId, String targetName) {
        // Read the stored record on the worker first. The menu itself is
        // built on the main thread, but every history call after this finds
        // the record in memory.
        plugin.worker().execute(() -> {
            plugin.history().preload(targetId, targetName);
            plugin.mainThread().run(
                    () -> new HistoryMenu(plugin, viewer, targetId, targetName, 0).open());
        });
    }

    public HistorySort historySort(UUID viewer) {
        return historySorts.getOrDefault(viewer, HistorySort.FRESHNESS);
    }

    public void setHistorySort(UUID viewer, HistorySort sort) {
        historySorts.put(viewer, sort);
    }

    public JsonObject lastStatus() {
        return lastStatus;
    }

    public JsonObject lastSessions() {
        return lastSessions;
    }

    @EventHandler
    public void onClick(InventoryClickEvent event) {
        InventoryHolder holder = event.getInventory().getHolder();
        if (!(holder instanceof Menu menu)) {
            return;
        }
        event.setCancelled(true);
        if (event.getClickedInventory() != event.getInventory()) {
            return;
        }
        menu.handleClick(event);
    }

    @EventHandler
    public void onDrag(InventoryDragEvent event) {
        if (event.getInventory().getHolder() instanceof Menu) {
            event.setCancelled(true);
        }
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/me/everyone/oculusai/ui/Monitor.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.ui;


import me.everyone.oculusai.core.Service;
import me.everyone.oculusai.core.TickLoop;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;
import me.everyone.oculusai.player.PlayerData;
import me.everyone.oculusai.core.Msg;
import org.bukkit.command.CommandSender;
import org.bukkit.entity.Player;

public final class Monitor implements Service {

    public static final int PERIOD_TICKS = 20;

    private static final int HEADER_EVERY = 15;

    private static final int MAX_ROWS = 12;

    private static final String CONSOLE = "console";
    /** A tiny state file rather than config.yml: saving Bukkit's config on
     *  every toggle rewrites the file and can drop its comments. */
    private static final String STATE_FILE = "monitor.state";

    private static final class Session {
        private final String id;
        private final CommandSender sender;
        private final List<String> names;
        private final boolean crystal;
        private int lines;

        private Session(String id, CommandSender sender, List<String> names, boolean crystal) {
            this.id = id;
            this.sender = sender;
            this.names = names;
            this.crystal = crystal;
        }
    }

    private final OculusAI plugin;
    private final Map<String, Session> sessions = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private TickLoop.Handle task;
    /** Everybody who asked for the watch over all of pvp, by player UUID or
     *  {@link #CONSOLE}. Each of them gets the frames and nobody else does:
     *  /oai monitor is a private feed per operator, not a staff broadcast and
     *  not a single feed two admins have to fight over. */
    private final Set<String> globalWatchers = ConcurrentHashMap.newKeySet();
    private final Map<UUID, Long> aimPrinted = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private final Map<UUID, Long> crystalPrinted = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

    public Monitor(OculusAI plugin) {
        this.plugin = plugin;
    }

    @Override
    public void enable() {
        loadGlobalWatchers();
        task = plugin.ticks().every(PERIOD_TICKS, this::tick);
    }

    @Override
    public void reload() {
        // /oai reload keeps the watch the operator turned on; the state file
        // is the source of truth, config.yml is the first-run default.
        loadGlobalWatchers();
    }

    /** Reads who was watching when the server last stopped: one recipient per
     *  line, either {@link #CONSOLE} or a player UUID. A line that is neither
     *  is skipped - older versions wrote a plain "on", which names nobody, and
     *  turning that into a console feed would spam a console that never asked
     *  for one. */
    private void loadGlobalWatchers() {
        globalWatchers.clear();
        Path state = plugin.getDataFolder().toPath().resolve(STATE_FILE);
        try {
            if (Files.isRegularFile(state)) {
                for (String line : Files.readAllLines(state, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
                    String value = line.trim();
                    if (value.isEmpty() || value.equals("off")) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    if (value.equals(CONSOLE)) {
                        globalWatchers.add(CONSOLE);
                        continue;
                    }
                    try {
                        globalWatchers.add(UUID.fromString(value).toString());
                    } catch (IllegalArgumentException notAWatcher) {
                        // An "on" from an older state file, or a hand-edit.
                    }
                }
                return;
            }
        } catch (IOException failure) {
            plugin.getLogger().log(java.util.logging.Level.WARNING,
                    "Could not read " + state + "; using monitor.enabled", failure);
        }
        if (plugin.config().monitorEnabled()) {
            globalWatchers.add(CONSOLE);
        }
    }

    private void saveGlobal() {
        Path state = plugin.getDataFolder().toPath().resolve(STATE_FILE);
        try {
            Files.createDirectories(state.getParent());
            String value = globalWatchers.isEmpty()
                    ? "off" : String.join("\n", new ArrayList<>(globalWatchers));
            Files.writeString(state, value + "\n", StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        } catch (IOException failure) {
            plugin.getLogger().log(java.util.logging.Level.WARNING,
                    "Could not save the monitor state to " + state, failure);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void disable() {
        if (task != null) {
            task.cancel();
            task = null;
        }
        sessions.clear();
        globalWatchers.clear();
        aimPrinted.clear();
        crystalPrinted.clear();
    }

    /** Whether anybody at all is on the watch over everybody. */
    public boolean globalWatching() {
        return !globalWatchers.isEmpty();
    }

    /** Whether this sender is. */
    public boolean globalWatching(CommandSender sender) {
        return globalWatchers.contains(idOf(sender));
    }

    /** Switches the watch over everybody on or off for this sender, and only
     *  for them. Returns their new state.
     *
     *  <p>Two admins watching at once is the normal case on a staffed server,
     *  so this is a per-operator subscription: one of them turning it off
     *  cannot turn it off for the other, and turning it on cannot take the
     *  feed away from them either. The list is saved, so a restart - or the
     *  operator reconnecting - does not quietly stop the watch. */
    public boolean toggleGlobal(CommandSender sender) {
        String id = idOf(sender);
        boolean on = !globalWatchers.remove(id);
        if (on) {
            globalWatchers.add(id);
        }
        saveGlobal();
        return on;
    }

    /** The console, an online player, or null when that id is nobody who can
     *  be written to right now. */
    private CommandSender senderOf(String id) {
        if (id == null) {
            return null;
        }
        if (id.equals(CONSOLE)) {
            return plugin.getServer().getConsoleSender();
        }
        Player player;
        try {
            player = plugin.getServer().getPlayer(UUID.fromString(id));
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException malformed) {
            return null;
        }
        return player != null && player.isOnline() ? player : null;
    }

    public static String idOf(CommandSender sender) {
        if (sender instanceof Player player) {
            return player.getUniqueId().toString();
        }
        return CONSOLE;
    }

    public boolean watching(CommandSender sender) {
        return sessions.containsKey(idOf(sender));
    }

    public int count() {
        return sessions.size();
    }

    public void start(CommandSender sender, List<String> names) {
        start(sender, names, false);
    }

    public void startCrystal(CommandSender sender, List<String> names) {
        start(sender, names, true);
    }

    private void start(CommandSender sender, List<String> names, boolean crystal) {
        Session session = new Session(idOf(sender), sender, List.copyOf(names), crystal);
        sessions.put(session.id, session);
    }

    public boolean toggleCrystal(CommandSender sender) {
        String id = idOf(sender);
        Session current = sessions.get(id);
        if (current != null && current.crystal) {
            sessions.remove(id);
            return false;
        }
        startCrystal(sender, List.of());
        return true;
    }

    public boolean stop(CommandSender sender) {
        return sessions.remove(idOf(sender)) != null;
    }

    public void forget(UUID uuid) {
        sessions.remove(uuid.toString());
        aimPrinted.remove(uuid);
        crystalPrinted.remove(uuid);
    }

    private void tick() {
        if (!globalWatchers.isEmpty()) {
            broadcastCombat();
        }
        for (Session session : new ArrayList<>(sessions.values())) {
            if (session.sender instanceof Player player && !player.isOnline()) {
                sessions.remove(session.id);
                continue;
            }
            String frame = frame(session);
            if (frame != null) {
                session.sender.sendMessage(frame);
                session.lines++;
            }
        }
    }

    /** Префикс античита, модель, ник и показание числом в цвете детекта. */
    private String pvpRow(PlayerData data) {
        double probability = shownProbability(data);
        String value = Double.isNaN(probability)
                ? "<dark_gray>-"
                : "<" + Msg.heatColour(probability) + ">" + Msg.probability(probability);
        return plugin.config().prefix() + Msg.parse(plugin.theme().resolveAccent(
                "<accent>" + modelName(data) + " <white>" + data.name() + " " + value));
    }

    /** One line per player and check for the latest new prediction. */
    private void broadcastCombat() {
        List<CommandSender> targets = new ArrayList<>();
        for (String id : globalWatchers) {
            CommandSender watcher = senderOf(id);
            if (watcher != null && watcher.hasPermission("oculusai.alerts")) {
                targets.add(watcher);
            }
        }
        if (targets.isEmpty()) {
            return;
        }
        long window = plugin.config().monitorPvpMs();
        List<String> lines = new ArrayList<>();
        for (PlayerData data : plugin.data().all()) {
            long at = data.lastProbabilityMs();
            if (at > 0L && data.inCombat(window)
                    && !Long.valueOf(at).equals(aimPrinted.put(data.uuid(), at))) {
                lines.add(aimRow(data));
            }
            var crystal = data.crystal().reading();
            if (Double.isFinite(crystal.probability())
                    && !Long.valueOf(crystal.sequence()).equals(crystalPrinted.put(data.uuid(), crystal.sequence()))) {
                lines.add("<accent>Crystal <white>" + data.name()
                        + " <gray>p <" + Msg.heatColour(crystal.probability()) + ">"
                        + Msg.probability(crystal.probability())
                        + " <gray>buf <white>" + Msg.round(crystal.buffer(), 1));
            }
        }
        if (lines.isEmpty()) {
            return;
        }
        String frame = Msg.parse(plugin.theme().resolveAccent(String.join("\n", lines)));
        for (CommandSender watcher : targets) {
            watcher.sendMessage(frame);
        }
    }

    private String aimRow(PlayerData data) {
        double smoothed = data.probability();
        double raw = data.rawProbability();
        return "<accent>Aim <white>" + data.name()
                + " <gray>p <" + Msg.heatColour(smoothed) + ">" + Msg.probability(smoothed)
                + " <gray>raw <" + Msg.heatColour(raw) + ">" + Msg.probability(raw)
                + " <gray>buf <white>" + Msg.round(data.buffer(), 1)
                + " <dark_gray>#" + data.windowsAnalysed();
    }

    /** Dev назначается конкретному игроку, остальные используют модель сервера. */
    private String modelName(PlayerData data) {
        if (!plugin.testServer().devModel(data.uuid()).isEmpty()) {
            return "Oculus Dev";
        }
        String active = plugin.api().activeModelName();
        if (!active.isBlank()) {
            return active.replace("<", "").replace(">", "");
        }
        String tier = plugin.api().serviceModel();
        if ("fast".equalsIgnoreCase(tier)) {
            return "Monolith Fast";
        }
        if ("pro".equalsIgnoreCase(tier)) {
            return "Monolith Pro";
        }
        return "Monolith";
    }

    private String frame(Session session) {
        List<PlayerData> rows = new ArrayList<>();
        if (session.names.isEmpty()) {
            for (PlayerData data : plugin.data().all()) {
                if (session.crystal
                        ? (!Double.isNaN(data.crystal().probability()) || data.crystal().buffer() > 0.0D)
                        : (data.windowsAnalysed() > 0 || data.buffer() > 0.0D)) {
                    rows.add(data);
                }
            }
        } else {
            for (String name : session.names) {
                PlayerData data = plugin.data().byName(name);
                if (data != null) {
                    rows.add(data);
                }
            }
        }
        rows.sort(session.crystal
                ? Comparator.comparingDouble((PlayerData data) -> data.crystal().buffer()).reversed()
                : Comparator.comparingDouble(PlayerData::buffer).reversed());

        StringBuilder out = new StringBuilder();
        if (session.lines % HEADER_EVERY == 0) {
            out.append(Msg.parse(plugin.config().prefix()
                    + "<gray>Monitor <dark_gray>" + rows.size()));
        }

        if (rows.isEmpty()) {
            if (out.length() > 0) {
                out.append('\n');
            }
            out.append(plugin.lang().text("monitor-cmd.empty"));
            return Msg.parse(out.toString());
        }

        int shown = 0;
        for (PlayerData data : rows) {
            if (shown >= MAX_ROWS) {
                break;
            }
            out.append('\n').append(session.crystal ? crystalRow(data) : row(data));
            shown++;
        }
        if (shown < rows.size()) {
            out.append("\n").append(Msg.parse(plugin.lang().text("monitor-cmd.more",
                    Map.of("value", Integer.toString(rows.size() - shown)))));
        }
        return Msg.parse(out.toString());
    }

    private String row(PlayerData data) {
        return pvpRow(data);
    }

    private String crystalRow(PlayerData data) {
        double probability = data.crystal().probability();
        String value = Double.isNaN(probability)
                ? "<dark_gray>-"
                : "<" + Msg.heatColour(probability) + ">" + Msg.probability(probability);
        return plugin.config().prefix() + Msg.parse(plugin.theme().resolveAccent(
                "<accent>Crystal <white>" + data.name() + " " + value
                        + " <gray>buffer <white>" + Msg.round(data.crystal().buffer(), 1)));
    }

    private double shownProbability(PlayerData data) {
        if (!plugin.api().acceptsModel(data.uuid(), data.aimModelId())) {
            return Double.NaN;
        }
        return data.displayProbability(!plugin.detection().mathEnabled());
    }

    public List<String> onlineNames(String partial) {
        String lower = partial.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        List<String> names = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Player player : plugin.getServer().getOnlinePlayers()) {
            if (player.getName().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).startsWith(lower)) {
                names.add(player.getName());
            }
        }
        return names;
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/me/everyone/oculusai/ui/ResourcePack.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.ui;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.security.MessageDigest;
import java.security.NoSuchAlgorithmException;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;
import me.everyone.oculusai.core.Service;
import me.everyone.oculusai.core.Msg;
import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
import org.bukkit.event.EventHandler;
import org.bukkit.event.EventPriority;
import org.bukkit.event.HandlerList;
import org.bukkit.event.Listener;
import org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerChangedWorldEvent;
import org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerJoinEvent;
import org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerQuitEvent;
import org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerResourcePackStatusEvent;

/** Ресурспак с логотипом OculusAI.
 *
 *  <p>В паке логотип и две плашки для префиксов, каждая привязана к своему
 *  символу из частной области Юникода. Сами по себе символы ничего не значат -
 *  у игрока без пака они рисуются пустым квадратом, - поэтому
 *  {@link #logo(Player)} отдаёт их только тем, чей клиент ответил, что пак
 *  загружен. Глифы умножаются на цвет текста, поэтому плашки нужно выводить
 *  белым ({@code §f}), иначе они перекрасятся в цвет темы.
 *
 *  <p>Пак лежит внутри jar, и по нему же считается SHA-1. Клиент качает его
 *  с сервиса OculusAI: туда выкладывается тот же самый zip, сборка у него
 *  повторяемая, так что хэш сходится. */
public final class ResourcePack implements Service, Listener {

    /** Символ, которому в паке назначен логотип. */
    public static final String LOGO = "";

    /** Символ плашки ADMIN из пака. */
    public static final String ADMIN = "\uE0A2";

    /** Символ плашки PLAYER из пака. */
    public static final String PLAYER = "\uE0A3";
    public static final String BOT = "\uE0A4";

    private static final String BUNDLED = "pack/OculusAI-pack.zip";
    /** Эндпоинт пака на сервисе; адрес сервиса - api.url. */
    private static final String PACK_PATH = "/api/v1/resource-pack.zip";
    /** Свой id у пака, чтобы на 1.20.3+ он лёг рядом с паком сервера, а не
     *  вместо него. Постоянный: клиент кэширует пак по нему. */
    private static final UUID ID = UUID.nameUUIDFromBytes(
            "oculusai:resource-pack".getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));

    private final OculusAI plugin;
    private final Set<UUID> sent = ConcurrentHashMap.newKeySet();
    private final Set<UUID> loaded = ConcurrentHashMap.newKeySet();
    private volatile String url;
    private volatile byte[] hash;
    private volatile boolean vanillaDelivery;

    public ResourcePack(OculusAI plugin) {
        this.plugin = plugin;
    }

    @Override
    public void enable() {
        resolve();
        plugin.getServer().getPluginManager().registerEvents(this, plugin);
    }

    @Override
    public void disable() {
        HandlerList.unregisterAll(this);
        sent.clear();
        loaded.clear();
    }

    @Override
    public void reload() {
        resolve();
    }

    /** Логотип с пробелом для начала строки, или пусто, если пака у игрока нет. */
    public String logo(Player player) {
        return logo(player.getUniqueId());
    }

    String logo(UUID playerId) {
        // Белым: глиф из пака умножается на цвет текста, и в цвете темы
        // серебряный логотип стал бы фиолетовым или золотым.
        return loaded.contains(playerId) ? "§f" + LOGO + " " : "";
    }

    public String botPrefix(Player player) {
        return loaded.contains(player.getUniqueId()) ? BOT + " " : "[BOT] ";
    }

    private void resolve() {
        vanillaDelivery = plugin.getConfig().getBoolean("resource-pack.vanilla-delivery", false);
        String configured = plugin.config().packUrl();
        url = configured.isEmpty() ? plugin.config().apiUrl() + PACK_PATH : configured;
        String sha1 = plugin.config().packSha1();
        if (!"auto".equalsIgnoreCase(sha1)) {
            hash = hex(sha1);
            return;
        }
        hash = bundledHash();
        if (hash == null) {
            // Без хэша клиент пак примет, но не сможет закэшировать, а
            // главное - сломанная сборка без пака внутри будет незаметна.
            plugin.getLogger().warning("Resource pack is missing from the plugin jar;"
                    + " the scoreboard logo is off.");
            url = null;
        }
    }

    private byte[] bundledHash() {
        try (InputStream in = plugin.getResource(BUNDLED)) {
            if (in == null) {
                return null;
            }
            MessageDigest digest = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-1");
            byte[] buffer = new byte[8192];
            int read;
            while ((read = in.read(buffer)) > 0) {
                digest.update(buffer, 0, read);
            }
            return digest.digest();
        } catch (IOException | NoSuchAlgorithmException failure) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    private static byte[] hex(String value) {
        if (value == null || value.length() != 40) {
            return null;
        }
        byte[] bytes = new byte[20];
        try {
            for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
                bytes[i] = (byte) Integer.parseInt(value.substring(i * 2, i * 2 + 2), 16);
            }
        } catch (NumberFormatException invalid) {
            return null;
        }
        return bytes;
    }

    private boolean inArena(Player player) {
        return plugin.config().testServerEnabled()
                && player.getWorld().getName().equalsIgnoreCase(plugin.config().testServerWorld());
    }

    private void offer(Player player) {
        if (!plugin.config().packEnabled() || vanillaDelivery || url == null) {
            return;
        }
        if (plugin.config().packArenaOnly() && !inArena(player)) {
            return;
        }
        if (!sent.add(player.getUniqueId())) {
            return;
        }
        String prompt = Msg.parse(plugin.config().packPrompt());
        boolean required = plugin.config().packRequired();
        // Секунда после входа: клиент, которому пак прилетел прямо в момент
        // загрузки мира, на части версий молча его теряет.
        plugin.ticks().after(20L, () -> plugin.platform().onEntity(player, () -> {
            if (player.isOnline()) {
                PackSender.send(player, ID, url, hash, prompt, required);
            }
        }));
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.MONITOR)
    public void onJoin(PlayerJoinEvent event) {
        offer(event.getPlayer());
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.MONITOR)
    public void onWorldChange(PlayerChangedWorldEvent event) {
        offer(event.getPlayer());
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.MONITOR)
    public void onStatus(PlayerResourcePackStatusEvent event) {
        if (!plugin.config().packEnabled() || (!vanillaDelivery
                && !sent.contains(event.getPlayer().getUniqueId())) || !PackSender.ours(event, ID)) {
            return;
        }
        // По имени, а не по константе: ACCEPTED, DOWNLOADED и прочие
        // промежуточные ответы появились не во всех версиях API.
        String status = event.getStatus().name();
        UUID uuid = event.getPlayer().getUniqueId();
        if ("SUCCESSFULLY_LOADED".equals(status)) {
            loaded.add(uuid);
            plugin.npcs().refreshTab(event.getPlayer());
        } else if (!"ACCEPTED".equals(status) && !"DOWNLOADED".equals(status)) {
            loaded.remove(uuid);
        }
        plugin.getLogger().info("OculusAI resource pack for "
                + event.getPlayer().getName() + ": " + status);
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.MONITOR)
    public void onQuit(PlayerQuitEvent event) {
        sent.remove(event.getPlayer().getUniqueId());
        loaded.remove(event.getPlayer().getUniqueId());
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/me/everyone/oculusai/ui/Sidebar.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.ui;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import org.bukkit.Bukkit;
import org.bukkit.ChatColor;
import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
import org.bukkit.scoreboard.DisplaySlot;
import org.bukkit.scoreboard.Objective;
import org.bukkit.scoreboard.Scoreboard;
import org.bukkit.scoreboard.Team;

/** Сайдбар одного игрока, который обновляется на месте.
 *
 * <p>Раньше каждое обновление собирало новый скорборд и подменяло им старый
 * ({@code getNewScoreboard} и {@code setScoreboard}): на время подмены
 * сайдбар у клиента исчезал, и при частом обновлении он мерцал. Здесь доска
 * одна на всё время, а строки не удаляются и не создаются заново:
 *
 * <ul>
 *   <li>у каждой строки постоянная запись - невидимый уникальный цветовой
 *       код - и своя команда; текст строки - префикс команды;</li>
 *   <li>префикс и заголовок меняются, только если текст правда другой, так
 *       что неизменившиеся строки не шлют клиенту ни одного пакета;</li>
 *   <li>лишние строки при укорачивании списка снимаются по одной.</li>
 * </ul>
 *
 * <p>Только для Paper: на Folia скорбордов нет, и вызывающий это проверяет.
 */
public final class Sidebar {

    /** Больше строк сайдбар клиента не показывает. */
    public static final int MAX_LINES = 15;
    /** Длина префикса команды, которую принимает сервер на всех версиях. */
    private static final int PREFIX_LIMIT = 64;

    private final Scoreboard board;
    private final Objective objective;
    private final List<String> shown = new ArrayList<>();
    private String title;

    public Sidebar(String title) {
        this.board = Bukkit.getScoreboardManager().getNewScoreboard();
        this.objective = board.registerNewObjective("oai_side", "dummy", title);
        hideScoreNumbers();
        this.objective.setDisplaySlot(DisplaySlot.SIDEBAR);
        this.title = title;
    }

    private void hideScoreNumbers() {
        try {
            Class<?> format = Class.forName("io.papermc.paper.scoreboard.numbers.NumberFormat");
            Object blank = format.getMethod("blank").invoke(null);
            Objective.class.getMethod("numberFormat", format).invoke(objective, blank);
        } catch (ReflectiveOperationException ignored) {
            // Older Paper versions render the score values.
        }
    }

    /** Ставит доску игроку, если у него сейчас другая. */
    public void show(Player player) {
        if (player.getScoreboard() != board) {
            player.setScoreboard(board);
        }
    }

    public void title(String value) {
        if (!value.equals(title)) {
            objective.setDisplayName(value);
            title = value;
        }
    }

    /** Строки сверху вниз. */
    public void lines(List<String> lines) {
        int count = Math.min(lines.size(), MAX_LINES);
        List<String> next = new ArrayList<>(count);
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            String text = lines.get(i);
            if (text.length() > PREFIX_LIMIT) {
                text = text.substring(0, PREFIX_LIMIT);
            }
            next.add(text);
            String entry = entry(i);
            Team team = team(i, entry);
            if (i >= shown.size() || !text.equals(shown.get(i))) {
                team.setPrefix(text);
            }
            // Счёт задаёт порядок: верхняя строка - наибольший. Пишется на
            // каждом вызове, но клиенту уходит только при изменении.
            int score = count - i;
            if (!objective.getScore(entry).isScoreSet() || objective.getScore(entry).getScore() != score) {
                objective.getScore(entry).setScore(score);
            }
        }
        for (int i = count; i < shown.size(); i++) {
            board.resetScores(entry(i));
        }
        shown.clear();
        shown.addAll(next);
    }

    private Team team(int index, String entry) {
        String name = "oai_line_" + index;
        Team team = board.getTeam(name);
        if (team == null) {
            team = board.registerNewTeam(name);
            team.addEntry(entry);
        }
        return team;
    }

    /** Невидимая уникальная запись строки: цветовой код и сброс. */
    private static String entry(int index) {
        return ChatColor.values()[index].toString() + ChatColor.RESET;
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/me/everyone/oculusai/ui/TabStyle.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.ui;

import java.lang.reflect.Method;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.function.Function;
import java.util.function.Supplier;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;
import me.everyone.oculusai.config.Themes.Theme;
import org.bukkit.plugin.Plugin;

public final class TabStyle {
    private static final String LOGO = "%oculusai-logo%";
    private static final String TITLE = "%oculusai-tab-title%";
    private static final String SITE = "%oculusai-tab-site%";
    private static final String NAME = "OculusAI";
    private static final int FRAME_MS = 150;

    private TabStyle() {}

    public static Runnable register(OculusAI plugin) {
        Plugin tab = plugin.getServer().getPluginManager().getPlugin("TAB");
        if (tab == null || !tab.isEnabled()) {
            return () -> {};
        }
        try {
            ClassLoader loader = tab.getClass().getClassLoader();
            Class<?> api = loader.loadClass("me.neznamy.tab.api.TabAPI");
            Class<?> managerType = loader.loadClass("me.neznamy.tab.api.placeholder.PlaceholderManager");
            Method playerId = loader.loadClass("me.neznamy.tab.api.TabPlayer").getMethod("getUniqueId");
            Object manager = api.getMethod("getPlaceholderManager").invoke(api.getMethod("getInstance").invoke(null));
            Method unregister = managerType.getMethod("unregisterPlaceholder", String.class);
            Function<Object, String> logo = player -> {
                try {
                    return plugin.resourcePack().logo((UUID) playerId.invoke(player)).replace('§', '&');
                } catch (ReflectiveOperationException error) {
                    return "";
                }
            };
            Method registerServer = managerType.getMethod(
                    "registerServerPlaceholder", String.class, int.class, Supplier.class);
            Map<String, List<String>> frames = plugin.theme().themes().stream()
                    .collect(Collectors.toMap(Theme::id, TabStyle::frames));
            Supplier<String> title = () -> {
                List<String> animation = frames.get(plugin.theme().current().id());
                int index = Math.floorMod(System.nanoTime() / (FRAME_MS * 1_000_000L), animation.size());
                return animation.get(index);
            };
            Supplier<String> site = () -> "&" + plugin.theme().current().accentSoft() + "oculusai.space";
            registerServer.invoke(manager, TITLE, FRAME_MS, title);
            registerServer.invoke(manager, SITE, 500, site);
            managerType.getMethod("registerPlayerPlaceholder", String.class, int.class, Function.class)
                    .invoke(manager, LOGO, 500, logo);
            return () -> {
                if (!tab.isEnabled()) return;
                try {
                    for (String key : List.of(LOGO, TITLE, SITE)) {
                        unregister.invoke(manager, key);
                    }
                } catch (ReflectiveOperationException error) {
                    plugin.getLogger().log(Level.FINE, "Could not unregister the OculusAI TAB styling", error);
                }
            };
        } catch (ReflectiveOperationException | LinkageError error) {
            plugin.getLogger().log(Level.WARNING, "Could not register the OculusAI styling with TAB", error);
            return () -> {};
        }
    }

    private static List<String> frames(Theme theme) {
        int primary = Integer.parseInt(theme.primary().substring(1), 16);
        int secondary = Integer.parseInt(theme.secondary().substring(1), 16);
        int highlight = Integer.parseInt(theme.accentSoft().substring(1), 16);
        List<String> animation = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int position = -3; position < NAME.length() + 3; position++) {
            StringBuilder title = new StringBuilder();
            for (int letter = 0; letter < NAME.length(); letter++) {
                int base = blend(primary, secondary, (double) letter / (NAME.length() - 1));
                double weight = Math.max(0, 1 - Math.abs(position - letter) / 3.0);
                int color = blend(base, highlight, weight);
                title.append("&#").append(Integer.toHexString(0x1000000 | color).substring(1))
                        .append("&l").append(NAME.charAt(letter));
            }
            animation.add(title.toString());
        }
        return animation;
    }

    private static int blend(int left, int right, double ratio) {
        int result = 0;
        for (int shift = 16; shift >= 0; shift -= 8) {
            int start = (left >> shift) & 0xff;
            int end = (right >> shift) & 0xff;
            result |= (int) Math.round(start + (end - start) * ratio) << shift;
        }
        return result;
    }
}
```

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.ui;

import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;

public final class Ui implements Service {

    private final Hud hud;
    private final Menus menus;
    private final Monitor monitor;

        this.hud = new Hud(plugin);
        this.menus = new Menus(plugin);
        this.monitor = new Monitor(plugin);
    }

    @Override
    public void enable() {
        hud.enable();
        monitor.enable();
        menus.enable();
    }

    @Override

        menus.disable();
        monitor.disable();
        hud.disable();
    }

    public Hud hud() {
        return hud;
    }

    public Menus menus() {
        return menus;
    }

    public Monitor monitor() {
        return monitor;
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/me/everyone/oculusai/ui/gui/Menu.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.ui.gui;

import java.lang.reflect.Method;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.function.Consumer;
import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;
import me.everyone.oculusai.core.Platform;
import org.bukkit.Bukkit;
import org.bukkit.Material;
import org.bukkit.NamespacedKey;
import org.bukkit.OfflinePlayer;
import org.bukkit.Sound;
import org.bukkit.enchantments.Enchantment;
import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
import org.bukkit.event.inventory.ClickType;
import org.bukkit.event.inventory.InventoryClickEvent;
import org.bukkit.inventory.Inventory;
import org.bukkit.inventory.InventoryHolder;
import org.bukkit.inventory.ItemFlag;
import org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack;
import org.bukkit.inventory.meta.ItemMeta;
import org.bukkit.inventory.meta.SkullMeta;

/** Base class for every inventory in the plugin - with an opening animation,
 *  a moving frame and sound.
 *
 * <p>A menu declares its title, size and contents in {@link #build()}. Simple
 * screens can keep using {@link #onClick(InventoryClickEvent)}; screens with
 * many controls register a button - an item plus a click action.
 *
 * <p>Как меню живёт после открытия:
 * <ol>
 *   <li><b>Раскрытие.</b> Инвентарь открывается пустым, столбцы появляются от
 *       центра к краям, на каждом шаге - нота чуть выше предыдущей, в конце -
 *       короткий звон.</li>
 *   <li><b>Рамка.</b> По пустым клеткам периметра бегут две цветные
 *       «змейки» навстречу друг другу; цвета - от темы плагина.</li>
 *   <li><b>Мерцание.</b> Кнопки, отмеченные {@link #pulse(int)}, переливаются
 *       блеском зачарования.</li>
 * </ol>
 *
 * <p>Работает и на 1.16.5, и на Folia: блеск - через зачарование со скрытой
 * строкой, а не через API 1.20.5; скрытая подсказка у стекла - через
 * отражение, если сервер её умеет; анимация идёт задачей на потоке самого
 * зрителя, как того требует Folia.
 */
public abstract class Menu implements InventoryHolder {

    /** What a click did, so a button can react differently to left and right. */
    public record Click(InventoryClickEvent event, boolean right, boolean shift) {
    }

    private record Button(ItemStack item, Consumer<Click> action) {
    }

    private static final int REVEAL_STEP_TICKS = 2;
    private static final int SNAKE_STEP_TICKS = 2;
    private static final int FLICKER_TICKS = 10;
    /** Сколько ждать, пока инвентарь откроется (на Folia - задачей позже). */
    private static final int OPEN_GRACE_TICKS = 40;
    private static final Method HIDE_TOOLTIP = hideTooltipMethod();
    private static final Enchantment GLOW = Enchantment.getByKey(NamespacedKey.minecraft("unbreaking"));

    protected final OculusAI plugin;
    protected final Player viewer;
    private Inventory inventory;
    private final Map<Integer, Button> buttons = new HashMap<>();
    private final Map<Integer, ItemStack> content = new HashMap<>();
    private final Set<Integer> pulsing = new HashSet<>();
    private List<Integer> border = List.of();
    private Platform.Cancellable task;
    private boolean revealed;
    private boolean seenOpen;
    private int tick;

    protected Menu(OculusAI plugin, Player viewer) {
        this.plugin = plugin;
        this.viewer = viewer;
    }

    protected abstract String title();

    protected abstract int size();

    /** Fills the inventory. Called on open and on every refresh. */
    protected abstract void build();

    /** Fallback for menus that still switch on slots. */
    protected void onClick(InventoryClickEvent event) {
    }

    public final void open() {
        inventory = Bukkit.createInventory(this, size(), title());
        border = perimeter(size() / 9);
        rebuild();
        revealed = false;
        seenOpen = false;
        tick = 0;
        // On Folia an inventory may only be opened from the thread owning the
        // viewer. A menu opened from a command is already there; one opened
        // from a timer is not.
        plugin.platform().onEntity(viewer, () -> {
            // Та же страница другого вида - листание, сортировка: раскрытие уже
            // было, и показывать его на каждой странице значит мигать меню.
            // Новое встаёт сразу, а змейки продолжают с того же места.
            Menu previous = viewer.getOpenInventory().getTopInventory().getHolder() instanceof Menu open
                    && open.getClass() == getClass() ? open : null;
            if (previous != null) {
                revealed = true;
                tick = previous.tick;
                previous.stop();
            }
            viewer.openInventory(inventory);
            if (previous != null) {
                paintAll();
            } else {
                viewer.playSound(viewer.getLocation(), Sound.BLOCK_ENDER_CHEST_OPEN, 0.5F, 1.4F);
            }
            stop();
            task = plugin.platform().entityRepeating(viewer, 1L, 1L, this::animate);
        });
    }

    /** Пересобирает содержимое без повторной анимации раскрытия. */
    public final void refresh() {
        if (inventory == null) {
            return;
        }
        rebuild();
        if (revealed) {
            paintAll();
        }
    }

    private void rebuild() {
        content.clear();
        buttons.clear();
        pulsing.clear();
        build();
    }

    private void stop() {
        if (task != null) {
            task.cancel();
            task = null;
        }
    }

    @Override
    public final Inventory getInventory() {
        return inventory;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ API

    /** Places an item and gives it a left-click action. */
    protected final void button(int slot, ItemStack item, Runnable action) {
        button(slot, item, click -> action.run());
    }

    /** Places an item and gives it a left-click action; right-click can do
     *  something else (the dashboard's power switch uses this). */
    protected final void button(int slot, ItemStack item, Consumer<Click> action) {
        set(slot, item);
        if (slot >= 0 && slot < 54) {
            buttons.put(slot, new Button(item, action));
        }
    }

    /** Places an item that reacts only to a right click. */
    protected final void rightClick(int slot, ItemStack item, Runnable action) {
        button(slot, item, click -> {
            if (click.right()) {
                action.run();
            }
        });
    }

    /** A two-state button: left click toggles, right click opens settings if
     *  a handler is supplied. */
    protected final void toggle(int slot, ItemStack item, Runnable toggle, Runnable settings) {
        button(slot, item, click -> {
            if (click.right() && settings != null) {
                settings.run();
            } else if (!click.right()) {
                toggle.run();
            }
        });
    }

    protected final void set(int slot, ItemStack item) {
        if (inventory == null || slot < 0 || slot >= inventory.getSize()) {
            return;
        }
        if (item == null) {
            content.remove(slot);
        } else {
            content.put(slot, item);
        }
        if (revealed) {
            inventory.setItem(slot, item);
        }
    }

    /** Кнопка будет мерцать блеском зачарования - для того, на что стоит
     *  обратить внимание. */
    protected final void pulse(int slot) {
        pulsing.add(slot);
    }

    /** Клетки внутри рамки, слева направо и сверху вниз: ряды без первого и
     *  последнего, столбцы без крайних. Списки раскладываются только сюда -
     *  иначе иконки ложатся на рамку, а змейки бегут между ними. */
    protected final int[] grid() {
        int rows = size() / 9;
        if (rows < 3) {
            int[] all = new int[size()];
            for (int i = 0; i < all.length; i++) {
                all[i] = i;
            }
            return all;
        }
        int[] slots = new int[(rows - 2) * 7];
        int at = 0;
        for (int row = 1; row < rows - 1; row++) {
            for (int column = 1; column <= 7; column++) {
                slots[at++] = row * 9 + column;
            }
        }
        return slots;
    }

    /** Номер клетки сетки, в которую кликнули, или -1. */
    protected final int gridIndex(int slot) {
        int[] grid = grid();
        for (int i = 0; i < grid.length; i++) {
            if (grid[i] == slot) {
                return i;
            }
        }
        return -1;
    }

    /** {@code count} клеток ряда {@code row}, симметрично вокруг середины.
     *  Нечётное число - с середины, чётное - середина пропускается: шесть
     *  иконок встают по три с каждой стороны, а не прижимаются влево. */
    protected static int[] centred(int row, int count) {
        int n = Math.max(0, Math.min(7, count));
        int[] columns = switch (n) {
            case 1 -> new int[]{4};
            case 2 -> new int[]{3, 5};
            case 3 -> new int[]{3, 4, 5};
            case 4 -> new int[]{2, 3, 5, 6};
            case 5 -> new int[]{2, 3, 4, 5, 6};
            case 6 -> new int[]{1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7};
            case 7 -> new int[]{1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7};
            default -> new int[0];
        };
        int[] slots = new int[columns.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < columns.length; i++) {
            slots[i] = row * 9 + columns[i];
        }
        return slots;
    }

    protected final void toggleButton(int slot, ItemStack item, String path, boolean fallback) {
        button(slot, item, () -> {
            plugin.getConfig().set(path, !plugin.getConfig().getBoolean(path, fallback));
            plugin.saveConfig();
            plugin.reloadEverything();
            refresh();
        });
    }

    public final void handleClick(InventoryClickEvent event) {
        Button button = buttons.get(event.getSlot());
        if (button != null) {
            viewer.playSound(viewer.getLocation(), Sound.UI_BUTTON_CLICK, 0.4F, 1.6F);
            button.action().accept(new Click(event,
                    event.getClick() == ClickType.RIGHT || event.getClick() == ClickType.SHIFT_RIGHT,
                    event.getClick() == ClickType.SHIFT_LEFT || event.getClick() == ClickType.SHIFT_RIGHT));
            return;
        }
        onClick(event);
    }

    protected static ItemStack item(Material material, String name, List<String> lore) {
        ItemStack stack = new ItemStack(material);
        ItemMeta meta = stack.getItemMeta();
        meta.setDisplayName(name);
        if (lore != null && !lore.isEmpty()) {
            meta.setLore(new ArrayList<>(lore));
        }
        stack.setItemMeta(meta);
        return stack;
    }

    protected static ItemStack head(OfflinePlayer owner, String name, List<String> lore) {
        ItemStack stack = item(Material.PLAYER_HEAD, name, lore);
        if (stack.getItemMeta() instanceof SkullMeta meta) {
            meta.setOwningPlayer(owner);
            stack.setItemMeta(meta);
        }
        return stack;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ анимация

    private void animate() {
        boolean open = viewer.isOnline() && viewer.getOpenInventory().getTopInventory() == inventory;
        if (open) {
            seenOpen = true;
        } else if (seenOpen || tick > OPEN_GRACE_TICKS || !viewer.isOnline()) {
            stop();
            return;
        }
        tick++;
        if (!open) {
            return;
        }
        if (!revealed) {
            reveal();
            return;
        }
        if (tick % SNAKE_STEP_TICKS == 0) {
            paintBorder();
        }
        if (!pulsing.isEmpty() && tick % FLICKER_TICKS == 0) {
            flicker();
        }
    }

    /** Раскрытие от центрального столбца наружу. */
    private void reveal() {
        if (tick % REVEAL_STEP_TICKS != 0) {
            return;
        }
        int step = tick / REVEAL_STEP_TICKS - 1;
        if (step > 4) {
            revealed = true;
            tick = 0;
            paintAll();
            viewer.playSound(viewer.getLocation(), Sound.BLOCK_NOTE_BLOCK_CHIME, 0.7F, 1.6F);
            return;
        }
        for (int slot = 0; slot < inventory.getSize(); slot++) {
            if (Math.abs(slot % 9 - 4) == step) {
                ItemStack item = content.get(slot);
                inventory.setItem(slot, item != null ? item
                        : border.contains(slot) ? glass(Material.BLACK_STAINED_GLASS_PANE) : null);
            }
        }
        viewer.playSound(viewer.getLocation(), Sound.BLOCK_NOTE_BLOCK_HAT, 0.5F, 0.8F + step * 0.2F);
        viewer.playSound(viewer.getLocation(), Sound.BLOCK_NOTE_BLOCK_PLING, 0.2F, 0.7F + step * 0.25F);
    }

    private void paintAll() {
        for (int slot = 0; slot < inventory.getSize(); slot++) {
            ItemStack item = content.get(slot);
            if (item != null) {
                inventory.setItem(slot, item);
            } else if (!border.contains(slot)) {
                inventory.setItem(slot, null);
            }
        }
        paintBorder();
    }

    /** Две змейки по пустым клеткам периметра, навстречу друг другу. */
    private void paintBorder() {
        int n = border.size();
        if (n == 0) {
            return;
        }
        Material[] palette = palette();
        int head = (tick / SNAKE_STEP_TICKS) % n;
        int opposite = (head + n / 2) % n;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int slot = border.get(i);
            if (content.containsKey(slot)) {
                continue;
            }
            int behind = Math.min((head - i + n) % n, (opposite - i + n) % n);
            Material glass = behind < palette.length ? palette[behind] : Material.BLACK_STAINED_GLASS_PANE;
            ItemStack current = inventory.getItem(slot);
            if (current == null || current.getType() != glass) {
                inventory.setItem(slot, glass(glass));
            }
        }
    }

    /** Голова и хвост змейки - в цветах темы. */
    private Material[] palette() {
        String theme = plugin.theme() == null || plugin.theme().current() == null
                ? "aurora" : plugin.theme().current().id();
        return switch (theme) {
            case "ember" -> new Material[]{Material.RED_STAINED_GLASS_PANE,
                    Material.ORANGE_STAINED_GLASS_PANE, Material.GRAY_STAINED_GLASS_PANE};
            case "ocean" -> new Material[]{Material.LIGHT_BLUE_STAINED_GLASS_PANE,
                    Material.CYAN_STAINED_GLASS_PANE, Material.GRAY_STAINED_GLASS_PANE};
            case "rose" -> new Material[]{Material.PINK_STAINED_GLASS_PANE,
                    Material.MAGENTA_STAINED_GLASS_PANE, Material.GRAY_STAINED_GLASS_PANE};
            case "mint" -> new Material[]{Material.LIME_STAINED_GLASS_PANE,
                    Material.GREEN_STAINED_GLASS_PANE, Material.GRAY_STAINED_GLASS_PANE};
            case "midnight" -> new Material[]{Material.BLUE_STAINED_GLASS_PANE,
                    Material.CYAN_STAINED_GLASS_PANE, Material.GRAY_STAINED_GLASS_PANE};
            default -> new Material[]{Material.PURPLE_STAINED_GLASS_PANE,
                    Material.MAGENTA_STAINED_GLASS_PANE, Material.GRAY_STAINED_GLASS_PANE};
        };
    }

    private void flicker() {
        if (GLOW == null) {
            return;
        }
        boolean on = (tick / FLICKER_TICKS) % 2 == 0;
        for (int slot : pulsing) {
            ItemStack item = inventory.getItem(slot);
            if (item == null || item.getType().isAir()) {
                continue;
            }
            ItemMeta meta = item.getItemMeta();
            if (meta == null) {
                continue;
            }
            if (on) {
                meta.addEnchant(GLOW, 1, true);
                meta.addItemFlags(ItemFlag.HIDE_ENCHANTS);
            } else {
                meta.removeEnchant(GLOW);
            }
            item.setItemMeta(meta);
            inventory.setItem(slot, item);
        }
    }

    /** Декоративное стекло без подсказки при наведении. */
    private static ItemStack glass(Material material) {
        ItemStack stack = new ItemStack(material);
        ItemMeta meta = stack.getItemMeta();
        if (meta == null) {
            return stack;
        }
        if (HIDE_TOOLTIP != null) {
            try {
                HIDE_TOOLTIP.invoke(meta, true);
            } catch (ReflectiveOperationException ignored) {
                meta.setDisplayName(" ");
            }
        } else {
            meta.setDisplayName(" ");
        }
        stack.setItemMeta(meta);
        return stack;
    }

    private static Method hideTooltipMethod() {
        try {
            return ItemMeta.class.getMethod("setHideTooltip", boolean.class);
        } catch (NoSuchMethodException olderServer) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    private static List<Integer> perimeter(int rows) {
        List<Integer> out = new ArrayList<>();
        if (rows < 3) {
            return out;
        }
        int last = rows - 1;
        for (int c = 0; c < 9; c++) {
            out.add(c);
        }
        for (int r = 1; r < last; r++) {
            out.add(r * 9 + 8);
        }
        for (int c = 8; c >= 0; c--) {
            out.add(last * 9 + c);
        }
        for (int r = last - 1; r >= 1; r--) {
            out.add(r * 9);
        }
        return out;
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/me/everyone/oculusai/ui/menu/CheckSettingsMenu.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.ui.menu;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;
import me.everyone.oculusai.check.Check;
import me.everyone.oculusai.ui.gui.Menu;
import me.everyone.oculusai.core.Msg;
import org.bukkit.Material;
import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
import org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack;

/** Settings for one registered check.
 *
 * <p>Number rows use left click to increase and right click to decrease;
 * shift multiplies the step by five. Boolean rows toggle with left click.
 * Every row writes straight to config.yml and reloads the plugin, matching the
 * rest of the dashboard. */
public final class CheckSettingsMenu extends Menu {

    private static final int SLOT_HEADER = 4;
    private static final int SLOT_BACK = 40;
    private static final int[] OPTION_SLOTS = {
            10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16,
            19, 20, 21, 22, 23, 24, 25,
            28, 29, 30, 31, 32, 33, 34
    };

    private record Option(String key, Material material, String path, boolean toggle,
                          double fallback, double min, double max, double step,
                          boolean integer, boolean millis) {

        static Option toggle(String key, Material material, String path, boolean fallback) {
            return new Option(key, material, path, true, fallback ? 1.0D : 0.0D,
                    0.0D, 1.0D, 1.0D, true, false);
        }

        static Option number(String key, Material material, String path, double fallback,
                             double min, double max, double step, boolean integer) {
            return new Option(key, material, path, false, fallback, min, max, step,
                    integer, false);
        }

        static Option millis(String key, Material material, String path, double fallback,
                             double min, double max, double step) {
            return new Option(key, material, path, false, fallback, min, max, step,
                    true, true);
        }
    }

    private final String checkId;

    public CheckSettingsMenu(OculusAI plugin, Player viewer, String checkId) {
        super(plugin, viewer);
        this.checkId = checkId == null ? "" : checkId.toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);
    }

    @Override
    protected String title() {
        return plugin.theme().title(plugin.lang().text("check-settings.title",
                Map.of("check", plugin.lang().textOr("check.name." + checkId, checkId))));
    }

    @Override
    protected int size() {
        return 45;
    }

    @Override
    protected void build() {
        Check check = plugin.checks().find(checkId);
        String name = plugin.lang().textOr("check.name." + checkId, checkId);
        boolean enabled = check != null && plugin.getConfig().getBoolean(check.enabledPath(), true);
        set(SLOT_HEADER, item(icon(checkId), name,
                List.of(
                        plugin.lang().text(enabled
                                ? "check-settings.state-on" : "check-settings.state-off"),
                        plugin.lang().textOr("check.desc." + checkId,
                                plugin.lang().text("check-settings.no-description")),
                        "",
                        plugin.lang().text("check-settings.header-hint"))));

        List<Option> options = options();
        int[] slots = options.size() <= 7 ? centred(2, options.size()) : OPTION_SLOTS;
        for (int i = 0; i < options.size() && i < slots.length; i++) {
            Option option = options.get(i);
            button(slots[i], optionItem(option), click -> change(option, click));
        }

        button(SLOT_BACK, item(Material.ARROW, plugin.lang().text("check-settings.back"),
                List.of(plugin.lang().text("check-settings.back-hint"))),
                () -> new ChecksMenu(plugin, viewer).open());
    }

    private List<Option> options() {
        return switch (checkId) {
            case "aim" -> List.of(
                    Option.toggle("enabled", Material.LEVER, "checks.aim.enabled", true),
                    Option.toggle("test-only", Material.LEVER, "checks.aim.test-only", false),
                    Option.number("smooth", Material.HOPPER, "checks.aim.smooth-windows",
                            plugin.config().checkAimSmoothWindows(), 1.0D, 15.0D, 1.0D, true),
                    Option.number("alert-at", Material.BELL, "buffer.alert-at",
                            plugin.config().alertAt(), 0.0D, plugin.config().bufferMax(),
                            0.1D, false),
                    Option.number("punish-at", Material.IRON_SWORD, "buffer.punish-at",
                            plugin.config().punishAt(), 0.0D, plugin.config().bufferMax(),
                            0.1D, false),
                    Option.number("buffer-max", Material.CHEST, "buffer.max",
                            plugin.config().bufferMax(), 0.1D, 50.0D, 0.5D, false),
                    Option.number("gain", Material.REDSTONE, "buffer.gain",
                            plugin.config().gain(), 0.1D, 10.0D, 0.1D, false),
                    Option.number("decay", Material.GUNPOWDER, "buffer.decay",
                            plugin.config().decay(), 0.1D, 10.0D, 0.1D, false),
                    Option.number("leak", Material.SNOWBALL, "buffer.leak",
                            plugin.config().bufferLeak(), 0.0D, 0.9D, 0.1D, false),
                    Option.number("max-step", Material.LEAD, "buffer.max-step",
                            plugin.config().bufferMaxStep(), 0.0D, 20.0D, 0.1D, false),
                    Option.toggle("reset-after-combat", Material.WATER_BUCKET,
                            "checks.aim.reset-after-combat", true),
                    Option.number("confirmations", Material.REPEATER, "checks.aim.confirmations",
                            plugin.config().checkAimConfirmations(), 1.0D, 50.0D, 1.0D, true),
                    Option.millis("cooldown-ms", Material.CLOCK, "checks.aim.cooldown-ms",
                            plugin.config().checkAimCooldownMs(), 0.0D, 600_000.0D, 1_000.0D));
            case "wall" -> List.of(
                    Option.toggle("enabled", Material.LEVER, "checks.wall.enabled", true),
                    Option.toggle("test-only", Material.LEVER, "checks.wall.test-only", false),
                    Option.number("max-distance", Material.IRON_DOOR, "checks.wall.max-distance",
                            plugin.config().wallCheckMaxDistance(), 0.5D, 20.0D, 0.5D, false),
                    Option.millis("cooldown-ms", Material.CLOCK, "checks.wall.cooldown-ms",
                            plugin.config().checkWallCooldownMs(), 0.0D, 600_000.0D, 1_000.0D));
            case "hitbox" -> List.of(
                    Option.toggle("enabled", Material.LEVER, "checks.hitbox.enabled", true),
                    Option.toggle("test-only", Material.LEVER, "checks.hitbox.test-only", false),
                    Option.number("max-distance", Material.ARMOR_STAND,
                            "checks.hitbox.max-distance",
                            plugin.config().hitboxMaxDistance(), 0.5D, 20.0D, 0.5D, false),
                    Option.number("hitbox-margin", Material.ARMOR_STAND,
                            "checks.hitbox.hitbox-margin",
                            plugin.config().hitboxMargin(), 0.0D, 0.5D, 0.1D, false),
                    Option.number("max-angle", Material.ARROW,
                            "checks.hitbox.max-angle",
                            plugin.config().hitboxMaxAngle(), 0.0D, 45.0D, 1.0D, false),
                    Option.millis("cooldown-ms", Material.CLOCK, "checks.hitbox.cooldown-ms",
                            plugin.config().checkHitboxCooldownMs(), 0.0D, 600_000.0D, 1_000.0D));
            default -> List.of(
                    Option.toggle("enabled", Material.LEVER,
                            "checks." + checkId + ".enabled", true));
        };
    }

    private ItemStack optionItem(Option option) {
        return item(option.material(), plugin.lang().text(nameKey(option)),
                List.of(
                        plugin.lang().text("check-settings.value",
                                Map.of("value", display(option))),
                        "",
                        plugin.lang().text(hintKey(option)),
                        plugin.lang().text(option.toggle()
                                ? "check-settings.toggle-hint" : "check-settings.number-hint")));
    }

    private void change(Option option, Click click) {
        String path = option.path();
        if (option.toggle()) {
            if (click.right()) {
                return;
            }
            plugin.getConfig().set(path,
                    !plugin.getConfig().getBoolean(path, option.fallback() >= 0.5D));
        } else {
            double current = plugin.getConfig().getDouble(path, option.fallback());
            double step = option.step() * (click.shift() ? 5.0D : 1.0D);
            double next = click.right() ? current - step : current + step;
            next = Math.max(option.min(), Math.min(option.max(), next));
            if (option.integer()) {
                next = Math.rint(next);
            } else {
                next = Math.round(next * 10.0D) / 10.0D;
            }
            plugin.getConfig().set(path, next);
        }
        plugin.saveConfig();
        plugin.reloadEverything();
        refresh();
    }

    private String display(Option option) {
        if (option.toggle()) {
            return plugin.lang().text(plugin.getConfig().getBoolean(option.path(),
                    option.fallback() >= 0.5D)
                    ? "check-settings.enabled" : "check-settings.disabled");
        }
        double value = plugin.getConfig().getDouble(option.path(), option.fallback());
        if (option.millis()) {
            return Msg.round(value / 1000.0D, 1) + " "
                    + plugin.lang().text("check-settings.seconds");
        }
        return option.integer()
                ? Long.toString(Math.round(value))
                : Msg.round(value, 1);
    }

    private String nameKey(Option option) {
        return shared(option) ? "check-settings.shared." + option.key() + ".name"
                : "check-settings." + checkId + "." + option.key() + ".name";
    }

    private String hintKey(Option option) {
        return shared(option) ? "check-settings.shared." + option.key() + ".hint"
                : "check-settings." + checkId + "." + option.key() + ".hint";
    }

    private boolean shared(Option option) {
        return switch (option.key()) {
            case "enabled", "test-only", "confirmations", "cooldown-ms" -> true;
            default -> false;
        };
    }

    private Material icon(String id) {
        return switch (id) {
            case "wall" -> Material.IRON_DOOR;
            case "aim" -> Material.ENDER_EYE;
            case "hitbox" -> Material.ARMOR_STAND;
            case "crystal" -> Material.END_CRYSTAL;
            case "crystalpredict" -> Material.FIRE_CHARGE;
            default -> Material.PAPER;
        };
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/me/everyone/oculusai/ui/menu/ChecksMenu.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.ui.menu;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;
import me.everyone.oculusai.check.Check;
import me.everyone.oculusai.ui.gui.Menu;
import org.bukkit.Material;
import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
import org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack;

/** The list of every registered check.
 *
 * <p>Left click toggles a check, right click opens its own settings screen.
 * The list is read from {@link me.everyone.oculusai.check.Checks}, so adding a
 * check to the plugin makes it appear here without a second hard-coded menu
 * entry. */
public final class ChecksMenu extends Menu {

    private static final int SLOT_HEADER = 4;
    private static final int SLOT_BACK = 40;

    public ChecksMenu(OculusAI plugin, Player viewer) {
        super(plugin, viewer);
    }

    @Override
    protected String title() {
        return plugin.theme().title(plugin.lang().text("checks-menu.title"));
    }

    @Override
    protected int size() {
        return 45;
    }

    @Override
    protected void build() {
        List<Check> checks = plugin.checks().all();
        set(SLOT_HEADER, item(Material.COMPARATOR, plugin.lang().text("checks-menu.header"),
                List.of(
                        plugin.lang().text("checks-menu.registered",
                                Map.of("value", Integer.toString(checks.size()))),
                        plugin.lang().text(plugin.config().analysisEnabled()
                                ? "checks-menu.analysis-on" : "checks-menu.analysis-off"),
                        "",
                        plugin.lang().text("checks-menu.hint"))));

        // В один ряд по центру, пока помещаются; больше - по сетке внутри рамки.
        int[] slots = checks.size() <= 7 ? centred(2, checks.size()) : grid();
        for (int i = 0; i < checks.size() && i < slots.length; i++) {
            Check check = checks.get(i);
            boolean enabled = enabled(check);
            ItemStack icon = item(icon(check), plugin.lang().textOr(
                            "check.name." + check.id(), check.id()),
                    List.of(
                            plugin.lang().text(enabled
                                    ? "checks-menu.state-on" : "checks-menu.state-off"),
                            plugin.lang().textOr("check.desc." + check.id(),
                                    plugin.lang().text("checks-menu.no-description")),
                            "",
                            plugin.lang().text("checks-menu.left"),
                            plugin.lang().text("checks-menu.right")));
            toggle(slots[i], icon,
                    () -> setEnabled(check, !enabled),
                    () -> new CheckSettingsMenu(plugin, viewer, check.id()).open());
        }

        if (checks.isEmpty()) {
            set(22, item(Material.BARRIER, plugin.lang().text("checks-menu.empty"),
                    List.of(plugin.lang().text("checks-menu.empty-hint"))));
        }

        button(SLOT_BACK, item(Material.ARROW, plugin.lang().text("checks-menu.back"),
                List.of(plugin.lang().text("checks-menu.back-hint"))),
                () -> new DashboardMenu(plugin, viewer).open());
    }

    private boolean enabled(Check check) {
        return plugin.getConfig().getBoolean(check.enabledPath(), true);
    }

    private void setEnabled(Check check, boolean value) {
        plugin.getConfig().set(check.enabledPath(), value);
        plugin.saveConfig();
        plugin.reloadEverything();
        refresh();
    }

    private Material icon(Check check) {
        return switch (check.id()) {
            case "wall" -> Material.IRON_DOOR;
            case "aim" -> Material.ENDER_EYE;
            case "hitbox" -> Material.ARMOR_STAND;
            case "crystal" -> Material.END_CRYSTAL;
            case "crystalpredict" -> Material.FIRE_CHARGE;
            default -> Material.PAPER;
        };
    }
}
```
