`src/test/java/me/everyone/oculusai/core/MsgLegacyTest.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.core;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

@DisplayName("legacy colour codes")
class MsgLegacyTest {

    @Test
    @DisplayName("an ampersand code becomes a colour")
    void translatesCodes() {
        assertEquals("§cno analysing", Msg.parse("&cno analysing"));
        assertEquals("§lbold", Msg.parse("&lbold"));
        assertEquals("§creset§r", Msg.parse("&creset&r"));
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("an uppercase code is accepted and normalised")
    void acceptsUppercase() {
        assertEquals("§cred", Msg.parse("&Cred"));
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("an ampersand that is not a code stays an ampersand")
    void leavesPlainAmpersands() {
        assertEquals("tom & jerry", Msg.parse("tom & jerry"));
        assertEquals("a&", Msg.parse("a&"));
        assertEquals("&z", Msg.parse("&z"));
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("the HTML escapes still survive the translation")
    void keepsEscapes() {
        // &amp; begins with an ampersand followed by `a`, which is itself a
        // colour code, so the order these two run in is load-bearing: codes
        // first would eat the escape and leave a stray colour.
        assertEquals("&", Msg.parse("&amp;"));
        assertEquals("<red>", Msg.parse("&lt;red&gt;"));
        assertEquals("&amp;", Msg.parse("&amp;amp;"));
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("tags and ampersand codes mix")
    void mixesWithTags() {
        String out = Msg.parse("<white>%player% <dark_gray>| &cno analysing");
        assertTrue(out.contains("§cno analysing"), out);
        assertTrue(out.startsWith("§f"), out);
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("strip removes what the parser produced")
    void stripsBoth() {
        assertEquals("no analysing", Msg.strip("&cno analysing"));
        assertEquals("no analysing", Msg.strip("<red>no analysing"));
    }
}
```

`src/test/java/me/everyone/oculusai/core/ValuesFormatTest.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.core;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import me.everyone.oculusai.player.PlayerData;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class ValuesFormatTest {

    private static String plain(String miniMessage) {
        return Msg.strip(miniMessage);
    }

    @Test
    void recentListsTheLastFiveOldestFirstAndAveragesThem() {
        List<PlayerData.Reading> readings = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            readings.add(new PlayerData.Reading(i, i / 10.0D, 0.0D));
        }
        String recent = plain(Values.recent(readings));
        assertEquals(".20 .30 .40 .50 .60", recent);
        assertEquals("0.40", plain(Values.average(readings)));
        assertTrue(plain(Values.recent(List.of())).equals("-"));
    }
}
```

`src/test/java/me/everyone/oculusai/detection/AttackLinkedRotationTest.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.detection;

import java.util.List;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;

@DisplayName("attack-linked rotation")
class AttackLinkedRotationTest {

    private static RotationSample sample(float yaw, boolean attacked) {
        return new RotationSample(yaw, 0.0F, attacked, Double.NaN);
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("a flick before the attack sample still counts")
    void flickBeforeHit() {
        // The client can send the look that sets up the hit before the attack
        // packet. The attack flag then lands one sample later, and looking only
        // at the marked sample left the flick out - a fast hit-and-turn was
        // never analysed.
        List<RotationSample> window = List.of(
                sample(0.0F, false),
                sample(35.0F, false),
                sample(35.0F, true));
        assertEquals(35.0D, Detection.attackLinkedRotation(window), 1.0E-9D);
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("a flick after the attack sample still counts")
    void flickAfterHit() {
        List<RotationSample> window = List.of(
                sample(0.0F, false),
                sample(0.0F, true),
                sample(30.0F, false));
        assertEquals(30.0D, Detection.attackLinkedRotation(window), 1.0E-9D);
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("rotation with no attack nearby is not counted")
    void noAttack() {
        List<RotationSample> window = List.of(
                sample(0.0F, false),
                sample(30.0F, false),
                sample(60.0F, false));
        assertEquals(0.0D, Detection.attackLinkedRotation(window), 1.0E-9D);
    }
}
```

`src/test/java/me/everyone/oculusai/detection/CritTimingTest.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.detection;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

@DisplayName("critical-hit timing")
class CritTimingTest {

    private static AttackMoment jumped(int airTicks, double aimError) {
        return new AttackMoment(aimError, (float) fallenAfter(airTicks), airTicks, false, false);
    }

    private static double fallenAfter(int airTicks) {
        double velocity = 0.42D;
        double fallen = 0.0D;
        for (int tick = 0; tick < airTicks; tick++) {
            velocity = (velocity - 0.08D) * 0.98D;
            if (velocity < 0.0D) {
                fallen += -velocity;
            }
        }
        return fallen;
    }

    private static AttackMoment grounded(double aimError) {
        return new AttackMoment(aimError, 0.0F, 0, true, false);
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("an empty history leaves every column at zero")
    void emptyHistoryIsNeutral() {
        CritTiming timing = CritTiming.of(List.of());

        assertEquals(0.0D, timing.fallMean());
        assertEquals(0.0D, timing.fallMin());
        assertEquals(0.0D, timing.airTicksMean());
        assertEquals(0.0D, timing.airTicksStd());
        assertEquals(0.0D, timing.airTicksModeShare());
        assertEquals(0.0D, timing.fallQuantumError());
        assertEquals(0.0D, timing.impossibleRatio());
        assertEquals(0.0D, timing.aimErrorDelta());
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("a fixed tick offset separates a forced crit from a jumped one")
    void metronomicTimingStandsOut() {
        List<AttackMoment> forced = new ArrayList<>();
        List<AttackMoment> human = new ArrayList<>();
        int[] humanTicks = {9, 11, 8, 13, 9, 8, 12, 10};
        for (int i = 0; i < humanTicks.length; i++) {
            forced.add(jumped(7, 1.0D));
            human.add(jumped(humanTicks[i], 1.0D));
        }

        CritTiming forcedTiming = CritTiming.of(forced);
        CritTiming humanTiming = CritTiming.of(human);

        assertEquals(0.0D, forcedTiming.airTicksStd());
        assertEquals(1.0D, forcedTiming.airTicksModeShare());
        assertTrue(humanTiming.airTicksStd() > 1.0D);
        assertTrue(humanTiming.airTicksModeShare() < 0.5D);
        assertTrue(forcedTiming.fallMin() < humanTiming.fallMin());
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("a fall distance off the physics ladder scores an error, a real one does not")
    void fallDistanceIsCheckedAgainstPhysics() {
        CortRealAndFake pair = new CortRealAndFake();

        assertTrue(pair.real.fallQuantumError() < 0.05D);
        assertTrue(pair.fake.fallQuantumError() > 0.3D);
    }

    private static final class CortRealAndFake {
        final CritTiming real;
        final CritTiming fake;

        CortRealAndFake() {
            List<AttackMoment> realHits = new ArrayList<>();
            List<AttackMoment> fakeHits = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int ticks = 6; ticks < 12; ticks++) {
                realHits.add(jumped(ticks, 1.0D));
                fakeHits.add(new AttackMoment(1.0D, 0.004F, ticks, false, false));
            }
            real = CritTiming.of(realHits);
            fake = CritTiming.of(fakeHits);
        }
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("a crit while sprinting or on the ground is counted as impossible")
    void impossibleCritsAreCounted() {
        List<AttackMoment> history = List.of(
                jumped(8, 1.0D),
                new AttackMoment(1.0D, 0.5F, 4, false, true),
                new AttackMoment(1.0D, 0.5F, 0, true, false),
                grounded(1.0D));

        CritTiming timing = CritTiming.of(history);

        assertEquals(2.0D / 3.0D, timing.impossibleRatio(), 1.0E-9D);
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("a swing in water or on a mount is not a crit")
    void blockedSwingsAreNotCrits() {
        AttackMoment inWater = new AttackMoment(1.0D, 0.5F, 9, false, false, true);
        assertFalse(inWater.crit());
        assertFalse(inWater.impossibleCrit());

        CritTiming timing = CritTiming.of(List.of(inWater, jumped(9, 1.0D)));
        assertEquals(9.0D, timing.airTicksMean(), 1.0E-9D);
        assertEquals(1.0D, timing.airTicksModeShare(), 1.0E-9D);
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("the aim error delta is zero until both kinds of hit exist")
    void aimErrorDeltaNeedsBothKinds() {
        assertEquals(0.0D, CritTiming.of(List.of(jumped(8, 4.0D))).aimErrorDelta());
        assertEquals(0.0D, CritTiming.of(List.of(grounded(1.0D))).aimErrorDelta());

        CritTiming mixed = CritTiming.of(List.of(jumped(8, 4.0D), grounded(1.0D)));
        assertEquals(3.0D, mixed.aimErrorDelta(), 1.0E-9D);
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("crit_rate comes from the window, every other column from the history")
    void windowAndHistoryAreSeparate() {
        List<RotationSample> window = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
            boolean attack = i == 5 || i == 15;
            AttackMoment moment = attack ? jumped(8, 1.5D) : null;
            window.add(new RotationSample(i * 3.0F, 10.0F + i * 0.5F, attack,
                    attack ? 1.5D : Double.NaN, moment));
        }

        assertEquals(1.0D, FeatureExtractor.critRate(window), 1.0E-9D);

        Map<String, Double> hit = CritTiming
                .of(List.of(jumped(8, 1.5D), jumped(8, 1.5D), grounded(0.5D)))
                .toMap(FeatureExtractor.critRate(window));

        assertEquals(14, hit.size());
        assertEquals(1.0D, hit.get("crit_rate"), 1.0E-9D);
        assertEquals(1.0D, hit.get("crit_air_ticks_mode_share"), 1.0E-9D);
        assertEquals(8.0D, hit.get("crit_air_ticks_mean"), 1.0E-9D);
        assertEquals(1.0D, hit.get("crit_aim_error_delta"), 1.0E-9D);
        assertEquals(0.0D, hit.get("crit_impossible_ratio"), 1.0E-9D);
        assertTrue(hit.get("crit_fall_min") > 0.0D);
        assertEquals(2.0D / 3.0D, hit.get("crit_share"), 1.0E-9D);
        assertEquals(0.5D, hit.get("crit_streak_share"), 1.0E-9D);
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("a window with no attacks keeps crit_rate at zero")
    void noAttacksMeansNoRate() {
        List<RotationSample> window = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
            window.add(new RotationSample(i * 3.0F, 10.0F, false, Double.NaN));
        }

        assertEquals(0.0D, FeatureExtractor.critRate(window));
        assertEquals(0.0D, CritTiming.of(List.of()).toMap(0.0D).get("crit_rate"));
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("the rhythm of the swings is measured, not the window they fell in")
    void rhythmComesFromIntervals() {
        List<AttackMoment> metronome = new ArrayList<>();
        List<AttackMoment> hand = new ArrayList<>();
        long[] handGaps = {280L, 410L, 330L, 520L, 300L, 390L};
        for (int i = 0; i < handGaps.length; i++) {
            metronome.add(swing(350L, -1));
            hand.add(swing(handGaps[i], -1));
        }

        CritTiming metronomic = CritTiming.of(metronome);
        CritTiming human = CritTiming.of(hand);

        assertEquals(350.0D, metronomic.intervalMean(), 1.0E-9D);
        assertEquals(0.0D, metronomic.intervalStd(), 1.0E-9D);
        assertTrue(human.intervalStd() > 50.0D);
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("a sprint released right before the swing is counted")
    void sprintReleaseIsCounted() {
        CritTiming timing = CritTiming.of(List.of(
                swing(300L, 2),
                swing(300L, 0),
                swing(300L, 40),
                swing(300L, -1)));

        assertEquals(0.5D, timing.sprintReleaseShare(), 1.0E-9D);
    }

    private static AttackMoment swing(long intervalMs, int sprintDroppedTicks) {
        return new AttackMoment(1.0D, 0.0F, 0, true, false, false,
                intervalMs, sprintDroppedTicks);
    }
}
```

`src/test/java/me/everyone/oculusai/detection/FeatureExtractorTest.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.detection;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNull;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

class FeatureExtractorTest {

    private static final String[] RATIO_FEATURES = {
            "yaw_std_rel", "pitch_mean_rel", "pitch_std_rel",
            "yaw_accel_rel", "pitch_accel_rel", "pitch_span_rel"};

    private static RotationSample sample(double yaw, double pitch) {
        return new RotationSample((float) yaw, (float) pitch, false, Double.NaN);
    }

    private static List<RotationSample> movingWindow(int ticks) {
        List<RotationSample> window = new ArrayList<>(ticks);
        double yaw = 0.0D;
        double pitch = 0.0D;
        for (int i = 0; i < ticks; i++) {
            window.add(sample(yaw, pitch));
            yaw += 2.5D + (i % 3);
            pitch += 0.4D * (i % 2 == 0 ? 1 : -1);
        }
        return window;
    }

    private static List<RotationSample> stillThenFlickWindow(int ticks, int stillTicks) {
        List<RotationSample> window = new ArrayList<>(ticks);
        for (int i = 0; i < ticks; i++) {
            window.add(sample(0.0D, 0.0D));
        }
        double yaw = 0.0D;
        double pitch = 0.0D;
        for (int i = stillTicks; i < ticks; i++) {
            window.set(i, sample(yaw, pitch));
            yaw += 0.8D;
            pitch += 0.2D;
        }
        return window;
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("a window that never moved is refused instead of scored")
    void stillWindowIsRefused() {
        assertNull(FeatureExtractor.extract(stillThenFlickWindow(20, 20), 1.0D));
        assertNull(FeatureExtractor.extract(List.of(sample(1, 1), sample(1, 1), sample(1, 1)), 1.0D));
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("a sparse flick is scored even when most samples are still")
    void sparseFlickIsScored() {
        // A short fight can be one fast turn surrounded by still samples. The
        // median delta is zero there, but the window is not empty - refusing it
        // let a fast hit-and-turn go unanalysed.
        for (int stillTicks = 10; stillTicks <= 18; stillTicks++) {
            List<RotationSample> window = stillThenFlickWindow(20, stillTicks);
            assertNotNull(FeatureExtractor.extract(window, 1.0D),
                    "stillTicks=" + stillTicks + " has a real flick");
        }
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("a one-tick 180 degree flick produces a bounded vector")
    void fastFlickAmongStillSamples() {
        List<RotationSample> window = new ArrayList<>(20);
        for (int i = 0; i < 19; i++) {
            window.add(sample(0.0D, 0.0D));
        }
        window.add(sample(180.0D, 0.0D));

        FeatureVector vector = FeatureExtractor.extract(window, 1.0D);

        assertNotNull(vector);
        Map<String, Double> features = vector.toMap();
        assertTrue(features.get("snap_ratio") > 1.0D);
        assertTrue(features.get("zero_ratio") > 0.9D);
        for (String name : RATIO_FEATURES) {
            assertTrue(Double.isFinite(features.get(name)), name + " is not finite");
            assertTrue(features.get(name) < 1.0E3D, name + " blew up to " + features.get(name));
        }
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("no window that is scored carries a divided-by-nothing value")
    void ratioFeaturesStayBounded() {
        for (int ticks = 3; ticks <= 40; ticks++) {
            for (int stillTicks = 0; stillTicks < ticks; stillTicks += 3) {
                List<RotationSample> window = stillThenFlickWindow(ticks, stillTicks);
                FeatureVector vector = FeatureExtractor.extract(window, 1.0D);
                if (vector == null) {
                    continue;
                }
                Map<String, Double> features = vector.toMap();
                for (String name : RATIO_FEATURES) {
                    double value = features.get(name);
                    assertTrue(Double.isFinite(value), name + " is not finite");
                    assertTrue(value < 1.0E3D,
                            name + " blew up to " + value + " for ticks=" + ticks
                                    + " stillTicks=" + stillTicks);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("an ordinary window still produces a usable vector")
    void movingWindowIsScored() {
        FeatureVector vector = FeatureExtractor.extract(movingWindow(20), 2.0D);

        assertNotNull(vector);
        Map<String, Double> features = vector.toMap();
        assertEquals(17, features.size());
        assertTrue(features.get("yaw_std_rel") > 0.0D);
        assertTrue(features.get("quanta_per_tick") > 0.0D);
        assertTrue(features.get("scale_vs_baseline") > 0.0D);
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("a still window is refused regardless of the baseline")
    void baselineDoesNotRescueAStillWindow() {
        List<RotationSample> window = stillThenFlickWindow(20, 20);

        assertNull(FeatureExtractor.extract(window, 0.0D));
        assertNull(FeatureExtractor.extract(window, 1.0D));
        assertNull(FeatureExtractor.extract(window, 1.0E9D));
    }
}
```

`src/test/java/me/everyone/oculusai/detection/MedianWindowTest.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.detection;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;

@DisplayName("probability smoothing")
class MedianWindowTest {

    @Test
    @DisplayName("a window of one or zero keeps the raw reading")
    void passthrough() {
        MedianWindow one = new MedianWindow(1);
        assertEquals(0.42D, one.add(0.42D), 1.0E-12D);
        assertEquals(0.03D, one.add(0.03D), 1.0E-12D);

        assertEquals(1, new MedianWindow(0).size());
        assertEquals(0.42D, new MedianWindow(0).add(0.42D), 1.0E-12D);
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("one dropout mid-cheat does not reach the buffer")
    void ignoresOneDropout() {
        // The case this exists for: a window held a single swing, several
        // columns went degenerate, and the reading fell to near zero while the
        // player carried on cheating. A mean would pull the answer under the
        // 0.5 suspicion line and hand back the reading; the median should not
        // notice at all.
        MedianWindow window = new MedianWindow(3);
        window.add(0.90D);
        window.add(0.88D);
        assertEquals(0.88D, window.add(0.05D), 1.0E-12D);
        assertEquals(0.88D, window.add(0.91D), 1.0E-12D);
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("it answers from fewer readings than the window holds")
    void coldStart() {
        MedianWindow window = new MedianWindow(3);
        assertEquals(0.80D, window.add(0.80D), 1.0E-12D);
        assertEquals(0.50D, window.add(0.20D), 1.0E-12D);
        assertEquals(0.20D, window.add(0.10D), 1.0E-12D);
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("a sustained change is followed, one window late")
    void followsRealChange() {
        MedianWindow window = new MedianWindow(3);
        window.add(0.10D);
        window.add(0.10D);
        assertEquals(0.10D, window.add(0.90D), 1.0E-12D);
        assertEquals(0.90D, window.add(0.90D), 1.0E-12D);
        assertEquals(0.90D, window.add(0.90D), 1.0E-12D);
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("a reset forgets the previous player's readings")
    void resetClears() {
        MedianWindow window = new MedianWindow(3);
        window.add(0.90D);
        window.add(0.90D);
        window.reset();
        assertEquals(0.10D, window.add(0.10D), 1.0E-12D);
    }
}
```

`src/test/java/me/everyone/oculusai/detection/RunningStatsTest.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.detection;

import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

@DisplayName("running session statistics")
class RunningStatsTest {

    private static final String[] NAMES = {"a", "b"};

    @Test
    @DisplayName("an untouched set of statistics is all zeroes")
    void coldStartIsZero() {
        Map<String, Double> map = new RunningStats(NAMES).toMap();

        assertEquals(4, map.size());
        assertEquals(0.0D, map.get("a_run_mean"));
        assertEquals(0.0D, map.get("a_run_std"));
        assertEquals(0.0D, map.get("b_run_mean"));
        assertEquals(0.0D, map.get("b_run_std"));
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("one window is its own mean and has no spread")
    void singleWindow() {
        RunningStats stats = new RunningStats(NAMES);
        stats.add(new double[]{3.0D, -1.5D});
        Map<String, Double> map = stats.toMap();

        assertEquals(3.0D, map.get("a_run_mean"), 1.0E-12D);
        assertEquals(-1.5D, map.get("b_run_mean"), 1.0E-12D);
        assertEquals(0.0D, map.get("a_run_std"), 1.0E-12D);
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("mean and population std match the long way round")
    void matchesDirectArithmetic() {
        double[][] windows = {{1.0D, 10.0D}, {2.0D, 14.0D}, {6.0D, 12.0D}, {3.0D, 20.0D}};
        RunningStats stats = new RunningStats(NAMES);
        for (double[] window : windows) {
            stats.add(window);
        }
        Map<String, Double> map = stats.toMap();

        for (int column = 0; column < NAMES.length; column++) {
            double mean = 0.0D;
            for (double[] window : windows) {
                mean += window[column];
            }
            mean /= windows.length;
            double variance = 0.0D;
            for (double[] window : windows) {
                variance += Math.pow(window[column] - mean, 2);
            }
            variance /= windows.length;

            assertEquals(mean, map.get(NAMES[column] + "_run_mean"), 1.0E-9D);
            assertEquals(Math.sqrt(variance), map.get(NAMES[column] + "_run_std"), 1.0E-9D);
        }
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("a five-figure column keeps its precision over a long session")
    void staysPreciseOnLargeValues() {
        RunningStats stats = new RunningStats(new String[]{"q"});
        for (int i = 0; i < 5000; i++) {
            stats.add(new double[]{56000.0D + (i % 2 == 0 ? 0.5D : -0.5D)});
        }
        Map<String, Double> map = stats.toMap();

        assertEquals(56000.0D, map.get("q_run_mean"), 1.0E-6D);
        assertEquals(0.5D, map.get("q_run_std"), 1.0E-6D);
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("NaN and infinity are skipped rather than poisoning the mean")
    void ignoresNonFinite() {
        RunningStats stats = new RunningStats(NAMES);
        stats.add(new double[]{2.0D, Double.NaN});
        stats.add(new double[]{4.0D, Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY});
        Map<String, Double> map = stats.toMap();

        assertEquals(3.0D, map.get("a_run_mean"), 1.0E-12D);
        assertTrue(Double.isFinite(map.get("b_run_mean")));
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("a window of the wrong width is refused, not folded in")
    void refusesWrongWidth() {
        RunningStats stats = new RunningStats(NAMES);
        stats.add(new double[]{1.0D});
        stats.add(new double[]{1.0D, 2.0D, 3.0D});

        assertEquals(0L, stats.count());
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("a decaying horizon still starts as its own mean")
    void decayingSingleWindow() {
        RunningStats stats = new RunningStats(NAMES, 15);
        stats.add(new double[]{3.0D, -1.5D});
        Map<String, Double> map = stats.toMap();

        assertEquals(3.0D, map.get("a_run_mean"), 1.0E-12D);
        assertEquals(-1.5D, map.get("b_run_mean"), 1.0E-12D);
        assertEquals(0.0D, map.get("a_run_std"), 1.0E-12D);
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("a decaying horizon matches the exponential average the long way round")
    void decayingMatchesDirectArithmetic() {
        double[][] windows = {{1.0D, 10.0D}, {2.0D, 14.0D}, {6.0D, 12.0D}, {3.0D, 20.0D}};
        int horizon = 3;
        double alpha = 2.0D / (horizon + 1.0D);
        RunningStats stats = new RunningStats(NAMES, horizon);
        for (double[] window : windows) {
            stats.add(window);
        }
        Map<String, Double> map = stats.toMap();

        for (int column = 0; column < NAMES.length; column++) {
            double mean = windows[0][column];
            double variance = 0.0D;
            for (int i = 1; i < windows.length; i++) {
                double delta = windows[i][column] - mean;
                mean += alpha * delta;
                variance = (1.0D - alpha) * (variance + alpha * delta * delta);
            }
            assertEquals(mean, map.get(NAMES[column] + "_run_mean"), 1.0E-9D);
            assertEquals(Math.sqrt(variance), map.get(NAMES[column] + "_run_std"), 1.0E-9D);
        }
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("old history stops deciding the mean once the horizon decays")
    void decayingForgetsTheAlibi() {
        // The point of the horizon: a long honest session must not be able to
        // swallow a change in behaviour. Cumulatively it does - after a
        // thousand windows at zero, twenty windows at one barely move the
        // mean - and that is how a cheat switched on late used to dissolve in
        // its own player's history.
        RunningStats cumulative = new RunningStats(NAMES, 0);
        RunningStats decaying = new RunningStats(NAMES, 15);
        for (int i = 0; i < 1000; i++) {
            cumulative.add(new double[]{0.0D, 0.0D});
            decaying.add(new double[]{0.0D, 0.0D});
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
            cumulative.add(new double[]{1.0D, 1.0D});
            decaying.add(new double[]{1.0D, 1.0D});
        }

        assertTrue(cumulative.toMap().get("a_run_mean") < 0.05D,
                "a cumulative mean is still dominated by the thousand quiet windows");
        assertTrue(decaying.toMap().get("a_run_mean") > 0.8D,
                "a decaying mean should have caught up with the recent twenty");
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("horizon zero is the old unbounded behaviour")
    void horizonZeroIsCumulative() {
        RunningStats explicit = new RunningStats(NAMES, 0);
        RunningStats byDefault = new RunningStats(NAMES);
        for (double value : new double[]{1.0D, 7.0D, 3.0D}) {
            explicit.add(new double[]{value, value});
            byDefault.add(new double[]{value, value});
        }

        assertEquals(0, explicit.horizon());
        assertEquals(byDefault.toMap(), explicit.toMap());
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("both schemas name the same columns, in the order the service expects")
    void schemasMatchTheService() {
        List<String> columns = FeatureSchemas.names(FeatureSchemas.COLUMNS);
        // 16 колонок вращения, 14 удара, затем бегущие среднее и разброс по
        // колонкам вращения - по 16 каждое.
        assertEquals(62, columns.size());
        assertEquals("scale_vs_baseline", columns.get(0));
        assertEquals("crit_rate", columns.get(16));
        assertEquals("scale_vs_baseline_run_mean", columns.get(30));
        assertEquals("aim_error_min_run_std", columns.get(61));

        // Схемы различаются не колонками, а тем, что лежит под строкой:
        // v2 требует сырых тиков, v1 - нет.
        assertEquals(columns, FeatureSchemas.names(FeatureSchemas.TICKS));
        assertFalse(FeatureSchemas.needsTicks(FeatureSchemas.COLUMNS));
        assertTrue(FeatureSchemas.needsTicks(FeatureSchemas.TICKS));
        assertTrue(FeatureSchemas.known(FeatureSchemas.COLUMNS));
        assertTrue(FeatureSchemas.known(FeatureSchemas.TICKS));
        assertFalse(FeatureSchemas.known(2));
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("slicing takes columns by name, not by position")
    void slicingIsByName() {
        Map<String, Double> everything = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        for (String name : FeatureSchemas.names(FeatureSchemas.COLUMNS)) {
            everything.put(name, 1.0D);
        }
        everything.put("attacks_per_second", 9.0D);

        Map<String, Double> sliced = FeatureSchemas.slice(everything, FeatureSchemas.COLUMNS);
        assertEquals(62, sliced.size());
        assertEquals(1.0D, sliced.get("scale_vs_baseline"));
        assertEquals(1.0D, sliced.get("scale_vs_baseline_run_mean"));
        // Выброшенная колонка не возвращается, даже если её кто-то прислал.
        assertEquals(null, sliced.get("attacks_per_second"));

        Map<String, Double> missing = FeatureSchemas.slice(Map.of(), FeatureSchemas.COLUMNS);
        assertEquals(62, missing.size());
        assertEquals(0.0D, missing.get("smoothness"));
    }
}
```

`src/test/java/me/everyone/oculusai/detection/SuspicionBufferTest.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.detection;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;

@DisplayName("suspicion buffer arithmetic")
class SuspicionBufferTest {

    private static final double SUSPICION = 0.5D;
    private static final double GAIN = 1.5D;
    private static final double DECAY = 1.4D;
    private static final double LEAK = 0.4D;
    private static final double MAX = 10.0D;
    private static final double NO_CAP = 0.0D;

    private static double add(double buffer, double probability) {
        return SuspicionBuffer.add(buffer, probability, SUSPICION, GAIN, DECAY, LEAK, MAX, NO_CAP);
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("a burst of cheating builds the buffer exactly as before")
    void growthIsUnchanged() {
        // 0.9 is 0.4 above the line, gain 1.5 adds 0.6 per window. The leak
        // must not touch the evidence path, or the tuned detection speed moves.
        double buffer = 0.0D;
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            buffer = add(buffer, 0.90D);
        }
        assertEquals(2.4D, buffer, 1.0E-12D);
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("one honest window clears a two-second cheat burst")
    void shortBurstDoesNotOutliveTheCheat() {
        double buffer = 0.0D;
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            buffer = add(buffer, 0.90D);
        }
        assertEquals(2.4D, buffer, 1.0E-12D);
        // Without the leak this only fell to 1.84 - still above the 1.7 alert
        // threshold - and the first honest window was flagged.
        buffer = add(buffer, 0.10D);
        assertEquals(1.104D, buffer, 1.0E-12D);
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("a reading on the suspicion line still releases the buffer")
    void lineItselfLeaks() {
        // The old rule subtracted distance * decay. At exactly 0.5 that is
        // zero, so the buffer froze and the next fight inherited it.
        assertEquals(1.5D, add(2.5D, SUSPICION), 1.0E-12D);
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("a zero leak reproduces the old arithmetic")
    void leakCanBeDisabled() {
        double withOldRule = Math.max(0.0D, Math.min(MAX,
                2.5D + (0.10D - SUSPICION) * DECAY));
        assertEquals(withOldRule, SuspicionBuffer.add(2.5D, 0.10D, SUSPICION,
                GAIN, DECAY, 0.0D, MAX, NO_CAP), 1.0E-12D);
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("the cap limits one reading without touching the rest")
    void capLimitsASingleReading() {
        // 0.99 is 0.49 above the line and would add 0.735 uncapped.
        assertEquals(0.735D,
                SuspicionBuffer.add(0.0D, 0.99D, SUSPICION, GAIN, DECAY, LEAK, MAX, NO_CAP),
                1.0E-12D);
        assertEquals(0.4D,
                SuspicionBuffer.add(0.0D, 0.99D, SUSPICION, GAIN, DECAY, LEAK, MAX, 0.4D),
                1.0E-12D);
        // A step already under the cap is untouched, so the cap only ever
        // removes the spikes it was added for.
        assertEquals(0.15D,
                SuspicionBuffer.add(0.0D, 0.60D, SUSPICION, GAIN, DECAY, LEAK, MAX, 0.4D),
                1.0E-12D);
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("the cap does not interfere with release")
    void capLeavesDecayAlone() {
        assertEquals(add(2.5D, 0.10D),
                SuspicionBuffer.add(2.5D, 0.10D, SUSPICION, GAIN, DECAY, LEAK, MAX, 0.4D),
                1.0E-12D);
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("the buffer stays inside its bounds")
    void clamped() {
        assertEquals(MAX, add(MAX, 0.99D), 1.0E-12D);
        assertEquals(0.0D, add(0.0D, 0.01D), 1.0E-12D);
    }
}
```

`src/test/java/me/everyone/oculusai/detection/crystal/CrystalTimelineTest.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.detection.crystal;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertArrayEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;

import java.util.List;
import me.everyone.oculusai.detection.RotationSample;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class CrystalTimelineTest {

    private static RotationSample tick() {
        return new RotationSample(0.0F, 0.0F, false, Double.NaN);
    }

    @Test
    void aBurstOfEventsBecomesOneFullWindow() {
        CrystalTimeline timeline = new CrystalTimeline();
        timeline.recording(true);
        for (int i = 0; i < 25; i++) {
            timeline.onTick(tick());
        }
        timeline.placed(5.0D, 3.0D);
        timeline.onTick(tick());
        timeline.onTick(tick());
        timeline.broken(12.0D, 3.5D);
        timeline.slotSwitched();
        timeline.onTick(tick());
        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
            timeline.onTick(tick());
        }

        assertEquals(1, timeline.recorded());
        List<List<double[]>> drained = timeline.drain();
        double[] row = drained.get(0).get(0);
        double[] ticks = drained.get(1).get(0);
        assertEquals(CrystalSchema.WINDOW * CrystalSchema.TICK_CHANNELS.size(), ticks.length);
        // places, breaks, place->break ticks, place angle, break angle,
        // slot switches, dealt, taken, totems, anchor charges, anchor
        // explosions, blast angle mean (-1: no look yet), unseen hits
        assertArrayEquals(new double[]{1, 1, 2, 5, 12, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, -1, 0}, row, 1.0e-9);
        assertEquals(0, timeline.recorded());
    }

    @Test
    void nothingIsWrittenWhileNotRecording() {
        CrystalTimeline timeline = new CrystalTimeline();
        for (int i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
            timeline.onTick(tick());
        }
        timeline.placed(5.0D, 3.0D);
        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
            timeline.onTick(tick());
        }
        assertEquals(0, timeline.recorded());
    }

    @Test
    void anEventBeforeAFullHistoryIsDropped() {
        CrystalTimeline timeline = new CrystalTimeline();
        timeline.recording(true);
        timeline.onTick(tick());
        timeline.placed(5.0D, 3.0D);
        for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
            timeline.onTick(tick());
        }
        assertEquals(0, timeline.recorded());
    }

    @Test
    void windowsGoToPredictionWithoutRecording() {
        CrystalTimeline timeline = new CrystalTimeline();
        java.util.List<double[]> sent = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        timeline.sink((columns, ticks) -> sent.add(columns));
        for (int i = 0; i < 25; i++) {
            timeline.onTick(tick());
        }
        timeline.broken(3.0D, 2.0D);
        for (int i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
            timeline.onTick(tick());
        }
        assertEquals(1, sent.size());
        assertEquals(1.0D, sent.get(0)[1], 1.0e-9);
        // Без записи в датасет ничего не копится.
        assertEquals(0, timeline.recorded());
    }

    @Test
    void theCrystalBufferIsItsOwn() {
        CrystalTimeline timeline = new CrystalTimeline();
        for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
            timeline.applyProbability(0.95D, 0.5D, 1.5D, 1.4D, 0.4D, 10.0D, 0.0D);
        }
        org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue(timeline.buffer() > 3.0D, "buffer " + timeline.buffer());
        assertEquals(0.95D, timeline.probability(), 1.0e-9);
        timeline.resetBuffer();
        assertEquals(0.0D, timeline.buffer(), 1.0e-9);
    }

    @Test
    void aHitBeforeTheSpawnPacketIsAPrediction() throws Exception {
        CrystalTimeline timeline = new CrystalTimeline();
        timeline.spawned(100, true, 0, 64, 0);
        Thread.sleep(2);
        timeline.attackArrived(100);
        org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse(timeline.hitBeforeSeen(100),
                "a crystal the client had been sent");

        timeline.attackArrived(101);
        Thread.sleep(2);
        timeline.spawned(101, true, 0, 64, 0);
        org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue(timeline.hitBeforeSeen(101),
                "the spawn went out after the hit");

        timeline.attackArrived(102);
        org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue(timeline.hitBeforeSeen(102),
                "never sent at all");
    }

    @Test
    void noSpawnsSeenMeansNoVerdict() {
        CrystalTimeline timeline = new CrystalTimeline();
        timeline.attackArrived(7);
        org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse(timeline.hitBeforeSeen(7),
                "with no spawn packet ever seen the listener is not working");
    }

    @Test
    void theLookAtTheNearestCrystalIsWrittenEveryTick() {
        CrystalTimeline timeline = new CrystalTimeline();
        timeline.recording(true);
        // Кристалл в 4 блоках прямо по курсу (yaw 0 смотрит на +z).
        timeline.spawned(5, true, 0.0D, 63.0D, 4.0D);
        timeline.look("world", 0.0D, 64.0D, 0.0D, 0.0F, 0.0F);
        for (int i = 0; i < 25; i++) {
            timeline.onTick(tick());
        }
        timeline.placed(0.0D, 4.0D);
        for (int i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
            timeline.onTick(tick());
        }
        double[] ticks = timeline.drain().get(1).get(0);
        int channels = CrystalSchema.TICK_CHANNELS.size();
        int angleAt = CrystalSchema.TICK_CHANNELS.indexOf("blast_angle");
        int distanceAt = CrystalSchema.TICK_CHANNELS.indexOf("blast_distance");
        // Первый тик окна, без всякого события: наводка уже есть.
        assertEquals(0.0D, ticks[angleAt], 1.0e-6);
        assertEquals(4.0D, ticks[distanceAt], 1.0e-6);
        timeline.destroyed(5);
    }

    @Test
    void aChargedAnchorCountsAsABlastSource() {
        CrystalTimeline timeline = new CrystalTimeline();
        CrystalTimeline.anchorArmed("world", 2, 63, 0);
        try {
            timeline.recording(true);
            timeline.look("world", 0.0D, 64.0D, 0.0D, 0.0F, 0.0F);
            for (int i = 0; i < 25; i++) {
                timeline.onTick(tick());
            }
            timeline.anchorCharged(10.0D, 2.5D);
            for (int i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
                timeline.onTick(tick());
            }
            List<List<double[]>> drained = timeline.drain();
            double[] ticks = drained.get(1).get(0);
            int distanceAt = CrystalSchema.TICK_CHANNELS.indexOf("blast_distance");
            org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue(ticks[distanceAt] > 2.5D && ticks[distanceAt] < 3.0D,
                    "distance " + ticks[distanceAt]);
            assertEquals(1.0D, drained.get(0).get(0)[CrystalSchema.COLUMNS.indexOf("anchor_charges")], 1.0e-9);
        } finally {
            CrystalTimeline.clearAnchors();
        }
    }

    @Test
    void schemaStartsWithTheAimChannels() {
        assertEquals(me.everyone.oculusai.detection.Detection.TICK_CHANNELS,
                CrystalSchema.TICK_CHANNELS.subList(0, me.everyone.oculusai.detection.Detection.TICK_CHANNELS.size()));
        assertEquals(32, CrystalSchema.TICK_CHANNELS.size());
        assertEquals(13, CrystalSchema.COLUMNS.size());
    }
}
```

`src/test/java/me/everyone/oculusai/network/ApiClientTest.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.network;

import com.google.gson.JsonArray;
import java.util.List;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

class ApiClientTest {

    @Test
    @DisplayName("a window that was never scored becomes null, not an exception")
    void unscoredWindowsBecomeNull() {
        List<double[]> context = List.of(
                new double[]{Double.NaN, Double.NaN},
                new double[]{0.93, 7.5});

        JsonArray scores = ApiClient.column(context, 0);
        JsonArray buffers = ApiClient.column(context, 1);

        assertEquals(2, scores.size());
        assertTrue(scores.get(0).isJsonNull());
        assertEquals(0.93, scores.get(1).getAsDouble(), 1e-9);
        assertTrue(buffers.get(0).isJsonNull());
        assertEquals(7.5, buffers.get(1).getAsDouble(), 1e-9);
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("a capture of nothing but unscored windows serialises")
    void allUnscoredSerialises() {
        List<double[]> context = List.of(
                new double[]{Double.NaN, Double.NaN},
                new double[]{Double.NaN, Double.NaN});

        JsonArray scores = ApiClient.column(context, 0);

        assertEquals("[null,null]", scores.toString());
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("only captures the model actually scored carry the columns")
    void scoredCapturesAreRecognised() {
        assertFalse(ApiClient.anyScored(List.of(
                new double[]{Double.NaN, Double.NaN},
                new double[]{Double.NaN, Double.NaN})));
        assertTrue(ApiClient.anyScored(List.of(
                new double[]{Double.NaN, Double.NaN},
                new double[]{0.5, 2.0})));
        assertFalse(ApiClient.anyScored(List.of()));
    }
}
```

`src/test/java/me/everyone/oculusai/network/UpdaterTest.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.network;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

@DisplayName("update checks")
class UpdaterTest {

    @Test
    @DisplayName("a higher version is newer, component by component")
    void ordersVersions() {
        assertTrue(Updater.newer("1.3.8", "1.3.7"));
        assertTrue(Updater.newer("1.4.0", "1.3.99"));
        assertTrue(Updater.newer("2.0", "1.9.9"));
        assertTrue(Updater.newer("1.3.8.1", "1.3.8"));
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("the same or older version is not newer")
    void refusesSameOrOlder() {
        assertFalse(Updater.newer("1.3.7", "1.3.7"));
        assertFalse(Updater.newer("1.3.7", "1.3.8"));
        assertFalse(Updater.newer("1.3", "1.3.0"));
        assertFalse(Updater.newer("1.2.9", "1.10.0"));
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("a version that cannot be parsed is never newer")
    void malformedIsNeverNewer() {
        // This decides whether executable code is downloaded, so anything the
        // comparison cannot read has to mean "do nothing" rather than "try".
        assertFalse(Updater.newer("", "1.3.7"));
        assertFalse(Updater.newer("latest", "1.3.7"));
        assertFalse(Updater.newer("1.3.x", "1.3.7"));
        assertFalse(Updater.newer("../../etc", "1.3.7"));
        assertFalse(Updater.newer("1.3.8", "not-a-version"));
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("a pre-release suffix is compared on its numbers")
    void suffixIgnored() {
        assertTrue(Updater.newer("1.3.8-rc1", "1.3.7"));
        assertFalse(Updater.newer("1.3.7-rc1", "1.3.7"));
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("release notes are trimmed to one chat line")
    void notesAreOneLine() {
        // The notes come from whoever published the build, and a newline in
        // them would split the reminder into two messages the client renders
        // on their own.
        assertEquals("Faster windows", Updater.firstLine("Faster windows\nand a fix"));
        assertEquals("Faster windows", Updater.firstLine("  Faster windows  "));
        assertEquals("", Updater.firstLine(null));
        assertEquals("", Updater.firstLine("   "));
        assertEquals(120, Updater.firstLine("x".repeat(400)).length());
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("only https on the allowed hosts is trusted")
    void trustsOnlyTheAllowlist() {
        assertTrue(Updater.trusted(
                "https://github.com/gobgolaxi/OculusAI/releases/download/v1.3.8/OculusAI.jar"));
        assertTrue(Updater.trusted("https://objects.githubusercontent.com/x.jar"));

        assertFalse(Updater.trusted("http://github.com/x.jar"));
        assertFalse(Updater.trusted("https://evil.example/x.jar"));
        assertFalse(Updater.trusted("file:///tmp/x.jar"));
        assertFalse(Updater.trusted(""));
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("a host that merely contains an allowed name is not trusted")
    void refusesLookalikeHosts() {
        // The check is on the parsed host, not on the text of the URL, so none
        // of the usual ways of smuggling a hostname past a substring test work.
        assertFalse(Updater.trusted("https://github.com.evil.example/x.jar"));
        assertFalse(Updater.trusted("https://notgithub.com/x.jar"));
        assertFalse(Updater.trusted("https://evil.example/?u=github.com/x.jar"));
        assertFalse(Updater.trusted("https://evil.example/#github.com"));
        assertFalse(Updater.trusted("https://user@evil.example/x.jar"));
    }
}
```

`src/test/java/me/everyone/oculusai/player/RecordedScoresTest.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.player;

import java.lang.reflect.Proxy;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;
import org.bukkit.Location;
import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNotEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

/** A recorded window carries what the model said about it.
 *
 *  <p>The score and buffer columns have been in the upload format from the
 *  start and went out empty for as long as analysis stopped while recording.
 *  They are filled in a round trip after the row is written, which is the
 *  whole reason the epoch exists: between those two moments the capture may
 *  have been committed and cleared, and a late answer must not be written
 *  into whatever row now sits at that index. */
@DisplayName("recorded windows carry the model's answer")
class RecordedScoresTest {

    private static final List<String> NAMES = List.of("a", "b");

    private static PlayerData player() {
        UUID uuid = UUID.nameUUIDFromBytes("Recorded".getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        Player stub = (Player) Proxy.newProxyInstance(
                Player.class.getClassLoader(),
                new Class<?>[]{Player.class},
                (proxy, method, args) -> switch (method.getName()) {
                    case "getUniqueId" -> uuid;
                    case "getName" -> "Recorded";
                    case "getEntityId" -> 1;
                    case "getLocation" -> new Location(null, 0, 0, 0);
                    case "isOnline" -> true;
                    case "hashCode" -> 1;
                    case "equals" -> proxy == args[0];
                    case "toString" -> "Recorded";
                    default -> null;
                });
        return new PlayerData(stub);
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("a row is written with no score and gets one later")
    void fillsInTheAnswer() {
        PlayerData data = player();
        int epoch = data.recordedEpoch();

        int first = data.record(NAMES, new double[]{1.0D, 2.0D});
        int second = data.record(NAMES, new double[]{3.0D, 4.0D});
        assertEquals(0, first);
        assertEquals(1, second);

        // Written down before the service has answered: a capture must not
        // depend on the network, so the row exists with an empty score.
        assertTrue(Double.isNaN(data.recordedContext().get(0)[0]),
                "a fresh row has no score yet");

        data.scoreRecorded(epoch, first, 0.91D, 4.2D);
        data.scoreRecorded(epoch, second, 0.12D, 0.5D);

        assertEquals(0.91D, data.recordedContext().get(0)[0], 1.0E-9D);
        assertEquals(4.2D, data.recordedContext().get(0)[1], 1.0E-9D);
        assertEquals(0.12D, data.recordedContext().get(1)[0], 1.0E-9D);
        assertEquals(2, data.recordedCount());
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("an answer that arrives after the capture was committed is dropped")
    void dropsAStaleAnswer() {
        PlayerData data = player();
        int epoch = data.recordedEpoch();
        int row = data.record(NAMES, new double[]{1.0D, 2.0D});

        // What a commit does: the rows are uploaded and the capture starts
        // over. The request for the last window is still in flight.
        data.clearRecorded();
        assertEquals(0, data.recordedCount());

        int reused = data.record(NAMES, new double[]{9.0D, 9.0D});
        assertEquals(row, reused, "the new capture reuses the index");

        data.scoreRecorded(epoch, row, 0.99D, 7.0D);

        assertTrue(Double.isNaN(data.recordedContext().get(0)[0]),
                "the late answer did not land on the new row");
        assertNotEquals(epoch, data.recordedEpoch(), "committing moved the epoch on");
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("an index that is no longer there is ignored")
    void ignoresAMissingRow() {
        PlayerData data = player();
        int epoch = data.recordedEpoch();
        data.record(NAMES, new double[]{1.0D, 2.0D});

        // A window measured while not recording reports -1 as its row, and
        // the answer for it arrives all the same.
        data.scoreRecorded(epoch, -1, 0.5D, 1.0D);
        data.scoreRecorded(epoch, 99, 0.5D, 1.0D);

        assertEquals(1, data.recordedCount());
        assertTrue(Double.isNaN(data.recordedContext().get(0)[0]));
    }
}
```

`src/test/java/me/everyone/oculusai/storage/DatasetStoreRosterTest.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.storage;

import java.lang.reflect.Proxy;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.UUID;
import me.everyone.oculusai.player.PlayerData;
import org.bukkit.Location;
import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNull;

@DisplayName("the roster is found by name, online or not")
class DatasetStoreRosterTest {

    private static PlayerData player(String name) {
        UUID uuid = UUID.nameUUIDFromBytes(name.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        Player stub = (Player) Proxy.newProxyInstance(
                Player.class.getClassLoader(),
                new Class<?>[]{Player.class},
                (proxy, method, args) -> switch (method.getName()) {
                    case "getUniqueId" -> uuid;
                    case "getName" -> name;
                    case "getEntityId" -> 1;
                    case "getLocation" -> new Location(null, 0, 0, 0);
                    case "isOnline" -> true;
                    case "hashCode" -> 1;
                    case "equals" -> proxy == args[0];
                    case "toString" -> name;
                    default -> null;
                });
        return new PlayerData(stub);
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("a player who logged off is still on the roster by name")
    void findsAPlayerWhoLeft() {
        // The case this exists for: an admin wants somebody off the roster
        // after they logged off, and the roster used to be reachable only
        // through the players who are online right now.
        DatasetStore store = new DatasetStore(null);
        PlayerData data = player("Hokuso17");
        store.enrol(data, DatasetStore.CHEATER);

        DatasetStore.RosterEntry entry = store.entryByName("Hokuso17");

        assertEquals(data.uuid(), entry.uuid());
        assertEquals("Hokuso17", entry.name());
        assertEquals(DatasetStore.CHEATER, entry.label());
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("the name is matched the way an admin types it")
    void ignoresCaseAndSpaces() {
        DatasetStore store = new DatasetStore(null);
        store.enrol(player("Hokuso17"), DatasetStore.LEGIT);

        assertEquals("Hokuso17", store.entryByName("hokuso17").name());
        assertEquals("Hokuso17", store.entryByName("  HoKuSo17  ").name());
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("a name nobody signed up with finds nothing")
    void unknownNameFindsNothing() {
        DatasetStore store = new DatasetStore(null);
        store.enrol(player("Hokuso17"), DatasetStore.CHEATER);

        assertNull(store.entryByName("Somebody"));
        assertNull(store.entryByName(""));
        assertNull(store.entryByName("   "));
        assertNull(store.entryByName(null));
    }
}
```

`src/test/java/me/everyone/oculusai/storage/JournalPersistenceTest.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.storage;

import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
import com.google.gson.JsonParser;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

@DisplayName("journal survives a restart")
class JournalPersistenceTest {

    private static final String UUID_ONE = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111";

    private static JsonObject parse(String json) {
        return new JsonParser().parse(json).getAsJsonObject();
    }

    private static String written() {
        return "{\"entries\":[{"
                + "\"uuid\":\"" + UUID_ONE + "\","
                + "\"name\":\"Hokuso17\","
                + "\"first_seen_at\":1000,"
                + "\"last_seen_at\":5000,"
                + "\"peak_buffer\":7.25,"
                + "\"last_buffer\":3.5,"
                + "\"last_probability\":0.82,"
                + "\"windows\":412,"
                + "\"history\":[{\"t\":4000,\"p\":0.7,\"b\":2.5},"
                + "{\"t\":5000,\"p\":0.82,\"b\":3.5}]}]}";
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("everything the panel shows comes back from disk")
    void readsBackEveryField() {
        Map<UUID, JournalStore.Entry> entries = JournalStore.decode(parse(written()));

        assertEquals(1, entries.size());
        JournalStore.Entry entry = entries.get(UUID.fromString(UUID_ONE));
        assertEquals("Hokuso17", entry.name());
        assertEquals(1000L, entry.firstSeenAt());
        assertEquals(5000L, entry.lastSeenAt());
        assertEquals(7.25D, entry.peakBuffer(), 1e-9);
        assertEquals(3.5D, entry.lastBuffer(), 1e-9);
        assertEquals(0.82D, entry.lastProbability(), 1e-9);
        assertEquals(412, entry.windowsAnalysed());
        assertEquals(2, entry.history().size());
        assertEquals(0.7D, entry.history().get(0).probability(), 1e-9);
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("writing what was read gives the same file back")
    void roundTripsUnchanged() {
        JsonObject once = JournalStore.encode(
                JournalStore.decode(parse(written())).values());
        JsonObject twice = JournalStore.encode(
                JournalStore.decode(once).values());

        assertEquals(once.toString(), twice.toString());
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("one broken row does not cost the whole journal")
    void skipsBrokenRows() {
        String json = "{\"entries\":[{\"uuid\":\"not-a-uuid\"},"
                + written().substring(written().indexOf("{\"uuid\"")) ;
        Map<UUID, JournalStore.Entry> entries = JournalStore.decode(parse(json));

        assertEquals(1, entries.size());
        assertTrue(entries.containsKey(UUID.fromString(UUID_ONE)));
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("an empty or missing file is an empty journal, not a crash")
    void emptyIsEmpty() {
        assertEquals(0, JournalStore.decode(parse("{}")).size());
        assertEquals(0, JournalStore.decode(null).size());
    }
}
```

`src/v116/java/me/everyone/oculusai/npc/ArenaGuide.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.npc;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import org.bukkit.Location;
import org.bukkit.entity.ArmorStand;
import org.bukkit.entity.Entity;

final class ArenaGuide {
    private ArenaGuide() {}

    static List<Entity> spawn(Location position, List<String> lines) {
        List<Entity> stands = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < lines.size(); i++) {
            String line = lines.get(i);
            Location at = position.clone().add(0, (lines.size() - 1 - i) * 0.27D, 0);
            stands.add(at.getWorld().spawn(at, ArmorStand.class, stand -> {
                stand.setVisible(false);
                stand.setMarker(true);
                stand.setGravity(false);
                stand.setInvulnerable(true);
                stand.setPersistent(false);
                stand.setCustomName(line);
                stand.setCustomNameVisible(true);
            }));
        }
        return stands;
    }
}
```

`src/v116/java/me/everyone/oculusai/npc/NpcPackets.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.npc;

import com.comphenix.protocol.PacketType;
import com.comphenix.protocol.ProtocolLibrary;
import com.comphenix.protocol.events.PacketContainer;
import com.comphenix.protocol.wrappers.EnumWrappers.ItemSlot;
import com.comphenix.protocol.wrappers.EnumWrappers.NativeGameMode;
import com.comphenix.protocol.wrappers.EnumWrappers.PlayerInfoAction;
import com.comphenix.protocol.wrappers.Pair;
import com.comphenix.protocol.wrappers.PlayerInfoData;
import com.comphenix.protocol.wrappers.WrappedChatComponent;
import java.util.List;
import org.bukkit.Material;
import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
import org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack;

public final class NpcPackets implements NpcProtocol {

    @Override
    public void spawn(Player viewer, Npc npc, String tabName) {
        PacketContainer info = packet(PacketType.Play.Server.PLAYER_INFO);
        info.getPlayerInfoAction().write(0, PlayerInfoAction.ADD_PLAYER);
        info.getPlayerInfoDataLists().write(0, List.of(new PlayerInfoData(
                npc.profile(), 0, NativeGameMode.SURVIVAL,
                WrappedChatComponent.fromText(tabName))));
        send(viewer, info);

        PacketContainer spawn = packet(PacketType.Play.Server.NAMED_ENTITY_SPAWN);
        spawn.getIntegers().write(0, npc.entityId());
        spawn.getUUIDs().write(0, npc.uuid());
        spawn.getDoubles().write(0, npc.x()).write(1, npc.y()).write(2, npc.z());
        spawn.getBytes().write(0, angle(npc.yaw())).write(1, angle(npc.pitch()));
        send(viewer, spawn);

        look(viewer, npc);
    }

    @Override
    public void tabName(Player viewer, Npc npc, String tabName) {
        PacketContainer info = packet(PacketType.Play.Server.PLAYER_INFO);
        info.getPlayerInfoAction().write(0, PlayerInfoAction.UPDATE_DISPLAY_NAME);
        info.getPlayerInfoDataLists().write(0, List.of(new PlayerInfoData(
                npc.profile(), 0, NativeGameMode.SURVIVAL,
                WrappedChatComponent.fromText(tabName))));
        send(viewer, info);
    }

    @Override
    public void despawn(Player viewer, Npc npc) {
        PacketContainer destroy = packet(PacketType.Play.Server.ENTITY_DESTROY);
        destroy.getIntegerArrays().write(0, new int[] {npc.entityId()});
        send(viewer, destroy);

        PacketContainer info = packet(PacketType.Play.Server.PLAYER_INFO);
        info.getPlayerInfoAction().write(0, PlayerInfoAction.REMOVE_PLAYER);
        info.getPlayerInfoDataLists().write(0, List.of(new PlayerInfoData(
                npc.profile(), 0, NativeGameMode.SURVIVAL,
                WrappedChatComponent.fromText(npc.name()))));
        send(viewer, info);
    }

    @Override
    public void hurt(Player viewer, Npc npc) {
        status(viewer, npc, (byte) 2);
    }

    @Override
    public void death(Player viewer, Npc npc) {
        status(viewer, npc, (byte) 3);
    }

    private void status(Player viewer, Npc npc, byte status) {
        PacketContainer packet = packet(PacketType.Play.Server.ENTITY_STATUS);
        packet.getIntegers().write(0, npc.entityId());
        packet.getBytes().write(0, status);
        send(viewer, packet);
    }

    @Override
    public void move(Player viewer, Npc npc, double dx, double dy, double dz) {
        PacketContainer packet = packet(PacketType.Play.Server.REL_ENTITY_MOVE_LOOK);
        packet.getIntegers().write(0, npc.entityId());
        packet.getShorts().write(0, delta(dx)).write(1, delta(dy)).write(2, delta(dz));
        packet.getBytes().write(0, angle(npc.yaw())).write(1, angle(npc.pitch()));
        packet.getBooleans().write(0, !npc.airborne());
        send(viewer, packet);
    }

    @Override
    public void look(Player viewer, Npc npc) {
        PacketContainer head = packet(PacketType.Play.Server.ENTITY_HEAD_ROTATION);
        head.getIntegers().write(0, npc.entityId());
        head.getBytes().write(0, angle(npc.yaw()));
        send(viewer, head);

        PacketContainer body = packet(PacketType.Play.Server.ENTITY_LOOK);
        body.getIntegers().write(0, npc.entityId());
        body.getBytes().write(0, angle(npc.yaw())).write(1, angle(npc.pitch()));
        body.getBooleans().write(0, !npc.airborne());
        send(viewer, body);
    }

    @Override
    public void swing(Player viewer, Npc npc) {
        PacketContainer packet = packet(PacketType.Play.Server.ANIMATION);
        packet.getIntegers().write(0, npc.entityId()).write(1, 0);
        send(viewer, packet);
    }

    @Override
    public void equip(Player viewer, Npc npc) {
        PacketContainer packet = packet(PacketType.Play.Server.ENTITY_EQUIPMENT);
        packet.getIntegers().write(0, npc.entityId());
        packet.getSlotStackPairLists().write(0, List.of(
                new Pair<>(ItemSlot.MAINHAND, gear(Material.NETHERITE_SWORD)),
                new Pair<>(ItemSlot.HEAD, gear(Material.IRON_HELMET)),
                new Pair<>(ItemSlot.CHEST, gear(Material.IRON_CHESTPLATE)),
                new Pair<>(ItemSlot.LEGS, gear(Material.IRON_LEGGINGS)),
                new Pair<>(ItemSlot.FEET, gear(Material.IRON_BOOTS))));
        send(viewer, packet);
    }

    private static byte angle(float degrees) {
        return (byte) (degrees * 256.0F / 360.0F);
    }

    private static short delta(double blocks) {
        return (short) Math.max(Short.MIN_VALUE, Math.min(Short.MAX_VALUE, Math.round(blocks * 4096.0D)));
    }

    private void send(Player viewer, PacketContainer packet) {
        ProtocolLibrary.getProtocolManager().sendServerPacket(viewer, packet);
    }

    private PacketContainer packet(PacketType type) {
        return ProtocolLibrary.getProtocolManager().createPacket(type);
    }

    private static ItemStack gear(Material material) {
        return new ItemStack(material);
    }
}
```

`src/v116/java/me/everyone/oculusai/packet/CrystalPackets.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.packet;

import com.comphenix.protocol.PacketType;
import com.comphenix.protocol.ProtocolLibrary;
import com.comphenix.protocol.ProtocolManager;
import com.comphenix.protocol.events.ListenerPriority;
import com.comphenix.protocol.events.PacketAdapter;
import com.comphenix.protocol.events.PacketContainer;
import com.comphenix.protocol.events.PacketEvent;
import com.comphenix.protocol.events.PacketListener;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;
import me.everyone.oculusai.core.Service;
import me.everyone.oculusai.player.PlayerData;
import org.bukkit.entity.EntityType;

/** Что из сущностей увидел клиент - для CrystalPredict и наводки на кристаллы.
 *
 * <p>То же, что в сборке 1.21, с разницей в пакетах 1.16: удаление несёт
 * номера массивом, а не списком, и кристалл зовётся ENDER_CRYSTAL.
 */
public final class CrystalPackets implements Service {

    private final OculusAI plugin;
    private final ProtocolManager protocolManager = ProtocolLibrary.getProtocolManager();
    private PacketListener listener;

    public CrystalPackets(OculusAI plugin) {
        this.plugin = plugin;
    }

    @Override
    public void enable() {
        listener = new PacketAdapter(plugin, ListenerPriority.MONITOR,
                PacketType.Play.Server.SPAWN_ENTITY, PacketType.Play.Server.ENTITY_DESTROY) {
            @Override
            public void onPacketSending(PacketEvent event) {
                try {
                    handle(event);
                } catch (Throwable throwable) {
                    plugin.getLogger().log(Level.WARNING,
                            "Error reading " + event.getPacket().getType(), throwable);
                }
            }
        };
        protocolManager.addPacketListener(listener);
    }

    @Override
    public void disable() {
        if (listener != null) {
            protocolManager.removePacketListener(listener);
            listener = null;
        }
    }

    private void handle(PacketEvent event) {
        if (event.isCancelled() || event.getPlayer() == null) {
            return;
        }
        PlayerData data = plugin.data().get(event.getPlayer());
        if (data == null) {
            return;
        }
        PacketContainer packet = event.getPacket();
        if (event.getPacketType() == PacketType.Play.Server.SPAWN_ENTITY) {
            Integer id = packet.getIntegers().readSafely(0);
            if (id == null) {
                return;
            }
            EntityType type = packet.getEntityTypeModifier().readSafely(0);
            boolean crystal = type != null
                    && (type.name().equals("ENDER_CRYSTAL") || type.name().equals("END_CRYSTAL"));
            data.crystal().spawned(id, crystal,
                    packet.getDoubles().read(0), packet.getDoubles().read(1), packet.getDoubles().read(2));
            return;
        }
        int[] ids = packet.getIntegerArrays().readSafely(0);
        if (ids != null) {
            for (int id : ids) {
                data.crystal().destroyed(id);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

`src/v116/java/me/everyone/oculusai/packet/PacketBridge.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.packet;


import me.everyone.oculusai.core.Service;
import com.comphenix.protocol.PacketType;
import com.comphenix.protocol.ProtocolLibrary;
import com.comphenix.protocol.ProtocolManager;
import com.comphenix.protocol.events.ListenerPriority;
import com.comphenix.protocol.events.PacketAdapter;
import com.comphenix.protocol.events.PacketEvent;
import com.comphenix.protocol.events.PacketListener;
import com.comphenix.protocol.wrappers.EnumWrappers;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;
import me.everyone.oculusai.detection.AimGeometry;
import me.everyone.oculusai.player.PlayerData;
import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
import org.bukkit.potion.PotionEffectType;

public final class PacketBridge implements Service {

    private final OculusAI plugin;
    private final ProtocolManager protocolManager = ProtocolLibrary.getProtocolManager();
    private PacketListener listener;

    public PacketBridge(OculusAI plugin) {
        this.plugin = plugin;
    }

    @Override
    public void enable() {
        listener = new PacketAdapter(plugin, ListenerPriority.HIGHEST,
                PacketType.Play.Client.USE_ENTITY,
                // Махнул рукой, никого не ударив. Килоаура обычно машет
                // только по цели; человек промахивается и бьёт по воздуху.
                PacketType.Play.Client.ARM_ANIMATION,
                PacketType.Play.Client.POSITION,
                PacketType.Play.Client.POSITION_LOOK,
                PacketType.Play.Client.LOOK,
                PacketType.Play.Client.FLYING) {
            @Override
            public void onPacketReceiving(PacketEvent event) {
                try {
                    handle(event);
                } catch (Throwable throwable) {
                    plugin.getLogger().log(Level.SEVERE, "Error reading " + event.getPacket().getType(), throwable);
                }
            }
        };
        protocolManager.addPacketListener(listener);
    }

    @Override
    public void disable() {
        if (listener != null) {
            protocolManager.removePacketListener(listener);
            listener = null;
        }
    }

    private void handle(PacketEvent event) {
        Player player = event.getPlayer();
        PlayerData data = plugin.data().get(player);
        if (data == null) {
            return;
        }
        // While the send-off is playing the cheater is frozen: attacks,
        // looks and positions are all dropped here, so nothing they do from
        // the moment of the verdict counts. Their own client keeps swinging
        // and turning on screen - no server can stop that - but the server
        // never hears any of it.
        if (plugin.punishments().isHeld(player.getUniqueId())) {
            event.setCancelled(true);
            return;
        }

        PacketType type = event.getPacketType();

        if (type == PacketType.Play.Client.ARM_ANIMATION) {
            // Флагом, а не записью: тик закрывается следующим пакетом
            // движения, и до него неизвестно, прилетит ли за этим свингом
            // атака. Порядок пакетов у клиента - сначала анимация, потом
            // USE_ENTITY, поэтому к закрытию тика ответ уже есть.
            data.noteEmptySwing();
            return;
        }

        if (type == PacketType.Play.Client.USE_ENTITY) {
            if (event.isCancelled()) {
                return;
            }
            EnumWrappers.EntityUseAction action = event.getPacket().getEntityUseActions().readSafely(0);
            if (action == EnumWrappers.EntityUseAction.ATTACK) {
                int targetEntityId = event.getPacket().getIntegers().read(0);
                // Любой удар, до фильтра по игрокам: кристалл не игрок,
                // а увидеть его удар можно только здесь (CrystalPredict).
                data.crystal().attackArrived(targetEntityId);
                // Only a hit on a player counts as combat. A mob is a
                // different measurement entirely - it walks a straight line
                // and never strafes, so honest farming reads like a cheat -
                // and an entity nobody tracks is not proof of anything.
                if (!plugin.tracker().playerLike(targetEntityId)) {
                    return;
                }
                if (plugin.checks().onAttack(player, data, targetEntityId)) {
                    event.setCancelled(true);
                } else {
                    data.markAttack(aimError(data, targetEntityId), player.getFallDistance(),
                            player.isOnGround(), player.isSprinting(), critBlocked(player));
                }
            }
            return;
        }

        if (isFlying(type)) {
            // An elytra flight is a different instrument. Rotation steers the
            // body rather than a crosshair, pitch is held at extremes for
            // seconds at a time, and the whole window is smooth by
            // construction - which is what the model was taught to read as
            // assistance. Samples are dropped rather than merely left
            // unscored, and the window is cleared, so that a flight cannot
            // splice onto the ground fight that follows it.
            if (player.isGliding()) {
                data.clearWindow();
                return;
            }
            data.noteGround(player.isOnGround());
            data.noteSprint(player.isSprinting());
            if (type == PacketType.Play.Client.POSITION || type == PacketType.Play.Client.FLYING) {
                me.everyone.oculusai.detection.crystal.CrystalLook.update(plugin, player, data,
                        data.lastYaw(), data.lastPitch());
                data.addSample(data.lastYaw(), data.lastPitch(),
                        plugin.config().windowTicks(),
                        AimGeometry.of(plugin.tracker(), data.entityId(),
                                data.lastYaw(), data.lastPitch()),
                        player.isOnGround(), player.isSprinting());
                return;
            }
            float yaw = event.getPacket().getFloat().readSafely(0) != null ? event.getPacket().getFloat().read(0) : data.lastYaw();
            float pitch = event.getPacket().getFloat().readSafely(1) != null ? event.getPacket().getFloat().read(1) : data.lastPitch();
            me.everyone.oculusai.detection.crystal.CrystalLook.update(plugin, player, data, yaw, pitch);
            data.addSample(yaw, pitch, plugin.config().windowTicks(),
                    AimGeometry.of(plugin.tracker(), data.entityId(), yaw, pitch),
                    player.isOnGround(), player.isSprinting());
        }
    }

    /** Угол до цели в тике удара.
     *
     *  <p>Арифметика живёт в {@link AimGeometry}: тот же угол считается
     *  теперь в каждом тике, и два определения одного числа - это стык, на
     *  котором модель учится вместо поведения. */
    private double aimError(PlayerData data, int targetEntityId) {
        return AimGeometry.angleTo(plugin.tracker().get(data.entityId()),
                plugin.tracker().get(targetEntityId), data.lastYaw(), data.lastPitch());
    }

    private boolean critBlocked(Player player) {
        return player.isInsideVehicle()
                || player.isInWater()
                || player.hasPotionEffect(PotionEffectType.BLINDNESS);
    }

    private boolean isFlying(PacketType type) {
        return type == PacketType.Play.Client.POSITION
                || type == PacketType.Play.Client.POSITION_LOOK
                || type == PacketType.Play.Client.LOOK
                || type == PacketType.Play.Client.FLYING;
    }
}
```
