`src/v116/java/me/everyone/oculusai/ui/Hud.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.ui;


import me.everyone.oculusai.core.Service;
import me.everyone.oculusai.core.TickLoop;
import com.comphenix.protocol.PacketType;
import com.comphenix.protocol.ProtocolLibrary;
import com.comphenix.protocol.ProtocolManager;
import com.comphenix.protocol.events.PacketContainer;
import com.comphenix.protocol.wrappers.WrappedChatComponent;
import com.comphenix.protocol.wrappers.WrappedDataWatcher;
import com.comphenix.protocol.wrappers.WrappedWatchableObject;
import java.lang.reflect.Type;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;
import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;
import me.everyone.oculusai.player.PlayerData;
import me.everyone.oculusai.core.Msg;
import org.bukkit.Location;
import org.bukkit.entity.EntityType;
import org.bukkit.entity.Player;

public final class Hud implements Service {
    private static final int DISPLAY_UPDATE_TICKS = 2;

    private record Watch(UUID target, long expiresAt, List<Line> holograms, boolean compact, boolean permanent) {
    }

    private record Line(int entityId, UUID uuid) {
    }

    private static final byte ENTITY_FLAG_INVISIBLE = 0x20;
    private static final byte ARMOR_STAND_FLAG_SMALL = 0x01;
    private static final byte ARMOR_STAND_FLAG_MARKER = 0x10;
    private static final AtomicInteger NEXT_ENTITY_ID = new AtomicInteger(2_000_000);

    private final OculusAI plugin;
    private final ProtocolManager protocolManager = ProtocolLibrary.getProtocolManager();
    private final Map<UUID, Map<UUID, Watch>> watching = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private TickLoop.Handle task;

    public Hud(OculusAI plugin) {
        this.plugin = plugin;
    }

    @Override
    public void enable() {
        task = plugin.ticks().every(1L, DISPLAY_UPDATE_TICKS, this::tick);
    }

    @Override
    public void disable() {
        if (task != null) {
            task.cancel();
            task = null;
        }
        for (Map.Entry<UUID, Map<UUID, Watch>> entry : watching.entrySet()) {
            Player watcher = plugin.getServer().getPlayer(entry.getKey());
            if (watcher != null) {
                for (Watch watch : entry.getValue().values()) {
                    destroyHolograms(watcher, watch);
                }
            }
        }
        watching.clear();
    }

    public void watch(Player watcher, PlayerData target) {
        // One line unless the operator asked for the tall one. Six lines of
        // hologram over a head in a fight hide the thing being watched, and the
        // two numbers that decide anything - the reading and the buffer - fit
        // on one line.
        watch(watcher, target, plugin.hudConfig().hologramCompact(), false);
    }

    /** 1.16 has no Display entity to hang text on, so there is nothing to
     *  draw. Saying so is the point of this method: the dashboard used to
     *  offer the toggle here and the click did nothing at all. */
    public boolean supportsAlwaysProb() {
        return false;
    }

    public boolean enableAlwaysProb(Player viewer) {
        return false;
    }

    public void disableAlwaysProb(Player viewer) {
    }

    public boolean isAlwaysProb(UUID viewer) {
        return false;
    }

    public void resyncAlwaysProb(Player viewer) {
    }

    public void resyncAlwaysProb() {
    }

    private void watch(Player watcher, PlayerData target, boolean compact, boolean permanent) {
        Map<UUID, Watch> watches = watching.computeIfAbsent(watcher.getUniqueId(), ignored -> new ConcurrentHashMap<>());
        Watch previous = watches.get(target.uuid());
        if (previous != null && previous.compact() == compact && previous.permanent() == permanent) {
            return;
        }
        previous = watches.remove(target.uuid());
        if (previous != null) {
            destroyHolograms(watcher, previous);
        }
        Watch watch = new Watch(
                target.uuid(),
                permanent ? Long.MAX_VALUE : System.currentTimeMillis() + plugin.hudConfig().hologramSeconds() * 1000L,
                List.of(),
                compact,
                permanent);
        watches.put(target.uuid(), watch);
    }

    public void stop(Player watcher) {
        Map<UUID, Watch> removed = watching.remove(watcher.getUniqueId());
        if (removed != null) {
            for (Watch watch : removed.values()) {
                destroyHolograms(watcher, watch);
            }
        }
    }

    public boolean isWatching(UUID watcher) {
        Map<UUID, Watch> watches = watching.get(watcher);
        return watches != null && !watches.isEmpty();
    }

    private void tick() {
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        watching.entrySet().removeIf(entry -> {
            Player watcher = plugin.getServer().getPlayer(entry.getKey());
            Map<UUID, Watch> watches = entry.getValue();
            if (watcher == null || !watcher.isOnline()) {
                for (Watch watch : watches.values()) {
                    destroyHolograms(watcher, watch);
                }
                return true;
            }

            watches.entrySet().removeIf(watchEntry -> {
                Watch watch = watchEntry.getValue();
                PlayerData target = plugin.data().get(watch.target());
                if (target == null
                        || !target.player().isOnline()
                        || !canKeepWatch(watcher, target.player(), watch.permanent())
                        || (!watch.permanent() && now > watch.expiresAt())) {
                    destroyHolograms(watcher, watch);
                    return true;
                }
                return false;
            });

            if (watches.isEmpty()) {
                watcher.spigot().sendMessage(net.md_5.bungee.api.ChatMessageType.ACTION_BAR,
                        net.md_5.bungee.api.chat.TextComponent.fromLegacyText(""));
                return true;
            }

            watcher.spigot().sendMessage(net.md_5.bungee.api.ChatMessageType.ACTION_BAR,
                    net.md_5.bungee.api.chat.TextComponent.fromLegacyText(actionBar(watches)));
            return false;
        });
    }

    private String actionBar(Map<UUID, Watch> watches) {
        List<Watch> temporary = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Watch watch : watches.values()) {
            if (!watch.permanent()) {
                temporary.add(watch);
            }
        }
        if (temporary.isEmpty()) {
            return "";
        }
        if (temporary.size() == 1) {
            Watch watch = temporary.get(0);
            PlayerData target = plugin.data().get(watch.target());
            return target == null ? "" : (watch.compact() ? compactActionBarForTarget(target) : actionBarForTarget(target));
        }
        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder();
        boolean first = true;
        for (Watch watch : temporary) {
            PlayerData target = plugin.data().get(watch.target());
            if (target == null) {
                continue;
            }
            if (!first) {
                builder.append("<dark_gray> | ");
            }
            // With one target the action bar has room for the configured
            // format. With several it used to collapse to a name and a bar,
            // which says that something is happening without saying what -
            // whether a buffer of 4.6 is climbing towards a kick or a reading
            // of 0.9 just arrived. Both numbers fit if the bar goes.
            builder.append(arrow(target)).append(" <white>").append(target.name()).append("<dark_gray>: ");
            if (!target.analysing(plugin.hudConfig().staleMs())) {
                builder.append("&cno analysing");
            } else {
                builder.append("<gray>").append(Msg.probability(shownProbability(target)));
                builder.append("<dark_gray>/<white>").append(Msg.round(target.buffer(), 1));
            }
            first = false;
        }
        return Msg.parse(builder.toString());
    }

    private String actionBarForTarget(PlayerData target) {
        double fraction = target.buffer() / plugin.config().bufferMax();
        if (!target.analysing(plugin.hudConfig().staleMs())) {
            return Msg.parse("%arrow% <white>%player% <dark_gray>| &cno analysing",
                    placeholders(target, fraction, 10, Map.of("trend", "-----")));
        }
        return Msg.parse(plugin.hudConfig().actionBarFormat(), placeholders(target, fraction, 10, null));
    }

    private String compactActionBarForTarget(PlayerData target) {
        double fraction = target.buffer() / plugin.config().bufferMax();
        if (!target.analysing(plugin.hudConfig().staleMs())) {
            return Msg.parse("%arrow% <white>%player% <dark_gray>| &cno analysing",
                    placeholders(target, fraction, 10, Map.of("trend", "-----")));
        }
        return Msg.parse(plugin.hudConfig().actionBarFormat(),
                placeholders(target, fraction, 10, Map.of("trend", compactHistory(target.bufferHistory()))));
    }

    private List<Line> createLines() {
        return createLines(Math.max(1, plugin.hudConfig().hologramLines()));
    }

    private List<Line> createLines(int count) {
        List<Line> lines = new ArrayList<>(count);
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            lines.add(new Line(NEXT_ENTITY_ID.getAndIncrement(), UUID.randomUUID()));
        }
        return lines;
    }

    private void spawnHolograms(Player watcher, PlayerData target, Watch watch) {
        List<String> lines = hologramLines(target, watch.compact());
        for (int i = 0; i < watch.holograms().size(); i++) {
            Line line = watch.holograms().get(i);
            send(watcher, spawnPacket(line.entityId(), line.uuid(), packetLocation(target, i, lines.size())));
            send(watcher, metadataPacket(line.entityId(), i < lines.size() ? lines.get(i) : ""));
        }
    }

    private void updateHolograms(Player watcher, PlayerData target, Watch watch) {
        List<String> lines = hologramLines(target, watch.compact());
        for (int i = 0; i < watch.holograms().size(); i++) {
            Line line = watch.holograms().get(i);
            send(watcher, teleportPacket(line.entityId(), packetLocation(target, i, lines.size())));
            send(watcher, metadataPacket(line.entityId(), i < lines.size() ? lines.get(i) : ""));
        }
    }

    private Location packetLocation(PlayerData target, int index, int lineCount) {
        Location base = target.player().getLocation();
        double top = plugin.hudConfig().hologramHeight();
        double step = 0.28D;
        double y = base.getY() + top + (lineCount - index - 1) * step;
        return new Location(base.getWorld(), base.getX(), y, base.getZ(), 0.0F, 0.0F);
    }

    private PacketContainer spawnPacket(int entityId, UUID uuid, Location location) {
        PacketContainer packet = protocolManager.createPacket(PacketType.Play.Server.SPAWN_ENTITY, true);
        packet.getIntegers().write(0, entityId);
        packet.getUUIDs().write(0, uuid);
        packet.getEntityTypeModifier().write(0, EntityType.ARMOR_STAND);
        packet.getDoubles().write(0, location.getX());
        packet.getDoubles().write(1, location.getY());
        packet.getDoubles().write(2, location.getZ());
        return packet;
    }

    private PacketContainer teleportPacket(int entityId, Location location) {
        PacketContainer packet = protocolManager.createPacket(PacketType.Play.Server.ENTITY_TELEPORT, true);
        packet.getIntegers().write(0, entityId);
        packet.getDoubles().write(0, location.getX());
        packet.getDoubles().write(1, location.getY());
        packet.getDoubles().write(2, location.getZ());
        packet.getBytes().write(0, (byte) 0);
        packet.getBytes().write(1, (byte) 0);
        packet.getBooleans().write(0, false);
        return packet;
    }

    private PacketContainer metadataPacket(int entityId, String line) {
        List<WrappedWatchableObject> metadata = new ArrayList<>(5);
        metadata.add(new WrappedWatchableObject(new WrappedDataWatcher.WrappedDataWatcherObject(
                0, WrappedDataWatcher.Registry.get((Type) Byte.class)), ENTITY_FLAG_INVISIBLE));
        metadata.add(new WrappedWatchableObject(new WrappedDataWatcher.WrappedDataWatcherObject(
                2, WrappedDataWatcher.Registry.getChatComponentSerializer(true)),
                Optional.of(chatComponent(line))));
        metadata.add(new WrappedWatchableObject(new WrappedDataWatcher.WrappedDataWatcherObject(
                3, WrappedDataWatcher.Registry.get((Type) Boolean.class)), true));
        metadata.add(new WrappedWatchableObject(new WrappedDataWatcher.WrappedDataWatcherObject(
                5, WrappedDataWatcher.Registry.get((Type) Boolean.class)), true));
        metadata.add(new WrappedWatchableObject(new WrappedDataWatcher.WrappedDataWatcherObject(
                14, WrappedDataWatcher.Registry.get((Type) Byte.class)),
                (byte) (ARMOR_STAND_FLAG_SMALL | ARMOR_STAND_FLAG_MARKER)));

        PacketContainer packet = protocolManager.createPacket(PacketType.Play.Server.ENTITY_METADATA, true);
        packet.getIntegers().write(0, entityId);
        packet.getWatchableCollectionModifier().write(0, metadata);
        return packet;
    }

    private WrappedChatComponent chatComponent(String line) {
        WrappedChatComponent[] components = WrappedChatComponent.fromChatMessage(line == null ? "" : line);
        if (components.length == 0) {
            return WrappedChatComponent.fromText("");
        }
        return components[0];
    }

    private List<String> hologramLines(PlayerData target, boolean compact) {
        if (compact) {
            return List.of(compactLine(target));
        }
        double fraction = target.buffer() / plugin.config().bufferMax();
        String trend = historyDigits(target.bufferHistory(), 5, false);
        if (trend.isEmpty()) {
            trend = "-";
        }
        String state = target.analysing(plugin.hudConfig().staleMs())
                ? "live reading"
                : (target.windowsAnalysed() == 0 ? "&cno analysing &7(waiting for combat)"
                                                 : "&cno analysing");

        int max = Math.max(1, plugin.hudConfig().hologramLines());
        List<String> lines = new ArrayList<>(max);
        for (String format : plugin.hudConfig().hologramFormat()) {
            if (lines.size() >= max) {
                break;
            }
            lines.add(Msg.parse(format, placeholders(target, fraction, 12, Map.of(
                    "trend", trend,
                    "windows", Integer.toString(target.windowsAnalysed()),
                    "state", state))));
        }
        while (lines.size() < max) {
            lines.add(Msg.parse("<dark_gray>"));
        }
        return lines;
    }

    private String compactLine(PlayerData target) {
        double fraction = target.buffer() / plugin.config().bufferMax();
        // A number left over from a minute ago looks exactly like a live one,
        // which is the thing most likely to mislead whoever is watching. When
        // windows stop arriving the line says that instead.
        if (!target.analysing(plugin.hudConfig().staleMs())) {
            return Msg.parse(plugin.hudConfig().staleFormat(),
                    placeholders(target, fraction, 10, Map.of("trend", "-----")));
        }
        return Msg.parse(plugin.hudConfig().hologramCompactFormat(),
                placeholders(target, fraction, 10, Map.of("trend", compactHistory(target.bufferHistory()))));
    }

    private String historyDigits(List<Double> history) {
        return historyDigits(history, 5, false);
    }

    /** Which way the buffer is going, as one glyph: up means the last window
     *  pushed it towards a punishment, down means it is draining. Direction is
     *  the thing a watcher cannot get from the number alone - 3.1 on the way
     *  up and 3.1 on the way down are the same number and opposite situations. */
    private String arrow(PlayerData target) {
        List<Double> history = target.bufferHistory();
        if (history.size() < 2) {
            return "<dark_gray>\u25ac";
        }
        double last = history.get(history.size() - 1);
        double previous = history.get(history.size() - 2);
        if (last > previous + 0.01D) {
            return "<red>\u25b2";
        }
        if (last < previous - 0.01D) {
            return "<green>\u25bc";
        }
        return "<dark_gray>\u25ac";
    }

    private String compactHistory(List<Double> history) {
        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder(5);
        int start = Math.max(0, history.size() - 5);
        for (int i = start; i < history.size(); i++) {
            int digit = Math.min(9, Math.max(0, (int) Math.round(history.get(i))));
            builder.append(digit);
        }
        while (builder.length() < 5) {
            builder.insert(0, '-');
        }
        if (builder.length() > 5) {
            return builder.substring(builder.length() - 5);
        }
        return builder.toString();
    }

    private String historyDigits(List<Double> history, int count, boolean padded) {
        if (history.size() <= 1) {
            return padded ? "-----" : "";
        }
        int start = Math.max(0, history.size() - (count + 1));
        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = start; i < history.size() - 1; i++) {
            double value = history.get(i);
            double fraction = value / plugin.config().bufferMax();
            if (builder.length() > 0) {
                builder.append(padded ? "" : "<dark_gray> ");
            }
            builder.append("<").append(historyColour(fraction)).append(">");
            builder.append(Math.min(9, Math.max(0, (int) Math.round(value))));
        }
        if (padded) {
            while (builder.length() < count) {
                builder.append("-");
            }
        }
        return builder.toString();
    }

    private boolean isVisibleTo(Player viewer, Player target) {
        if (viewer == null || target == null) {
            return false;
        }
        if (!viewer.isOnline() || !target.isOnline()) {
            return false;
        }
        if (viewer.getUniqueId().equals(target.getUniqueId())) {
            return false;
        }
        return viewer.canSee(target);
    }

    private boolean canKeepWatch(Player watcher, Player target, boolean permanent) {
        if (watcher == null || target == null) {
            return false;
        }
        if (!watcher.isOnline() || !target.isOnline()) {
            return false;
        }
        if (watcher.getUniqueId().equals(target.getUniqueId())) {
            return !permanent;
        }
        return watcher.canSee(target);
    }

    /** The model output /oai math asks for: raw when it is off, the smoothed
     *  reading that feeds the buffer otherwise. */
    private double shownProbability(PlayerData target) {
        return target.displayProbability(!plugin.detection().mathEnabled());
    }

    private Map<String, String> placeholders(PlayerData target, double fraction, int barWidth,
                                             Map<String, String> extra) {
        var theme = plugin.theme().current();
        Map<String, String> placeholders = new HashMap<>();
        placeholders.put("bar", Msg.bar(fraction, barWidth));
        placeholders.put("arrow", arrow(target));
        placeholders.put("probability", Msg.probability(shownProbability(target)));
        var readings = target.readings();
        placeholders.put("avg", me.everyone.oculusai.core.Values.average(readings));
        placeholders.put("recent", me.everyone.oculusai.core.Values.recent(readings));
        placeholders.put("buffer", Msg.round(target.buffer(), 1));
        placeholders.put("max_buffer", Msg.round(plugin.config().bufferMax(), 0));
        placeholders.put("player", target.name());
        placeholders.put("primary", theme.primary());
        placeholders.put("secondary", theme.secondary());
        placeholders.put("accent", theme.accent());
        placeholders.put("accent_soft", theme.accentSoft());
        if (extra != null) {
            placeholders.putAll(extra);
        }
        return placeholders;
    }

    private String historyColour(double fraction) {
        if (fraction >= 0.66D) {
            return "#ff5a5a";
        }
        if (fraction >= 0.33D) {
            return "#ffd25e";
        }
        return "#67f08a";
    }

    private void destroyHolograms(Player watcher, Watch watch) {
        watcher.spigot().sendMessage(net.md_5.bungee.api.ChatMessageType.ACTION_BAR,
                net.md_5.bungee.api.chat.TextComponent.fromLegacyText(""));
    }

    private void send(Player watcher, PacketContainer packet) {
        protocolManager.sendServerPacket(watcher, packet);
    }

    public void forget(UUID uuid) {
        Map<UUID, Watch> removed = watching.remove(uuid);
        if (removed != null) {
            Player watcher = plugin.getServer().getPlayer(uuid);
            if (watcher != null) {
                for (Watch watch : removed.values()) {
                    destroyHolograms(watcher, watch);
                }
            }
            return;
        }

        List<UUID> watchers = new ArrayList<>(watching.keySet());
        for (UUID watcherId : watchers) {
            Map<UUID, Watch> watches = watching.get(watcherId);
            if (watches == null) {
                continue;
            }
            Watch watch = watches.remove(uuid);
            if (watch != null) {
                Player watcher = plugin.getServer().getPlayer(watcherId);
                if (watcher != null) {
                    destroyHolograms(watcher, watch);
                }
            }
            if (watches.isEmpty()) {
                watching.remove(watcherId);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.ui;

import java.util.UUID;
import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
import org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerResourcePackStatusEvent;

/** Отправка ресурспака на 1.16.5: у клиента один серверный пак, подсказки и
 *  обязательности API этой версии ещё не знает. Пак сервера, если он есть,
 *  этим заменяется - поэтому по умолчанию пак шлётся только на арене. */
public final class PackSender {

    public static void send(Player player, UUID id, String url, byte[] hash,
                            String prompt, boolean required) {
        if (hash == null) {
            player.setResourcePack(url);
        } else {
            player.setResourcePack(url, hash);
        }
    }

    /** Пак один, так что любой ответ - про наш. */
    public static boolean ours(PlayerResourcePackStatusEvent event, UUID id) {
        return true;
    }

    private PackSender() {
    }
}
```

`src/v121/java/me/everyone/oculusai/npc/NpcPackets.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.npc;

import com.comphenix.protocol.PacketType;
import com.comphenix.protocol.ProtocolLibrary;
import com.comphenix.protocol.events.PacketContainer;
import com.comphenix.protocol.utility.MinecraftVersion;
import com.comphenix.protocol.wrappers.EnumWrappers.ItemSlot;
import com.comphenix.protocol.wrappers.EnumWrappers.NativeGameMode;
import com.comphenix.protocol.wrappers.EnumWrappers.PlayerInfoAction;
import com.comphenix.protocol.wrappers.Pair;
import com.comphenix.protocol.wrappers.PlayerInfoData;
import com.comphenix.protocol.wrappers.WrappedChatComponent;
import java.util.EnumSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import org.bukkit.Material;
import org.bukkit.entity.EntityType;
import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
import org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack;
import org.bukkit.plugin.java.JavaPlugin;

public final class NpcPackets implements NpcProtocol {

    private static final int NPC_TAB_ORDER = -1;

    /** Packet types this server build will not let ProtocolLib construct.
     *
     * <p>ProtocolLib builds an outgoing packet by instantiating the server's
     * own packet class, which it can only do for versions it has been taught.
     * 5.4.0 knows up to 1.21.8, so on a newer server some packets - head
     * rotation and the swing animation among them - throw on creation.
     *
     * <p>Before this latch the throw travelled up through tick(), so one
     * unsupported cosmetic packet cost the whole NPC tick: the manikin stopped
     * dealing damage and stopped being registered with the hitbox tracker,
     * and the log took a stack trace every tick. Now the effect is dropped,
     * reported once, and everything that does work keeps working. */
    private final Set<PacketType> unsupported = ConcurrentHashMap.newKeySet();

    @Override
    public void spawn(Player viewer, Npc npc, String tabName) {
        PacketContainer info = packet(PacketType.Play.Server.PLAYER_INFO);
        if (info == null) {
            return;
        }
        EnumSet<PlayerInfoAction> actions = EnumSet.of(
                PlayerInfoAction.ADD_PLAYER,
                PlayerInfoAction.UPDATE_LISTED,
                PlayerInfoAction.UPDATE_GAME_MODE,
                PlayerInfoAction.UPDATE_DISPLAY_NAME);
        if (MinecraftVersion.getCurrentVersion().isAtLeast(MinecraftVersion.v1_21_2)) {
            actions.add(PlayerInfoAction.UPDATE_LIST_ORDER);
        }
        info.getPlayerInfoActions().write(0, actions);
        info.getPlayerInfoDataLists().write(1, List.of(new PlayerInfoData(
                npc.uuid(), 0, true, NativeGameMode.SURVIVAL, npc.profile(),
                WrappedChatComponent.fromText(tabName), NPC_TAB_ORDER, null)));
        send(viewer, info);

        PacketContainer spawn = packet(PacketType.Play.Server.SPAWN_ENTITY);
        if (spawn == null) {
            return;
        }
        spawn.getIntegers().write(0, npc.entityId());
        spawn.getUUIDs().write(0, npc.uuid());
        spawn.getEntityTypeModifier().write(0, EntityType.PLAYER);
        spawn.getDoubles().write(0, npc.x()).write(1, npc.y()).write(2, npc.z());
        spawn.getBytes()
                .write(0, angle(npc.pitch()))
                .write(1, angle(npc.yaw()))
                .write(2, angle(npc.yaw()));
        send(viewer, spawn);

        look(viewer, npc);
    }

    @Override
    public void tabName(Player viewer, Npc npc, String tabName) {
        PacketContainer info = packet(PacketType.Play.Server.PLAYER_INFO);
        if (info == null) {
            return;
        }
        info.getPlayerInfoActions().write(0, EnumSet.of(PlayerInfoAction.UPDATE_DISPLAY_NAME));
        info.getPlayerInfoDataLists().write(1, List.of(new PlayerInfoData(
                npc.uuid(), 0, true, NativeGameMode.SURVIVAL, npc.profile(),
                WrappedChatComponent.fromText(tabName))));
        send(viewer, info);
    }

    @Override
    public void despawn(Player viewer, Npc npc) {
        PacketContainer destroy = packet(PacketType.Play.Server.ENTITY_DESTROY);
        if (destroy != null) {
            destroy.getIntLists().write(0, List.of(npc.entityId()));
            send(viewer, destroy);
        }

        PacketContainer info = packet(PacketType.Play.Server.PLAYER_INFO_REMOVE);
        if (info != null) {
            info.getUUIDLists().write(0, List.of(npc.uuid()));
            send(viewer, info);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void hurt(Player viewer, Npc npc) {
        PacketContainer packet = packet(PacketType.Play.Server.HURT_ANIMATION);
        if (packet == null) {
            return;
        }
        packet.getIntegers().write(0, npc.entityId());
        packet.getFloat().write(0, 0.0F);
        send(viewer, packet);
    }

    @Override
    public void death(Player viewer, Npc npc) {
        PacketContainer packet = packet(PacketType.Play.Server.ENTITY_STATUS);
        if (packet == null) {
            return;
        }
        packet.getIntegers().write(0, npc.entityId());
        packet.getBytes().write(0, (byte) 3);
        send(viewer, packet);
    }

    @Override
    public void move(Player viewer, Npc npc, double dx, double dy, double dz) {
        PacketContainer packet = packet(PacketType.Play.Server.REL_ENTITY_MOVE_LOOK);
        if (packet == null) {
            return;
        }
        packet.getIntegers().write(0, npc.entityId());
        packet.getShorts().write(0, delta(dx)).write(1, delta(dy)).write(2, delta(dz));
        packet.getBytes().write(0, angle(npc.yaw())).write(1, angle(npc.pitch()));
        packet.getBooleans().write(0, !npc.airborne());
        send(viewer, packet);
    }

    @Override
    public void look(Player viewer, Npc npc) {
        PacketContainer head = packet(PacketType.Play.Server.ENTITY_HEAD_ROTATION);
        if (head != null) {
            head.getIntegers().write(0, npc.entityId());
            head.getBytes().write(0, angle(npc.yaw()));
            send(viewer, head);
        }

        PacketContainer body = packet(PacketType.Play.Server.ENTITY_LOOK);
        if (body != null) {
            body.getIntegers().write(0, npc.entityId());
            body.getBytes().write(0, angle(npc.yaw())).write(1, angle(npc.pitch()));
            body.getBooleans().write(0, !npc.airborne());
            send(viewer, body);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void swing(Player viewer, Npc npc) {
        PacketContainer packet = packet(PacketType.Play.Server.ANIMATION);
        if (packet == null) {
            return;
        }
        packet.getIntegers().write(0, npc.entityId()).write(1, 0);
        send(viewer, packet);
    }

    @Override
    public void equip(Player viewer, Npc npc) {
        PacketContainer packet = packet(PacketType.Play.Server.ENTITY_EQUIPMENT);
        if (packet == null) {
            return;
        }
        packet.getIntegers().write(0, npc.entityId());
        packet.getSlotStackPairLists().write(0, List.of(
                new Pair<>(ItemSlot.MAINHAND, gear(Material.NETHERITE_SWORD)),
                new Pair<>(ItemSlot.HEAD, gear(Material.IRON_HELMET)),
                new Pair<>(ItemSlot.CHEST, gear(Material.IRON_CHESTPLATE)),
                new Pair<>(ItemSlot.LEGS, gear(Material.IRON_LEGGINGS)),
                new Pair<>(ItemSlot.FEET, gear(Material.IRON_BOOTS))));
        send(viewer, packet);
    }

    private static byte angle(float degrees) {
        return (byte) (degrees * 256.0F / 360.0F);
    }

    private static short delta(double blocks) {
        return (short) Math.max(Short.MIN_VALUE, Math.min(Short.MAX_VALUE, Math.round(blocks * 4096.0D)));
    }

    private void send(Player viewer, PacketContainer packet) {
        ProtocolLibrary.getProtocolManager().sendServerPacket(viewer, packet);
    }

    /** Creates a packet, or null if this server build cannot. */
    private PacketContainer packet(PacketType type) {
        if (unsupported.contains(type)) {
            return null;
        }
        try {
            return ProtocolLibrary.getProtocolManager().createPacket(type);
        } catch (RuntimeException | LinkageError failure) {
            unsupported.add(type);
            JavaPlugin.getProvidingPlugin(NpcPackets.class).getLogger().log(Level.WARNING,
                    "ProtocolLib cannot create " + type.name() + " packets on this server"
                            + " build, so the sparring manikin will do without that effect."
                            + " ProtocolLib 5.4.0 supports Minecraft up to 1.21.8; a newer"
                            + " build of ProtocolLib fixes this. Reported once.", failure);
            return null;
        }
    }

    private static ItemStack gear(Material material) {
        return new ItemStack(material);
    }
}
```

`src/v121/java/me/everyone/oculusai/packet/CrystalPackets.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.packet;

import com.comphenix.protocol.PacketType;
import com.comphenix.protocol.ProtocolLibrary;
import com.comphenix.protocol.ProtocolManager;
import com.comphenix.protocol.events.ListenerPriority;
import com.comphenix.protocol.events.PacketAdapter;
import com.comphenix.protocol.events.PacketContainer;
import com.comphenix.protocol.events.PacketEvent;
import com.comphenix.protocol.events.PacketListener;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;
import me.everyone.oculusai.core.Service;
import me.everyone.oculusai.player.PlayerData;
import org.bukkit.entity.EntityType;

/** Что из сущностей увидел клиент - для CrystalPredict и наводки на кристаллы.
 *
 * <p>Исходящие пакеты появления и удаления: когда клиенту сказали о сущности
 * и где стоит каждый кристалл, о котором он знает. Удар по кристаллу раньше
 * пакета его появления значит, что клиент угадал его номер, а не увидел.
 */
public final class CrystalPackets implements Service {

    private final OculusAI plugin;
    private final ProtocolManager protocolManager = ProtocolLibrary.getProtocolManager();
    private PacketListener listener;

    public CrystalPackets(OculusAI plugin) {
        this.plugin = plugin;
    }

    @Override
    public void enable() {
        listener = new PacketAdapter(plugin, ListenerPriority.MONITOR,
                PacketType.Play.Server.SPAWN_ENTITY, PacketType.Play.Server.ENTITY_DESTROY) {
            @Override
            public void onPacketSending(PacketEvent event) {
                try {
                    handle(event);
                } catch (Throwable throwable) {
                    plugin.getLogger().log(Level.WARNING,
                            "Error reading " + event.getPacket().getType(), throwable);
                }
            }
        };
        protocolManager.addPacketListener(listener);
    }

    @Override
    public void disable() {
        if (listener != null) {
            protocolManager.removePacketListener(listener);
            listener = null;
        }
    }

    private void handle(PacketEvent event) {
        if (event.isCancelled() || event.getPlayer() == null) {
            return;
        }
        PlayerData data = plugin.data().get(event.getPlayer());
        if (data == null) {
            return;
        }
        PacketContainer packet = event.getPacket();
        if (event.getPacketType() == PacketType.Play.Server.SPAWN_ENTITY) {
            Integer id = packet.getIntegers().readSafely(0);
            if (id == null) {
                return;
            }
            EntityType type = packet.getEntityTypeModifier().readSafely(0);
            boolean crystal = type != null && type.name().equals("END_CRYSTAL");
            data.crystal().spawned(id, crystal,
                    packet.getDoubles().read(0), packet.getDoubles().read(1), packet.getDoubles().read(2));
            return;
        }
        List<Integer> ids = packet.getIntLists().readSafely(0);
        if (ids != null) {
            for (int id : ids) {
                data.crystal().destroyed(id);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

`src/v121/java/me/everyone/oculusai/packet/PacketBridge.java`:

```java
package me.everyone.oculusai.packet;


import me.everyone.oculusai.core.Service;
import com.comphenix.protocol.PacketType;
import com.comphenix.protocol.ProtocolLibrary;
import com.comphenix.protocol.ProtocolManager;
import com.comphenix.protocol.events.ListenerPriority;
import com.comphenix.protocol.events.PacketAdapter;
import com.comphenix.protocol.events.PacketEvent;
import com.comphenix.protocol.events.PacketListener;
import com.comphenix.protocol.wrappers.EnumWrappers;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import me.everyone.oculusai.OculusAI;
import me.everyone.oculusai.detection.AimGeometry;
import me.everyone.oculusai.player.PlayerData;
import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
import org.bukkit.potion.PotionEffectType;

public final class PacketBridge implements Service {

    private final OculusAI plugin;
    private final ProtocolManager protocolManager = ProtocolLibrary.getProtocolManager();
    private PacketListener listener;

    public PacketBridge(OculusAI plugin) {
        this.plugin = plugin;
    }

    @Override
    public void enable() {
        listener = new PacketAdapter(plugin, ListenerPriority.HIGHEST,
                PacketType.Play.Client.USE_ENTITY,
                // Махнул рукой, никого не ударив. Килоаура обычно машет
                // только по цели; человек промахивается и бьёт по воздуху.
                PacketType.Play.Client.ARM_ANIMATION,
                PacketType.Play.Client.POSITION,
                PacketType.Play.Client.POSITION_LOOK,
                PacketType.Play.Client.LOOK,
                // Движение без позиции и поворота - только флаг земли. На
                // 1.21 это GROUND; прежняя константа здесь не
                // зарегистрирована, и подписка на неё молча ничего не ловила.
                PacketType.Play.Client.GROUND) {
            @Override
            public void onPacketReceiving(PacketEvent event) {
                try {
                    handle(event);
                } catch (Throwable throwable) {
                    plugin.getLogger().log(Level.SEVERE,
                            "Error reading " + event.getPacket().getType(), throwable);
                }
            }
        };
        protocolManager.addPacketListener(listener);
    }

    @Override
    public void disable() {
        if (listener != null) {
            protocolManager.removePacketListener(listener);
            listener = null;
        }
    }

    private void handle(PacketEvent event) {
        Player player = event.getPlayer();
        PlayerData data = plugin.data().get(player);
        if (data == null) {
            return;
        }
        // While the send-off is playing the cheater is frozen: attacks,
        // looks and positions are all dropped here, so nothing they do from
        // the moment of the verdict counts. Their own client keeps swinging
        // and turning on screen - no server can stop that - but the server
        // never hears any of it.
        if (plugin.punishments().isHeld(player.getUniqueId())) {
            event.setCancelled(true);
            return;
        }

        PacketType type = event.getPacketType();

        if (type == PacketType.Play.Client.ARM_ANIMATION) {
            // Флагом, а не записью: тик закрывается следующим пакетом
            // движения, и до него неизвестно, прилетит ли за этим свингом
            // атака. Порядок пакетов у клиента - сначала анимация, потом
            // USE_ENTITY, поэтому к закрытию тика ответ уже есть.
            data.noteEmptySwing();
            return;
        }

        if (type == PacketType.Play.Client.USE_ENTITY) {
            if (event.isCancelled()) {
                return;
            }
            var wrapped = event.getPacket().getEnumEntityUseActions().readSafely(0);
            if (wrapped != null && wrapped.getAction() == EnumWrappers.EntityUseAction.ATTACK) {
                int targetEntityId = event.getPacket().getIntegers().read(0);
                // Любой удар, до фильтра по игрокам: кристалл не игрок,
                // а увидеть его удар можно только здесь (CrystalPredict).
                data.crystal().attackArrived(targetEntityId);
                // Only a hit on a player counts as combat. A mob is a
                // different measurement entirely - it walks a straight line
                // and never strafes, so honest farming reads like a cheat -
                // and an entity nobody tracks is not proof of anything.
                if (!plugin.tracker().playerLike(targetEntityId)) {
                    return;
                }
                if (plugin.checks().onAttack(player, data, targetEntityId)) {
                    event.setCancelled(true);
                } else {
                    data.markAttack(aimError(data, targetEntityId), player.getFallDistance(),
                            player.isOnGround(), player.isSprinting(), critBlocked(player));
                }
            }
            return;
        }

        if (isMovement(type)) {
            // An elytra flight is a different instrument. Rotation steers the
            // body rather than a crosshair, pitch is held at extremes for
            // seconds at a time, and the whole window is smooth by
            // construction - which is what the model was taught to read as
            // assistance. Samples are dropped rather than merely left
            // unscored, and the window is cleared, so that a flight cannot
            // splice onto the ground fight that follows it.
            if (player.isGliding()) {
                data.clearWindow();
                return;
            }
            data.noteGround(player.isOnGround());
            data.noteSprint(player.isSprinting());
            if (type == PacketType.Play.Client.POSITION || type == PacketType.Play.Client.GROUND) {
                me.everyone.oculusai.detection.crystal.CrystalLook.update(plugin, player, data,
                        data.lastYaw(), data.lastPitch());
                data.addSample(data.lastYaw(), data.lastPitch(),
                        plugin.config().windowTicks(),
                        AimGeometry.of(plugin.tracker(), data.entityId(),
                                data.lastYaw(), data.lastPitch()),
                        player.isOnGround(), player.isSprinting());
                return;
            }
            float yaw = event.getPacket().getFloat().readSafely(0) != null
                    ? event.getPacket().getFloat().read(0) : data.lastYaw();
            float pitch = event.getPacket().getFloat().readSafely(1) != null
                    ? event.getPacket().getFloat().read(1) : data.lastPitch();
            me.everyone.oculusai.detection.crystal.CrystalLook.update(plugin, player, data, yaw, pitch);
            data.addSample(yaw, pitch, plugin.config().windowTicks(),
                    AimGeometry.of(plugin.tracker(), data.entityId(), yaw, pitch),
                    player.isOnGround(), player.isSprinting());
        }
    }

    /** Угол до цели в тике удара.
     *
     *  <p>Арифметика живёт в {@link AimGeometry}: тот же угол считается
     *  теперь в каждом тике, и два определения одного числа - это стык, на
     *  котором модель учится вместо поведения. */
    private double aimError(PlayerData data, int targetEntityId) {
        return AimGeometry.angleTo(plugin.tracker().get(data.entityId()),
                plugin.tracker().get(targetEntityId), data.lastYaw(), data.lastPitch());
    }

    private boolean critBlocked(Player player) {
        return player.isInsideVehicle()
                || player.isInWater()
                || player.hasPotionEffect(PotionEffectType.BLINDNESS);
    }

    private boolean isMovement(PacketType type) {
        return type == PacketType.Play.Client.POSITION
                || type == PacketType.Play.Client.POSITION_LOOK
                || type == PacketType.Play.Client.LOOK
                || type == PacketType.Play.Client.GROUND;
    }
}
```

```java
public final class UseActions {

    public static String of(PacketContainer packet) {
        WrappedEnumEntityUseAction wrapped = packet.getEnumEntityUseActions().readSafely(0);
        return wrapped == null || wrapped.getAction() == null ? null : wrapped.getAction().name();
    }

    private UseActions() {
    }
```
